a.example: I want a cup of tea and a piece of cake.
a.exampleZh: 我想要一杯茶和一块蛋糕。

abandon.example: He decided to abandon the old plan and start again.
abandon.exampleZh: 他决定放弃旧计划，重新开始。

abbreviation.example: The abbreviation for this word is easy to remember.
abbreviation.exampleZh: 这个单词的缩写形式很容易记住。

abide.example: You must abide by the rules if you want to stay here.
abide.exampleZh: 如果你想留在这里，就必须遵守规则。

ability.example: She has the ability to learn new languages very quickly.
ability.exampleZh: 她有快速学习新语言的能力。

abnormal.example: It is abnormal for him to be so quiet in class.
abnormal.exampleZh: 他在课堂上这么安静是反常的。

aboard.example: The passengers were already aboard the plane when the storm began.
aboard.exampleZh: 暴风雨开始时，乘客们已经登上了飞机。

abolish.example: The country decided to abolish the old law last year.
abolish.exampleZh: 这个国家去年决定废除那条旧法律。

about.example: She told me a story about her trip to the mountains.
about.exampleZh: 她给我讲了一个关于她去山里旅行的故事。

above.example: The plane flew above the clouds for two hours.
above.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方飞了两个小时。

abroad.example: My sister wants to study abroad next year, so she is learning English.
abroad.exampleZh: 我姐姐明年想出国留学，所以她正在学英语。

abrupt.example: The car came to an abrupt stop at the red light.
abrupt.exampleZh: 汽车在红灯前突然停了下来。

absence.example: Her absence at the meeting made everyone ask many questions.
absence.exampleZh: 她在会议上的缺席让大家都问了很多问题。

absent.example: She was absent from class yesterday because she felt sick.
absent.exampleZh: 她昨天因为觉得不舒服而没去上课。

absolute.example: The king had absolute power over everyone in the country.
absolute.exampleZh: 国王对全国所有人拥有绝对的权力。

absorb.example: Plants absorb water and nutrients from the soil through their roots.
absorb.exampleZh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收水分和养分。

abstract.example: The idea is too abstract for most young students to understand.
abstract.exampleZh: 这个概念太抽象了，大多数年轻学生理解不了。

absurd.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for our own mistakes.
absurd.exampleZh: 把我们自己的错误归咎于天气是荒谬的。

abundant.example: This area has abundant water and rich soil for farming.
abundant.exampleZh: 这个地区有充裕的水源和肥沃的土壤，适合耕种。

abuse.example: He was punished for the abuse of his power at work.
abuse.exampleZh: 他因在工作中滥用职权而受到惩罚。

academic.example: Her academic work is excellent, but she rarely talks with other students.
academic.exampleZh: 她的学术工作很出色，但她很少和其他学生交谈。

academy.example: My sister studies music at a famous academy in London.
academy.exampleZh: 我姐姐在伦敦一所著名的学院学习音乐。

accelerate.example: The new law will accelerate the growth of small businesses in our city.
accelerate.exampleZh: 这项新法律将加快我们城市小企业的发展。

accent.example: She speaks English with a strong French accent, but everyone understands her.
accent.exampleZh: 她说英语带着很重的法国口音，但大家都听得懂。

accept.example: She decided to accept the new job offer.
accept.exampleZh: 她决定接受这份新工作的录用。

access.example: Students can get access to the library computers after six in the evening.
access.exampleZh: 学生晚上六点以后可以使用图书馆的电脑。

accident.example: I heard about the car accident on my way to work.
accident.exampleZh: 我在上班路上听说了那起车祸。

accidental.example: Their meeting was accidental, but it led to a close friendship.
accidental.exampleZh: 他们的相遇是偶然的，却促成了亲密的友谊。

accommodate.example: This small hotel can accommodate up to fifty guests every night.
accommodate.exampleZh: 这家小旅馆每晚最多能容纳五十位客人。

accommodation.example: The hotel offers cheap accommodation for students who travel in summer.
accommodation.exampleZh: 这家旅馆为夏天出行的学生提供便宜的住处。

accompany.example: My mother will accompany me to the hospital tomorrow morning.
accompany.exampleZh: 我母亲明天早上会陪我去医院。

accomplish.example: She worked hard and accomplished her goal before the end of the year.
accomplish.exampleZh: 她努力工作，在年底前实现了自己的目标。

accord.example: Their views are in accord with the new plan.
accord.exampleZh: 他们的看法与新计划一致。

accordance.example: Everything was done in accordance with the safety rules of the school.
accordance.exampleZh: 一切都按照学校的安全规则进行。

accordingly.example: The weather was bad, so accordingly we stayed home all day.
accordingly.exampleZh: 天气不好，因此我们整天都待在家里。

account.example: Please check your bank account to see how much money you have.
account.exampleZh: 请查看你的银行账户，看看你有多少钱。

accountant.example: My aunt works as an accountant in a small bank downtown.
accountant.exampleZh: 我姑姑在市中心一家小银行做会计。

accumulate.example: Over the years, he accumulated a large collection of old books.
accumulate.exampleZh: 多年来，他积累了大量旧书。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of this map is very important for our trip.
accuracy.exampleZh: 这张地图的准确性对我们的旅行非常重要。

accurate.example: The weather report is not always accurate, so bring an umbrella.
accurate.exampleZh: 天气预报并不总是准确的，所以带把伞吧。

accuse.example: They accuse him of taking the money without any proof.
accuse.exampleZh: 他们没有任何证据就指责他拿了钱。

accustomed.example: She is accustomed to waking up early every morning before work.
accustomed.exampleZh: 她习惯每天早上上班前早起。

ache.example: My legs ache after the long walk, but I still want to go.
ache.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后我的腿很疼，但我还是想去。

achieve.example: She worked very hard every day to achieve her dream.
achieve.exampleZh: 她每天非常努力，为了实现自己的梦想。

achievement.example: Winning the science prize was her greatest achievement in high school.
achievement.exampleZh: 赢得科学奖是她高中时期最大的成就。

acid.example: Lemon juice contains acid, which gives it a sour taste.
acid.exampleZh: 柠檬汁含有酸，这使它带有酸味。

acknowledge.example: She did not acknowledge my email, so I called her again.
acknowledge.exampleZh: 她没有确认收到我的邮件，所以我又给她打了电话。

acquaint.example: I will acquaint you with the new rules before Monday.
acquaint.exampleZh: 我会在周一之前让你熟悉新规则。

acquaintance.example: She is an old acquaintance of mine from our school days.
acquaintance.exampleZh: 她是我学生时代就认识的一位老熟人。

acquire.example: She worked hard to acquire the skills she needs for her new job.
acquire.exampleZh: 她努力工作，以学到新工作所需的技能。

acquisition.example: The company announced its acquisition of a smaller firm last week.
acquisition.exampleZh: 该公司上周宣布收购了一家较小的公司。

acre.example: They bought a small farm with fifty acres of land.
acre.exampleZh: 他们买了一个有五十英亩土地的小农场。

across.example: We walked across the bridge to the other side of the river.
across.exampleZh: 我们走过桥，到了河的另一边。

act.example: We must act now to protect our city.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须现在行动起来保护我们的城市。

action.example: The government must take action now to protect the environment.
action.exampleZh: 政府现在必须采取行动来保护环境。

active.example: She stays active by walking and swimming every morning.
active.exampleZh: 她每天早上通过散步和游泳保持活跃。

activity.example: The school has many outdoor activities for students in the spring.
activity.exampleZh: 学校在春天为学生们安排了许多户外活动。

actor.example: The actor is very famous and many people love his new film.
actor.exampleZh: 这位演员非常有名，很多人都喜欢他的新电影。

actress.example: The actress gave a wonderful performance in the new film last night.
actress.exampleZh: 这位女演员昨晚在新电影中献上了一场精彩的表演。

actual.example: The actual cost was much higher than we expected.
actual.exampleZh: 实际费用比我们预期的要高得多。

acute.example: The doctor said her pain was acute and gave her some medicine.
acute.exampleZh: 医生说她的疼痛是急性的，并给她开了一些药。

adapt.example: It takes time to adapt to a new school and new friends.
adapt.exampleZh: 适应一所新学校和新的朋友需要时间。

add.example: Please add some milk to my coffee.
add.exampleZh: 请给我的咖啡加些牛奶。

addition.example: In addition to English, she can speak two other languages.
addition.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还会说另外两种语言。

additional.example: We need some additional chairs for the meeting this afternoon.
additional.exampleZh: 今天下午的会议我们需要一些额外的椅子。

address.example: Please write your address on this form before you leave.
address.exampleZh: 请在离开前把你的地址写在这张表格上。

adequate.example: The room was small but adequate for two people.
adequate.exampleZh: 房间虽小，但两个人住足够了。

adhere.example: Please adhere to the safety rules when you work in the lab.
adhere.exampleZh: 在实验室工作时，请遵守安全规则。

adjacent.example: Our hotel is adjacent to the train station, so we can walk there easily.
adjacent.exampleZh: 我们的酒店紧邻火车站，所以我们走过去很方便。

adjective.example: In this sentence, the word happy is an adjective.
adjective.exampleZh: 在这句话中，happy 这个词是形容词。

adjoin.example: Our small garden adjoins the old school and a quiet park.
adjoin.exampleZh: 我们的小花园与那所老学校和一座安静的公园毗连。

adjust.example: You can adjust the chair height to make your back more comfortable.
adjust.exampleZh: 你可以调整椅子的高度，让你的背部更舒服。

administration.example: The new manager is in charge of the administration of the whole company.
administration.exampleZh: 新经理负责整个公司的管理工作。

admiration.example: My admiration for my grandmother grew as she helped everyone in the village.
admiration.exampleZh: 随着奶奶帮助村里的每个人，我对她的钦佩与日俱增。

admire.example: I really admire her because she works hard and never gives up.
admire.exampleZh: 我真的很钦佩她，因为她努力工作，从不放弃。

admission.example: The admission fee to the museum is only five dollars.
admission.exampleZh: 博物馆的入场费只要五美元。

admit.example: She was afraid to admit her mistake to the whole team.
admit.exampleZh: 她害怕向整个团队承认自己的错误。

adopt.example: The small company decided to adopt a new plan for saving money.
adopt.exampleZh: 这家小公司决定采用一项省钱的新方案。

adult.example: An adult should take care of their own health and money.
adult.exampleZh: 成年人应该照顾好自己的健康和金钱。

advance.example: The team made great progress and advanced the project ahead of schedule.
advance.exampleZh: 团队取得了很大进展，并提前推进了这个项目。

advanced.example: This hospital uses advanced machines to help doctors treat sick people.
advanced.exampleZh: 这家医院使用先进的机器来帮助医生治疗病人。

advantage.example: One big advantage of living near the office is that I can walk to work.
advantage.exampleZh: 住在办公室附近的一大好处是我可以走路去上班。

adventure.example: The children had a great adventure in the forest near their house.
adventure.exampleZh: 孩子们在自家附近的森林里经历了一场很棒的冒险。

adverb.example: In the sentence, the word quickly is an adverb.
adverb.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，quickly 这个词是副词。

advertise.example: The small shop uses social media to advertise its new products.
advertise.exampleZh: 这家小店利用社交媒体为新产品做广告。

advertisement.example: I saw an advertisement for a new phone on the bus today.
advertisement.exampleZh: 我今天在公交车上看到一则新手机的广告。

advice.example: My teacher gave me some good advice about studying English.
advice.exampleZh: 我的老师给了我一些关于学英语的好建议。

advisable.example: It is advisable to check the weather before you go out.
advisable.exampleZh: 出门前查看天气是明智的。

advise.example: I advise you to see a doctor before the pain gets worse.
advise.exampleZh: 我建议你在疼痛加重之前去看医生。

adviser.example: My adviser helped me choose the right classes for next year.
adviser.exampleZh: 我的指导教授帮我选了明年的合适课程。

advocate.example: She advocates for clean water and often speaks for poor families.
advocate.exampleZh: 她提倡清洁用水，并经常为贫困家庭发声。

aerial.example: The aerial view of the city shows many small parks and rivers.
aerial.exampleZh: 这座城市的空中景观显示出许多小公园和河流。

aesthetic.example: She has a very aesthetic sense and always decorates her room beautifully.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 她有很强的审美感，总是把房间装饰得很漂亮。

affair.example: The whole affair was a mistake, but we learned from it.
affair.exampleZh: 整件事情是个错误，但我们从中吸取了教训。

affect.example: The bad weather will affect our plans for the trip tomorrow.
affect.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气会影响我们明天的旅行计划。

affection.example: She showed great affection for her old teacher.
affection.exampleZh: 她对年迈的老师表现出深厚的感情。

affirm.example: The doctor affirmed that the test results were correct.
affirm.exampleZh: 医生确认了检查结果是对的。

afford.example: We cannot afford a new car this year because prices are too high.
afford.exampleZh: 今年我们买不起新车，因为价格太高了。

afraid.example: The little boy is afraid of the dark, so he sleeps with a light on.
afraid.exampleZh: 小男孩怕黑，所以他开灯睡觉。

after.example: We went home after the movie and ate dinner together.
after.exampleZh: 看完电影后我们回家一起吃了晚饭。

afternoon.example: I often drink a cup of tea in the afternoon.
afternoon.exampleZh: 我经常在下午喝一杯茶。

afterward(s).example: We had dinner and afterward we walked home together.
afterward(s).exampleZh: 我们吃了晚饭，后来一起走回家。

again.example: I read the letter again and found a small mistake.
again.exampleZh: 我又读了一遍这封信，发现了一个小错误。

against.example: The team voted against the new plan because it cost too much.
against.exampleZh: 团队投票反对这项新计划，因为它花费太多。

age.example: She started to learn the piano at the age of six.

agency.example: She works for a small travel agency near the station.
agency.exampleZh: 她在车站附近的一家小型旅行社工作。

agenda.example: The first item on our agenda is the new budget.
agenda.exampleZh: 我们议事日程上的第一项是新预算。

agent.example: The agent helped us buy the house at a good price.
agent.exampleZh: 这位代理人帮我们以好价钱买下了这所房子。

aggressive.example: His aggressive style helped the small team win the big game.
aggressive.exampleZh: 他有进攻性的风格帮助这支小球队赢得了那场重要比赛。

ago.example: I moved to this city three years ago with my family.
ago.exampleZh: 三年前我和家人搬到了这座城市。

agree.example: I agree with you on this plan.
agree.exampleZh: 我同意你对这个计划的看法。

agreement.example: The two sides finally reached an agreement after a long talk.
agreement.exampleZh: 双方经过长时间商谈后终于达成了一项协议。

agricultural.example: The agricultural land near our village is very good for growing rice.
agricultural.exampleZh: 我们村庄附近的农业用地非常适合种植水稻。

agriculture.example: My family has worked in agriculture for many years, growing rice and vegetables.
agriculture.exampleZh: 我家从事农业多年，种植水稻和蔬菜。

ahead.example: We should look ahead and plan for the next year.
ahead.exampleZh: 我们应该向前看，为明年做好规划。

aid.example: The teacher gave me some aid with my homework after school today.
aid.exampleZh: 今天放学后，老师帮我做了一些家庭作业。

aim.example: Our aim is to help students learn English with simple daily practice.
aim.exampleZh: 我们的目标是帮助学生通过简单的日常练习学习英语。

air.example: The air in the mountains is fresh and clean, so we opened the windows to air the room.
air.exampleZh: 山里的空气清新干净，所以我们打开窗户给房间通风。

aircraft.example: The aircraft landed safely after a long flight over the ocean.
aircraft.exampleZh: 这架飞机在飞越海洋的长途飞行后安全着陆。

airline.example: The airline lost my bag on the flight to Paris.
airline.exampleZh: 这家航空公司在飞往巴黎的航班上弄丢了我的行李。

airplane.example: The airplane flew high above the clouds for three hours.
airplane.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方高高飞行了三个小时。

airport.example: We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight to Tokyo.
airport.exampleZh: 我们在飞往东京的航班起飞前两小时到达了机场。

alarm.example: The loud alarm woke me up at six this morning.
alarm.exampleZh: 今天早上六点，响亮的闹钟把我吵醒了。

album.example: My sister put the old family photos in a new album.
album.exampleZh: 我姐姐把家里的老照片放进了一本新相册里。

alcohol.example: He never drinks alcohol because it makes him feel very sick.
alcohol.exampleZh: 他从不喝酒，因为酒精会让他感到非常难受。

alert.example: The guard stayed alert all night and watched the gate.
alert.exampleZh: 警卫整夜保持警觉，看守着大门。

alien.example: The strange lights in the sky came from an alien spaceship.
alien.exampleZh: 天空中那些奇怪的光来自一艘外星飞船。

alienate.example: His constant criticism began to alienate his closest friends.
alienate.exampleZh: 他不断的批评开始让他最亲近的朋友疏远他。

alike.example: The two sisters look very much alike and often wear the same clothes.
alike.exampleZh: 这两姐妹长得很像，还经常穿同样的衣服。

alive.example: The old tree is still alive and gives us shade every summer.
alive.exampleZh: 那棵老树仍然活着，每年夏天为我们提供阴凉。

all.example: All the students in my class like this new teacher very much.
all.exampleZh: 我们班所有的学生都非常喜欢这位新老师。

allege.example: They allege that the company hid the truth from the public.
allege.exampleZh: 他们宣称这家公司向公众隐瞒了真相。

alleviate.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to alleviate the pain in his back.
alleviate.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些药来减轻他背部的疼痛。

alliance.example: The two small countries formed an alliance to protect each other.
alliance.exampleZh: 这两个小国结成联盟以互相保护。

allocate.example: The teacher will allocate one book to each student.
allocate.exampleZh: 老师将给每个学生分配一本书。

allow.example: My parents allow me to play outside after I finish my homework.
allow.exampleZh: 我父母允许我做完作业后到外面玩。

allowance.example: My parents give me a small allowance every week.
allowance.exampleZh: 我父母每周给我一点零用钱。

ally.example: The small country became a strong ally of its neighbor during the war.
ally.exampleZh: 战争期间，这个小国成了其邻国的强大盟友。

almost.example: Almost all the students in our class passed the math test this morning.
almost.exampleZh: 今天上午我们班几乎所有学生都通过了数学考试。

alone.example: She lives alone in a small house near the park, but she is never lonely.
alone.exampleZh: 她独自住在公园附近的一栋小房子里，但她从不感到孤独。

along.example: We walked along the river and talked about our plans.
along.exampleZh: 我们沿着河边散步，聊着我们的计划。

alongside.example: The old church stands alongside the river near our small school.
alongside.exampleZh: 那座老教堂坐落在我们小学附近的河边。

aloud.example: Please read the letter aloud so everyone in the room can hear it.
aloud.exampleZh: 请把信出声读出来，让房间里的每个人都能听到。

alphabet.example: Children learn the alphabet before they learn to read simple words.
alphabet.exampleZh: 孩子们在学习阅读简单单词之前先学习字母表。

already.example: She has already finished her homework and is now watching television.
already.exampleZh: 她已经做完作业，现在正在看电视。

also.example: She also wants to visit China with her family next year.
also.exampleZh: 她明年也想和家人一起去中国。

alter.example: The tailor will alter my dress so it fits me better.
alter.exampleZh: 裁缝会改一下我的连衣裙，让它更合身。

alternate.example: We alternate between studying and playing every hour.
alternate.exampleZh: 我们每小时在学习和玩耍之间轮流交替。

alternative.example: We have no alternative, so we must leave early tomorrow morning.
alternative.exampleZh: 我们没有别的选择，所以明天早上必须早点出发。

although.example: Although the rain was heavy, we still walked to school this morning.
although.exampleZh: 虽然雨很大，我们今天早上还是走路去了学校。

altitude.example: The plane is flying at a high altitude above the clouds.
altitude.exampleZh: 飞机正在云层上方的高海拔处飞行。

altogether.example: The trip was not altogether easy, but we enjoyed it very much.
altogether.exampleZh: 这次旅行并不完全轻松，但我们非常享受。

aluminum.example: This pan is made of aluminum, so it is very light.
aluminum.exampleZh: 这个锅是铝制的，所以非常轻。

always.example: She always drinks a cup of tea in the morning.

amateur.example: As an amateur, he plays tennis on weekends with his friends.
amateur.exampleZh: 作为一名业余爱好者，他周末和朋友们打网球。

amaze.example: The magician's tricks always amaze the children at the party.
amaze.exampleZh: 魔术师的戏法总是让派对上的孩子们感到惊奇。

ambassador.example: The ambassador met the president this morning to talk about peace.
ambassador.exampleZh: 今天上午，大使会见了总统，讨论和平问题。

ambiguous.example: The teacher's ambiguous answer made the students even more confused.
ambiguous.exampleZh: 老师模棱两可的回答让学生们更加困惑了。

ambition.example: Her ambition is to become a doctor and help sick children.
ambition.exampleZh: 她的抱负是成为一名医生，帮助生病的孩子。

ambitious.example: She is an ambitious young woman who wants to start her own business.
ambitious.exampleZh: 她是一位有雄心的年轻女性，想创办自己的公司。

ambulance.example: The ambulance took the sick man to the hospital very quickly.
ambulance.exampleZh: 救护车很快把那个病人送到了医院。

among.example: She is the tallest girl among her classmates.
among.exampleZh: 她是她同学中最高的女孩。

amount.example: The amount of water in the bottle is not enough.

ample.example: The hotel room had ample space for four people and their bags.
ample.exampleZh: 这间酒店房间有足够的空间容纳四个人和他们的行李。

amplifier.example: This small amplifier makes the guitar sound much louder in the room.
amplifier.exampleZh: 这台小放大器让房间里的吉他声音响得多。

amuse.example: The funny clown tried to amuse the children at the birthday party.
amuse.exampleZh: 那个滑稽的小丑努力逗乐生日聚会上的孩子们。

analogy.example: Teachers often use an analogy to explain difficult ideas to students.
analogy.exampleZh: 老师经常用类比来向学生解释难懂的概念。

analyse.example: We need to analyse the data before we make a final decision.
analyse.exampleZh: 我们需要在做出最终决定之前分析这些数据。

analysis.example: Her analysis of the problem was clear and helpful.
analysis.exampleZh: 她对这个问题的分析清晰且有帮助。

ancestor.example: My ancestor came from a small village in the south of China.
ancestor.exampleZh: 我的祖先来自中国南方的一个小村庄。

anchor.example: The ship dropped its anchor in the bay and stayed there all night.
anchor.exampleZh: 那艘船在海湾抛锚，并整夜停在那里。

ancient.example: This ancient tree is older than the town itself.
ancient.exampleZh: 这棵古老的树比这个镇子本身还要年长。

and.example: I like apples and bananas, so I eat them every morning.
and.exampleZh: 我喜欢苹果和香蕉，所以我每天早上都吃。

anecdote.example: My teacher told a funny anecdote about her first day at work.
anecdote.exampleZh: 我的老师讲了一件关于她第一天上班的趣事。

angel.example: She is like an angel who always helps people in trouble.
angel.exampleZh: 她就像一个天使，总是帮助有困难的人。

anger.example: He could not hide his anger when he saw the broken window.
anger.exampleZh: 当他看到被打破的窗户时，他无法掩饰自己的愤怒。

angle.example: From this angle, the problem looks much easier to solve.
angle.exampleZh: 从这个角度看，这个问题似乎容易解决得多。

angry.example: The angry man shouted at his dog in the park.
angry.exampleZh: 那个生气的人在公园里对着他的狗大喊。

animal.example: The zoo has many kinds of animals, and the children love to watch them.
animal.exampleZh: 动物园里有许多种动物，孩子们喜欢观看它们。

ankle.example: I hurt my ankle while playing football with my friends yesterday.
ankle.exampleZh: 昨天我和朋友们踢足球时伤了脚踝。

anniversary.example: My parents will celebrate their thirtieth wedding anniversary next Saturday.
anniversary.exampleZh: 我父母下周六将庆祝他们的三十周年结婚纪念日。

announce.example: The school will announce the winner of the contest tomorrow morning.
announce.exampleZh: 学校将在明天上午宣布比赛的获胜者。

annoy.example: Loud music late at night really annoys my neighbors.
annoy.exampleZh: 深夜的大声音乐确实让我的邻居们感到烦恼。

annual.example: Our school holds an annual sports meeting every spring.
annual.exampleZh: 我们学校每年春天举办一次年度运动会。

anonymous.example: An anonymous letter arrived at the office this morning.
anonymous.exampleZh: 今天早上办公室收到了一封匿名信。

another.example: I don't like this pen, so please give me another one.
another.exampleZh: 我不喜欢这支笔，请再给我一支。

answer.example: Please answer my question before you leave the office today.
answer.exampleZh: 请你在今天离开办公室之前回答我的问题。

ant.example: A small ant is carrying a piece of bread across the floor.
ant.exampleZh: 一只小蚂蚁正搬着一块面包穿过地板。

antarctic.example: The Antarctic is very cold and covered with ice all year.
antarctic.exampleZh: 南极地区非常寒冷，全年都被冰雪覆盖。

anticipate.example: We anticipate a rise in prices next month.
anticipate.exampleZh: 我们预计下个月价格会上涨。

antique.example: My grandmother keeps an antique clock in her warm living room.
antique.exampleZh: 我奶奶在她温暖的客厅里放着一座古董钟。

anxiety.example: She felt a lot of anxiety before her first day at work.
anxiety.exampleZh: 她在第一天上班前感到非常焦虑。

anxious.example: She feels anxious about the exam tomorrow, but she is studying hard.
anxious.exampleZh: 她对明天的考试感到焦虑，但她正在努力学习。

any.example: Do you have any questions about this lesson today?
any.exampleZh: 你今天对这节课有任何问题吗？

anybody.example: Anybody can learn to swim if they practice a little every day.
anybody.exampleZh: 任何人只要每天练习一点都能学会游泳。

anyhow.example: It was raining hard, but anyhow we decided to go out.
anyhow.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，但无论如何我们还是决定出门。

anyone.example: Anyone can join our English club on Friday afternoon.
anyone.exampleZh: 任何人都可以参加我们周五下午的英语俱乐部。

anything.example: You can ask me anything if you are not sure about it.
anything.exampleZh: 如果你不确定，可以问我任何事情。

anyway.example: It's raining, but I will go out anyway.
anyway.exampleZh: 虽然在下雨，但我无论如何都要出去。

anywhere.example: I can't find my keys anywhere in this room.
anywhere.exampleZh: 我在这个房间里到处都找不到我的钥匙。

apart.example: The two houses stand far apart on the same quiet street.
apart.exampleZh: 这两栋房子在同一条安静的街道上相隔很远。

apartment.example: My apartment is small but very clean and close to the park.
apartment.exampleZh: 我的公寓很小，但非常干净，而且离公园很近。

apologize.example: You should apologize to her for being late yesterday.
apologize.exampleZh: 你应该为昨天的迟到向她道歉。

apology.example: She gave me a sincere apology for being late to the meeting.
apology.exampleZh: 她为开会迟到向我真诚地道了歉。

apparatus.example: The lab has new apparatus for testing water.
apparatus.exampleZh: 实验室有用来检测水质的新设备。

apparent.example: It was apparent that she was tired after the long trip.
apparent.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，她显然很累了。

appeal.example: The charity made an appeal for food and clothes after the flood.
appeal.exampleZh: 洪水过后，慈善机构呼吁人们捐赠食物和衣物。

appear.example: Strange lights appear in the sky every night.
appear.exampleZh: 每晚天空中都会出现奇怪的光。

appearance.example: The cat made a sudden appearance in the garden this morning.
appearance.exampleZh: 今天早上那只猫突然出现在花园里。

appendix.example: The appendix at the end of the book lists all the useful websites.
appendix.exampleZh: 书末的附录列出了所有有用的网站。

appetite.example: The long walk gave him a good appetite for dinner.
appetite.exampleZh: 长途散步让他晚饭时胃口很好。

applaud.example: The students applauded loudly after the teacher finished her short speech.
applaud.exampleZh: 老师讲完简短的话后，学生们热烈鼓掌。

applause.example: The audience gave the singer loud applause after her last song.
applause.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众给了她热烈的掌声。

apple.example: I eat a red apple every morning before I go to school.
apple.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一个红苹果。

appliance.example: This kitchen appliance makes cooking much easier for busy families.
appliance.exampleZh: 这个厨房器具让忙碌的家庭做饭轻松多了。

applicable.example: This rule is applicable to all students in our school.
applicable.exampleZh: 这条规则适用于我们学校的所有学生。

applicant.example: The applicant sent his resume to the company last week.
applicant.exampleZh: 这位申请人上周把他的简历寄给了那家公司。

application.example: You can send your application to the school by email today.
application.exampleZh: 你今天可以通过电子邮件把申请发送给学校。

apply.example: I want to apply for a new job in another city.
apply.exampleZh: 我想在另一个城市申请一份新工作。

appoint.example: The school decided to appoint a new teacher for the science class.
appoint.exampleZh: 学校决定为科学课任命一位新老师。

appointment.example: I have a doctor's appointment at three this afternoon.
appointment.exampleZh: 我今天下午三点有一个医生的预约。

appraisal.example: The teacher gave a fair appraisal of my work this term.
appraisal.exampleZh: 老师对我这学期的作业给出了公正的评价。

appreciate.example: I really appreciate your help with my English homework today.
appreciate.exampleZh: 我非常感激你今天帮我做英语作业。

approach.example: We need a better approach to solve this problem together.
approach.exampleZh: 我们需要一个更好的方法来共同解决这个问题。

appropriate.example: She wore appropriate clothes for the cold weather.
appropriate.exampleZh: 她穿了适合寒冷天气的衣服。

approval.example: Her parents gave their approval for the trip to the mountains.
approval.exampleZh: 她的父母同意了她去山里的旅行。

approve.example: My parents do not approve of my plan to travel alone.
approve.exampleZh: 我父母不赞成我独自旅行的计划。

approximate.example: The approximate cost of the trip is about two hundred dollars.
approximate.exampleZh: 这次旅行的大致费用大约是两百美元。

april.example: My birthday is in April, and we often have a small party.
april.exampleZh: 我的生日在四月，我们常常举办一个小派对。

arbitrary.example: The teacher made an arbitrary decision without asking anyone in the class.
arbitrary.exampleZh: 老师没有问班上任何人就做出了武断的决定。

architect.example: The architect designed a bright new library for our small town.
architect.exampleZh: 这位建筑师为我们的小镇设计了一座明亮的新图书馆。

architecture.example: She studies architecture at a famous university and wants to design beautiful buildings.
architecture.exampleZh: 她在一所著名大学学习建筑学，并想设计美丽的建筑。

area.example: The area of this room is about twenty square meters.
area.exampleZh: 这个房间的面积大约是二十平方米。

argue.example: They often argue about small things at home.
argue.exampleZh: 他们经常在家里为小事争论。

argument.example: They had a long argument about money, but nobody got angry.
argument.exampleZh: 他们就钱的问题争论了很久，但没有人发火。

arise.example: Many problems arise when people do not talk to each other.
arise.exampleZh: 当人们彼此不沟通时，许多问题就会出现。

arithmetic.example: My son is good at arithmetic and can solve simple math problems quickly.
arithmetic.exampleZh: 我儿子擅长算术，能很快解出简单的数学题。

arm.example: She hurt her left arm when she fell off the bike yesterday.
arm.exampleZh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来时伤了左臂。

army.example: My brother joined the army after he finished school last year.
army.exampleZh: 我哥哥去年完成学业后参军了。

around.example: The children ran around the garden and played near the big tree.
around.exampleZh: 孩子们绕着花园跑，在大树附近玩耍。

arouse.example: The loud noise outside the window aroused the baby from her sleep.
arouse.exampleZh: 窗外的噪音把宝宝从睡梦中唤醒了。

arrange.example: I will arrange the chairs and tables for the meeting.
arrange.exampleZh: 我会为会议布置好桌椅。

arrangement.example: We made an arrangement to meet at the library after school.
arrangement.exampleZh: 我们约定放学后在图书馆见面。

array.example: The store offers a wide array of fresh fruit and vegetables.
array.exampleZh: 这家商店提供种类繁多的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

arrest.example: The police arrested the man near the bank and took him away.
arrest.exampleZh: 警察在银行附近逮捕了那名男子并把他带走了。

arrival.example: Our arrival at the hotel was late, so we went straight to bed.
arrival.exampleZh: 我们到酒店时已经很晚，所以直接去睡觉了。

arrive.example: We will arrive at the station before the last train leaves.
arrive.exampleZh: 我们会在末班车开走之前到达车站。

arrow.example: The hunter shot an arrow at the deer in the forest.
arrow.exampleZh: 猎人在森林里朝鹿射了一箭。

art.example: My sister studies art at school and draws pictures every day.
art.exampleZh: 我妹妹在学校学习美术，每天都会画画。

artery.example: The doctor said the blood was flowing through a major artery in his leg.
artery.exampleZh: 医生说血液正流经他腿上的一条主要动脉。

article.example: I read an interesting article about healthy food in the newspaper.
article.exampleZh: 我在报纸上读到一篇关于健康食物的有趣文章。

artificial.example: This artificial flower looks almost the same as a real one.
artificial.exampleZh: 这朵人造花看起来几乎和真花一样。

artist.example: The artist painted a picture of the sea for his friends.
artist.exampleZh: 这位艺术家为他的朋友们画了一幅大海的画。

artistic.example: Her artistic skills make the room look warm and beautiful.
artistic.exampleZh: 她的艺术才华让这个房间看起来温暖又漂亮。

as.example: She sang as she walked home from school yesterday.
as.exampleZh: 她昨天从学校走回家时一边唱着歌。

ash.example: The fire burned down and left only a pile of ash.
ash.exampleZh: 火烧完后只剩下一堆灰烬。

ashamed.example: She felt ashamed when she forgot her best friend's birthday.
ashamed.exampleZh: 当她忘了最好朋友的生日时，她感到很惭愧。

aside.example: He stepped aside to let the old man pass.
aside.exampleZh: 他退到旁边，让那位老人过去。

ask.example: I want to ask you a question about the lesson.
ask.exampleZh: 我想问你一个关于这节课的问题。

asleep.example: The little boy fell asleep on the sofa before dinner was ready.
asleep.exampleZh: 晚饭还没做好，小男孩就在沙发上睡着了。

aspect.example: The most important aspect of this job is learning to work with others.
aspect.exampleZh: 这份工作最重要的方面是学会与他人合作。

assault.example: The soldiers made a sudden assault on the enemy camp at night.
assault.exampleZh: 士兵们在夜里对敌军营地发动了突然袭击。

assemble.example: The students assemble in the hall every Monday morning before class.
assemble.exampleZh: 学生们每周一早上上课前在礼堂集合。

assembly.example: The whole school came to the assembly in the morning.
assembly.exampleZh: 全校师生早上都来参加集会。

assert.example: He likes to assert his opinion in every meeting.
assert.exampleZh: 他喜欢在每次会议上坚持自己的观点。

assess.example: Teachers assess students' progress at the end of each term.
assess.exampleZh: 老师们在每学期末评估学生的进步。

asset.example: Her ability to stay calm is a great asset in this job.
asset.exampleZh: 她能保持冷静的能力是这份工作中的一大优势。

assign.example: The teacher will assign each group a different task today.
assign.exampleZh: 老师今天会给每个小组分配一项不同的任务。

assignment.example: Our teacher gave us a short writing assignment for the weekend.
assignment.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一个周末的短篇写作作业。

assist.example: The nurses assist the doctor with small tasks every morning.
assist.exampleZh: 护士们每天早上协助医生做一些小任务。

assistant.example: My assistant helps me answer emails every morning before the meeting starts.
assistant.exampleZh: 我的助手每天早上在会议开始前帮我回复邮件。

associate.example: I associate this song with my happy school days.
associate.exampleZh: 我把这首歌和我快乐的学校时光联系起来。

association.example: She joined a local art association and made many new friends there.
association.exampleZh: 她加入了一个当地的艺术协会，并在那里结识了许多新朋友。

assume.example: I assume you will come to the meeting on time.
assume.exampleZh: 我假设你会准时来参加会议。

assumption.example: We made a wrong assumption about the cost of the trip.
assumption.exampleZh: 我们对这次旅行的费用做出了错误的假设。

assurance.example: She spoke with quiet assurance and answered every question easily.
assurance.exampleZh: 她说话时带着平静的自信，轻松地回答了每个问题。

assure.example: I assure you that the work will be finished on time.
assure.exampleZh: 我向你保证，这项工作会按时完成。

astonish.example: The magician's trick will astonish everyone in the room.
astonish.exampleZh: 魔术师的戏法会让房间里的每个人大吃一惊。

astronaut.example: The astronaut waved at us from the window of the spacecraft.
astronaut.exampleZh: 那位宇航员从航天器的窗口向我们挥手。

astronomy.example: She studies astronomy at night because she loves watching stars.
astronomy.exampleZh: 她晚上学习天文学，因为她喜欢观察星星。

at.example: We will meet at the station at nine tomorrow morning.
at.exampleZh: 我们明天早上九点在车站见面。

athlete.example: The young athlete runs fast and trains hard every day.
athlete.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员跑得很快，每天刻苦训练。

atlas.example: I opened the atlas to find the small country where my friend lives.
atlas.exampleZh: 我打开地图册，想找到我朋友居住的那个小国家。

atmosphere.example: The restaurant has a warm atmosphere, so we often eat there with friends.
atmosphere.exampleZh: 这家餐厅气氛温馨，所以我们常和朋友去那里吃饭。

atom.example: Every atom in the human body is incredibly small.
atom.exampleZh: 人体中的每一个原子都极其微小。

atomic.example: It is hard for one country to make atomic weapons today.
atomic.exampleZh: 如今，一个国家很难独自制造原子武器。

attach.example: Please attach the file to your email before you send it.
attach.exampleZh: 发送邮件前，请把文件附上。

attack.example: The dog may attack strangers if it feels afraid or nervous.
attack.exampleZh: 如果狗感到害怕或紧张，它可能会攻击陌生人。

attain.example: She worked hard for many years and finally attained her goal.
attain.exampleZh: 她努力了很多年，最终实现了自己的目标。

attempt.example: He will attempt to fix the old bike this afternoon.
attempt.exampleZh: 他今天下午会尝试修理那辆旧自行车。

attend.example: I will attend the meeting tomorrow and listen to the new plan.
attend.exampleZh: 我明天将出席会议并听取新计划。

attendance.example: His attendance at every meeting made him a trusted team member.
attendance.exampleZh: 他每次会议都出席，这使他成为值得信赖的团队成员。

attention.example: Please pay attention to the teacher and write down the new words.
attention.exampleZh: 请注意听老师讲课，并把新单词记下来。

attitude.example: Her attitude toward the new plan is very positive.
attitude.exampleZh: 她对新计划的态度非常积极。

attorney.example: The attorney asked the judge for more time to review the case.
attorney.exampleZh: 律师请求法官多给一些时间审阅此案。

attract.example: The new museum attracts many visitors from other cities.
attract.exampleZh: 这座新博物馆吸引了许多来自其他城市的游客。

attraction.example: The main attraction of this small town is its beautiful old bridge.
attraction.exampleZh: 这座小镇最大的吸引力是它那座美丽的古桥。

attractive.example: The garden looks very attractive in spring with all those colorful flowers.
attractive.exampleZh: 春天那些五颜六色的花让这个花园看起来非常迷人。

attribute.example: Scientists attribute the rising temperatures to human activity and certain natural factors.
attribute.exampleZh: 科学家把气温上升归因于人类活动和某些自然因素。

auction.example: She bought an old painting at the auction for very little money.
auction.exampleZh: 她在拍卖会上花了很少的钱买下一幅旧画。

audience.example: The audience clapped and cheered loudly after the wonderful show ended.
audience.exampleZh: 精彩的演出结束后，观众们大声鼓掌欢呼。

audio.example: The audio quality of this old radio is still very good.
audio.exampleZh: 这台旧收音机的音频质量仍然很好。

august.example: We will take a long family trip to the beach next August.
august.exampleZh: 明年八月我们将去海边进行一次全家长途旅行。

aunt.example: My aunt lives in a small house near the river.
aunt.exampleZh: 我的姑妈住在河边的一栋小房子里。

author.example: The author wrote a popular book about life in a small town.
author.exampleZh: 这位作者写了一本关于小镇生活的畅销书。

authority.example: The local authority is responsible for keeping the streets clean and safe.
authority.exampleZh: 当地政府负责保持街道清洁和安全。

automatic.example: The door is automatic, so it opens when you walk near it.
automatic.exampleZh: 这扇门是自动的，所以你走近时它就会打开。

automation.example: Our new factory uses automation to make the work faster and safer.
automation.exampleZh: 我们的新工厂利用自动化让工作更快、更安全。

automobile.example: My father drives his automobile to work every morning.
automobile.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上开他的汽车去上班。

autonomy.example: The school gives teachers more autonomy in choosing what to teach.
autonomy.exampleZh: 学校在决定教学内容方面给予教师更多自主权。

autumn.example: The leaves turn red and gold in autumn.
autumn.exampleZh: 秋天时树叶变成红色和金色。

auxiliary.example: The auxiliary staff helped the nurses during the busy morning shift.
auxiliary.exampleZh: 在忙碌的早班期间，辅助人员帮助了护士们。

available.example: This room is available if you want to use it today.
available.exampleZh: 如果你今天想用，这个房间是可用的。

avenue.example: The wide avenue in front of our school is full of tall green trees.
avenue.exampleZh: 我们学校门前那条宽阔的大街上长满了高大的绿树。

average.example: The average of three, four and five is four, which is easy to see.
average.exampleZh: 三、四和五的平均数是四，这很容易看出来。

avert.example: She quickly looked away to avert her eyes from the accident.
avert.exampleZh: 她迅速转过头，把目光从事故现场移开。

aviation.example: My uncle works in aviation and repairs airplane engines.
aviation.exampleZh: 我叔叔从事航空业，负责修理飞机发动机。

avoid.example: You should avoid eating too much sugar every day.
avoid.exampleZh: 你应该避免每天吃太多糖。

await.example: We await your reply and hope to hear from you soon.
await.exampleZh: 我们等待你的回复，希望很快收到你的消息。

awake.example: The loud noise will awake the baby who is sleeping.
awake.exampleZh: 巨大的噪音会吵醒正在睡觉的婴儿。

award.example: The school gave her an award for her hard work last year.
award.exampleZh: 学校去年因她的努力而给她颁了一个奖。

aware.example: She was aware of the danger and closed the window quickly.
aware.exampleZh: 她意识到了危险，赶紧关上了窗户。

awful.example: The weather was awful, so we stayed home and watched a movie.
awful.exampleZh: 天气很糟糕，所以我们待在家里看了一部电影。

awkward.example: It was an awkward moment when I forgot his name.
awkward.exampleZh: 我忘记他名字的那一刻很尴尬。

axe/ax.example: He used an axe to cut the old tree into small pieces.
axe/ax.exampleZh: 他用斧头把那棵老树砍成小块。

axis.example: The earth turns around its axis once every twenty-four hours.
axis.exampleZh: 地球每二十四小时绕它的轴自转一圈。

baby.example: The baby sleeps in a small bed next to our room.
baby.exampleZh: 婴儿睡在我们房间旁边的一张小床上。

bachelor.example: My uncle is still a bachelor and lives alone in a small apartment.
bachelor.exampleZh: 我叔叔仍然是个单身汉，独自住在一间小公寓里。

back.example: My back hurts after sitting in that hard chair all day.
back.exampleZh: 在那把硬椅子上坐了一整天后，我的背很疼。

background.example: She has a strong background in computer science and math.
background.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学和数学方面有很强的背景。

backward.example: He took a backward step and almost fell down the stairs.
backward.exampleZh: 他向后退了一步，差点从楼梯上摔下去。

bacon.example: I like bacon and eggs for breakfast every morning.
bacon.exampleZh: 我每天早上喜欢吃咸肉煎蛋。

bacteria.example: Bacteria can grow quickly in warm food, so we should keep it cold.
bacteria.exampleZh: 细菌在温热的食物中会快速繁殖，所以我们应该把食物冷藏。

bacterium.example: This tiny bacterium can live in very hot water and deep ice.
bacterium.exampleZh: 这种微小的细菌能生活在极热的水中和深冰里。

bad.example: Smoking is a bad habit that is hard to stop.
bad.exampleZh: 吸烟是一个很难戒掉的坏习惯。

badge.example: Every student wears a small badge with the school name on it.
badge.exampleZh: 每个学生都佩戴着一枚印有校名的小徽章。

badly.example: He badly hurt his leg when he fell off the bike.
badly.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔下来时，腿严重受伤了。

badminton.example: My sister and I play badminton in the park every Sunday morning.
badminton.exampleZh: 我和姐姐每周日早上在公园里打羽毛球。

bag.example: She put the apples in a paper bag and left the store.
bag.exampleZh: 她把苹果装进一个纸袋里，然后离开了商店。

baggage.example: Please keep your baggage with you at all times in the station.
baggage.exampleZh: 在车站里请随时把你的行李带在身边。

bake.example: My mother likes to bake bread on Sunday mornings.
bake.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在周日早上烤面包。

bakery.example: I buy fresh bread at the bakery near my house every morning.
bakery.exampleZh: 我每天早上都在我家附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

balance.example: She lost her balance on the wet floor and fell down.
balance.exampleZh: 她在湿滑的地板上失去了平衡，摔倒了。

balcony.example: We sat on the balcony and watched the busy street below us.
balcony.exampleZh: 我们坐在阳台上，看着下方繁忙的街道。

ball.example: The boy kicked the ball across the grass to his friend.
ball.exampleZh: 男孩把球踢过草地，传给了他的朋友。

ballet.example: My sister takes ballet lessons every Saturday morning at the dance school.
ballet.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周六上午在舞蹈学校上芭蕾舞课。

balloon.example: The red balloon flew high into the blue sky.
balloon.exampleZh: 那个红色的气球高高飞向蓝天。

ballot.example: Every citizen has the right to cast a ballot in the election.
ballot.exampleZh: 每个公民都有权在选举中投票。

bamboo.example: The panda is eating bamboo in the forest.
bamboo.exampleZh: 熊猫正在森林里吃竹子。

ban.example: The school bans phones in class so students can focus on their lessons.
ban.exampleZh: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机，这样学生就能专心听课。

banana.example: I eat a banana every morning before I go to school.
banana.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前吃一根香蕉。

band.example: The band played a popular song at the school concert last night.
band.exampleZh: 昨晚乐队在学校音乐会上演奏了一首流行歌曲。

bandage.example: The nurse put a clean bandage on his leg wound.
bandage.exampleZh: 护士在他的腿伤上敷了一块干净的绷带。

bang.example: She banged the door and the loud bang made everyone jump.
bang.exampleZh: 她砰地关上门，巨大的响声把大家都吓了一跳。

bank.example: I put my money in the bank near my house.
bank.exampleZh: 我把钱存进我家附近的银行里。

bankrupt.example: The company went bankrupt after losing its biggest customer last year.
bankrupt.exampleZh: 这家公司在去年失去最大客户后破产了。

banner.example: The students hung a red banner across the front of the school gate.
banner.exampleZh: 学生们在学校大门前挂起了一条红色的横幅。

bar.example: The bar is closed tonight, so we will go home.
bar.exampleZh: 酒吧今晚关门了，所以我们要回家。

barber.example: My father goes to the same barber for a haircut every month.
barber.exampleZh: 我父亲每个月都去同一位理发师那里理发。

bare.example: His bare feet hurt on the hot sand.
bare.exampleZh: 他赤裸的双脚踩在滚烫的沙子上很疼。

barely.example: I could barely hear his voice over the loud music.
barely.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，我几乎听不见他的声音。

bargain.example: I bought this coat at a very good bargain in the market.
bargain.exampleZh: 我在市场上以便宜的价格买到了这件外套。

bark.example: The dog began to bark loudly when a stranger walked near the gate.
bark.exampleZh: 当陌生人走近大门时，那只狗开始大声吠叫。

barn.example: The farmer keeps his cows and hay inside the big red barn.
barn.exampleZh: 农夫把他的奶牛和干草存放在那座红色的大谷仓里。

barrel.example: The old farmer filled a large barrel with fresh water from the well.
barrel.exampleZh: 老农夫从井里打了满满一大桶清水。

barrier.example: Language can be a barrier when people do not share the same words.
barrier.exampleZh: 当人们不使用相同的语言时，语言可能会成为障碍。

base.example: The base of the lamp is made of heavy metal.
base.exampleZh: 这盏灯的底座是用重金属制成的。

baseball.example: My brother plays baseball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
baseball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每个星期六下午都和朋友们打棒球。

basement.example: They keep old boxes and tools in the basement.
basement.exampleZh: 他们把旧箱子和工具存放在地下室里。

basic.example: Food and water are basic needs for every person in the world.
basic.exampleZh: 食物和水是世界上每个人的基本需求。

basically.example: The test is basically easy, but a few questions are hard.
basically.exampleZh: 这次考试基本上是容易的，但有几道题很难。

basin.example: She washed the fresh apples in a basin of cold water.
basin.exampleZh: 她在一盆冷水里洗新鲜的苹果。

basis.example: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
basis.exampleZh: 信任是每一段良好友谊的基础。

basket.example: She put the fresh apples into a small basket on the table.
basket.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的苹果放进桌上的一个小篮子里。

basketball.example: My brother plays basketball with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
basketball.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周六下午都和朋友们打篮球。

bat.example: He picked up a wooden bat and hit the ball over the fence.
bat.exampleZh: 他拿起一根木制球棒，把球打出了围栏。

batch.example: The factory made a new batch of bread this morning.
batch.exampleZh: 今天早上工厂生产了一批新的面包。

bath.example: I take a hot bath every night before I go to bed.
bath.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会洗个热水澡。

bathe.example: After work, I like to bathe my baby in warm water.
bathe.exampleZh: 下班后，我喜欢用温水给我的宝宝洗澡。

bathroom.example: Our new apartment has a small bathroom next to the kitchen.
bathroom.exampleZh: 我们的新公寓在厨房旁边有一个小浴室。

battery.example: I need to charge my phone battery before we leave the house.
battery.exampleZh: 我们出门前我需要给手机电池充电。

battle.example: The soldiers fought a long battle to protect their small town.
battle.exampleZh: 士兵们打了一场漫长的战役来保护他们的小镇。

bay.example: We parked the boat in a quiet bay near the small fishing village.
bay.exampleZh: 我们把船停在小渔村附近一个安静的海湾里。

be.example: I want to be a good teacher one day.
be.exampleZh: 我希望有一天成为一名好老师。

beach.example: We walked along the beach and watched the sun go down.
beach.exampleZh: 我们沿着海滩散步，看着太阳落下。

beam.example: A bright beam of light came through the small window.
beam.exampleZh: 一束明亮的光线从小窗户照了进来。

bean.example: My mother puts red bean in the soup every winter morning.
bean.exampleZh: 我妈妈每年冬天的早晨都会在汤里放红豆。

bear.example: She cannot bear the loud noise from the busy street at night.
bear.exampleZh: 她无法忍受夜里繁忙街道上传来的嘈杂噪音。

beard.example: My grandfather has a long white beard and likes to tell stories.
beard.exampleZh: 我祖父留着长长的白胡子，喜欢讲故事。

bearing.example: His calm bearing made everyone feel safe during the long journey.
bearing.exampleZh: 他沉稳的举止让每个人在漫长旅途中都感到安心。

beast.example: The wild beast slept quietly under the tall tree last night.
beast.exampleZh: 那头野兽昨晚在高大的树下安静地睡着了。

beat.example: Our team beat the stronger side by two goals last night.
beat.exampleZh: 我们队昨晚以两球击败了更强的一方。

beautiful.example: The garden looks beautiful in spring when all the flowers open.
beautiful.exampleZh: 春天所有花都开的时候，这个花园看起来很美。

beauty.example: She enjoys the beauty of the lake at sunset.
beauty.exampleZh: 她喜欢日落时湖面的美景。

because.example: I stayed at home because it was raining hard.
because.exampleZh: 因为雨下得很大，我待在家里。

become.example: She wants to become a doctor when she grows up.
become.exampleZh: 她长大后想成为一名医生。

bed.example: My dog likes to sleep under the bed every night.
bed.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢每天晚上睡在床底下。

bee.example: The busy bee flies from flower to flower all day long.
bee.exampleZh: 这只忙碌的蜜蜂整天在花丛间飞来飞去。

beef.example: My mother cooks beef with potatoes for dinner every Sunday.
beef.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都用土豆炖牛肉。

beer.example: We drank cold beer in the garden after dinner last night.
beer.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们在花园里喝了冰啤酒。

before.example: Please wash your hands before you eat dinner.

beforehand.example: Please tell me beforehand if you plan to arrive late tomorrow.
beforehand.exampleZh: 如果你打算明天晚到，请提前告诉我。

beg.example: The old man had to beg for food on the cold street.
beg.exampleZh: 那位老人不得不在寒冷的街上乞讨食物。

beggar.example: The poor beggar sat on the cold street and asked people for money.
beggar.exampleZh: 那个可怜的乞丐坐在寒冷的街上向人们要钱。

begin.example: We begin our English class at nine every morning.
begin.exampleZh: 我们每天早上九点开始上英语课。

beginning.example: The beginning of the story is very sad.
beginning.exampleZh: 这个故事的开头非常悲伤。

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of all the students at the meeting.
behalf.exampleZh: 她在会上代表全体学生发言。

behave.example: The children behave very well when their teacher is in the room.
behave.exampleZh: 老师在房间里的时候，孩子们表现得很好。

behavior.example: His behavior in class is always polite and kind to others.
behavior.exampleZh: 他在课堂上的举止总是彬彬有礼，对他人很友善。

behind.example: The little boy hid behind the door and waited for his mother.
behind.exampleZh: 小男孩躲在门后等着他的母亲。

being.example: Every human being deserves respect and kindness from other people.
being.exampleZh: 每个人都值得他人尊重和善待。

belief.example: Her belief in her son gave him the courage to try again.
belief.exampleZh: 她对儿子的信任给了他再次尝试的勇气。

believe.example: I believe he is a good teacher.
believe.exampleZh: 我相信他是一位好老师。

bell.example: The school bell rings loudly at eight every morning.
bell.exampleZh: 学校的铃每天早上八点大声响起。

belly.example: The little boy lay on his belly and watched the ants on the ground.
belly.exampleZh: 小男孩趴在地上，肚皮贴着地面，看着地上的蚂蚁。

belong.example: This old book belongs to my grandfather and is very important to him.
belong.exampleZh: 这本旧书属于我祖父，对他来说非常重要。

beloved.example: She is my beloved wife and my best friend.
beloved.exampleZh: 她是我深爱的妻子，也是我最好的朋友。

below.example: The temperature dropped below zero last night, so the lake froze.
below.exampleZh: 昨晚气温降到了零度以下，所以湖面结冰了。

belt.example: He wore a black leather belt with his new jeans.
belt.exampleZh: 他穿新牛仔裤时系了一条黑色皮带。

bench.example: An old man sat on a wooden bench in the park.
bench.exampleZh: 一位老人坐在公园里的木制长椅上。

bend.example: The road bends to the left after the old bridge.
bend.exampleZh: 那座旧桥过后，道路向左弯曲。

beneath.example: The old cat is sleeping beneath the warm wooden table.
beneath.exampleZh: 那只老猫正睡在温暖的木桌下面。

beneficial.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both your body and your mind.
beneficial.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的身体和心理都有益。

benefit.example: Regular exercise can bring great benefits to your health and help you feel better every day.
benefit.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对健康大有好处，能帮助你每天都感觉更好。

bent.example: The old man walked slowly with a bent back.
bent.exampleZh: 那位老人弯着背慢慢走着。

beside.example: She sat beside me on the bus and said nothing.
beside.exampleZh: 她在公交车上坐在我旁边，什么也没说。

besides.example: Besides English, she also studies French and Chinese at school.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英语，她在学校还学习法语和中文。

best.example: This is the best book I have ever read.
best.exampleZh: 这是我读过的最好的书。

bet.example: I bet you ten dollars that our team will win the game.
bet.exampleZh: 我跟你赌十美元，我们队会赢得这场比赛。

betray.example: He would never betray his friends, even when the police questioned him.
betray.exampleZh: 即使在警察审问他时，他也绝不会背叛他的朋友。

better.example: She is much better at math than her brother is.
better.exampleZh: 她数学比她弟弟好得多。

between.example: Please sit between Tom and me at the dinner table tonight.
between.exampleZh: 今晚吃饭时请坐在汤姆和我之间。

beware.example: Beware of the dog in the front yard.

bewilder.example: The many strange signs in the old city bewildered the young traveler.
bewilder.exampleZh: 老城里众多陌生的路牌让这位年轻游客不知所措。

beyond.example: The small village lies beyond those green hills.
beyond.exampleZh: 那个小村庄位于那些青山的那一边。

bible.example: My grandmother reads the bible every night before she goes to bed.
bible.exampleZh: 我奶奶每晚睡觉前都会读圣经。

bicycle.example: My father bought me a new bicycle for my tenth birthday.
bicycle.exampleZh: 我父亲在我十岁生日时给我买了一辆新自行车。

bid.example: They decided to bid a higher price for the old house.
bid.exampleZh: 他们决定为那栋老房子出更高的价。

big.example: This is a big problem for our small team.
big.exampleZh: 这对我们这个小团队来说是个大问题。

bike.example: I ride my bike to school every morning with my sister.
bike.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起骑自行车去学校。

bill.example: She paid the bill for dinner and then took a taxi home.
bill.exampleZh: 她付了晚餐的账单，然后打车回家。

billion.example: The company spent one billion dollars on a new factory last year.
billion.exampleZh: 这家公司去年花十亿美元建了一座新工厂。

bin.example: Please put the empty bottles in the bin near the door.
bin.exampleZh: 请把空瓶子放进靠近门的垃圾箱里。

binder.example: She put all her notes into a blue binder for the meeting.
binder.exampleZh: 她把所有笔记都放进一个蓝色活页夹里，准备开会用。

biography.example: She read a biography of a famous writer last week.
biography.exampleZh: 她上周读了一本关于一位著名作家的传记。

biology.example: My sister studies biology at the university and wants to become a teacher.
biology.exampleZh: 我姐姐在大学学习生物学，她想成为一名老师。

bird.example: A small bird is singing in the tree outside my window.
bird.exampleZh: 一只小鸟正在我窗外的树上唱歌。

birth.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby boy last night.
birth.exampleZh: 她昨晚生下了一个健康的男婴。

birthday.example: My birthday is in May, and my family always eats cake together.
birthday.exampleZh: 我的生日在五月，家人总会一起吃蛋糕。

biscuit.example: My mother bought a box of biscuits and we ate them with tea.
biscuit.exampleZh: 我妈妈买了一盒饼干，我们就着茶把它们吃完了。

bishop.example: The bishop wore a tall hat and spoke to the people in the church.
bishop.exampleZh: 主教戴着高高的帽子，在教堂里向人们讲话。

bit.example: Could you give me a bit of bread for my soup?
bit.exampleZh: 你能给我一点面包配汤吗？

bite.example: Be careful, that small dog may bite your hand.
bite.exampleZh: 小心，那只小狗可能会咬你的手。

bitter.example: The medicine is bitter, but it helps me feel better.
bitter.exampleZh: 这药很苦，但它让我感觉好一些。

bizarre.example: It was a bizarre dream, but I still remember every detail of it.
bizarre.exampleZh: 那是一个古怪的梦，但我仍然记得它的每一个细节。

black.example: She wore a black coat and carried a small black bag to work.
black.exampleZh: 她穿着一件黑色外套，带着一个黑色小包去上班。

blackboard.example: The teacher writes new words on the blackboard with white chalk.
blackboard.exampleZh: 老师用白粉笔在黑板上写新单词。

blame.example: Don't blame him for the mistake because he is new here.
blame.exampleZh: 不要因为那个错误责怪他，因为他是新来的。

blank.example: Please write your name in the blank space at the top of the page.
blank.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶部的空白处。

blanket.example: She wrapped the baby in a warm blanket before going outside.
blanket.exampleZh: 她出门前用一条温暖的毯子把婴儿裹了起来。

blast.example: The blast broke every window in the old building.
blast.exampleZh: 爆炸震碎了那栋旧楼的每一扇窗户。

blaze.example: The blaze in the fireplace kept our small room warm all night long.
blaze.exampleZh: 壁炉里的火焰整夜让我们的小房间保持温暖。

bleed.example: The cut on his hand began to bleed after he fell down.
bleed.exampleZh: 他摔倒后，手上的伤口开始流血。

blend.example: She likes to blend fresh fruit with milk for breakfast.
blend.exampleZh: 她喜欢把新鲜水果和牛奶混合起来当早餐。

bless.example: Every night she blesses her children before they go to sleep.
bless.exampleZh: 每天晚上，她都会在孩子们睡觉前祝福他们。

blind.example: The bright light can blind you if you look at it directly.
blind.exampleZh: 如果你直视那道强光，它可能会让你失明。

blink.example: I blink my eyes when the bright light shines.
blink.exampleZh: 当强光照过来时，我会眨眼睛。

block.example: A fallen tree became a big block on the narrow road.
block.exampleZh: 一棵倒下的树成了狭窄道路上的一大障碍物。

blood.example: The doctor said he lost a lot of blood in the accident.
blood.exampleZh: 医生说他在这场事故中失了很多血。

bloody.example: The bloody knife was on the table after the fight.
bloody.exampleZh: 打斗之后，那把流血的刀就在桌子上。

bloom.example: The garden is beautiful because all the flowers bloom in spring.
bloom.exampleZh: 花园很美，因为所有的花都在春天开放。

blossom.example: The apple trees blossom in spring and the garden looks beautiful.
blossom.exampleZh: 苹果树在春天开花，花园看起来很美。

blow.example: The wind began to blow hard against the windows last night.
blow.exampleZh: 昨晚风开始猛烈地吹打着窗户。

blue.example: She wore a blue dress and felt happy all day.
blue.exampleZh: 她穿了一条蓝色的裙子，一整天都感到开心。

blueprint.example: The architect showed us a blueprint of the new school building.
blueprint.exampleZh: 建筑师给我们看了新学校大楼的蓝图。

blunder.example: He made a big blunder at work and lost an important client.
blunder.exampleZh: 他在工作中犯了一个大错，失去了一位重要客户。

blur.example: The rain made the whole city a blur from my window.
blur.exampleZh: 雨让整座城市从我窗外望去一片模糊。

blush.example: She began to blush when everyone looked at her new dress.
blush.exampleZh: 当所有人都看向她的新裙子时，她开始脸红了。

board.example: The board met this morning to discuss the new school rules.
board.exampleZh: 董事会今天上午开会讨论新的学校规定。

boat.example: We took a small boat across the lake to visit the old village.
boat.exampleZh: 我们乘一艘小船穿过湖去参观那个古老的村庄。

body.example: Regular exercise keeps your body strong and healthy.
body.exampleZh: 经常锻炼能让你的身体保持强壮和健康。

boil.example: Please boil the water before you make tea for the guests.
boil.exampleZh: 请先把水煮开，再为客人泡茶。

bold.example: She made a bold choice to speak the truth.
bold.exampleZh: 她做出了大胆的选择，说出了真相。

bolt.example: He used a long bolt to fix the broken gate.
bolt.exampleZh: 他用一根长螺栓固定住了坏掉的大门。

bomb.example: The old bomb was found in the field and the police closed the road.
bomb.exampleZh: 那颗旧炸弹在田里被发现，警察封锁了道路。

bond.example: A strong bond between parents and children helps the whole family stay happy.
bond.exampleZh: 父母与孩子之间牢固的纽带有助于整个家庭保持幸福。

bone.example: The dog buried a big bone in the backyard yesterday.
bone.exampleZh: 那只狗昨天在后院埋了一根大骨头。

bonus.example: The workers got a small bonus at the end of the year.
bonus.exampleZh: 工人们在年底拿到了一笔小额奖金。

book.example: I want to book a table for two, and then read my new book.
book.exampleZh: 我想预订一张两人桌，然后读我的新书。

booklet.example: The nurse gave me a small booklet about healthy eating.
booklet.exampleZh: 护士给了我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

bookshop.example: I often go to the bookshop near my school to buy new books.
bookshop.exampleZh: 我经常去学校附近的那家书店买新书。

boom.example: The small town saw a building boom after the new road opened.
boom.exampleZh: 新公路开通后，这座小镇出现了建筑热潮。

boost.example: The new policy will boost the local economy and create more jobs.
boost.exampleZh: 新政策将促进当地经济发展并创造更多就业机会。

boot.example: He put his boots by the door before going to work.
boot.exampleZh: 他去上班前把靴子放在了门口。

border.example: The river forms the border between the two countries.
border.exampleZh: 这条河形成了两国之间的边界。

bore.example: The long speech began to bore most of the students.
bore.exampleZh: 那场冗长的演讲开始让大多数学生感到厌烦。

boring.example: This long movie is so boring that I almost fell asleep.
boring.exampleZh: 这部长电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。

born.example: She was born in a small village near the sea.
born.exampleZh: 她出生在海边的一个小村庄里。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your pen for a minute, please?
borrow.exampleZh: 我可以借用一下你的笔吗？

boss.example: My boss said the meeting starts at nine tomorrow morning.
boss.exampleZh: 我老板说会议明天早上九点开始。

both.example: Both of my sisters like to read books before bed.
both.exampleZh: 我的两个姐姐都喜欢在睡前看书。

bother.example: I am sorry to bother you, but I need your help.
bother.exampleZh: 很抱歉打扰你，但我需要你的帮助。

bottle.example: He put the cold water in a glass bottle and took it to work.
bottle.exampleZh: 他把冷水装进一个玻璃瓶里，带去了上班。

bottom.example: At the bottom of the page, you can see my name.
bottom.exampleZh: 在页面的底部，你可以看到我的名字。

bounce.example: The ball will bounce high off the hard floor.
bounce.exampleZh: 球从硬地板上弹得很高。

bound.example: The train is bound for the city and will leave soon.
bound.exampleZh: 这列火车开往那座城市，很快就要出发了。

boundary.example: The river forms a natural boundary between the two villages.
boundary.exampleZh: 这条河形成了两个村庄之间的天然分界线。

bow.example: She gave a polite bow and then began to play her new violin.
bow.exampleZh: 她礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后开始拉她的小提琴。

bowl.example: Please put the hot soup into a big bowl on the table.
bowl.exampleZh: 请把热汤倒进桌上的大碗里。

box.example: She put the old books in a box and carried it upstairs.
box.exampleZh: 她把旧书放进一个箱子里，然后把它搬到了楼上。

boy.example: The boy is playing football with his friends in the park.
boy.exampleZh: 那个男孩正在公园里和朋友们踢足球。

boycott.example: Many people decided to boycott the company after they learned about its poor working conditions.
boycott.exampleZh: 许多人在了解到该公司恶劣的工作条件后，决定抵制它。

brain.example: The human brain is very complex and needs a lot of energy to work.
brain.exampleZh: 人类的大脑非常复杂，需要大量能量才能运转。

brake.example: He hit the brake hard when a dog ran into the road.
brake.exampleZh: 一只狗跑到路上时，他猛踩刹车。

branch.example: The bird sat on a branch of the old tree.
branch.exampleZh: 那只鸟停在老树的一根树枝上。

brand.example: You can choose any brand of coffee you like.
brand.exampleZh: 你可以选择任何你喜欢的牌子的咖啡。

brass.example: The old door handle is made of brass and shines brightly.
brass.exampleZh: 那个旧门把手是黄铜做的，闪闪发亮。

brave.example: The brave little boy helped the lost dog find its home.
brave.exampleZh: 那个勇敢的小男孩帮助那只迷路的狗找到了家。

bread.example: We buy fresh bread from the small shop every morning.
bread.exampleZh: 我们每天早上从那家小店买新鲜面包。

breadth.example: The breadth of the river makes it hard to cross.
breadth.exampleZh: 这条河的宽度使得它很难被穿越。

break.example: He broke the glass and then took a short break.
break.exampleZh: 他打破了玻璃，然后短暂休息了一下。

breakdown.example: The sudden breakdown of the old machine stopped all work in the factory.
breakdown.exampleZh: 那台旧机器的突然故障使工厂里的所有工作都停了下来。

breakfast.example: I eat breakfast with my family before I go to work.
breakfast.exampleZh: 我上班前和家人一起吃早餐。

breath.example: She took a deep breath before she began to speak.
breath.exampleZh: 她深吸一口气，然后开始说话。

breathe.example: I like to breathe the fresh air in the park every morning.
breathe.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早上在公园里呼吸新鲜空气。

breed.example: Farmers breed sheep for wool and meat on this small farm.
breed.exampleZh: 农民在这个小农场里养羊，以获取羊毛和羊肉。

breeze.example: A cool breeze came through the open window and made us feel relaxed.
breeze.exampleZh: 一阵凉风从敞开的窗户吹进来，让我们感到很放松。

bribe.example: He tried to bribe the police officer with money.
bribe.exampleZh: 他试图用钱贿赂那名警察。

brick.example: The old house was built with red brick and has a small garden.
brick.exampleZh: 那座老房子是用红砖建成的，还有一个小花园。

bride.example: The bride looked very happy at her wedding.
bride.exampleZh: 新娘在她的婚礼上看起来非常幸福。

bridge.example: The old bridge across the river is narrow, so we walk across it slowly.
bridge.exampleZh: 河上的那座旧桥很窄，所以我们慢慢地走过去。

brief.example: The teacher gave a brief talk about the new class rules.
brief.exampleZh: 老师就新的班级规则做了简短的讲话。

bright.example: The bright sun made the whole room warm and cheerful.
bright.exampleZh: 明亮的阳光让整个房间变得温暖而愉快。

brilliant.example: She is a brilliant scientist and everyone in the lab respects her.
brilliant.exampleZh: 她是一位杰出的科学家，实验室里的每个人都很尊敬她。

brim.example: The cup was full to the brim with hot tea.
brim.exampleZh: 杯子里装满了热茶，满到边。

bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class tomorrow morning so we can check the answers together.
bring.exampleZh: 请明天早上把笔记本带到课堂上，这样我们可以一起核对答案。

brisk.example: A brisk walk in the morning helps me feel awake and ready for the day.
brisk.exampleZh: 早晨轻快地走一走，能让我清醒过来，准备好迎接新的一天。

broad.example: The river is very broad here, so we cannot swim across it easily.
broad.exampleZh: 这里的河面很宽，我们不容易游过去。

broadcast.example: The radio station will broadcast the football match live tonight.
broadcast.exampleZh: 电台今晚将现场直播这场足球赛。

broaden.example: Reading more books can broaden your mind and help you grow.
broaden.exampleZh: 多读书能拓宽你的视野，帮助你成长。

broken.example: The broken window let cold air into the old house.
broken.exampleZh: 那扇破了的窗户让冷空气吹进了这座老房子。

broker.example: My broker helped me buy shares in a small company.
broker.exampleZh: 我的经纪人帮我买入了一家小公司的股票。

brook.example: The children played near the brook while their mother watched them.
brook.exampleZh: 孩子们在小溪边玩耍，母亲在一旁看着他们。

broom.example: She used an old broom to sweep the kitchen floor after dinner.
broom.exampleZh: 晚饭后，她用一把旧扫帚打扫了厨房地板。

brother.example: My brother and I play football in the park every Sunday.
brother.exampleZh: 我和我哥哥每个星期天都在公园里踢足球。

brow.example: She wiped the sweat from her brow and kept walking up the hill.
brow.exampleZh: 她擦去额头上的汗水，继续往山上走。

brown.example: The leaves turn brown in autumn and fall to the ground.
brown.exampleZh: 秋天树叶变成褐色，然后落在地上。

browse.example: After dinner, we like to browse the shops near our home.
browse.exampleZh: 晚饭后，我们喜欢在家附近的商店随便逛逛。

bruise.example: She got a bad bruise on her leg after falling off the bike.
bruise.exampleZh: 她从自行车上摔下来后，腿上留下了一块严重的瘀伤。

brush.example: She uses a small brush to paint the wall white.
brush.exampleZh: 她用一把小刷子把墙刷成白色。

bubble.example: A soap bubble floated up and popped in the air.
bubble.exampleZh: 一个肥皂泡飘起来，在空中破掉了。

bucket.example: She carried a heavy bucket of water from the well to the kitchen.
bucket.exampleZh: 她从井边提了一桶沉重的水到厨房。

budget.example: We must keep the monthly budget low and plan every cost carefully.
budget.exampleZh: 我们必须把每月预算控制得很低，并仔细计划每一笔开支。

build.example: They plan to build a new school near the park next year.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

building.example: There are many tall buildings near my school in the city center.
building.exampleZh: 在我学校附近的市中心有许多高楼。

bulb.example: Please turn off the light bulb before you leave the room.
bulb.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯泡关掉。

bulk.example: The bulk of the work is already done.
bulk.exampleZh: 大部分工作已经完成了。

bullet.example: The police found a bullet near the broken window last night.
bullet.exampleZh: 昨晚警察在破碎的窗户附近发现了一颗子弹。

bulletin.example: The school put a bulletin on the wall to announce the new timetable.
bulletin.exampleZh: 学校在墙上贴了一张公告，公布新的课程表。

bump.example: I bump my head on the low door every morning.
bump.exampleZh: 我每天早上都在那扇矮门上撞到头。

bunch.example: She gave him a bunch of red flowers for his birthday.
bunch.exampleZh: 她送给他一束红花作为生日礼物。

bundle.example: She carried a bundle of old clothes to the shop.
bundle.exampleZh: 她把一捆旧衣服带到了商店。

burden.example: The new job brought a heavy burden on his family life.
burden.exampleZh: 这份新工作给他的家庭生活带来了沉重的负担。

bureau.example: The travel bureau can help you find a cheap hotel near the station.
bureau.exampleZh: 旅行社可以帮你找到车站附近便宜的旅馆。

burn.example: Be careful with that hot pan or you will burn your hand.
burn.exampleZh: 小心那个滚烫的锅，否则你会烫伤手的。

burst.example: The old pipe burst and water went everywhere in the kitchen.
burst.exampleZh: 旧水管破裂了，厨房里到处都是水。

bury.example: The dog likes to bury its bone in the garden.
bury.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢把骨头埋在花园里。

bus.example: I take the bus to school every morning.
bus.exampleZh: 我每天早上坐公共汽车去学校。

bush.example: There is a small bush with red flowers in our garden.
bush.exampleZh: 我们的花园里有一株开着红花的小灌木。

business.example: My father runs a small business in our town.
business.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们镇上经营一家小公司。

busy.example: My mother is busy cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
busy.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里忙着做晚饭。

but.example: I want to go out, but it is raining very hard now.
but.exampleZh: 我想出去，但是现在雨下得很大。

butcher.example: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces for us.
butcher.exampleZh: 屠夫为我们把肉切成了小块。

butter.example: I spread some butter on my warm bread and ate it.
butter.exampleZh: 我在热面包上涂了些黄油，然后把它吃了。

butterfly.example: A colorful butterfly landed on the flower in our garden.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一只色彩鲜艳的蝴蝶落在了我们花园里的花上。

button.example: She lost a button on her coat and could not find it.
button.exampleZh: 她外套上掉了一颗纽扣，怎么也找不到。

buy.example: I want to buy a new book for my sister today.
buy.exampleZh: 我今天想给妹妹买一本新书。

buzz.example: The room was full of buzz as students rushed to finish their work.
buzz.exampleZh: 学生们赶着完成作业时，房间里充满了忙乱的嗡嗡声。

by.example: She went to school by bus and arrived before eight.
by.exampleZh: 她坐公交车去学校，八点前就到了。

bypass.example: The new road lets drivers bypass the busy town center.
bypass.exampleZh: 这条新路让司机可以绕过繁忙的市中心。

cabbage.example: My mother cooks cabbage with some meat and rice for dinner.
cabbage.exampleZh: 我妈妈晚餐用卷心菜配一些肉和米饭做菜。

cabin.example: The small wooden cabin sits quietly near the lake in the forest.
cabin.exampleZh: 那间小木屋静静地坐落在森林中的湖边。

cabinet.example: The cups are in the kitchen cabinet next to the sink.
cabinet.exampleZh: 杯子在水槽旁边的厨房橱柜里。

cable.example: They laid a new cable under the sea to connect the two islands.
cable.exampleZh: 他们在海底铺设了一条新电缆，把这两座岛屿连接起来。

cafe.example: We met at a small cafe near the station and talked for hours.
cafe.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面，聊了几个小时。

cage.example: The zoo keeper put the small bird back in its cage.
cage.exampleZh: 动物园管理员把那只小鸟放回了它的笼子里。

cake.example: My mother made a chocolate cake for my birthday party last night.
cake.exampleZh: 昨晚妈妈为我的生日聚会做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

calculate.example: We can calculate the total cost before we buy the tickets.
calculate.exampleZh: 我们可以在买票之前计算出总费用。

calendar.example: I write every important date on my calendar at home.
calendar.exampleZh: 我把每一个重要的日期都写在家里的日历上。

call.example: I will call my mother tonight and tell her about the visit.
call.exampleZh: 我今晚会给妈妈打电话，告诉她这次拜访的事。

calm.example: She stayed calm and helped the children find a safe way out.
calm.exampleZh: 她保持镇定，帮助孩子们找到了一条安全的出路。

camera.example: She took a photo of the sunset with her new camera.
camera.exampleZh: 她用她的新相机拍了一张日落照片。

camp.example: We will camp near the lake and set up our tent before dark.
camp.exampleZh: 我们将在湖边露营，并在天黑前搭好帐篷。

campaign.example: The students started a campaign to keep their school clean.
campaign.exampleZh: 学生们发起了一场保持校园清洁的运动。

campus.example: The new library is in the middle of our campus.
campus.exampleZh: 新图书馆位于我们校园的中心。

can.example: I can open the can of soup with a knife.
can.exampleZh: 我可以用刀打开那罐汤。

canal.example: The old canal runs through the city and brings water to many farms.
canal.exampleZh: 这条古老的运河穿过城市，为许多农场送水。

cancel.example: She had to cancel her trip because she got sick.
cancel.exampleZh: 她因为生病不得不取消旅行。

cancer.example: My aunt is very brave and is fighting cancer with a smile.
cancer.exampleZh: 我的姑姑非常勇敢，正微笑着与癌症作斗争。

candidate.example: Each candidate must answer three simple questions before the interview begins.
candidate.exampleZh: 每位候选人必须在面试开始前回答三个简单的问题。

candle.example: She lit a candle on the table when the lights went out.
candle.exampleZh: 停电时，她在桌上点燃了一支蜡烛。

candy.example: The little boy ate too much candy at his birthday party yesterday.
candy.exampleZh: 那个小男孩昨天在他的生日聚会上吃了太多糖果。

canteen.example: I eat lunch in the school canteen every day at noon.
canteen.exampleZh: 我每天中午都在学校食堂吃午饭。

canvas.example: The artist painted a bright sunset on a large canvas.
canvas.exampleZh: 画家在一块大帆布上画了一幅明亮的日落。

cap.example: He put his cap on the table and then went out.
cap.exampleZh: 他把帽子放在桌上，然后走了出去。

capable.example: She is a capable worker and can finish the job on time.
capable.exampleZh: 她是个有能力的员工，能按时完成这项工作。

capacity.example: This room has enough capacity for thirty people to sit and work.
capacity.exampleZh: 这个房间能容纳三十个人坐下工作。

capital.example: Beijing is the capital of China and many people visit it every year.
capital.exampleZh: 北京是中国的首都，每年有很多人去参观。

capitalism.example: Many people think capitalism helps businesses grow and create new jobs.
capitalism.exampleZh: 许多人认为资本主义有助于企业发展并创造新的就业机会。

capsule.example: The doctor gave me a small capsule to take with water.
capsule.exampleZh: 医生给了我一颗小胶囊，用水送服。

captain.example: The captain of the ship is a very kind and brave man.
captain.exampleZh: 这艘船的船长是一位非常善良勇敢的人。

capture.example: The police worked hard to capture the thief near the old train station.
capture.exampleZh: 警察努力在旧火车站附近抓获了那个小偷。

carbon.example: Carbon is a key element in all living things.
carbon.exampleZh: 碳是所有生物体内的一种关键元素。

card.example: She wrote a short note on the card for her teacher.
card.exampleZh: 她在卡片上给老师写了一段简短的留言。

care.example: She takes good care of her little brother every day after school.
care.exampleZh: 她每天放学后都细心照顾她的弟弟。

career.example: She wants a career in medicine and studies hard every day.
career.exampleZh: 她想从事医学职业，每天都努力学习。

careful.example: Please be careful with the hot soup on the table.

careless.example: He was careless and left his keys on the table.
careless.exampleZh: 他很粗心，把钥匙落在了桌子上。

cargo.example: The ship carried a heavy cargo of grain to the north.
cargo.exampleZh: 这艘船载着一批沉重的谷物货物驶向北方。

carpenter.example: The carpenter made a small wooden table for our kitchen.
carpenter.exampleZh: 木匠为我们的厨房做了一张小木桌。

carpet.example: The workers will carpet the whole room before the new furniture arrives.
carpet.exampleZh: 工人们会在新家具送到之前给整个房间铺上地毯。

carriage.example: The old carriage moved slowly along the quiet country road.
carriage.exampleZh: 那辆旧马车沿着安静的乡间小路缓缓前行。

carrier.example: The carrier promised to deliver the package before noon tomorrow.
carrier.exampleZh: 承运人承诺明天中午前送达包裹。

carrot.example: My mother puts a carrot in the soup and it tastes sweet.
carrot.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了一根胡萝卜，味道很甜。

carry.example: Please carry this bag to the car for me.
carry.exampleZh: 请帮我把这个包拿到车上去。

cart.example: The farmer loaded the hay onto a large cart.
cart.exampleZh: 农民把干草装上了一辆大车。

cartoon.example: My little brother watches a cartoon every morning before he goes to school.
cartoon.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天早上上学前都会看一部动画片。

case.example: In this case, the doctor said I should rest at home.
case.exampleZh: 在这种情况下，医生说我应该在家休息。

cash.example: I paid for the tickets in cash and kept the receipt.
cash.exampleZh: 我用现金买了票，并保留了收据。

cassette.example: I found an old cassette with my favorite songs in the drawer.
cassette.exampleZh: 我在抽屉里找到了一盒录着我最喜欢的歌的旧磁带。

cast.example: The director will cast three young actors in the new film about a small village school.
cast.exampleZh: 导演将选派三位年轻演员出演这部讲述乡村小学的新电影。

casual.example: He wore casual clothes to the party and felt relaxed.
casual.exampleZh: 他穿着休闲的衣服去参加聚会，感觉很放松。

catalog.example: Please catalog all the books in the school library before Friday.
catalog.exampleZh: 请在周五前为学校图书馆的所有书籍编好目录。

catch.example: He ran fast to catch the bus before the doors closed.
catch.exampleZh: 他跑得很快，想在车门关上之前赶上公交车。

category.example: This book belongs to a different category than the others.
category.exampleZh: 这本书属于与其他书不同的类别。

cattle.example: The farmer keeps cattle on his land and feeds them every morning.
cattle.exampleZh: 农民在自己的土地上养牛，每天早上喂养它们。

cause.example: Careless driving causes many accidents on the road every year.
cause.exampleZh: 粗心驾驶每年在路上导致许多事故。

caution.example: Please use caution when you cross this busy street.
caution.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的街道时请小心。

cautious.example: She is cautious when she crosses the busy street every morning.
cautious.exampleZh: 她每天早上过那条繁忙的街道时都很小心。

cease.example: The factory will cease work next week for the holiday.
cease.exampleZh: 工厂下周将因假期停止工作。

ceiling.example: The ceiling in my bedroom is too low for a tall lamp.
ceiling.exampleZh: 我卧室的天花板太低，放不下一盏高台灯。

celebrate.example: We celebrate her birthday with a small cake and songs.
celebrate.exampleZh: 我们用一个小蛋糕和歌声庆祝她的生日。

cell.example: Each cell in the body has a special job to do.
cell.exampleZh: 身体里的每个细胞都有自己特殊的任务。

cement.example: Trust is the cement of friendship, and shared work cements it.
cement.exampleZh: 信任是友谊的黏合剂，共同的工作则巩固它。

cemetery.example: Every year we visit the old cemetery to clean my grandfather's grave.
cemetery.exampleZh: 每年我们都去那座老墓地给祖父扫墓。

center.example: The new library stands in the center of our small town.
center.exampleZh: 新图书馆坐落在我们小镇的中心。

centigrade.example: The water boils at one hundred degrees centigrade.
centigrade.exampleZh: 水在一百摄氏度时沸腾。

centimeter.example: The small box is about ten centimeters wide and five centimeters tall.
centimeter.exampleZh: 这个小盒子大约十厘米宽、五厘米高。

central.example: The library is in a central spot on campus, so it is easy to find.
central.exampleZh: 图书馆位于校园的中心位置，因此很容易找到。

century.example: This old church was built in the nineteenth century.
century.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于十九世纪。

cereal.example: I eat cereal with milk every morning before school.
cereal.exampleZh: 我每天早上上学前都吃麦片配牛奶。

ceremony.example: The wedding ceremony started at ten in the morning.
ceremony.exampleZh: 婚礼仪式在上午十点开始。

certain.example: I am certain that this is the right answer.
certain.exampleZh: 我确定这是正确的答案。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that the weather will be good tomorrow.
certainty.exampleZh: 明天天气好不好并不确定。

certificate.example: You need a certificate to show that you passed the exam.
certificate.exampleZh: 你需要一份证书来证明你通过了考试。

chain.example: The dog is tied to a tree with a strong chain.
chain.exampleZh: 那只狗被一条结实的链子拴在树上。

chair.example: She sat on a wooden chair and read a book by the window.
chair.exampleZh: 她坐在一把木椅上，在窗边看书。

challenge.example: Learning a new language is a big challenge, but she never gives up.
challenge.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言是个巨大的挑战，但她从不放弃。

chamber.example: The music sounded sweet in the small chamber.
chamber.exampleZh: 音乐在这个小房间里听起来很悦耳。

champion.example: She is a champion of children's rights and often speaks for them.
champion.exampleZh: 她是儿童权利的捍卫者，经常为他们发声。

chance.example: There is a good chance that we will meet again soon.
chance.exampleZh: 我们很有可能很快再见面。

change.example: I want to change some money and buy a cup of coffee.
change.exampleZh: 我想兑换一些钱，再买一杯咖啡。

channel.example: This channel carries fresh water from the river to the farms.
channel.exampleZh: 这条渠道把河水输送到农场。

chapter.example: We read the first chapter of the book in class today.
chapter.exampleZh: 我们今天在课上读了这本书的第一章。

character.example: The main character in this story has a very kind heart.
character.exampleZh: 这个故事里的主角有一颗非常善良的心。

characteristic.example: Kindness is a characteristic of good teachers.
characteristic.exampleZh: 善良是好老师的典型特征。

characterize.example: The quiet streets and old houses characterize this small town.
characterize.exampleZh: 安静的街道和老房子是这座小镇的特色。

charge.example: The hotel will charge us extra for breakfast, but the room is clean.
charge.exampleZh: 酒店会另收早餐费，不过房间很干净。

charity.example: She gives some money to charity every year to help poor children.
charity.exampleZh: 她每年都捐一些钱给慈善机构，帮助贫困儿童。

charm.example: Her smile and kindness give the old town a special charm.
charm.exampleZh: 她的笑容和善良给这座老城增添了特别的魅力。

chart.example: The teacher showed us a chart of the weather last week.
chart.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张上周天气的图表。

chase.example: The dog likes to chase the ball across the park every morning.
chase.exampleZh: 这只狗喜欢每天早上在公园里追着球跑。

chat.example: We often chat about our day after dinner.
chat.exampleZh: 我们常常在晚饭后聊聊各自的一天。

cheap.example: This cheap shirt looks nice, but it feels bad after one wash.
cheap.exampleZh: 这件便宜的衬衫看着不错，但洗一次后手感就很差。

cheat.example: He tried to cheat on the test and the teacher caught him.
cheat.exampleZh: 他考试时试图作弊，结果被老师抓住了。

check.example: Please check your answers carefully before you hand in the test paper.
check.exampleZh: 交卷前请仔细检查你的答案。

cheer.example: The whole crowd began to cheer when the team scored the winning goal.
cheer.exampleZh: 当球队踢进决胜球时，全场观众开始欢呼。

cheese.example: I like to put some cheese on my bread for breakfast.
cheese.exampleZh: 我早餐喜欢在面包上放一些奶酪。

chef.example: The chef in this small restaurant cooks very good food every day.
chef.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆的主厨每天做的饭菜都非常好吃。

chemical.example: Some farmers use chemicals to keep insects away from their crops.
chemical.exampleZh: 有些农民使用化学制品来防止昆虫侵害庄稼。

chemist.example: The chemist in our town can make this medicine for you.
chemist.exampleZh: 我们镇上的药剂师能为你配制这种药。

chess.example: My grandfather and I play chess every Sunday afternoon.
chess.exampleZh: 我和爷爷每个星期天下午都下国际象棋。

chest.example: The doctor put a cold stethoscope on my chest and told me to breathe.
chest.exampleZh: 医生把一个冰冷的听诊器放在我的胸口上，让我呼吸。

chew.example: Dogs love to chew on bones, but you should also chew your food slowly.
chew.exampleZh: 狗喜欢啃骨头，不过你吃东西也应该细嚼慢咽。

chicken.example: My mother cooks chicken with rice for dinner every Sunday.
chicken.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期日都做鸡肉配米饭当晚餐。

chief.example: The chief engineer explained the new plan to the whole team this morning.
chief.exampleZh: 首席工程师今天上午向整个团队解释了新计划。

child.example: The child is playing with a small red ball in the garden.
child.exampleZh: 那个小孩正在花园里玩一个红色的小球。

childhood.example: I have many happy memories of my childhood in the countryside.
childhood.exampleZh: 我对在乡下的童年有很多快乐的回忆。

chill.example: The soup is too hot, so put it in the fridge to chill.
chill.exampleZh: 汤太烫了，放进冰箱里冷藏一下吧。

chin.example: He rested his chin on his hand and listened to the story.
chin.exampleZh: 他把下巴搁在手上，听着那个故事。

china.example: She keeps her fine china in a wooden cupboard.
china.exampleZh: 她把精美的瓷器收在一个木柜子里。

chip.example: He ate a bag of chips while repairing the computer chip.
chip.exampleZh: 他一边修电脑芯片，一边吃了一袋薯片。

chocolate.example: My sister gave me a box of chocolate for my birthday.
chocolate.exampleZh: 我姐姐在我生日时送了我一盒巧克力。

choice.example: The small shop has a good choice of fresh fruit every morning.
choice.exampleZh: 这家小店每天早上都有很多新鲜水果可供选择。

choose.example: You can choose one book from the shelf and take it home.
choose.exampleZh: 你可以从书架上挑选一本书，然后带回家。

chop.example: Please chop the onions into small pieces before you put them in the pot.
chop.exampleZh: 请把洋葱剁成小块，然后再放进锅里。

christian.example: My neighbor is a Christian, and he goes to church every Sunday.
christian.exampleZh: 我的邻居是基督徒，他每个星期天都去教堂。

cigar.example: The old man sat on the porch and smoked a long cigar.
cigar.exampleZh: 老人坐在门廊上，抽着一支长长的雪茄。

cigarette.example: My father smokes a cigarette after dinner every evening.
cigarette.exampleZh: 我父亲每天晚饭后都会抽一支香烟。

circle.example: The children sat in a circle and sang songs together.
circle.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐成一个圆圈，一起唱歌。

circuit.example: The current flows around the circuit and lights the small bulb.
circuit.exampleZh: 电流沿着电路流动，点亮了那只小灯泡。

circular.example: The teacher gave each student a circular about the school trip next week.
circular.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生发了一份关于下周学校旅行的通知。

circulate.example: Blood circulates through the body and keeps us healthy.
circulate.exampleZh: 血液在全身循环，让我们保持健康。

circumstance.example: Under no circumstances should you open the door at night.
circumstance.exampleZh: 在任何情况下，你都不应该在夜里开门。

cite.example: The teacher asked us to cite two books in our report.
cite.exampleZh: 老师要求我们在报告中引用两本书。

citizen.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in the election.
citizen.exampleZh: 每个公民都有权在选举中投票。

civil.example: Civil rights are important for every person in a free country.
civil.exampleZh: 公民权利对自由国家的每个人都很重要。

civilian.example: The soldier helped the civilians leave the city before the fighting started.
civilian.exampleZh: 士兵在战斗开始前帮助平民离开了这座城市。

civilization.example: Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest civilizations in the world.
