civilization.exampleZh: 古埃及是世界上最早的文明之一。

claim.example: The company claims the new machine can save a lot of money.
claim.exampleZh: 该公司声称这台新机器能节省大量资金。

clap.example: The children clap their hands and sing a happy song together.
clap.exampleZh: 孩子们拍手，一起唱着一首快乐的歌。

clarify.example: Please clarify your question so I can give you a better answer.
clarify.exampleZh: 请澄清你的问题，这样我才能给你更好的回答。

clarity.example: The clarity of her writing helps students understand the lesson quickly.
clarity.exampleZh: 她写作的清晰度帮助学生很快理解了这堂课。

clash.example: There was a clash between the two groups over the new rules.
clash.exampleZh: 两个群体因新规定发生了冲突。

class.example: Our class has twenty students and we study English every morning.
class.exampleZh: 我们班有二十名学生，我们每天早上学英语。

classic.example: This old film is a classic story that many people still love today.
classic.exampleZh: 这部老电影是一个经典故事，如今仍有很多人喜爱它。

classical.example: She likes classical music and often listens to it at home.
classical.exampleZh: 她喜欢古典音乐，经常在家里听。

classification.example: The scientist put these animals into one classification based on their size.
classification.exampleZh: 这位科学家根据体型把这些动物归入了同一个类别。

classify.example: We can classify these books by subject.
classify.exampleZh: 我们可以按学科给这些书分类。

classmate.example: My classmate Amy sits next to me and helps me with math.
classmate.exampleZh: 我的同班同学艾米坐在我旁边，还帮我学数学。

classroom.example: Our classroom is clean and bright, and we read books there every morning.
classroom.exampleZh: 我们的教室干净明亮，我们每天早上在那里读书。

clause.example: This clause explains what you must do if you arrive late.
clause.exampleZh: 这个条款说明了如果你迟到必须做什么。

claw.example: The cat used its sharp claws to climb the tall tree.
claw.exampleZh: 那只猫用锋利的爪子爬上了那棵高树。

clay.example: The children made small animals out of clay in art class today.
clay.exampleZh: 今天美术课上，孩子们用黏土做了小动物。

clean.example: Please keep your room clean and clean the desk after you finish your homework.
clean.exampleZh: 请保持房间干净，并做完作业后把书桌收拾干净。

clear.example: The sky is clear today, so we can see the mountains.
clear.exampleZh: 今天天空晴朗，所以我们可以看到群山。

clerk.example: The clerk at the front desk helped me find my room key.
clerk.exampleZh: 前台的职员帮我找到了房间钥匙。

clever.example: The clever girl found a quick way to fix the old bike.
clever.exampleZh: 这个聪明的女孩很快找到了修理旧自行车的方法。

click.example: Click the button and the door will open.
click.exampleZh: 点击那个按钮，门就会打开。

client.example: Our client asked us to finish the report before Friday.
client.exampleZh: 我们的客户要求我们在周五之前完成这份报告。

cliff.example: The old house stands on a high cliff above the sea.
cliff.exampleZh: 那座老房子矗立在海边高高的悬崖上。

climate.example: The climate in this city is warm and wet all year.
climate.exampleZh: 这座城市的气候全年温暖湿润。

climb.example: The children climb the tall tree behind their house every summer.
climb.exampleZh: 孩子们每年夏天都爬他们家后面的那棵大树。

cling.example: He still clings to the old habits from his childhood.
cling.exampleZh: 他仍然依恋着童年时期养成的旧习惯。

clinic.example: The new clinic near my house is open every day.
clinic.exampleZh: 我家附近的新诊所每天都开门。

clinical.example: The doctor made a clinical decision after looking at all the test results.
clinical.exampleZh: 医生在查看了所有检查结果后做出了临床决定。

clip.example: She used a clip to hold the papers together on her desk.
clip.exampleZh: 她用夹子把桌上的文件夹在一起。

cloak.example: He wore a dark cloak to hide his face at night.
cloak.exampleZh: 他穿了一件深色斗篷，以便在夜里遮住脸。

clock.example: The clock on the wall shows half past seven, and the driver clocked 120 km/h on the highway.
clock.exampleZh: 墙上的钟显示七点半，而那位司机在高速公路上达到了每小时120公里的速度。

close.example: Please close the door; the shop is close to my home.
close.exampleZh: 请把门关上，这家店离我家很近。

cloth.example: She used a clean cloth to wipe the table after dinner.
cloth.exampleZh: 晚饭后她用一块干净的布擦了桌子。

clothes.example: I put my clothes in the closet after I wash them.
clothes.exampleZh: 我洗完衣服后把它们放进衣柜里。

clothing.example: She buys warm clothing for the cold winter months.
clothing.exampleZh: 她为寒冷的冬季购买保暖的衣物。

cloud.example: Dark clouds covered the sky, and rain began to fall on the small town.
cloud.exampleZh: 乌云密布天空，小镇开始下起雨来。

club.example: He joined a chess club and learned to play with new friends.
club.exampleZh: 他加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，并学会了和新朋友一起下棋。

clue.example: The police found an important clue near the old house.
clue.exampleZh: 警察在那座老房子附近发现了一条重要线索。

clumsy.example: My clumsy brother knocked over the glass while reaching for the salt.
clumsy.exampleZh: 我那笨手笨脚的弟弟在伸手拿盐时打翻了杯子。

cluster.example: A cluster of stars shone brightly in the night sky.
cluster.exampleZh: 夜空中一群星星闪闪发光。

clutch.example: She clutched the steering wheel tightly as the car skidded on the ice.
clutch.exampleZh: 汽车在冰面上打滑时，她紧紧抓住方向盘。

coach.example: Our coach trains the team every day after school.
coach.exampleZh: 我们的教练每天放学后训练球队。

coal.example: The old train burns coal to make steam for its long journey.
coal.exampleZh: 这列老式火车燃烧煤炭产生蒸汽，以完成漫长的旅程。

coast.example: We walked along the coast and watched the big waves come in.
coast.exampleZh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着大浪涌来。

coat.example: She put on a warm coat before going out in the cold wind.
coat.exampleZh: 她在寒风中外出的前先穿上一件暖和的外套。

cock.example: The old cock crowed loudly every morning before the sun came up.
cock.exampleZh: 那只老公鸡每天早上在太阳升起前大声啼叫。

code.example: Please enter the code to open the door.

cognitive.example: Sleep helps children develop strong cognitive skills for school.
cognitive.exampleZh: 睡眠有助于儿童发展出在学校学习所需的良好认知能力。

coherent.example: Her essay is coherent and easy to follow from start to finish.
coherent.exampleZh: 她的文章连贯顺畅，从头到尾都容易理解。

cohesion.example: Good communication helps build team cohesion during long and difficult projects.
cohesion.exampleZh: 良好的沟通有助于在漫长艰难的项目中建立团队凝聚力。

coil.example: The snake can coil its body around a branch and sleep there.
coil.exampleZh: 蛇能把身体盘绕在树枝上，在那里睡觉。

coin.example: She put a coin in the machine to buy a drink.
coin.exampleZh: 她往机器里投了一枚硬币来买饮料。

coincide.example: Our holidays coincide this year, so we can travel together.
coincide.exampleZh: 今年我们的假期时间正好重合，所以我们可以一起去旅行。

coincidence.example: It was just a coincidence that we met at the same café.
coincidence.exampleZh: 我们在同一家咖啡馆相遇，纯属巧合。

collaborate.example: The two teams collaborate closely to finish the project on time.
collaborate.exampleZh: 两个团队紧密合作，以按时完成这个项目。

collaboration.example: Good collaboration between the two teams made the project a success.
collaboration.exampleZh: 两个团队之间的良好合作使这个项目取得了成功。

collapse.example: The old bridge may collapse if heavy trucks keep crossing it.
collapse.exampleZh: 如果重型卡车继续从这座旧桥上通过，它可能会倒塌。

collar.example: He loosened his collar because the room was very hot.
collar.exampleZh: 因为房间很热，他松开了衣领。

colleague.example: I often eat lunch with a colleague from my office.
colleague.exampleZh: 我经常和办公室的一位同事一起吃午饭。

collect.example: My brother likes to collect old coins from different countries.
collect.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢收集来自不同国家的旧硬币。

collection.example: Her collection of old stamps is very famous in our town.
collection.exampleZh: 她的旧邮票收藏在我们镇上很有名。

collective.example: The team made a collective decision to finish the work early.
collective.exampleZh: 团队做出了集体决定，要早点完成工作。

college.example: She studies music at a small college near her home.
college.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小学院里学习音乐。

collide.example: The two cars collided at the busy corner near my school.
collide.exampleZh: 两辆汽车在我学校附近繁忙的街角相撞了。

collision.example: The two cars were badly damaged in the collision on the icy road.
collision.exampleZh: 两辆汽车在结冰路面上的碰撞中严重受损。

colonial.example: The colonial period in this country lasted for more than two hundred years.
colonial.exampleZh: 这个国家的殖民时期持续了两百多年。

colony.example: Many ants live together in a large colony under the ground.
colony.exampleZh: 许多蚂蚁一起住在地下的一个大群体里。

color.example: The bright color of the sky changed as the sun went down.
color.exampleZh: 太阳落山时，天空的明亮色彩发生了变化。

column.example: The old building has a tall stone column near the front door.
column.exampleZh: 这座老建筑的前门附近有一根高大的石柱。

comb.example: Please comb your hair before we leave for school.
comb.exampleZh: 我们去学校之前请把头发梳一梳。

combat.example: The new law aims to combat pollution in big cities.
combat.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在防止大城市的污染。

combination.example: This dish is a good combination of sweet and sour flavors.
combination.exampleZh: 这道菜是酸甜口味的良好结合。

combine.example: Please combine the two small teams into one group before Monday.
combine.exampleZh: 请在周一前把这两个小团队合并成一个小组。

come.example: Please come to my house after school today.

comedy.example: We watched a funny comedy last night and laughed all evening.
comedy.exampleZh: 我们昨晚看了一部滑稽的喜剧，笑了一整晚。

comfort.example: A warm cup of tea brings me great comfort on a cold day.
comfort.exampleZh: 在寒冷的日子里，一杯热茶给我带来极大的舒适。

comfortable.example: My new bed is very soft and comfortable, so I sleep well.
comfortable.exampleZh: 我的新床又软又舒服，所以我睡得很好。

command.example: The general will command the army and give clear orders tomorrow.
command.exampleZh: 将军明天将指挥军队并下达明确的命令。

commemorate.example: Many people visit the town every year to commemorate the famous writer.
commemorate.exampleZh: 每年都有很多人来到这个小镇纪念这位著名作家。

commence.example: The meeting will commence at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
commence.exampleZh: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。

commend.example: My teacher commended me for helping the new student in class.
commend.exampleZh: 老师表扬我在班上帮助了新来的同学。

comment.example: Please leave a comment below if you have any questions about the article.
comment.exampleZh: 如果你对这篇文章有任何疑问，请在下面留下评论。

commerce.example: Online commerce has changed the way people buy and sell goods.
commerce.exampleZh: 网络商务改变了人们买卖商品的方式。

commercial.example: The commercial was funny, so many people watched it online that night.
commercial.exampleZh: 那则商业广告很有趣，所以那天晚上很多人在网上观看了它。

commission.example: The city set up a commission to study the traffic problem.
commission.exampleZh: 市政府成立了一个委员会来研究交通问题。

commit.example: He promised not to commit any crime after leaving the small town.
commit.exampleZh: 他承诺离开那个小镇后不再犯罪。

commitment.example: She made a strong commitment to finish the project on time.
commitment.exampleZh: 她坚定地承诺要按时完成这个项目。

committee.example: The school committee will meet on Monday to discuss the new library.
committee.exampleZh: 学校委员会将于周一开会讨论新图书馆的事宜。

commodity.example: Clean water is a valuable commodity in many hot, dry countries.
commodity.exampleZh: 在许多炎热干旱的国家，干净的水是一种宝贵的商品。

common.example: Fresh fruit is very common in local markets here.
common.exampleZh: 新鲜水果在这里的当地市场很常见。

commonplace.example: It is commonplace to see people looking at their phones on the bus.
commonplace.exampleZh: 在公交车上看到人们看手机是很平常的事。

commonwealth.example: The two nations joined a peaceful commonwealth to share trade and ideas.
commonwealth.exampleZh: 这两个国家加入了一个和平的共同体，以共享贸易与理念。

communicate.example: We communicate with our teacher by email every week.
communicate.exampleZh: 我们每周通过电子邮件和老师交流。

communication.example: Good communication between parents and children makes family life much happier.
communication.exampleZh: 父母和孩子之间良好的沟通让家庭生活更幸福。

community.example: The whole community came together to clean the park last Saturday.
community.exampleZh: 上个星期六，整个社区的人一起打扫了公园。

commute.example: She commutes to work by train every morning and reads a book.
commute.exampleZh: 她每天早上坐火车通勤上班，并在车上读一本书。

compact.example: This compact camera fits easily in my pocket.
compact.exampleZh: 这台小巧的相机能轻松放进我的口袋里。

companion.example: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
companion.exampleZh: 我的狗是我长途散步时最好的伙伴。

company.example: My father works for a small company in the city.
company.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家小公司工作。

comparable.example: The two tests are comparable in difficulty, so students can choose either one.
comparable.exampleZh: 这两项测试难度相当，所以学生可以任选其一。

comparative.example: The report gives a comparative study of prices in three large cities.
comparative.exampleZh: 这份报告对三个大城市的物价做了比较研究。

compare.example: Please compare these two pictures and tell me the differences.
compare.exampleZh: 请比较这两张图片，然后告诉我它们的区别。

comparison.example: This comparison shows that the two plans are almost the same.
comparison.exampleZh: 这一比较表明，这两个方案几乎相同。

compartment.example: She put her bag in the small compartment above the seat.
compartment.exampleZh: 她把包放进了座位上方的隔间里。

compass.example: The hikers used a compass to find their way back to the camp.
compass.exampleZh: 徒步旅行者用指南针找到了回营地的路。

compel.example: Bad weather compelled us to stay at home all day.
compel.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气迫使我们整天待在家里。

compensate.example: The company will compensate the workers for their lost wages.
compensate.exampleZh: 公司将赔偿工人们损失的工资。

compensation.example: The company gave him extra money as compensation for his lost work days.
compensation.exampleZh: 公司额外给了他一笔钱，作为对他误工损失的补偿。

compete.example: Small shops find it hard to compete with big supermarkets.
compete.exampleZh: 小商店发现很难与大型超市竞争。

competent.example: She is a competent worker and always finishes her tasks on time.
competent.exampleZh: 她是一名有能力的员工，总是按时完成任务。

competition.example: The competition between the two teams was very strong this year.
competition.exampleZh: 今年这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。

competitive.example: The job market is very competitive, so you need good skills.
competitive.exampleZh: 就业市场竞争非常激烈，所以你需要有好的技能。

competitor.example: Our biggest competitor just released a new product at a lower price.
competitor.exampleZh: 我们最大的竞争对手刚刚以更低的价格推出了一款新产品。

complain.example: She often complains about the noise from the street at night.
complain.exampleZh: 她经常抱怨夜里街上的噪音。

complaint.example: Her only complaint was that the room was too noisy at night.
complaint.exampleZh: 她唯一的抱怨是房间晚上太吵了。

complement.example: The red wine is a perfect complement to the steak.
complement.exampleZh: 这款红葡萄酒是牛排的完美搭配。

complete.example: Please complete your homework before dinner and then we can watch a movie.
complete.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前完成作业，然后我们就可以看电影。

complex.example: This math problem is quite complex, so solve it step by step.
complex.exampleZh: 这道数学题相当复杂，所以要一步一步地解答。

complexity.example: The complexity of this math problem makes it hard for students.
complexity.exampleZh: 这道数学题的复杂性让学生们觉得很难。

complicate.example: Too many rules can complicate the simple process for new users.
complicate.exampleZh: 太多规则会让简单的流程对新用户来说变得复杂。

complicated.example: This math problem is too complicated for me to solve.
complicated.exampleZh: 这道数学题太复杂了，我解不出来。

complication.example: The doctor said the infection could cause serious complications after surgery.
complication.exampleZh: 医生说感染可能会在手术后引起严重的并发症。

component.example: Each component of the machine is tested before it leaves the factory.
component.exampleZh: 机器的每个部件在出厂前都要经过检测。

compose.example: The teacher asked us to compose a short song for the school show.
compose.exampleZh: 老师让我们为学校的演出创作一首短歌。

composition.example: My teacher liked the composition I wrote about my summer holiday.
composition.exampleZh: 老师很喜欢我写的那篇关于暑假的作文。

compound.example: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

comprehend.example: It is hard to comprehend why he left so suddenly.
comprehend.exampleZh: 很难理解他为什么这么突然地离开了。

comprehension.example: Reading every day can improve your comprehension of difficult texts.
comprehension.exampleZh: 每天阅读可以提高你对难懂文章的理解力。

comprehensive.example: The report gives a comprehensive view of our school.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 这份报告全面介绍了我们学校的情况。

compress.example: The doctor used a compress to stop the bleeding on his arm.
compress.exampleZh: 医生用一块止血垫止住了他手臂上的血。

comprise.example: The team comprises five engineers and two designers.
comprise.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名工程师和两名设计师组成。

compromise.example: Both sides agreed to a compromise after a long and difficult talk.
compromise.exampleZh: 经过长时间艰难的谈话，双方同意达成妥协。

compulsory.example: Swimming lessons are compulsory for all students in this school.
compulsory.exampleZh: 在这所学校，游泳课对所有学生都是必修的。

compute.example: We compute the total cost before we buy the new machines.
compute.exampleZh: 我们在购买新机器之前先计算总成本。

comrade.example: My father often talks about an old comrade from his army days.
comrade.exampleZh: 我父亲经常谈起他当兵时的一位老战友。

conceal.example: She tried to conceal the small key under a pile of old books.
conceal.exampleZh: 她试着把那把小钥匙藏在一堆旧书下面。

concede.example: He had to concede that his plan was wrong.
concede.exampleZh: 他不得不承认自己的计划是错的。

conceive.example: It is hard to conceive of life without a phone.
conceive.exampleZh: 很难设想没有手机的生活。

concentrate.example: I cannot concentrate on my homework when the TV is on.
concentrate.exampleZh: 电视开着的时候我无法专心做作业。

concentration.example: Good concentration helps students learn faster in class.
concentration.exampleZh: 良好的专注力能帮助学生在课堂上学得更快。

concept.example: The idea of freedom is a difficult concept for young children to understand.
concept.exampleZh: 自由这个概念对幼儿来说很难理解。

concern.example: The new safety rules concern every worker in our small company.
concern.exampleZh: 新的安全规定关系到我们这家小公司的每一位员工。

concerning.example: She asked me several questions concerning the new plan for next month.
concerning.exampleZh: 她问了我几个关于下个月新计划的问题。

concert.example: We went to a concert in the park last night.
concert.exampleZh: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

concession.example: She made a small concession so that the two sides could agree.
concession.exampleZh: 她做了一点小让步，这样双方就能达成一致。

concise.example: Her concise answer helped us understand the whole problem quickly.
concise.exampleZh: 她简明的回答帮助我们很快理解了整个问题。

conclude.example: We can conclude from these facts that the plan will work.
conclude.exampleZh: 根据这些事实，我们可以断定这个计划会成功。

conclusion.example: After a long discussion, we finally reached a clear conclusion together.
conclusion.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，我们终于一起得出了明确的结论。

concrete.example: The workers will use concrete to build a strong wall around the garden.
concrete.exampleZh: 工人们将用混凝土在花园周围建一堵坚固的墙。

condemn.example: Most people condemn any kind of violence against children.
condemn.exampleZh: 大多数人谴责任何针对儿童的暴力行为。

condense.example: You can condense the whole report into one short page.
condense.exampleZh: 你可以把整份报告压缩成一页短文。

condition.example: The old house is in poor condition and needs a lot of repair work.
condition.exampleZh: 这栋老房子状况很差，需要大量修缮工作。

conduct.example: The teacher will conduct a simple test in class today.
conduct.exampleZh: 老师今天将在课堂上进行一次简单的测试。

conductor.example: The conductor raised his hands and the music began.
conductor.exampleZh: 指挥家抬起双手，音乐随即响起。

confer.example: The two managers will confer with the team before they make a final decision.
confer.exampleZh: 两位经理会在做出最终决定前与团队商议。

conference.example: She went to a conference in Beijing last week with her team.
conference.exampleZh: 她上周和团队一起去北京参加了一个会议。

confess.example: He finally confessed that he had taken the money from the drawer.
confess.exampleZh: 他终于承认自己从抽屉里拿了钱。

confidence.example: She has great confidence in her English after months of daily practice.
confidence.exampleZh: 经过几个月的每日练习，她对自己的英语很有信心。

confident.example: She feels confident when she speaks English in front of her class.
confident.exampleZh: 她在全班同学面前说英语时感到很自信。

confidential.example: Please keep this report confidential and do not show it to anyone else.
confidential.exampleZh: 请对这份报告保密，不要给其他任何人看。

confine.example: Please confine your questions to the main topic of today's lesson.
confine.exampleZh: 请把你的问题限制在今天课程的主题范围内。

confirm.example: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
confirm.exampleZh: 请在周五前通过电子邮件确认您的预订。

conflict.example: There is often a conflict between what we want and what we need.
conflict.exampleZh: 我们想要的与我们需要的之间常常存在冲突。

conform.example: Most students conform to the school rules without any complaint.
conform.exampleZh: 大多数学生毫无怨言地遵守校规。

confront.example: Every day she must confront many small problems at work.
confront.exampleZh: 每天她都必须面对工作中的许多小问题。

confuse.example: The long instructions confuse most new students in the class.
confuse.exampleZh: 冗长的说明让班里大多数新学生感到困惑。

confusion.example: There was a lot of confusion about the new rules at school.
confusion.exampleZh: 学校里对新规定有很多困惑和混乱。

congratulate.example: We all congratulate her on passing the exam.
congratulate.exampleZh: 我们都祝贺她通过了考试。

congress.example: Congress will meet next week to talk about the new law.
congress.exampleZh: 国会下周将开会讨论这项新法律。

conjunction.example: The conjunction of heavy rain and strong wind caused many problems.
conjunction.exampleZh: 大雨和强风的结合造成了许多问题。

connect.example: Please connect your computer to the printer before you start the job.
connect.exampleZh: 开始工作前，请先把你的电脑连接到打印机上。

connection.example: There is a strong connection between the two events.
connection.exampleZh: 这两个事件之间有很强的联系。

conquer.example: He worked hard to conquer his fear of speaking in public.
conquer.exampleZh: 他努力克服了当众讲话的恐惧。

conquest.example: The king's conquest of the city brought great wealth to his people.
conquest.exampleZh: 国王对这座城市的征服给他的子民带来了巨大的财富。

conscience.example: My conscience would not let me tell a lie to my friend.
conscience.exampleZh: 我的良心不允许我对朋友说谎。

conscious.example: She was conscious of the danger and stepped back slowly.
conscious.exampleZh: 她意识到了危险，慢慢往后退了一步。

consciousness.example: Losing consciousness for a few seconds can be very scary.
consciousness.exampleZh: 失去意识几秒钟会让人非常害怕。

consensus.example: After a long talk, the team reached a consensus on the new plan.
consensus.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，团队就新方案达成了一致意见。

consent.example: Her parents finally gave their consent to the trip after a long talk.
consent.exampleZh: 经过长谈后，她的父母终于同意了她这次旅行。

consequence.example: Every choice has a consequence, so think carefully before you act.
consequence.exampleZh: 每个选择都有后果，所以行动前要仔细思考。

consequently.example: It rained hard, and consequently the game was cancelled.
consequently.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被取消了。

conservation.example: Water conservation is important for every family in this dry area.
conservation.exampleZh: 在这个干旱地区，节约用水对每个家庭都很重要。

conservative.example: My father is a conservative man and he does not like new things.
conservative.exampleZh: 我父亲是个保守的人，他不喜欢新事物。

consider.example: We should consider all the options before we make a decision.
consider.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们应该考虑所有的选择。

considerable.example: The project took a considerable amount of time and money to finish.
considerable.exampleZh: 完成这个项目花费了相当多的时间和金钱。

considerate.example: She is very considerate and always helps her old neighbors.
considerate.exampleZh: 她非常体贴，总是帮助年老的邻居。

consideration.example: Please give this problem careful consideration before you make a decision.
consideration.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，请仔细考虑这个问题。

consist.example: The team consists of five students and two teachers.
consist.exampleZh: 这个团队由五名学生和两名教师组成。

consistent.example: His work is consistent and always of a high quality.
consistent.exampleZh: 他的工作始终如一，质量一直很高。

console.example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news.
console.exampleZh: 听到坏消息后，她试着安慰她的朋友。

consolidate.example: We need to consolidate our team's ideas before the meeting.
consolidate.exampleZh: 我们需要在会议前整合团队的想法。

conspicuous.example: Her bright red coat was very conspicuous in the crowd of gray suits.
conspicuous.exampleZh: 她鲜红的 coat 在一片灰色西装中非常惹人注目。

constant.example: The baby needs constant care, and his mother never leaves his side.
constant.exampleZh: 这个婴儿需要不断的照顾，他母亲从不离开他身边。

constituent.example: The voters in my town are the most important constituents of the local government.
constituent.exampleZh: 我所在城镇的选民是地方政府最重要的组成部分。

constitute.example: These small parts together constitute a complete and useful system.
constitute.exampleZh: 这些小部件共同构成了一个完整而有用的系统。

constitution.example: The constitution protects the basic rights of every citizen in the country.
constitution.exampleZh: 宪法保护该国每一位公民的基本权利。

construct.example: Workers will construct a new bridge across the river next year.
construct.exampleZh: 工人们明年将在河上建造一座新桥。

construction.example: The new road is still under construction and will open next year.
construction.exampleZh: 这条新路仍在建设中，将于明年开通。

consult.example: You should consult your teacher before you choose these courses.
consult.exampleZh: 在选择这些课程之前，你应该咨询你的老师。

consultant.example: The company hired a consultant to help improve its customer service.
consultant.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来帮助改善客户服务。

consume.example: Cars consume a lot of fuel, so we should drive less.
consume.exampleZh: 汽车消耗大量燃料，所以我们应该少开车。

consumer.example: The new phone is popular with young consumers around the world.
consumer.exampleZh: 这款新手机很受全世界年轻消费者的欢迎。

consumption.example: The consumption of water in this city rises every summer.
consumption.exampleZh: 这座城市夏天的用水量每年都会上升。

contact.example: I lost contact with my old friend after we moved to different cities.
contact.exampleZh: 我们搬到不同的城市后，我就和那位老朋友失去了联系。

contain.example: This box can contain all of my old books and magazines.
contain.exampleZh: 这个箱子能装下我所有的旧书和杂志。

container.example: This container is full of fresh water and some fruit.
container.exampleZh: 这个容器装满了淡水和一些水果。

contaminate.example: Waste water from the factory can contaminate the river and kill the fish.
contaminate.exampleZh: 工厂排出的废水会污染河流，导致鱼类死亡。

contemporary.example: She enjoys contemporary art, and her brother is a contemporary of mine at college.
contemporary.exampleZh: 她喜欢当代艺术，而她的哥哥在大学里是我的同代人。

contend.example: Two teams will contend for the prize in the final match tomorrow.
contend.exampleZh: 两支队伍明天将在决赛中争夺这个奖项。

content.example: She is content with her simple life and never asks for more.
content.exampleZh: 她对自己简单的生活感到满足，从不奢求更多。

contest.example: She won first prize in the singing contest last year.
contest.exampleZh: 她在去年的歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

context.example: The teacher explained the word's meaning by looking at its context.
context.exampleZh: 老师通过看上下文来解释这个词的意思。

continent.example: Africa is a large continent with many countries and different languages.
continent.exampleZh: 非洲是一个拥有许多国家和不同语言的大大陆。

continual.example: The continual noise from the street makes it hard to sleep at night.
continual.exampleZh: 街上不断的噪音让人夜里难以入睡。

continue.example: The rain will continue all night, so please take an umbrella.
continue.exampleZh: 雨会持续下一整夜，所以请带把伞。

continuous.example: The machine makes a continuous noise all day long.
continuous.exampleZh: 这台机器整天发出连续不断的噪音。

contract.example: She signed a two-year contract with the company and started work on Monday.
contract.exampleZh: 她与公司签了一份为期两年的合同，并在周一开始工作。

contradict.example: His actions contradict what he said in the meeting yesterday.
contradict.exampleZh: 他的行为与他在昨天会议上的说法相矛盾。

contradiction.example: There is a clear contradiction between what he says and what he does.
contradiction.exampleZh: 他说的和做的之间存在明显的矛盾。

contrary.example: Contrary to what I thought, the test was quite easy.
contrary.exampleZh: 与我之前的想法相反，这次考试相当简单。

contrast.example: The contrast between the two pictures is easy to see.
contrast.exampleZh: 这两幅图之间的对比很容易看出来。

contribute.example: Many people contribute money to help children in poor areas go to school.
contribute.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助贫困地区的孩子上学。

contribution.example: Her many contributions to the project helped us finish the work on time.
contribution.exampleZh: 她对项目的诸多贡献帮助我们按时完成了工作。

control.example: She cannot control her little brother when their parents are away.
control.exampleZh: 父母不在时，她管不住她的弟弟。

controversy.example: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents and teachers.
controversy.exampleZh: 新的学校规定在家长和老师中引起了很大的争议。

convenience.example: I go to the shop near my home for convenience.
convenience.exampleZh: 为了图方便，我去家附近的商店买东西。

convenient.example: This small shop is very convenient for people who live nearby.
convenient.exampleZh: 这家小店对住在附近的人来说非常方便。

convention.example: Our school holds a yearly convention for all teachers and students.
convention.exampleZh: 我们学校每年为全体师生举办一次大会。

conventional.example: Her family still follows conventional ideas about marriage and work.
conventional.exampleZh: 她的家人仍然遵循关于婚姻和工作的传统观念。

conversation.example: I had a long conversation with my teacher about my future plans.
conversation.exampleZh: 我和老师就我的未来计划进行了一次长谈。

conversely.example: He likes quiet music, but conversely, his brother enjoys loud rock.
conversely.exampleZh: 他喜欢安静的音乐，相反地，他哥哥喜欢吵闹的摇滚乐。

conversion.example: The conversion of the old factory into a school took two years.
conversion.exampleZh: 把旧工厂改建成学校花了两年时间。

convert.example: They plan to convert the old school into a small hotel.
convert.exampleZh: 他们打算把这所旧学校改建成一家小旅馆。

convey.example: Her smile can convey more than a thousand words.
convey.exampleZh: 她的微笑能传达出胜过千言万语的信息。

convict.example: The judge will convict him if the new evidence is strong enough.
convict.exampleZh: 如果新证据足够有力，法官将判他有罪。

conviction.example: He spoke with great conviction about the need for change.
conviction.exampleZh: 他满怀坚定信念地谈到了变革的必要性。

convince.example: He tried to convince me that the plan was safe and easy.
convince.exampleZh: 他试图使我相信这个计划既安全又简单。

cook.example: My father likes to cook dinner for us on Sunday.
cook.exampleZh: 我爸爸喜欢在星期天为我们做晚饭。

cool.example: The soup is too hot, so please cool it for a few minutes.
cool.exampleZh: 汤太烫了，请把它冷却几分钟。

cooperate.example: Good team members cooperate with each other and share their ideas.
cooperate.exampleZh: 好的团队成员互相配合，并分享彼此的想法。

cooperation.example: Good cooperation between the two teams made the project finish on time.
cooperation.exampleZh: 两个团队之间的良好合作使项目按时完成。

cooperative.example: She is very cooperative and always helps her teammates finish the work on time.
cooperative.exampleZh: 她非常乐于合作，总是帮助队友按时完成工作。

coordinate.example: She coordinates the work of the two teams.
coordinate.exampleZh: 她协调两个团队的工作。

cop.example: The cop helped the lost child find his way home.
cop.exampleZh: 警察帮助那个迷路的孩子找到了回家的路。

cope.example: She has to cope with a lot of work every day.
cope.exampleZh: 她每天必须应付大量的工作。

copy.example: Please copy this page and give one copy to each student.
copy.exampleZh: 请复印这一页，并给每个学生一份。

copyright.example: The writer owns the copyright to all her books and songs.
copyright.exampleZh: 这位作家拥有她所有书籍和歌曲的版权。

cord.example: He tied the box with a strong cord before carrying it upstairs.
cord.exampleZh: 他把箱子用一根结实的绳子捆好，然后搬上楼。

core.example: The core of the problem is a lack of trust between the two teams.
core.exampleZh: 问题的核心是两支团队之间缺乏信任。

corn.example: My grandfather grows corn on his farm every summer.
corn.exampleZh: 我爷爷每年夏天都在他的农场上种玉米。

corner.example: The cat is sleeping in the corner of the room.
corner.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在房间的角落里。

corporate.example: Our corporate office is in the city center and has many meeting rooms.
corporate.exampleZh: 我们公司的办公室位于市中心，有很多会议室。

corporation.example: My father works for a large corporation in the city.
corporation.exampleZh: 我父亲在城里一家大公司工作。

correct.example: Please correct your mistakes before you hand in the test paper.
correct.exampleZh: 请在交试卷之前改正你的错误。

correlate.example: Researchers found that poor sleep can correlate with lower grades in school.
correlate.exampleZh: 研究人员发现睡眠不足可能与在校成绩偏低相关。

correspond.example: Your actions should correspond with the words you say in public.
correspond.exampleZh: 你的行为应当与你在公开场合所说的话一致。

correspondence.example: We kept up a long correspondence after she moved to another city.
correspondence.exampleZh: 她搬到另一个城市后，我们保持了长时间的通信。

correspondent.example: The correspondent sent a clear report from the city after the storm.
correspondent.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，那名记者从城里发回了一篇清晰的报道。

corridor.example: She walked down the long corridor to reach the meeting room.
corridor.exampleZh: 她沿着长长的走廊走向会议室。

corrode.example: Salt water can corrode the metal parts of a boat over time.
corrode.exampleZh: 海水会随着时间腐蚀船上的金属部件。

corrupt.example: Bad money can corrupt young people who work in big cities.
corrupt.exampleZh: 不义之财会腐蚀在大城市工作的年轻人。

corruption.example: The new mayor promised to fight corruption in the city government.
corruption.exampleZh: 新市长承诺要打击市政府中的腐败。

cost.example: The cost of living is high in this city, so we save money.
cost.exampleZh: 这个城市的生活成本很高，所以我们省钱。

costly.example: That old car was too costly to repair, so we sold it.
costly.exampleZh: 那辆旧车修理费太高了，所以我们把它卖掉了。

costume.example: She wore a beautiful costume to the school party last night.
costume.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一件漂亮的服装去参加学校聚会。

cottage.example: My grandmother lives in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.exampleZh: 我的祖母住在湖边的一座小村舍里。

cotton.example: My shirt is made of soft cotton and it feels very comfortable.
cotton.exampleZh: 我的衬衫是用柔软的棉布做的，穿起来很舒服。

couch.example: She sat on the couch and read a book all afternoon.
couch.exampleZh: 她坐在长沙发上看了一下午的书。

could.example: She said she could help us move the boxes tomorrow.
could.exampleZh: 她说她明天能帮我们搬这些箱子。

council.example: The city council will meet on Monday to discuss the new park.
council.exampleZh: 市议会将于周一开会讨论新公园。

counsel.example: My lawyer gave me good counsel before I signed the contract.
counsel.exampleZh: 在我签合同之前，我的律师给了我很好的建议。

count.example: Please count the books on this table before you leave.
count.exampleZh: 你离开前请数一下这张桌子上的书。

counter.example: She paid at the counter and left the shop quickly.
counter.exampleZh: 她在柜台付了钱，然后很快离开了商店。

counterpart.example: The manager met her counterpart from the other company for lunch.
counterpart.exampleZh: 这位经理与另一家公司的对应负责人共进午餐。

country.example: My country is big, and I love the quiet country near my home.
country.exampleZh: 我的国家很大，我喜欢我家附近安静的乡村。

countryside.example: My grandparents live in the countryside and grow their own vegetables.
countryside.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在乡下，自己种蔬菜。

county.example: She grew up on a small farm in the county.
county.exampleZh: 她在这个县的一个小农场里长大。

couple.example: The young couple bought a small house near the park last year.
couple.exampleZh: 这对年轻夫妇去年在公园附近买了一栋小房子。

courage.example: It takes real courage to speak the truth when everyone else stays silent.
courage.exampleZh: 当其他所有人都保持沉默时，说出真相需要真正的勇气。

course.example: This course teaches students how to write clear English sentences.
course.exampleZh: 这门课程教学生如何写出清晰的英语句子。

court.example: The young man went to court to fight for his land.
court.exampleZh: 那个年轻人去法院为自己的土地打官司。

courtesy.example: He showed great courtesy to every guest at the party.
courtesy.exampleZh: 他对派对上的每一位客人都表现得非常礼貌。

courtyard.example: The children played happily in the small courtyard behind the old house.
courtyard.exampleZh: 孩子们在旧屋后面的小院子里开心地玩耍。

cousin.example: My cousin lives in another city and visits us every summer.
cousin.exampleZh: 我的表姐住在另一个城市，每年夏天都来看我们。

cover.example: The book cover is blue, and it covers the old desk.
cover.exampleZh: 书皮是蓝色的，它盖住了那张旧书桌。

coverage.example: The newspaper's coverage of the local election was fair and detailed.
coverage.exampleZh: 这家报纸对地方选举的报道公正而详尽。

cow.example: The farmer keeps ten cows, and he never cows them with loud noises.
cow.exampleZh: 农夫养了十头奶牛，他从不靠大声喧哗来吓唬它们。

coward.example: He was called a coward because he ran away from the fight.
coward.exampleZh: 他因为从打斗中逃跑而被人称作懦夫。

cozy.example: The small room felt cozy with a warm fire and soft light.
cozy.exampleZh: 那间小屋里有温暖的火光和柔和的灯光，让人感觉温暖舒适。

crack.example: The ice began to crack under his feet as he walked across the frozen lake.
crack.exampleZh: 他走过冰封的湖面时，冰开始在他脚下裂开。

craft.example: She learned the craft of making glass bowls from her grandfather.
craft.exampleZh: 她从祖父那里学会了制作玻璃碗的手艺。

crane.example: The crane lifted the heavy box while a crane stood near the river.
crane.exampleZh: 起重机吊起那个沉重的箱子，而一只鹤站在河边。

crash.example: The old computer will crash if I open too many programs.
crash.exampleZh: 如果我打开太多程序，那台旧电脑就会崩溃。

crass.example: It was crass of him to laugh at her mistake.
crass.exampleZh: 他嘲笑她的错误，真是粗鲁。

crawl.example: The baby can crawl across the floor to reach the toys.
crawl.exampleZh: 宝宝能爬过地板去够那些玩具。

crazy.example: My brother is crazy about football and watches every game on TV.
crazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟对足球着迷，每场比赛都在电视上看。

cream.example: She puts cream in her coffee and uses cream on her face.
cream.exampleZh: 她在咖啡里加奶油，也在脸上涂面霜。

create.example: The new plan will create many jobs for young people in our town.
create.exampleZh: 这项新计划将为我们镇上的年轻人创造许多就业机会。

creation.example: The creation of this beautiful garden took many years of hard work.
creation.exampleZh: 这座美丽花园的创造花了许多年的辛勤劳动。

creative.example: She likes to do creative work in her small studio every morning.
creative.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上在她的小工作室里做有创造性的工作。

creature.example: Every creature in the forest needs water and food to live.
creature.exampleZh: 森林里的每一种生物都需要水和食物才能生存。

credit.example: I give him credit for finishing the hard work on time.
credit.exampleZh: 我因他按时完成这项艰难工作而赞扬他。

creep.example: A strange feeling began to creep over me as I walked home alone.
creep.exampleZh: 当我独自走回家时，一种奇怪的感觉开始悄悄涌上心头。

crew.example: The crew worked together to keep the ship safe during the storm.
crew.exampleZh: 全体船员齐心协力，在暴风雨中保障了船只的安全。

cricket.example: The children play cricket in the park every Sunday morning.
cricket.exampleZh: 孩子们每个星期天早上都在公园里打板球。

crime.example: The police are trying to stop crime in our city.
crime.exampleZh: 警方正努力阻止我们城市的犯罪。

criminal.example: The police caught the criminal who stole a car last night.
criminal.exampleZh: 警察抓住了昨晚偷车的那个罪犯。

crisis.example: The country faced a serious economic crisis last year.
crisis.exampleZh: 去年这个国家面临一场严重的经济危机。

crisp.example: The crisp apple tasted fresh, so she ate another one quickly.
crisp.exampleZh: 这个脆苹果尝起来很新鲜，所以她又很快吃了一个。

critic.example: The famous critic wrote a long review of the new film.
critic.exampleZh: 这位著名的评论家为这部新电影写了一篇长篇影评。

critical.example: The doctor said her condition was critical after the accident.
critical.exampleZh: 医生说事故发生后她的情况非常危急。

criticism.example: His new book received a lot of criticism from readers.
criticism.exampleZh: 他的新书受到了读者的许多批评。

criticize.example: My teacher criticized my essay because it had no clear main idea.
criticize.exampleZh: 老师批评了我的文章，因为它没有清晰的中心思想。

crop.example: Farmers work hard to grow crops and harvest them in autumn.
crop.exampleZh: 农民辛勤种植庄稼，并在秋天收获它们。

cross.example: Look both ways before you cross this busy street.
cross.exampleZh: 过这条繁忙的马路前要左右看看。

crow.example: The black crow sat on the fence and crowed loudly at sunrise.
crow.exampleZh: 那只黑乌鸦停在栅栏上，在日出时大声啼叫。

crowd.example: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium before the big game.
crowd.exampleZh: 大赛开始前，一大群人聚集在体育场外。

crown.example: The queen wore a golden crown on her head at the big ceremony.
crown.exampleZh: 女王在盛大的典礼上头戴一顶金冠。

crucial.example: Good sleep is crucial for students who want to learn well.
crucial.exampleZh: 对于想要学得好的学生来说，良好的睡眠至关重要。

crude.example: This crude oil must be cleaned before we can use it.
crude.exampleZh: 这种未加工的石油必须先经过净化才能使用。

cruel.example: It is cruel to leave a small dog alone all day.
cruel.exampleZh: 把一只小狗整天独自留在家是很残忍的。

cruise.example: We took a cruise ship around the islands and saw many beautiful beaches.
cruise.exampleZh: 我们乘游船环游了这些岛屿，看到了许多美丽的海滩。

crush.example: The heavy box will crush the small flowers if you put it there.
crush.exampleZh: 如果你把那个重箱子放在那里，它会压坏那些小花。

crust.example: The bread was soft inside, but its crust was hard and brown.
crust.exampleZh: 面包里面很软，但它的外皮又硬又呈褐色。

cry.example: The baby began to cry loudly when she could not find her mother.
cry.exampleZh: 婴儿找不到妈妈时开始大声哭起来。

crystal.example: The clear crystal in her necklace shone brightly in the sun.
crystal.exampleZh: 她项链上透明的水晶在阳光下闪闪发光。

cube.example: The child built a tall cube with six square pieces of paper.
cube.exampleZh: 那个孩子用六张方形纸搭了一个高高的立方体。

cue.example: The director gave me a cue, and I began to speak.
cue.exampleZh: 导演给了我一个提示，我便开始讲话。

cultivate.example: Farmers cultivate the land and grow rice every year.
cultivate.exampleZh: 农民每年耕种土地并种植水稻。

cultural.example: The city has many cultural events, such as music shows and art fairs.
cultural.exampleZh: 这座城市有许多文化活动，比如音乐演出和艺术展。

culture.example: Chinese culture is very old and has many special traditions.
culture.exampleZh: 中国文化非常古老，有许多独特的传统。

cunning.example: The cunning fox fooled every animal in the forest with a simple trick.
cunning.exampleZh: 那只狡猾的狐狸用一个简单的把戏骗过了森林里所有的动物。

cupboard.example: The cups are in the cupboard above the kitchen sink.
cupboard.exampleZh: 杯子在厨房水槽上方的橱柜里。

cure.example: The doctors hope the new medicine will cure his rare illness soon.
cure.exampleZh: 医生们希望这种新药能很快治愈他的罕见疾病。

curiosity.example: Her curiosity led her to open the old box.
curiosity.exampleZh: 她的好奇心促使她打开了那个旧盒子。

curious.example: The little girl is curious about the stars in the night sky.
curious.exampleZh: 这个小女孩对夜空中的星星很好奇。

currency.example: The country's currency lost value quickly during the economic crisis last year.
currency.exampleZh: 去年经济危机期间，这个国家的货币迅速贬值。

current.example: The current in the river is very strong today.
current.exampleZh: 今天河里的水流非常急。

curriculum.example: The school has a new curriculum for students in grades six to nine.
curriculum.exampleZh: 学校为六到九年级的学生制定了新的课程。

curse.example: He cursed loudly when he dropped the heavy box on his foot.
curse.exampleZh: 他把沉重的箱子砸到脚上时大声咒骂。

curtain.example: She opened the curtain to let the morning sun into the room.
curtain.exampleZh: 她拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进房间。

curve.example: The road has a sharp curve near the old bridge.
curve.exampleZh: 这条路在旧桥附近有一个急弯。

cushion.example: The soft cushion on the chair makes it comfortable to sit for hours.
cushion.exampleZh: 椅子上的软垫让人坐几个小时都很舒服。

custom.example: It is our custom to eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
custom.exampleZh: 除夕夜一起吃饺子是我们的习俗。

customary.example: It is customary to shake hands when you meet someone new.
customary.exampleZh: 初次见面时握手是习惯做法。

customer.example: The customer asked the shop owner for a cheaper price on the old chair.
customer.exampleZh: 这位顾客向店主要求把那把旧椅子卖便宜一些。

cut.example: Please cut the cake into small pieces for the children.
cut.exampleZh: 请把蛋糕切成小块给孩子们。

cute.example: The baby panda is very cute and everyone loves it.
cute.exampleZh: 那只小熊猫非常可爱，大家都很喜欢它。

cycle.example: She rides her cycle to work every morning before the sun rises.
cycle.exampleZh: 她每天早上在太阳升起前骑自行车去上班。

daily.example: Reading the daily news helps me understand what is happening around the world.
daily.exampleZh: 阅读每日新闻帮助我了解世界各地正在发生的事情。

dairy.example: My family buys milk and cheese at the dairy near our house.
dairy.exampleZh: 我家人在房子附近的乳品店买牛奶和奶酪。

dam.example: The old dam holds the river back and keeps the village safe from floods.
dam.exampleZh: 这座旧水坝拦住河水，使村庄免受洪水侵袭。

damage.example: The heavy rain caused serious damage to the old bridge last night.
damage.exampleZh: 昨晚的大雨对这座老桥造成了严重的损坏。

damp.example: The walls of the old house felt cold and damp after the rain.
damp.exampleZh: 雨后，老房子的墙壁摸起来又冷又潮湿。

dance.example: We dance together at the party every Friday night.
dance.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上在派对上一起跳舞。

danger.example: The broken bridge is a danger to everyone who walks across it.
danger.exampleZh: 这座破损的桥对每个从上面走过的人都是危险。

dangerous.example: It is dangerous to swim in this river after heavy rain.
dangerous.exampleZh: 大雨过后在这条河里游泳是危险的。

dare.example: No one dared to tell him the truth about the broken window.
dare.exampleZh: 没有人敢告诉他窗户被打破的真相。

dark.example: She was afraid of the dark room, so she turned on the light.
dark.exampleZh: 她害怕那个黑暗的房间，所以她打开了灯。

darling.example: She is my darling and I love her very much.
darling.exampleZh: 她是我的心爱之人，我非常爱她。

dash.example: He made a dash for the bus and jumped on just in time.
dash.exampleZh: 他冲向公交车，正好及时跳了上去。

data.example: The scientists looked at the data and found a clear pattern.
data.exampleZh: 科学家们查看了数据，发现了一个清晰的规律。

database.example: The school keeps all student records in a large database.
database.exampleZh: 学校把所有学生记录都保存在一个大数据库里。

date.example: Please write the date on your homework before you give it to me.
date.exampleZh: 交作业给我之前，请在上面写上日期。

daughter.example: Their daughter goes to the small school near the river.
daughter.exampleZh: 他们的女儿在河边那所小学校上学。

dawn.example: The truth began to dawn on him after he read the old letter.
dawn.exampleZh: 读完那封旧信之后，他开始渐渐明白真相。

day.example: Every day I walk to school with my sister.
day.exampleZh: 每天我和妹妹一起走路去学校。

dead.example: The old phone is dead, so I cannot call my mother today.
dead.exampleZh: 这部旧手机没电了，所以我今天不能给妈妈打电话。

deadline.example: We must finish the report before the deadline on Friday.
deadline.exampleZh: 我们必须在周五的截止时间之前完成报告。

deadly.example: The snake's bite is deadly, so stay away from it.
deadly.exampleZh: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的，所以要远离它。

deaf.example: The old man is deaf, so he cannot hear our voices.
deaf.exampleZh: 那位老人是聋的，所以听不见我们的声音。

deal.example: I will deal with this problem after lunch today.
deal.exampleZh: 我今天午饭后会处理这个问题。

dealer.example: The dealer sold us a used car at a fair price.
dealer.exampleZh: 经销商以合理的价格卖给我们一辆二手车。

dear.example: Dear, please do not forget to call your mother tonight.
dear.exampleZh: 亲爱的，今晚请别忘了给你妈妈打电话。

death.example: His death was a great shock to the whole family.
death.exampleZh: 他的死对整个家庭来说是个巨大的打击。

debate.example: The class will debate whether students should wear uniforms to school.
debate.exampleZh: 全班将就学生是否应该穿校服上学展开辩论。

debt.example: He borrowed too much money and now his debt is very large.
debt.exampleZh: 他借了太多钱，现在他的债务非常大。

decade.example: My grandmother has lived in this small town for over a decade.
decade.exampleZh: 我的祖母在这个小镇上住了十多年。

decay.example: Old fruit will decay quickly if you leave it in a warm room.
decay.exampleZh: 如果把旧水果放在温暖的房间里，它很快就会腐烂。

deceit.example: His deceit hurt everyone who had trusted him.
deceit.exampleZh: 他的欺骗伤害了所有信任过他的人。

deceive.example: He tried to deceive his friends about the money.
deceive.exampleZh: 他试图在钱的问题上欺骗他的朋友们。

decent.example: He is a decent man who always helps his neighbors.
decent.exampleZh: 他是个正派的人，总是帮助邻居。

decide.example: We must decide today where to go for our summer holiday.
decide.exampleZh: 我们今天必须决定暑假去哪里。

decidedly.example: She was decidedly the best player on the team that day.
decidedly.exampleZh: 那天她毫无疑问是队里最好的球员。

decimal.example: The answer is a decimal, not a whole number.
decimal.exampleZh: 答案是一个小数，而不是整数。

decision.example: She made a firm decision to study harder this year.
decision.exampleZh: 她下定决心今年要更努力学习。

decisive.example: Her decisive answer ended the long debate and made everyone happy.
decisive.exampleZh: 她果断的回答结束了漫长的争论，让每个人都很满意。

deck.example: We stood on the deck and watched the sun go down.
deck.exampleZh: 我们站在甲板上看着太阳落下。

declaration.example: The two countries signed a joint declaration to protect the ocean.
declaration.exampleZh: 两国签署了一份保护海洋的联合宣言。

declare.example: The government will declare a public holiday next Monday for everyone.
declare.exampleZh: 政府将宣布下周一为全民公共假日。

decline.example: Sales began to decline last year after the company raised its prices.
decline.exampleZh: 公司提价后，去年销售额开始下降。

decorate.example: We will decorate the living room with flowers for the party.
decorate.exampleZh: 我们会用鲜花把客厅装饰一下，为聚会做准备。

decrease.example: The number of students in our school will decrease next year.
decrease.exampleZh: 我们学校的学生人数明年将会减少。

deduct.example: The company will deduct the tax from your monthly salary.
deduct.exampleZh: 公司会从你的月薪中扣除税款。

deed.example: His kind deed helped many people in our small town.
deed.exampleZh: 他的善举帮助了我们小镇上的许多人。

deem.example: Many people deem this old bridge a very special place.
deem.exampleZh: 许多人认为这座古桥是一个非常特别的地方。

deep.example: The lake is very deep, so we cannot see the bottom.
deep.exampleZh: 这个湖很深，我们看不到湖底。

deer.example: We saw a deer drinking water by the lake this morning.
deer.exampleZh: 今天早上我们看到一只鹿在湖边喝水。

defeat.example: Our team worked hard and finally defeated the strong team from the next town.
defeat.exampleZh: 我们队努力拼搏，最终击败了邻镇的那支强队。

defect.example: The engineers found a small defect in the new machine before it shipped.
defect.exampleZh: 工程师在这台新机器发货前发现了它的一个小缺陷。

defective.example: This old machine is defective and cannot work well.
defective.exampleZh: 这台旧机器有缺陷，无法正常运转。

defend.example: They must defend their homes when the strong wind comes at night.
defend.exampleZh: 夜里刮起大风时，他们必须保卫自己的家园。

defendant.example: The defendant told the judge that he was not there that night.
defendant.exampleZh: 被告告诉法官，那天晚上他不在那里。

defense.example: The city built a strong defense against the flood.
defense.exampleZh: 这座城市修建了坚固的防洪设施。

defensive.example: He became defensive when we asked about the missing money.
defensive.exampleZh: 当我们问起那笔不见了的钱时，他变得戒备起来。

defiance.example: His quiet defiance surprised everyone in the room.
defiance.exampleZh: 他无声的违抗让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can make your bones weak and easily broken.
deficiency.exampleZh: 缺乏维生素D会使你的骨骼变得脆弱，容易骨折。

deficit.example: The company reported a large deficit at the end of the year.
deficit.exampleZh: 公司在年底报告了巨额亏损。

define.example: The teacher asked us to define the word in our own way.
define.exampleZh: 老师让我们用自己的话给这个词下定义。

definite.example: There is no definite answer to this question yet.
definite.exampleZh: 这个问题目前还没有明确的答案。

definitely.example: I will definitely come to your party on Saturday night.
definitely.exampleZh: 星期六晚上我一定会来参加你的聚会。

definition.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the word before the class ended.
definition.exampleZh: 下课前，老师给这个词下了一个清晰的定义。

defy.example: The young man dared to defy his father and left home.
defy.exampleZh: 那个年轻人敢于公然反抗父亲，离家出走了。

degree.example: Her degree of patience helped her solve the difficult problem calmly.
degree.exampleZh: 她的耐心程度帮助她冷静地解决了这个难题。

delay.example: The flight was delayed for two hours because of heavy snow.
delay.exampleZh: 由于大雪，航班延误了两个小时。

delegate.example: The manager will delegate the task to her assistant tomorrow.
delegate.exampleZh: 经理明天会把这项任务委派给她的助手。

delegation.example: The manager sent a small delegation to meet our new partners.
delegation.exampleZh: 经理派了一个小型代表团去会见我们的新合作伙伴。

delete.example: Please delete the old files from your computer before you leave today.
delete.exampleZh: 今天离开前，请把你电脑里的旧文件删除。

deliberate.example: She made a deliberate choice to speak slowly and clearly.
deliberate.exampleZh: 她刻意选择慢慢地、清楚地说。

delicate.example: She held the delicate glass cup with both hands.
delicate.exampleZh: 她用双手捧着那个精致脆弱的玻璃杯。

delicious.example: This soup is delicious and my whole family loves it.
delicious.exampleZh: 这汤很美味，我们全家都喜欢。

delight.example: To my great delight, the children were happy to see me.
delight.exampleZh: 让我非常高兴的是，孩子们见到我很开心。

deliver.example: The mailman will deliver the package to your house tomorrow morning.
deliver.exampleZh: 邮递员明天早上会把包裹送到你家。

delivery.example: The delivery of the package was late because of the heavy snow.
delivery.exampleZh: 由于大雪，包裹的递送迟了。

demand.example: Many customers demand better service, so the store is changing its rules.
demand.exampleZh: 许多顾客要求更好的服务，因此这家商店正在修改规定。

democracy.example: In a true democracy, every citizen has a voice in the government.
democracy.exampleZh: 在真正的民主国家里，每个公民在政府中都有发言权。

democratic.example: The country held a democratic election and everyone could vote freely.
democratic.exampleZh: 这个国家举行了民主选举，每个人都可以自由投票。

demonstrate.example: The teacher used a simple experiment to demonstrate how water turns into ice.
demonstrate.exampleZh: 老师用一个简单的实验来演示水如何变成冰。

demonstration.example: The teacher gave a simple demonstration of the new software for us.
demonstration.exampleZh: 老师为我们简单地演示了这个新软件。

denial.example: His denial of the mistake surprised everyone at the meeting.
denial.exampleZh: 他对这个错误的否认让会上所有人都感到惊讶。

denote.example: Dark clouds often denote rain, so take an umbrella with you.
denote.exampleZh: 乌云常常表示要下雨，所以带把伞吧。

denounce.example: The workers denounced the plan as unfair and dangerous for everyone.
denounce.exampleZh: 工人们谴责该计划不公平且对所有人都有危险。

dense.example: The city has a dense population, so the streets are always crowded.
dense.exampleZh: 这座城市人口稠密，所以街道上总是很拥挤。

density.example: The density of this city is very high in summer.
density.exampleZh: 这座城市在夏天的密度非常高。

dental.example: Regular dental care helps keep your teeth healthy and strong.
dental.exampleZh: 定期的牙齿护理有助于保持牙齿健康和坚固。

deny.example: She did not deny that she had made a mistake at work.
deny.exampleZh: 她没有否认自己在工作中犯了一个错误。

depart.example: The train will depart from the station at eight tomorrow morning.
depart.exampleZh: 火车将于明天早上八点从车站出发。

department.example: She works in the sales department of a large company.
department.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部工作。

departure.example: Our departure from the hotel is at eight tomorrow morning.
departure.exampleZh: 我们明天早上八点离开酒店。

depend.example: Many small shops depend on local customers for their daily sales.
depend.exampleZh: 许多小商店依靠本地顾客来维持日常销售。

dependent.example: Young children are dependent on their parents for food and care.
dependent.exampleZh: 幼儿依靠父母提供食物和照料。

depict.example: The book depicts life in a small village long ago.
depict.exampleZh: 这本书描绘了很久以前一个小村庄里的生活。

deposit.example: I need to deposit some money in the bank today.
deposit.exampleZh: 我今天需要去银行存一些钱。

depress.example: The bad weather and the long wait began to depress everyone in the group.
depress.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气和漫长的等待开始让团队里的每个人都感到沮丧。

depression.example: The depression of the economy made many people lose their jobs.
depression.exampleZh: 经济萧条使许多人失去了工作。

deputy.example: The manager sent her deputy to the meeting in another city.
deputy.exampleZh: 经理派她的副手去另一个城市参加那个会议。

derive.example: We can derive great pleasure from reading good books every day.
derive.exampleZh: 我们可以通过每天阅读好书获得很大的乐趣。

descend.example: The plane began to descend slowly toward the runway.
descend.exampleZh: 飞机开始缓慢下降，朝跑道飞去。

descendant.example: She is a direct descendant of a famous writer from the last century.
descendant.exampleZh: 她是上世纪一位著名作家的直系后裔。

describe.example: Can you describe the man you saw last night?
describe.exampleZh: 你能描述一下昨晚你看到的那个人吗？

description.example: Can you give me a short description of your new house?
description.exampleZh: 你能简单描述一下你的新房子吗？

desert.example: The camel can walk for days across the hot desert without any water.
desert.exampleZh: 骆驼能在炎热的沙漠中连续行走数天而不喝水。

deserve.example: Good students deserve praise when they work hard every day.
deserve.exampleZh: 好学生每天努力学习时就应该得到表扬。

design.example: She wants to design a small garden behind her new house.
design.exampleZh: 她想在新房子后面设计一个小花园。

designate.example: The manager will designate a new person to lead the morning meeting.
designate.exampleZh: 经理将指定一名新人来主持早会。

desirable.example: A quiet home near the park is desirable for a young family.
desirable.exampleZh: 对年轻家庭来说，公园附近安静的家是值得向往的。

desire.example: She has a strong desire to learn English well.
desire.exampleZh: 她有学好英语的强烈愿望。

desk.example: I put my books and a small lamp on the desk.
desk.exampleZh: 我把书和一盏小台灯放在书桌上。

despair.example: After many failures, he began to despair of ever finding a job.
despair.exampleZh: 多次失败之后，他开始对找到工作感到绝望。

desperate.example: He was desperate for a job after losing his old one.
desperate.exampleZh: 失去旧工作后，他极度渴望得到一份工作。

despise.example: I despise people who are rude to waiters and never say thank you.
despise.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些对服务员无礼、从不说谢谢的人。

despite.example: Despite the heavy rain, we still went to the park.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是去了公园。

dessert.example: We had ice cream for dessert after dinner last night.
dessert.exampleZh: 昨晚晚饭后我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

destination.example: We reached our destination after a long bus ride.
destination.exampleZh: 经过漫长的巴士旅程，我们到达了目的地。

destiny.example: She believes that destiny brought them together after so many years.
destiny.exampleZh: 她相信是命运让他们在这么多年后走到了一起。

destroy.example: The fire destroyed the old house in one night.
destroy.exampleZh: 大火在一夜之间摧毁了那座老房子。

destruction.example: The war brought destruction to many small towns and villages.
destruction.exampleZh: 战争给许多小镇和村庄带来了毁灭。

destructive.example: The storm was very destructive and damaged many homes in our town.
destructive.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨破坏性很强，损坏了我们镇上的许多房屋。

detail.example: Please tell me every detail about your trip to Beijing last week.
detail.exampleZh: 请告诉我你上周北京之行的每一个细节。

detect.example: The doctor can detect the early signs of this common disease.
detect.exampleZh: 医生能察觉这种常见疾病的早期迹象。

determination.example: Her determination to finish the race surprised everyone.
determination.exampleZh: 她完成比赛的决心让所有人感到惊讶。

determine.example: The judges will determine the winner after they hear all the songs.
determine.exampleZh: 评委听完所有歌曲后将决定获胜者。

develop.example: The company plans to develop a new app for young users.
develop.exampleZh: 这家公司计划为年轻用户开发一款新应用。

development.example: The rapid development of the city has created many new jobs.
development.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速发展创造了许多新的就业机会。

device.example: This small device helps us measure the temperature of the water.
device.exampleZh: 这个小装置帮助我们测量水的温度。

devil.example: The devil in the story is clever and very scary.
devil.exampleZh: 故事里的魔鬼既聪明又非常可怕。

devise.example: The team devised a simple plan to save more money this year.
devise.exampleZh: 团队想出了一个简单的计划，以便今年节省更多的钱。

devote.example: She devotes her free time to helping children learn to read.
devote.exampleZh: 她把空闲时间用来帮助孩子们学习阅读。

diagram.example: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board to explain the water cycle.
diagram.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一个简单的示意图来解释水循环。

dial.example: He turned the dial to the left and the light became brighter.
dial.exampleZh: 他把旋钮向左转，灯光变得更亮了。

dialect.example: People in this small village still speak an old dialect at home.
dialect.exampleZh: 这个小村庄的人们在家里仍然讲一种古老的方言。

dialogue.example: The two countries finally began a real dialogue about peace.
dialogue.exampleZh: 两国终于开始就和平进行真正的对话。

diameter.example: The circle has a diameter of ten centimeters across its widest point.
diameter.exampleZh: 这个圆最宽处的直径是十厘米。

diamond.example: She wore a diamond ring on her finger at the party.
diamond.exampleZh: 她在派对上手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。

diary.example: I write in my diary every night before I go to bed.
diary.exampleZh: 我每天晚上睡觉前都会在日记本里写日记。

dictate.example: The manager can dictate letters to his assistant every morning.
dictate.exampleZh: 经理每天早上可以向他的助理口授信件。

dictation.example: The teacher gave us a short dictation in class this morning.
dictation.exampleZh: 今天上午老师在课堂上给我们做了一段简短的听写。

dictator.example: The dictator made all the important decisions for the country.
dictator.exampleZh: 这个独裁者为国家做出所有重要决定。

dictionary.example: I keep a small dictionary on my desk to look up new words.
dictionary.exampleZh: 我在桌上放了一本小词典，用来查新单词。

die.example: My old dog died last winter, and we still miss him.
die.exampleZh: 我的老狗去年冬天死了，我们仍然想念他。

diet.example: My doctor says a healthy diet and daily exercise will help me feel better.
diet.exampleZh: 我的医生说，健康的饮食和每天锻炼会让我感觉更好。

differ.example: Their opinions differ, but they are still good friends.
differ.exampleZh: 他们的意见不同，但仍然是好朋友。

difference.example: There is a big difference between the two pictures on the wall.
difference.exampleZh: 墙上那两幅画之间有很大的差别。

different.example: My brother and I have different hobbies but we are still good friends.
different.exampleZh: 我和我哥哥有不同的爱好，但我们仍然是好朋友。

difficult.example: This math problem is too difficult for me to solve alone.
difficult.exampleZh: 这道数学题太难了，我一个人解不出来。

difficulty.example: I had some difficulty finding your house because the streets all look the same.
difficulty.exampleZh: 我费了些劲才找到你家，因为那些街道看起来都一样。

dig.example: The dog likes to dig in the garden behind our house.
dig.exampleZh: 那只狗喜欢在我们房子后面的花园里挖土。

digest.example: It takes time to digest all the new information from this book.
digest.exampleZh: 消化这本书里的所有新信息需要时间。

digital.example: My new watch shows the time in a digital way.
digital.exampleZh: 我的新手表用数字方式显示时间。

dignity.example: He lost his job but never lost his dignity.
dignity.exampleZh: 他失去了工作，但从未失去尊严。

dilemma.example: She faced a real dilemma when both job offers came on the same day.
dilemma.exampleZh: 当两份工作邀请在同一天到来时，她面临着真正的两难困境。

diligent.example: She is a diligent student who always finishes her homework on time.
diligent.exampleZh: 她是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。

dim.example: The room was dim, so I turned on a small light.
dim.exampleZh: 房间很昏暗，所以我打开了一盏小灯。

dimension.example: We must consider every dimension of the problem before making a decision.
dimension.exampleZh: 在做出决定之前，我们必须考虑这个问题的每一个方面。

diminish.example: The noise from the street began to diminish after the cars left.
diminish.exampleZh: 汽车离开后，街上的噪音开始减小。

dine.example: We often dine at a small restaurant near our home on Sundays.
dine.exampleZh: 我们星期天常在家附近的一家小餐馆吃饭。

dinner.example: We had dinner with our friends at a small restaurant last night.
dinner.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和朋友在一家小餐馆吃了晚餐。

dip.example: She dipped her hand in the cool water and then smiled.
dip.exampleZh: 她把手浸入清凉的水中，然后笑了。

diplomatic.example: She was very diplomatic when she told him his idea needed more work.
diplomatic.exampleZh: 当她告诉他他的想法还需要进一步完善时，她说得非常有策略。

direct.example: The teacher gave us direct instructions before the test began.
direct.exampleZh: 考试开始前，老师给了我们直接的指示。

direction.example: Please read the directions on the box before you start.
direction.exampleZh: 开始之前请阅读包装盒上的用法说明。

directly.example: She went directly home after work and did not stop anywhere.
directly.exampleZh: 她下班后直接回家，没有在任何地方停留。

director.example: The director told the actors to try the scene again.
director.exampleZh: 导演让演员们把这个场景再试一遍。

dirt.example: His shoes were covered with dirt after the long walk.
dirt.exampleZh: 走了很长的路之后，他的鞋上沾满了泥土。

dirty.example: His dirty hands made the clean white towel dirty again.
dirty.exampleZh: 他脏兮兮的手又把干净的白毛巾弄脏了。

disadvantage.example: One big disadvantage of this old phone is its very short battery life.
disadvantage.exampleZh: 这部旧手机的一大缺点就是电池续航时间很短。

disagree.example: My parents disagree with my plan to study art in another city.
disagree.exampleZh: 我父母不同意我去另一个城市学艺术的计划。

disappear.example: The sun disappeared behind the clouds and the sky turned grey.
disappear.exampleZh: 太阳消失在云层后面，天空变得灰暗。

disappoint.example: I hope my answer will not disappoint you.
disappoint.exampleZh: 希望我的回答不会让你失望。

disaster.example: The storm was a disaster for the small town and its people.
disaster.exampleZh: 这场风暴对小镇和它的居民来说是一场灾难。

discard.example: Please discard these old papers before the new staff arrive.
discard.exampleZh: 请在新员工到来之前把这些旧文件丢弃掉。

discharge.example: The factory must not discharge dirty water into the river.
discharge.exampleZh: 工厂不得将脏水排放到河里。

discipline.example: Good discipline helps students learn better and makes the whole class happier.
discipline.exampleZh: 良好的纪律有助于学生更好地学习，也让整个班级更愉快。

disclose.example: He did not disclose the reason for his sudden decision to leave.
disclose.exampleZh: 他没有透露自己突然决定离开的原因。

discount.example: The store gave me a small discount on the shirt.
discount.exampleZh: 商店给我这件衬衫打了一点折扣。

discourage.example: Don't let one mistake discourage you from trying again.
discourage.exampleZh: 不要让一次错误让你泄气而不敢再试。

discover.example: She was happy to discover a small cafe near her new home.
discover.exampleZh: 她很高兴发现新家附近有一家小咖啡馆。

discovery.example: The discovery of the new planet excited scientists around the world.
discovery.exampleZh: 这颗新行星的发现让全世界的科学家都很兴奋。

discuss.example: Let's discuss this problem together after class.
discuss.exampleZh: 我们下课后一起讨论这个问题吧。

discussion.example: We had a long discussion about our plans for the summer holiday.
discussion.exampleZh: 我们花了很长时间讨论暑假的计划。

disease.example: This serious disease can spread quickly from person to person.
disease.exampleZh: 这种严重的疾病可以在人与人之间迅速传播。

disguise.example: He tried to disguise his voice so nobody would know him.
disguise.exampleZh: 他试图伪装自己的声音，这样就没有人会认出他。

disgust.example: She felt deep disgust when she saw the dirty kitchen floor.
disgust.exampleZh: 当她看到脏兮兮的厨房地板时，感到深深的厌恶。

dish.example: She put the hot dish on the table and smiled.
dish.exampleZh: 她把热腾腾的菜放在桌上，笑了笑。

dishonest.example: He was dishonest about the money he lost that day.
dishonest.exampleZh: 他对那天丢失的钱说了谎。

disk.example: I saved all the photos on a disk before the computer broke.
disk.exampleZh: 电脑坏掉之前，我把所有照片都保存到了一张磁盘上。

dislike.example: I dislike getting up early on cold winter mornings.
dislike.exampleZh: 我不喜欢在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

dismiss.example: The manager decided to dismiss two workers who were always late.
dismiss.exampleZh: 经理决定解雇两名总是迟到的工人。

disorder.example: The sudden power cut left the whole office in complete disorder.
disorder.exampleZh: 突然停电让整个办公室陷入了完全的混乱。

display.example: The store will display its new phones near the front door.
display.exampleZh: 这家商店会把新手机陈列在前门附近。

disposal.example: The safe disposal of waste is important for every city.
disposal.exampleZh: 安全处理垃圾对每个城市都很重要。

dispose.example: We must dispose of the old furniture before we move.
dispose.exampleZh: 搬家前我们必须处理掉那些旧家具。

dispute.example: The two countries are trying to settle their long dispute over the border.
dispute.exampleZh: 这两个国家正试图解决他们之间长期的边界争端。

dissolve.example: Stir the sugar in warm water until it dissolves completely.
dissolve.exampleZh: 搅拌糖在温水中，直到它完全溶解。

distance.example: The distance between the two cities is about one hundred miles.
distance.exampleZh: 这两座城市之间的距离大约是一百英里。

distant.example: He lives in a distant city and rarely comes back home.
distant.exampleZh: 他住在一座遥远的城市，很少回家。

distinct.example: The two plans are distinct, so we can choose the better one.
distinct.exampleZh: 这两个方案截然不同，所以我们可以选择更好的那个。

distinction.example: There is a clear distinction between the two plans we discussed today.
distinction.exampleZh: 我们今天讨论的两个方案之间有明显的区别。

distinguish.example: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look almost the same.
distinguish.exampleZh: 很难区分这对双胞胎，因为他们看起来几乎一模一样。

distort.example: The newspaper distorted his words and made the story seem much worse.
distort.exampleZh: 报纸歪曲了他的话，使这件事看起来糟糕得多。

distract.example: Loud music can distract students when they try to study at home.
distract.exampleZh: 大声的音乐会在学生想在家学习时让他们分心。

distress.example: The loss of her old dog caused her great distress for many weeks.
distress.exampleZh: 老狗的死让她悲痛了好几个星期。

distribute.example: Teachers distribute the books to every student at the start of class.
distribute.exampleZh: 老师在课前把书分发给每一位学生。

distribution.example: The distribution of food to the poor families started early this morning.
distribution.exampleZh: 向贫困家庭分发食物的活动今天一早开始了。

district.example: Our school is in a quiet district near the river.
district.exampleZh: 我们学校位于河边一个安静的区域。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb me while I am working in the office.
disturb.exampleZh: 我在办公室工作时请别打扰我。

disturbance.example: The loud noise outside caused a serious disturbance during the exam.
disturbance.exampleZh: 外面的喧闹声在考试期间造成了严重的干扰。

ditch.example: The farmer dug a deep ditch to carry water away from the field.
ditch.exampleZh: 农民挖了一条深沟，把水从田里引走。

dive.example: She likes to dive into the pool and swim for hours.
dive.exampleZh: 她喜欢跳进泳池游上几个小时。

diverse.example: Our class is very diverse, with students from many different countries and cultures.
diverse.exampleZh: 我们班非常多元，学生来自许多不同的国家和文化。

diversion.example: The road was closed, so we had to take a diversion through town.
diversion.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，所以我们只得绕道穿过镇子。

divert.example: The police diverted traffic to another road after the accident.
divert.exampleZh: 事故发生后，警察把车流转移到了另一条路上。

divide.example: The teacher will divide the class into four small groups today.
divide.exampleZh: 老师今天会把班级分成四个小组。

division.example: The company created a new division to handle sales in Asia.
division.exampleZh: 公司成立了一个新部门来处理亚洲的销售业务。

divorce.example: After their divorce, they stayed friends for the sake of their children.
divorce.exampleZh: 离婚后，为了孩子，他们仍然保持朋友关系。

dizzy.example: The heat made me dizzy, so I sat down on the step.
dizzy.exampleZh: 炎热的天气让我头晕目眩，于是我在台阶上坐了下来。

do.example: What do you want to do after school today?
do.exampleZh: 你今天放学后想做什么？

dock.example: The ship will dock at the old harbor before sunset today.
dock.exampleZh: 这艘船今天日落前会在旧港口靠码头。

doctor.example: My mother told me to see a doctor because I felt sick.
doctor.exampleZh: 我妈妈让我去看医生，因为我感觉不舒服。

document.example: Please keep all your important documents in a safe place.
document.exampleZh: 请把你所有重要的文件放在一个安全的地方。

documentary.example: We watched a documentary about wild animals in class today.
documentary.exampleZh: 我们今天在课上看了一部关于野生动物的纪录片。

dog.example: My dog likes to run in the park every morning.
dog.exampleZh: 我的狗喜欢每天早上在公园里奔跑。

doll.example: The little girl carries her favorite doll everywhere she goes.
doll.exampleZh: 这个小女孩走到哪里都带着她最喜欢的洋娃娃。

dollar.example: I only have one dollar in my pocket today.
dollar.exampleZh: 我今天口袋里只有一美元。

domain.example: This subject is outside my domain, so I cannot answer it.
domain.exampleZh: 这个话题不在我的领域内，所以我无法回答。

dome.example: The old church has a large white dome on its roof.
dome.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂屋顶上有一个巨大的白色穹顶。

domestic.example: She spends most of her domestic time cooking and cleaning for the family.
domestic.exampleZh: 她把大部分家庭时间用在为家人做饭和打扫上。

dominant.example: The company is dominant in the local phone market.
dominant.exampleZh: 这家公司在当地手机市场占优势。

dominate.example: The company continues to dominate the local market with its low prices.
dominate.exampleZh: 这家公司凭借低价继续支配着当地市场。

donate.example: Many people donate money to help children in poor areas go to school.
donate.exampleZh: 许多人捐钱帮助贫困地区的孩子上学。

donation.example: She made a small donation to the school library last week.
donation.exampleZh: 上周她向学校图书馆捐了一小笔钱。

door.example: Please close the door when you leave the room.
door.exampleZh: 离开房间时请把门关上。

dormitory.example: The new students share a small dormitory near the school gate.
dormitory.exampleZh: 新生们共用学校大门附近的一间小宿舍。

dose.example: The doctor gave him a small dose of the medicine twice a day.
dose.exampleZh: 医生给他每天两次服用小剂量的这种药。

dot.example: She drew a small dot on the map to mark her house.
dot.exampleZh: 她在地图上画了一个小点来标记她的家。

double.example: She ordered a double room because her sister stayed with her.
double.exampleZh: 她订了一间双人房，因为她妹妹和她一起住。

doubt.example: I doubt he will come to the party tonight.
doubt.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

doubtful.example: I am doubtful that he will come to the party tonight.
doubtful.exampleZh: 我怀疑他今晚不会来参加聚会。

down.example: The old cat climbed down the tall tree and ran home.
down.exampleZh: 那只老猫从高高的树上爬下来，然后跑回了家。

downstairs.example: The kitchen is downstairs, and my bedroom is upstairs on the second floor.
downstairs.exampleZh: 厨房在楼下，我的卧室在二楼楼上。

downward.example: She looked downward at the floor and said nothing.
downward.exampleZh: 她低头看着地板，什么也没说。

dozen.example: We bought a dozen eggs and two bottles of milk this morning.
dozen.exampleZh: 我们今天早上买了一打鸡蛋和两瓶牛奶。

draft.example: She wrote a first draft of the report and sent it to her manager.
draft.exampleZh: 她写了报告的第一稿，然后发给了她的经理。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy box across the room.
drag.exampleZh: 他不得不把那个沉重的箱子拖过房间。

dragon.example: The dragon in the old story breathes fire and guards a golden treasure.
dragon.exampleZh: 这个古老故事里的龙会喷火，并守护着一份金色的宝藏。

drain.example: The heavy rain drained the water from the flooded streets into the drain.
drain.exampleZh: 大雨把洪水泛滥的街道上的水排进了排水沟。

drama.example: The school drama was about a family moving to a new city.
drama.exampleZh: 这部学校戏剧讲的是一个家庭搬到新城市的故事。

dramatic.example: The movie has a dramatic ending that surprised everyone in the theater.
dramatic.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个戏剧性的结局，让影院里的每个人都感到惊讶。

drastic.example: The company made drastic changes to cut costs last year.
drastic.exampleZh: 公司去年为削减成本做出了激烈的变革。

draw.example: The child likes to draw pictures of animals in the park.
draw.exampleZh: 这个孩子喜欢在公园里画动物的图画。

drawer.example: She put the old letters in the top drawer of her desk.
drawer.exampleZh: 她把那些旧信件放进了书桌最上面的抽屉里。

drawing.example: The little boy made a drawing of his family and his dog.
drawing.exampleZh: 这个小男孩画了一幅画，画的是他的家人和他的狗。

dream.example: My dream is to travel around the world with my family.
dream.exampleZh: 我的梦想是和家人一起环游世界。

dress.example: She wore a beautiful dress to the party last night.
dress.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条漂亮的连衣裙去参加聚会。

drift.example: The small boat began to drift slowly away from the shore.
drift.exampleZh: 小船开始慢慢漂离岸边。

drill.example: The workers will drill a deep hole in the wall tomorrow.
drill.exampleZh: 工人们明天会在墙上钻一个深洞。

drink.example: I drink a glass of water every morning before breakfast.
drink.exampleZh: 我每天早上早饭前喝一杯水。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the old pipe onto the floor.
drip.exampleZh: 水开始从旧管道滴到地板上。

drive.example: It takes a lot of drive and hard work to learn a new language well.
drive.exampleZh: 学好一门新语言需要很大的干劲和努力。

driver.example: The driver stopped the car in front of the small school.
driver.exampleZh: 司机把车停在了那所小学校门前。

drop.example: A drop of rain fell on my hand as I walked home.
drop.exampleZh: 我走回家时，一滴雨落在我的手上。

drought.example: The long drought hurt the farmers and many animals died.
drought.exampleZh: 长期的干旱让农民受损，许多动物也死了。

drown.example: The loud music drowned out her voice so no one could hear.
drown.exampleZh: 音乐太大声，淹没了她的声音，没人能听见。

drug.example: The doctor gave him a strong drug to ease the pain.
drug.exampleZh: 医生给他用了一种强效药物来缓解疼痛。

drum.example: He played the drum loudly at the school concert last night.
drum.exampleZh: 昨晚他在学校音乐会上大声地敲鼓。

drunk.example: He was too drunk to drive home last night.
drunk.exampleZh: 他昨晚醉得没法开车回家。

dry.example: The hot sun will dry your wet clothes very quickly.
dry.exampleZh: 炎热的太阳会很快把你的湿衣服晒干。

duck.example: The duck lowered its head to duck under the low bridge.
duck.exampleZh: 那只鸭子低下头，从低矮的桥下钻了过去。

due.example: The rent is due on the first day of each month.
due.exampleZh: 房租在每月的第一天到期。

dull.example: The old knife is dull and cannot cut the bread.
dull.exampleZh: 这把旧刀很钝，切不动面包。

dumb.example: He was struck dumb by the news and could not say a word.
dumb.exampleZh: 这个消息让他哑口无言，一句话也说不出来。

dump.example: They dump old furniture in the empty lot behind our building.
dump.exampleZh: 他们把旧家具倾倒在我们楼后的空地上。

durable.example: This bag is durable and can hold many heavy books.
durable.exampleZh: 这个包很耐用，能装很多厚重的书。

during.example: He fell asleep during the long meeting this afternoon.
during.exampleZh: 他在今天下午那场漫长的会议期间睡着了。

dusk.example: The sky turns red and gold at dusk.
dusk.exampleZh: 黄昏时天空变成了红色和金色。

dust.example: She dusted the old table and cleaned the dust from the shelves.
dust.exampleZh: 她掸去旧桌子上的灰，并清理了架子上的灰尘。

duty.example: It is my duty to help my parents at home.
duty.exampleZh: 在家帮助父母是我的责任。

dwarf.example: The big tree dwarfs the small house next to it.
dwarf.exampleZh: 那棵大树使旁边的小房子相形见绌。

dwell.example: Many small fish dwell in the shallow water near the shore.
dwell.exampleZh: 许多小鱼栖息在靠近岸边的浅水里。

dwelling.example: Their new dwelling is small but very warm in winter.
dwelling.exampleZh: 他们的新住所虽小，但冬天非常暖和。

dye.example: She used a natural dye to make the old white shirt bright red.
dye.exampleZh: 她用一种天然染料把旧白衬衫染成了鲜红色。

dynamic.example: The new teacher brings a dynamic energy to our small class every day.
dynamic.exampleZh: 新老师每天给我们这个小班级带来充满活力的能量。

each.example: Each student in our class has a small desk and a new book.
each.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都有一张小课桌和一本新书。

eager.example: The children are eager to open their gifts on Christmas morning.
eager.exampleZh: 孩子们急切地想在圣诞节早上打开礼物。

eagle.example: We saw a large eagle fly high above the trees.
eagle.exampleZh: 我们看到一只大鹰在树梢上方高高飞翔。

ear.example: My left ear hurts a little after I swim in the cold river.
ear.exampleZh: 在冰冷的河里游泳后，我的左耳有点疼。

early.example: I get up early every morning so I can walk to school.
early.exampleZh: 我每天早上都起得很早，这样就能步行去学校。

earn.example: She works hard every day to earn enough money for her family.
earn.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，为家人挣到足够的钱。

earnest.example: She is an earnest student who always asks questions in class.
earnest.exampleZh: 她是一个认真的学生，总是在课堂上提问。

earnings.example: Her monthly earnings help support the whole family.
earnings.exampleZh: 她的月收入供养着全家。

earth.example: The earth goes around the sun once every year.

earthquake.example: The earthquake broke many old buildings in our small town last night.
earthquake.exampleZh: 昨晚的地震毁坏了我们小镇上的许多老建筑。

ease.example: The soft music helped ease her stress after a long day at work.
ease.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐帮助缓解了她工作一整天后的压力。

easily.example: You can easily find the answer in this book.
easily.exampleZh: 你可以在这本书里轻松找到答案。

east.example: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
east.exampleZh: 太阳在东方升起，在西方落下。

easter.example: We paint colorful eggs and visit our grandparents every Easter.
easter.exampleZh: 每年复活节我们都会画彩蛋并去看望祖父母。

eastern.example: The eastern part of the city has many old temples and quiet streets.
eastern.exampleZh: 这座城市的东部有许多古老的寺庙和安静的街道。

easy.example: This new game is easy to learn and fun for everyone.
easy.exampleZh: 这个新游戏很容易学，对每个人来说都很有趣。

eat.example: We usually eat dinner together at home around seven every evening.
eat.exampleZh: 我们通常每天晚上七点左右在家一起吃晚饭。

echo.example: The echo of her voice came back from the empty hall.
echo.exampleZh: 她的声音从空荡的大厅里传回来，形成了回声。

ecology.example: The ecology of the lake changed a lot after the new factory opened.
ecology.exampleZh: 新工厂开工后，这个湖的生态环境发生了很大变化。

economic.example: The country is going through a difficult economic period right now.
economic.exampleZh: 这个国家目前正经历一个困难的经济时期。

economical.example: This small car is very economical on fuel, so it saves us a lot of money.
economical.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车很省油，所以为我们省下了很多钱。

economics.example: She studies economics at university and wants to work in a bank.
economics.exampleZh: 她在大学学习经济学，希望将来在银行工作。

economy.example: The country's economy is growing slowly this year.
economy.exampleZh: 这个国家的经济今年增长缓慢。

edge.example: The cup is near the edge of the table.

edit.example: I need to edit my essay before I send it to the teacher.
edit.exampleZh: 我需要在把文章交给老师之前先修改一下。

edition.example: This is the first edition of the book and it is very popular.
edition.exampleZh: 这是这本书的第一版，它非常受欢迎。

editor.example: The editor read my story and fixed a few small mistakes.
editor.exampleZh: 编辑读了我的故事，并改正了几个小错误。

editorial.example: The newspaper published an editorial about the new school policy.
editorial.exampleZh: 报纸就新的学校政策发表了一篇社论。

educate.example: Teachers educate children to be kind and honest.
educate.exampleZh: 老师教育孩子们要善良诚实。

education.example: She believes that education can change a person's life.
education.exampleZh: 她相信教育能够改变一个人的一生。

educational.example: The school offers many educational games for young children.
educational.exampleZh: 学校为幼儿提供了许多有教育意义的游戏。

effect.example: The new law will effect big changes in how we work.
effect.exampleZh: 这项新法律将在我们的工作方式上带来重大改变。

effective.example: This new medicine is very effective against the common cold.
effective.exampleZh: 这种新药对普通感冒非常有效。

efficiency.example: The new machine has greatly improved our work efficiency.
efficiency.exampleZh: 这台新机器大大提高了我们的工作效率。

efficient.example: She is an efficient worker who always finishes her tasks on time.
efficient.exampleZh: 她是一位效率很高的员工，总能按时完成工作。

effort.example: She put a lot of effort into her English class this year.
effort.exampleZh: 今年她在英语课上投入了很多努力。

egg.example: I eat one egg every morning before I go to work.
egg.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前吃一个鸡蛋。

eight.example: My little sister is eight years old and loves to draw pictures.
eight.exampleZh: 我的妹妹八岁，喜欢画画。

either.example: You can sit on either side of the table.
either.exampleZh: 你可以坐在桌子的任意一侧。

elaborate.example: He gave an elaborate explanation of how the new machine works.
elaborate.exampleZh: 他对这台新机器的工作原理做了详尽的解释。

elastic.example: The waistband of these pants is elastic, so they fit many people.
elastic.exampleZh: 这条裤子的腰头有弹性，所以适合很多人穿。

elbow.example: He put his elbow on the table and looked out the window.
elbow.exampleZh: 他把胳膊肘放在桌上，望着窗外。

elder.example: My elder sister always helps me with my homework after school.
elder.exampleZh: 我姐姐总是在放学后帮我做作业。

elderly.example: The elderly man walks slowly in the park every morning.
elderly.exampleZh: 那位年长的男士每天早上在公园里慢慢散步。

elect.example: The members will elect a new leader next month.
elect.exampleZh: 成员们下个月将选举一位新领导人。

election.example: The election for class president will be held next Friday.
election.exampleZh: 班长选举将于下周五举行。

electric.example: My father bought an electric car last month and he loves it.
electric.exampleZh: 我父亲上个月买了一辆电动汽车，他非常喜欢它。

electrical.example: The electrical wiring in this old house needs to be replaced soon.
electrical.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的电线需要尽快更换。

electricity.example: We use electricity to light our homes and cook food every day.
electricity.exampleZh: 我们每天用电来照明和做饭。

electron.example: An electron is a very small particle that moves around the center of an atom.
electron.exampleZh: 电子是一种非常小的粒子，它围绕原子中心运动。

electronic.example: My electronic dictionary helps me learn new English words every day.
electronic.exampleZh: 我的电子词典每天帮我学习新的英语单词。

elegant.example: Her elegant dress and quiet smile made everyone in the room feel calm.
elegant.exampleZh: 她优雅的裙子和安静的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到平静。

element.example: Trust is an important element of any good friendship.
