element.exampleZh: 信任是任何良好友谊中的一个重要要素。

elementary.example: My son is learning to read and write at the elementary school near our house.
elementary.exampleZh: 我儿子正在我们家附近的小学学习读书写字。

elephant.example: The elephant is very big and it drinks water with its long trunk.
elephant.exampleZh: 大象非常大，它用长长的鼻子喝水。

elevate.example: The doctor said I should elevate my leg to reduce the swelling.
elevate.exampleZh: 医生说，我应该把腿抬高，以减轻肿胀。

elevator.example: The elevator is slow, so we often walk up the stairs.
elevator.exampleZh: 电梯很慢，所以我们经常走楼梯上去。

eligible.example: Only students who pass the test are eligible for the scholarship.
eligible.exampleZh: 只有通过考试的学生才有资格获得奖学金。

eliminate.example: We must eliminate the bad habit of eating too much sugar.
eliminate.exampleZh: 我们必须消除吃太多糖这个坏习惯。

elite.example: Only a small elite can afford to live in this beautiful old city.
elite.exampleZh: 只有少数精英才住得起这座美丽的古城。

else.example: If the shop is closed, we will try somewhere else.
else.exampleZh: 如果这家店关门了，我们就去别的地方试试。

elsewhere.example: I looked for my keys here, but they must be elsewhere.
elsewhere.exampleZh: 我在这里找过我的钥匙，但它们一定在别处。

embarrass.example: Please do not ask me that question in public because it will embarrass me.
embarrass.exampleZh: 请不要在公共场合问我那个问题，因为那会让我很尴尬。

embassy.example: She went to the embassy to get a visa for her trip.
embassy.exampleZh: 她去大使馆办理旅行签证。

embrace.example: She opened her arms to embrace her old friend at the airport.
embrace.exampleZh: 她在机场张开双臂拥抱了她的老朋友。

emerge.example: New problems emerge when the old rules no longer work.
emerge.exampleZh: 当旧规则不再奏效时，新的问题就会出现。

emergency.example: Please call this number in an emergency.
emergency.exampleZh: 遇到紧急情况时，请拨打这个号码。

emission.example: The new law aims to reduce carbon emissions from cars and factories.
emission.exampleZh: 这项新法律旨在减少汽车和工厂的碳排放。

emit.example: The old factory emits thick black smoke into the air every morning.
emit.exampleZh: 那家老工厂每天早上向空气中排放浓浓的黑烟。

emotion.example: She could not hide the strong emotion in her voice when she spoke.
emotion.exampleZh: 她说话时无法掩饰声音里强烈的情绪。

emotional.example: She felt very emotional when she said goodbye to her old friends.
emotional.exampleZh: 当她向老朋友告别时，她感到非常激动。

emperor.example: The old emperor lived in a large palace with his family.
emperor.exampleZh: 这位年迈的皇帝和他的家人住在一座巨大的宫殿里。

emphasis.example: Our teacher puts great emphasis on reading English every day.
emphasis.exampleZh: 我们老师非常强调每天读英语。

emphasize.example: Teachers often emphasize the importance of reading every day.
emphasize.exampleZh: 老师经常强调每天阅读的重要性。

empire.example: The old empire was very large and had many soldiers.
empire.exampleZh: 这个古老的帝国幅员辽阔，拥有许多士兵。

employ.example: Our company plans to employ twenty new workers next month.
employ.exampleZh: 我们公司计划下个月雇用二十名新员工。

employee.example: The company hired a new employee to work in the sales office.
employee.exampleZh: 公司聘用了一名新员工在销售办公室工作。

employer.example: Her employer gave her a week off after the busy season.
employer.exampleZh: 忙碌季节过后，她的雇主给了她一周假期。

employment.example: He found employment at a small factory near his home.
employment.exampleZh: 他在家附近的一家小工厂找到了工作。

empty.example: He emptied the box because it was empty and old.
empty.exampleZh: 他把箱子倒空了，因为它又空又旧。

enable.example: This new app enables students to study at home easily.
enable.exampleZh: 这个新应用使学生能够在家轻松学习。

enclose.example: The fence encloses the small garden behind our house.
enclose.exampleZh: 这道篱笆围住了我们房子后面的小花园。

encounter.example: Yesterday I had a chance encounter with an old friend on the street.
encounter.exampleZh: 昨天我在街上偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

encourage.example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions in class.
encourage.exampleZh: 老师应该鼓励学生在课堂上提问。

end.example: We waited at the end of the long line.
end.exampleZh: 我们在长长的队伍末端等待。

endanger.example: Pollution and illegal hunting endanger many wild animals in the forest.
endanger.exampleZh: 污染和非法狩猎危及森林里的许多野生动物。

endeavor.example: We will endeavor to finish the project before Friday.
endeavor.exampleZh: 我们将努力在周五前完成这个项目。

ending.example: The movie has a happy ending, so everyone left the theater smiling.
ending.exampleZh: 这部电影有一个幸福的结局，所以大家离开影院时都面带微笑。

endless.example: The long drive through the desert felt endless to the tired children.
endless.exampleZh: 对疲惫的孩子们来说，穿越沙漠的长途车程仿佛没有尽头。

endure.example: She had to endure a long wait at the busy airport.
endure.exampleZh: 她不得不在繁忙的机场忍受漫长的等待。

enemy.example: The brave soldier fought against the enemy and protected his small village.
enemy.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的士兵与敌人作战，保护了他小小的村庄。

energy.example: She has a lot of energy in the morning.

enforce.example: The police must enforce the new traffic rules every day.
enforce.exampleZh: 警察必须每天执行新的交通规则。

engage.example: She likes to engage in outdoor activities with her friends on weekends.
engage.exampleZh: 她喜欢在周末和朋友们一起从事户外活动。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at a small family dinner last night.
engagement.exampleZh: 他们的订婚消息在昨晚的一次小型家庭晚宴上公布了。

engine.example: The car's engine stopped working, so we had to call for help.
engine.exampleZh: 汽车的发动机熄火了，所以我们只好打电话求助。

engineer.example: The engineer designed a small bridge for our town last year.
engineer.exampleZh: 这位工程师去年为我们的城镇设计了一座小桥。

engineering.example: She wants to study engineering at a good university next year.
engineering.exampleZh: 她想明年去一所好大学学习工程学。

enhance.example: Good lighting can enhance the beauty of a small room.
enhance.exampleZh: 良好的照明能提升小房间的美感。

enjoy.example: I really enjoy reading books in the park on sunny days.
enjoy.exampleZh: 在阳光明媚的日子里，我很喜欢在公园里读书。

enlarge.example: We plan to enlarge the small garden behind our house this spring.
enlarge.exampleZh: 我们打算今年春天把屋后的小花园扩大。

enormous.example: The elephant is an enormous animal that lives in Africa.
enormous.exampleZh: 大象是一种生活在非洲的巨大动物。

enough.example: We have enough time to finish the work before dinner.
enough.exampleZh: 我们有足够的时间在晚饭前完成这项工作。

enquire.example: I called the hotel to enquire about the price of a room.
enquire.exampleZh: 我打电话给酒店，询问房间的价格。

enrich.example: Reading good books can enrich your mind and make your life better.
enrich.exampleZh: 读好书能充实你的头脑，让你的生活更美好。

enrol(l).example: You must enroll at the front desk before you can join the class.
enrol(l).exampleZh: 你必须先在服务台登记，然后才能加入这个班级。

ensure.example: Please ensure that the door is locked before you leave.
ensure.exampleZh: 请确保你离开前门是锁好的。

enter.example: She entered the room quietly and sat down next to her friend.
enter.exampleZh: 她悄悄地走进房间，在朋友旁边坐了下来。

enterprise.example: She works for a small enterprise that makes parts for cars.
enterprise.exampleZh: 她在一家生产汽车零件的小企业工作。

entertain.example: We often entertain friends at home on weekends.
entertain.exampleZh: 我们经常在周末招待朋友到家里做客。

entertainment.example: Watching movies with my family is my favorite kind of entertainment.
entertainment.exampleZh: 和家人一起看电影是我最喜欢的娱乐方式。

enthusiasm.example: Her enthusiasm for teaching makes every class interesting and fun.
enthusiasm.exampleZh: 她对教学的热情让每一堂课都变得有趣又好。

enthusiastic.example: She is very enthusiastic about her new job at the school.
enthusiastic.exampleZh: 她对学校里的新工作非常热情。

entire.example: The entire class stayed after school to help clean the room.
entire.exampleZh: 全班同学放学后都留下来帮忙打扫房间。

entitle.example: This ticket entitles you to one free drink at the show.
entitle.exampleZh: 这张票使你有权在演出中免费获得一杯饮料。

entrance.example: We waited for her at the main entrance of the school.
entrance.exampleZh: 我们在学校的正门口等她。

entry.example: The guard checked my entry pass at the main gate.
entry.exampleZh: 警卫在大门检查了我的入场通行证。

environment.example: We must protect the environment for our children and their future.
environment.exampleZh: 我们必须为我们的孩子和他们的未来保护环境。

environmental.example: We must protect the environmental health of our city and its people.
environmental.exampleZh: 我们必须保护我们城市及其居民的环境健康。

envy.example: She felt a little envy when her friend got a better job.
envy.exampleZh: 当她的朋友得到一份更好的工作时，她感到有一点嫉妒。

episode.example: That funny episode happened during our first trip to Japan last year.
episode.exampleZh: 那个有趣的插曲发生在我们去年第一次去日本旅行的时候。

equal.example: In our class, every student is equal and has the same chance to speak.
equal.exampleZh: 在我们班上，每个学生都是平等的，都有同样的发言机会。

equality.example: The law should give all people equality and fair treatment.
equality.exampleZh: 法律应当给予所有人平等和公平的对待。

equation.example: This simple equation shows how the two sides stay equal.
equation.exampleZh: 这个简单的方程式说明了两边如何保持相等。

equip.example: The school equipped every classroom with a new computer.
equip.exampleZh: 学校为每个教室都配备了一台新电脑。

equipment.example: The workers put all the new equipment in the big room.
equipment.exampleZh: 工人们把所有新设备都放在那个大房间里。

equivalent.example: The two cups are equivalent in size, but they have different colors.
equivalent.exampleZh: 这两个杯子大小相等，但颜色不同。

era.example: The internet changed the way people live in this era.
era.exampleZh: 互联网在这个时代改变了人们的生活方式。

erect.example: They plan to erect a new school near the park next year.
erect.exampleZh: 他们计划明年在公园附近建一所新学校。

error.example: This small error in the report caused a big problem for us.
error.exampleZh: 报告中的这个小错误给我们带来了大麻烦。

erupt.example: The volcano could erupt at any time, so the nearby villages were evacuated.
erupt.exampleZh: 这座火山随时可能喷发，因此附近的村庄被疏散了。

escape.example: The little bird tried to escape from the cage, but the door was closed.
escape.exampleZh: 那只小鸟试图从笼子里逃出去，但门是关着的。

especially.example: I love fruit, especially apples and oranges in summer.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是夏天的苹果和橘子。

essay.example: She wrote a short essay about her summer trip to the beach.
essay.exampleZh: 她写了一篇关于她去海滩的暑假旅行的短文。

essence.example: The essence of her idea is simple and clear.
essence.exampleZh: 她的想法的本质简单明了。

essential.example: Water is essential for all living things on Earth.
essential.exampleZh: 水对地球上所有生物都是必需的。

establish.example: The two countries agreed to establish a new trade office last year.
establish.exampleZh: 两国去年同意设立一个新的贸易办事处。

establishment.example: The old hotel is a well-known establishment in our small town.
establishment.exampleZh: 那家老酒店是我们小镇上很有名的机构。

estate.example: His family sold the old house and a small estate near the river.
estate.exampleZh: 他的家人卖掉了那栋老房子和河边的一小块地产。

estimate.example: Can you estimate how much the repairs will cost?
estimate.exampleZh: 你能估算一下修理要花多少钱吗？

evaluate.example: Teachers evaluate our work at the end of each term.
evaluate.exampleZh: 老师在每学期末评价我们的作业。

even.example: Even the youngest students can solve this easy math problem.
even.exampleZh: 即使是最年幼的学生也能解出这道简单的数学题。

evening.example: We often take a walk after dinner in the evening.
evening.exampleZh: 我们经常在傍晚晚饭后散步。

event.example: The school event was fun for all the students and teachers.
event.exampleZh: 这次学校活动对所有师生来说都很有趣。

eventually.example: After many long delays, the train eventually arrived at the station.
eventually.exampleZh: 经过多次长时间延误，火车最终到达了车站。

ever.example: Have you ever seen a rainbow after a summer rain?
ever.exampleZh: 你曾经在夏雨之后见过彩虹吗？

every.example: Every student in my class has a new English book.
every.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都有一本新的英语书。

everybody.example: Everybody in our class likes the new teacher very much.
everybody.exampleZh: 我们班上每个人都非常喜欢这位新老师。

everyday.example: Reading is part of my everyday life, and I enjoy it.
everyday.exampleZh: 阅读是我日常生活的一部分，我很享受它。

everyone.example: Everyone in my class likes to play games after school.
everyone.exampleZh: 我们班每个人放学后都喜欢玩游戏。

everything.example: She told me everything about her trip to the old town.
everything.exampleZh: 她把去老城旅行的每件事都告诉了我。

everywhere.example: I looked everywhere for my keys but could not find them.
everywhere.exampleZh: 我到处找我的钥匙，但找不到。

evidence.example: The police found no evidence that he had broken the law.
evidence.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他违法的证据。

evident.example: It was evident that she was happy with the test results.
evident.exampleZh: 很明显，她对考试结果很满意。

evil.example: In the story, the evil king brought great pain to his people.
evil.exampleZh: 在故事里，邪恶的国王给他的子民带来了巨大的痛苦。

evolution.example: The evolution of language is a slow and complex process.
evolution.exampleZh: 语言的演变是一个缓慢而复杂的过程。

evolve.example: Small ideas can evolve into big changes over time.
evolve.exampleZh: 小小的想法随着时间的推移会逐渐发展成巨大的变化。

exact.example: Please give me the exact time of the meeting tomorrow morning.
exact.exampleZh: 请告诉我明天上午会议的确切时间。

exaggerate.example: Don't exaggerate the problem; it is not as bad as you think.
exaggerate.exampleZh: 别夸大这个问题，它没有你想的那么糟。

exam.example: I have a math exam tomorrow morning, so I need to study tonight.
exam.exampleZh: 我明天上午有一场数学考试，所以今晚我需要学习。

examination.example: The doctor gave him a careful examination and found nothing wrong.
examination.exampleZh: 医生给他做了仔细的检查，没有发现任何问题。

examine.example: The doctor will examine your eyes carefully before giving you new glasses.
examine.exampleZh: 医生会在给你配新眼镜之前仔细检查你的眼睛。

example.example: This is a good example for all of us to follow.
example.exampleZh: 这是我们大家都要学习的一个好榜样。

exceed.example: His daily sales often exceed the weekly goal set by his manager.
exceed.exampleZh: 他的每日销售额经常超过经理设定的每周目标。

exceedingly.example: The math test was exceedingly difficult for most students in our class.
exceedingly.exampleZh: 这次数学考试对我们班大多数学生来说极其困难。

excellent.example: She is an excellent teacher and all her students love her class.
excellent.exampleZh: 她是一位优秀的老师，所有学生都喜欢她的课。

except.example: Everyone went to the party except Tom, who stayed home sick.
except.exampleZh: 除了生病待在家里的汤姆，大家都去参加聚会了。

exception.example: There is one exception to this rule for very young children.
exception.exampleZh: 这条规则对幼儿有一个例外。

excess.example: Eating too much sugar can lead to an excess of weight gain.
excess.exampleZh: 吃太多糖会导致体重过度增加。

excessive.example: Excessive noise from the street makes it hard to sleep at night.
excessive.exampleZh: 街上过多的噪音让人晚上难以入睡。

exchange.example: Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size at the store?
exchange.exampleZh: 我可以在店里把这件衬衫换成大一点的尺码吗？

excite.example: The good news excited all the students in our class.
excite.exampleZh: 这个好消息让我们班上所有的学生都很兴奋。

excitement.example: The children jumped and shouted with excitement when the school trip was announced.
excitement.exampleZh: 学校宣布要去郊游时，孩子们兴奋得又跳又叫。

exciting.example: The football game was very exciting for all the young players.
exciting.exampleZh: 这场足球比赛对所有年轻球员来说都非常令人兴奋。

exclaim.example: She exclaimed with joy when she saw the beautiful gift on the table.
exclaim.exampleZh: 当她看到桌上那份漂亮的礼物时，她高兴地惊叫起来。

exclude.example: We should not exclude him from the game just because he is new.
exclude.exampleZh: 我们不应该仅仅因为他是新来的就把他排除在游戏之外。

exclusive.example: This club is exclusive, so only a few rich people can join it.
exclusive.exampleZh: 这家俱乐部排外，所以只有少数富人能加入。

excuse.example: Please excuse me for being late, but the traffic was very bad this morning.
excuse.exampleZh: 请原谅我迟到了，但今天早上交通非常糟糕。

execute.example: The team will execute the new plan next week.
execute.exampleZh: 团队将在下周执行这项新计划。

executive.example: The executive will meet the new manager in the office this afternoon.
executive.exampleZh: 这位主管今天下午将在办公室会见新经理。

exercise.example: My doctor says I should exercise for thirty minutes every day.
exercise.exampleZh: 我的医生说我应该每天锻炼三十分钟。

exert.example: Teachers exert a strong influence on the students they teach every day.
exert.exampleZh: 教师对每天所教的学生施加着很大的影响。

exhaust.example: The long trip exhausted us, and our car's exhaust was very loud.
exhaust.exampleZh: 长途旅行使我们精疲力尽，而且我们汽车的排气管声音很大。

exhibit.example: The museum will exhibit these old paintings for the first time next month.
exhibit.exampleZh: 博物馆下个月将首次展出这些古老的画作。

exhibition.example: We went to an art exhibition last Sunday and saw many beautiful paintings.
exhibition.exampleZh: 上周日我们去看了一个艺术展览，看到了许多美丽的画作。

exile.example: The poet lived in exile for ten years before he returned home.
exile.exampleZh: 这位诗人在流放中生活了十年才回到家乡。

exist.example: Many old trees exist in this quiet park near my house.
exist.exampleZh: 我家附近这个安静的公园里生长着许多老树。

existence.example: The existence of life on other planets is still a mystery.
existence.exampleZh: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍然是个谜。

exit.example: Please use the exit on the left side of the building.
exit.exampleZh: 请使用大楼左侧的出口。

expand.example: The company plans to expand its business into new markets next year.
expand.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将业务扩展到新的市场。

expansion.example: The company's rapid expansion created many new jobs in the city.
expansion.exampleZh: 公司的快速扩张在城市里创造了许多新工作岗位。

expect.example: We expect the train to arrive on time today.
expect.exampleZh: 我们预计火车今天会准点到达。

expectation.example: Her parents have high expectations for her future.
expectation.exampleZh: 她的父母对她的未来抱有很高的期望。

expense.example: The trip was expensive, so we shared every expense with friends.
expense.exampleZh: 这次旅行很贵，所以我们和朋友分摊了每一笔费用。

expensive.example: This watch is too expensive for me to buy.
expensive.exampleZh: 这块手表太贵了，我买不起。

experience.example: She has a lot of experience in teaching young children.
experience.exampleZh: 她在教幼童方面有很多经验。

experiment.example: We did a simple experiment in class and wrote down the results.
experiment.exampleZh: 我们在课堂上做了一个简单的实验，并记录下了结果。

experimental.example: The team is testing an experimental vaccine in a small study.
experimental.exampleZh: 该团队正在一项小型研究中测试一种实验性疫苗。

expert.example: She is an expert in computer science and often helps students.
expert.exampleZh: 她是计算机科学方面的专家，经常帮助学生。

expertise.example: Her expertise in computer science helped the team solve the problem quickly.
expertise.exampleZh: 她在计算机科学方面的专长帮助团队迅速解决了这个问题。

explain.example: The teacher will explain the new words to us.
explain.exampleZh: 老师会向我们解释这些新单词。

explanation.example: Her explanation was clear, so everyone understood the problem at once.
explanation.exampleZh: 她的解释很清楚，所以大家一下子就明白了这个问题。

explode.example: The old factory exploded last night and many people heard the loud noise.
explode.exampleZh: 那座旧工厂昨晚爆炸了，很多人听到了巨大的响声。

exploit.example: Some companies exploit young workers by making them work long hours for very little pay.
exploit.exampleZh: 一些公司通过让年轻工人长时间工作却只支付很少工资来剥削他们。

exploration.example: Their exploration of the cave took three days and was very dangerous.
exploration.exampleZh: 他们对这个洞穴的勘探花了三天时间，而且非常危险。

explore.example: Scientists went to explore the deep ocean and found many new animals.
explore.exampleZh: 科学家们去探索深海，发现了许多新动物。

explosion.example: The explosion broke every window in the old building.
explosion.exampleZh: 那次爆炸震碎了这栋老楼的所有窗户。

explosive.example: The police found explosive materials in the old house near the river.
explosive.exampleZh: 警方在河边的那所旧房子里发现了爆炸物。

export.example: The country exports coffee to many places around the world.
export.exampleZh: 这个国家向世界许多地方出口咖啡。

expose.example: The report exposed serious problems in the local school system.
expose.exampleZh: 这份报告揭露了当地学校系统中的严重问题。

exposure.example: Long exposure to the sun can harm your skin.
exposure.exampleZh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会伤害你的皮肤。

express.example: She used simple words to express her ideas clearly to the whole class.
express.exampleZh: 她用简单的词向全班清楚地表达了自己的想法。

expression.example: She had a happy expression on her face when she heard the good news.
expression.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时，脸上露出了开心的表情。

extend.example: They plan to extend the school library next year.
extend.exampleZh: 他们计划明年扩大学校的图书馆。

extension.example: The new extension to our house gives us two more rooms.
extension.exampleZh: 我们房子的新扩建部分让我们多了两个房间。

extensive.example: She has extensive knowledge of Chinese history and culture.
extensive.exampleZh: 她对中国历史和文化有广博的知识。

extent.example: To some extent, I agree with your plan, but the cost is still unclear.
extent.exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的计划，但成本仍不清楚。

exterior.example: The exterior walls of the old house are painted white.
exterior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的外墙被漆成白色。

external.example: Our team needs help from an external expert to finish this project.
external.exampleZh: 我们团队需要一位外部专家的帮助来完成这个项目。

extra.example: We need to pay extra money for the hotel room this weekend.
extra.exampleZh: 这个周末我们需要为酒店房间额外付钱。

extraordinary.example: She has an extraordinary ability to remember every name she hears.
extraordinary.exampleZh: 她有一种非凡的能力，能记住听到的每一个名字。

extreme.example: The weather here can be extreme in both summer and winter.
extreme.exampleZh: 这里的天气在夏天和冬天都可能非常极端。

extremely.example: The soup is extremely hot, so let it cool before you eat.
extremely.exampleZh: 汤非常烫，所以吃之前让它凉一凉。

eye.example: She looked me in the eye and told me the truth.
eye.exampleZh: 她直视我的眼睛，告诉了我真相。

eyesight.example: Good eyesight helps you read small words in a book.
eyesight.exampleZh: 良好的视力能帮助你读书里的小字。

fabric.example: The soft fabric of her dress feels nice on the skin.
fabric.exampleZh: 她裙子的柔软布料触感很好。

face.example: She washed her face and looked at the morning sky.
face.exampleZh: 她洗了脸，望着早晨的天空。

facet.example: We must consider every facet of the problem before making a decision.
facet.exampleZh: 在做决定之前，我们必须考虑问题的每一个方面。

faceup.example: She laid the cards faceup on the table so everyone could see them.
faceup.exampleZh: 她把牌面朝上摆在桌上，让所有人都能看到。

facilitate.example: Good roads facilitate travel between small towns and big cities.
facilitate.exampleZh: 良好的道路使小城镇与大城市的往来更加便利。

facility.example: The new school has excellent sports facilities for all the students.
facility.exampleZh: 这所新学校为所有学生提供了极好的体育设施。

fact.example: The fact that she passed the test surprised everyone in the class.
fact.exampleZh: 她通过考试这一事实让班上所有人都感到惊讶。

factor.example: Money is an important factor when people choose a new job.
factor.exampleZh: 人们在选择新工作时，金钱是一个重要的因素。

factory.example: My father works in a large factory near our home.
factory.exampleZh: 我父亲在我们家附近的一家大工厂工作。

faculty.example: The faculty meet every month to discuss changes to the courses.
faculty.exampleZh: 全体教员每月开会讨论课程的调整。

fade.example: The bright colors of the old curtains faded after many years in the sun.
fade.exampleZh: 旧窗帘的鲜艳颜色在多年日晒后褪去了。

fail.example: He studied hard and did not fail the test.
fail.exampleZh: 他努力学习，考试没有不及格。

failure.example: His failure to answer the letter made his parents worry a lot.
failure.exampleZh: 他没有回信，这让他的父母非常担心。

faint.example: The faint sound of music came from the room across the hall.
faint.exampleZh: 微弱的音乐声从走廊对面的房间传来。

fair.example: The teacher tries to be fair to every student in her class.
fair.exampleZh: 这位老师努力公平地对待班上的每一位学生。

fairly.example: The teacher treated all her students fairly and listened to everyone.
fairly.exampleZh: 老师公平地对待所有学生，并倾听每个人的意见。

fairy.example: The little girl believes a fairy lives in the garden behind her house.
fairy.exampleZh: 小女孩相信她家后面的花园里住着一位仙女。

faith.example: Her faith in her friends helped her through a very hard year.
faith.exampleZh: 她对朋友的信任帮助她度过了一个非常艰难的一年。

faithful.example: She is a faithful friend who always helps me when I need it.
faithful.exampleZh: 她是一个忠实的朋友，在我需要帮助时总是帮我。

fake.example: He tried to fake a smile when he heard the bad news.
fake.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，他试图挤出一个假笑。

fall.example: Leaves fall from the trees in autumn and cover the ground.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天树叶从树上落下，铺满地面。

false.example: His answer was false, so the teacher asked him to try again.
false.exampleZh: 他的答案是错误的，所以老师让他再试一次。

fame.example: The young singer became rich and famous after she rose to fame.
fame.exampleZh: 那位年轻歌手成名后变得富有又有名。

familiar.example: I am familiar with the streets around my new home.
familiar.exampleZh: 我对新家周围的街道很熟悉。

family.example: My family lives in a small house near the river.
family.exampleZh: 我的家人住在河边的一所小房子里。

famine.example: The long drought caused a serious famine in the small country.
famine.exampleZh: 长期干旱在这个小国引发了严重的饥荒。

famous.example: This city is famous for its beautiful parks and old buildings.
famous.exampleZh: 这座城市以其美丽的公园和古老的建筑而闻名。

fan.example: The fan is too loud, but the fans in the front row love it.
fan.exampleZh: 风扇太吵了，但前排的粉丝们很喜欢它。

fancy.example: She wore a fancy dress to the party last night.
fancy.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条花哨的连衣裙去参加聚会。

far.example: The school is not far from my home, so I walk there every day.
far.exampleZh: 学校离我家不远，所以我每天走着去。

fare.example: She paid the bus fare and sat down near the window.
fare.exampleZh: 她付了公交车费，在窗边坐了下来。

farewell.example: We had a party to say farewell to our teacher.
farewell.exampleZh: 我们举办了一场聚会向老师告别。

farm.example: My uncle grows rice and vegetables on a small farm near the river.
farm.exampleZh: 我叔叔在河边的一个小农场里种水稻和蔬菜。

farmer.example: The farmer gets up early every morning to feed his animals.
farmer.exampleZh: 这位农民每天早上早起喂他的动物。

farther.example: My school is farther from home than the bus stop.
farther.exampleZh: 我的学校离家比公交车站更远。

fascinate.example: Old maps always fascinate my little brother for hours.
fascinate.exampleZh: 旧地图总能让我的小弟弟着迷好几个小时。

fascinating.example: The history of space travel is fascinating to many young students.
fascinating.exampleZh: 太空旅行的历史对许多年轻学生来说非常迷人。

fashion.example: She works in fashion and makes clothes in her own way.
fashion.exampleZh: 她在时尚行业工作，并用自己的方式制作衣服。

fashionable.example: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
fashionable.exampleZh: 她上班总是穿时髦的衣服。

fast.example: The fast horse ran fast, and we had to fast all day.
fast.exampleZh: 那匹快马跑得很快，而我们不得不整天禁食。

fasten.example: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
fasten.exampleZh: 请在飞机起飞前系好安全带。

fat.example: This fat cat likes to sleep on my warm bed all day.
fat.exampleZh: 这只胖猫喜欢整天睡在我温暖的床上。

fatal.example: The driver made one fatal mistake and the car hit the tree.
fatal.exampleZh: 司机犯了一个致命的错误，汽车撞上了树。

fate.example: She believed fate brought them together after all those years.
fate.exampleZh: 她相信是命运在那么多年后让他们走到了一起。

father.example: My father taught me how to ride a bike last summer.
father.exampleZh: 去年夏天，我父亲教我学骑自行车。

fatigue.example: After the long trip, he felt great fatigue and went to bed early.
fatigue.exampleZh: 长途旅行后，他感到非常疲劳，早早就上床睡觉了。

fault.example: It is not my fault that the bus came late today.
fault.exampleZh: 今天公交车晚点不是我的错。

faulty.example: The faulty radio made a loud noise and then stopped working.
faulty.exampleZh: 那台有毛病的收音机发出很大的噪音，然后就不工作了。

favor.example: She asked a favor of her teacher and he kindly agreed.
favor.exampleZh: 她向老师请求帮助，老师欣然同意了。

favorable.example: The weather was favorable for our trip to the beach.
favorable.exampleZh: 天气对我们的海滩之旅很有利。

favorite.example: My favorite food is noodles with fresh vegetables.
favorite.exampleZh: 我最喜爱的食物是配新鲜蔬菜的面条。

fear.example: Many people fear failure, but fear can also help us stay safe.
fear.exampleZh: 许多人害怕失败，但恐惧也能帮助我们保持安全。

fearful.example: The fearful storm kept everyone inside the small house all night.
fearful.exampleZh: 那场可怕的暴风雨让大家整夜都待在小房子里。

feasible.example: It is not feasible to finish the whole project in one week.
feasible.exampleZh: 在一周内完成整个项目是不可行的。

feast.example: Every year our family has a big feast on New Year's Day.
feast.exampleZh: 每年元旦，我们家都会摆一桌丰盛的筵席。

feat.example: Climbing that mountain alone was a great feat for the young boy.
feat.exampleZh: 独自爬上那座山对这个男孩来说是一项伟大的壮举。

feature.example: The main feature of this phone is its very long battery life.
feature.exampleZh: 这款手机的主要特色是电池续航时间很长。

february.example: My birthday is in February, and it is usually very cold here.
february.exampleZh: 我的生日在二月，这里通常非常冷。

federal.example: The federal government makes laws that all states must follow.
federal.exampleZh: 联邦政府制定的法律，所有州都必须遵守。

fee.example: The school fee is not very high for students in this small town.
fee.exampleZh: 这座小镇学生的学费并不太高。

feeble.example: The old man was too feeble to walk up the stairs alone.
feeble.exampleZh: 那位老人太虚弱了，无法独自走上楼梯。

feed.example: Farmers feed the cows fresh grass every morning before sunrise.
feed.exampleZh: 农民每天日出前用新鲜的草喂奶牛。

feedback.example: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my English essay.
feedback.exampleZh: 老师对我的英语作文给出了有用的反馈。

feel.example: I can feel the soft wool under my fingers.
feel.exampleZh: 我能感觉到手指下柔软的羊毛。

feeling.example: I have a bad feeling about this test today.
feeling.exampleZh: 我对今天的这场考试有种不好的感觉。

fellow.example: My fellow workers are friendly and helpful to me every day.
fellow.exampleZh: 我的同事们每天都对我友好又乐于助人。

fellowship.example: The fellowship between the two old friends lasted for over forty years.
fellowship.exampleZh: 这两位老朋友之间的友谊持续了四十多年。

female.example: The female doctor explained the medicine to the patient very clearly.
female.exampleZh: 这位女医生非常清楚地向病人解释了这种药。

fence.example: The old farmer built a wooden fence around his small garden.
fence.exampleZh: 那位老农夫在他的小花园周围搭了一道木栅栏。

ferry.example: We take the ferry across the river to visit our grandmother every Sunday.
ferry.exampleZh: 我们每周日乘渡船过河去看望奶奶。

fertile.example: The soil near the river is very fertile and good for farming.
fertile.exampleZh: 河边的土壤非常肥沃，适合耕种。

fertilizer.example: The farmer put fertilizer on his corn field before the rain came.
fertilizer.exampleZh: 下雨前，农民在玉米地里施了肥。

festival.example: The whole town comes together to celebrate the music festival every summer.
festival.exampleZh: 每年夏天，全镇的人都会聚在一起庆祝这个音乐节。

fetch.example: Could you fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen?
fetch.exampleZh: 你能去厨房给我拿一杯水来吗？

fever.example: She has a high fever and needs to stay in bed today.
fever.exampleZh: 她发高烧，今天需要卧床休息。

few.example: Few people know the answer to this difficult question.
few.exampleZh: 很少有人知道这道难题的答案。

fiber.example: Vegetables and fruit are good for you because they are full of fiber.
fiber.exampleZh: 蔬菜和水果对你有好处，因为它们富含纤维。

fiction.example: His story about the lost key was pure fiction.
fiction.exampleZh: 他关于丢失钥匙的说法纯属捏造。

field.example: The farmer works in the field from morning to night.
field.exampleZh: 农民从早到晚在田里干活。

fierce.example: The fierce dog barked loudly at every stranger who walked past the gate.
fierce.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对着每个经过大门的陌生人狂吠。

fifteen.example: The little boy counted fifteen red apples in the big basket.
fifteen.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在大篮子里数出了十五个红苹果。

fifth.example: My office is on the fifth floor of that tall building.
fifth.exampleZh: 我的办公室在那栋高楼的第五层。

fifty.example: My grandfather is fifty years old and still works in his garden every day.
fifty.exampleZh: 我的祖父五十岁了，仍然每天在他的花园里干活。

fight.example: The two brothers often fight, but they still love each other.
fight.exampleZh: 两兄弟经常打架，但他们仍然彼此相爱。

figure.example: The figure in the painting looks like a famous old king.
figure.exampleZh: 画中的人物看起来像一位著名的老国王。

file.example: Please file these reports in the top drawer before the meeting.
file.exampleZh: 请在会议前把这些报告归档到最上面的抽屉里。

fill.example: Please fill the glass with water before you put it on the table.
fill.exampleZh: 请把杯子装满水，再放到桌子上。

film.example: She likes to film short movies on her phone.
film.exampleZh: 她喜欢用手机拍摄短片。

filter.example: This filter removes dirt from the water so we can drink it.
filter.exampleZh: 这个过滤器能去除水中的杂质，让我们可以饮用。

final.example: Our final exam will be next Friday morning in the main hall.
final.exampleZh: 我们的期末考试将在下周五上午于主楼大厅举行。

finally.example: After many long delays, the train finally arrived at the station.
finally.exampleZh: 经过多次长时间延误，火车终于到站了。

finance.example: The company needs more finance to build its new factory this year.
finance.exampleZh: 公司今年需要更多资金来建造新工厂。

financial.example: She works in a financial company in the city center.
financial.exampleZh: 她在市中心的一家金融公司工作。

find.example: She was happy to find her lost keys under the sofa.
find.exampleZh: 她很高兴在沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

finding.example: The new findings may help us solve the problem.
finding.exampleZh: 这些新的研究结果可能有助于我们解决这个问题。

fine.example: The weather is fine today, so let us go for a walk.
fine.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，我们去散步吧。

finger.example: She cut her finger while cooking dinner last night.
finger.exampleZh: 她昨晚做晚饭时切到了手指。

finish.example: We must finish the report before the meeting starts.
finish.exampleZh: 我们必须在会议开始前完成这份报告。

fire.example: The old man sat by the fire and told us a story.
fire.exampleZh: 老人坐在炉火旁给我们讲了一个故事。

fireman.example: The fireman ran into the burning house to save the little girl.
fireman.exampleZh: 那名消防队员冲进着火的房子去救那个小女孩。

firm.example: She works for a small firm that makes strong wooden chairs.
firm.exampleZh: 她在一家制作坚固木椅的小公司工作。

first.example: This is my first time to visit Beijing with my family.
first.exampleZh: 这是我第一次和家人一起游览北京。

fish.example: We caught a big fish in the river yesterday.
fish.exampleZh: 我们昨天在河里抓到了一条大鱼。

fisherman.example: The fisherman goes to the sea early every morning with his small boat.
fisherman.exampleZh: 这位渔民每天早上都带着他的小船出海。

fist.example: He hit the table with his fist and everyone became quiet.
fist.exampleZh: 他用拳头捶了一下桌子，所有人都安静了下来。

fit.example: These shoes fit me well, and the color is very suitable for summer.
fit.exampleZh: 这双鞋很合我的脚，颜色也很适合夏天。

fitness.example: Regular exercise is important for your fitness and your health.
fitness.exampleZh: 规律锻炼对你的体能和健康都很重要。

fitting.example: It is fitting that we thank her for the fittings she installed.
fitting.exampleZh: 我们感谢她安装的那些配件，这是恰当的。

five.example: My little sister is five years old and she starts school today.
five.exampleZh: 我妹妹五岁了，她今天开始上学。

fix.example: My father can fix the old bike in about an hour.
fix.exampleZh: 我爸爸能在一个小时左右修好这辆旧自行车。

flag.example: The red flag is easy to see from far away.
flag.exampleZh: 这面红旗从远处很容易看见。

flame.example: The old man watched the flame in the fireplace and felt warm.
flame.exampleZh: 老人看着壁炉里的火焰，感到温暖。

flash.example: A bright flash of lightning lit up the whole sky last night.
flash.exampleZh: 昨晚一道明亮的闪电照亮了整个天空。

flat.example: My new flat has a flat roof and a flat screen TV.
flat.exampleZh: 我的新公寓有一个平屋顶和一台平板电视。

flatter.example: He tried to flatter his boss to get a better job.
flatter.exampleZh: 他试图奉承老板以获得一份更好的工作。

flavor.example: This soup has a rich flavor, and I like it very much.
flavor.exampleZh: 这汤味道浓郁，我非常喜欢。

flaw.example: The only flaw in this old table is a small crack on the side.
flaw.exampleZh: 这张旧桌子唯一的瑕疵是侧面有一条小裂缝。

flee.example: The family had to flee their home when the fire started.
flee.exampleZh: 火灾发生时，这家人不得不逃离他们的家。

fleet.example: The company owns a large fleet of trucks that deliver goods across the country.
fleet.exampleZh: 这家公司拥有一个庞大的车队，把货物运送到全国各地。

flesh.example: The soft flesh of the peach is sweet and easy to eat.
flesh.exampleZh: 桃子柔软的果肉很甜，也很容易吃。

flexible.example: This flexible rope is easy to bend and carry.
flexible.exampleZh: 这根柔韧的绳子容易弯曲，也便于携带。

flight.example: Our flight to Beijing was delayed for two hours because of heavy snow.
flight.exampleZh: 由于大雪，我们飞往北京的航班延误了两个小时。

fling.example: He took a quick fling at the ball and missed it.
fling.exampleZh: 他朝球猛掷了一下，但没击中。

float.example: A small red boat can float on the calm water near the beach.
float.exampleZh: 一艘红色小船可以漂浮在海滩附近平静的水面上。

flock.example: A flock of birds flew over the lake this morning.
flock.exampleZh: 今天早上，一群鸟飞过了湖面。

flood.example: Heavy rain caused a flood that covered the roads and many houses.
flood.exampleZh: 大雨引发了一场洪水，淹没了道路和许多房屋。

floor.example: The children sat on the floor and played with their toys.
floor.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在地板上玩玩具。

flour.example: She bought a bag of flour to make bread for her family.
flour.exampleZh: 她买了一袋面粉，为家人做面包。

flourish.example: The small garden began to flourish after the spring rain.
flourish.exampleZh: 春雨过后，这个小花园开始枝繁叶茂。

flow.example: The river flows slowly through the small town and past the old bridge.
flow.exampleZh: 河水缓缓流过小镇，经过那座老桥。

flower.example: The garden is full of flowers in spring, and the roses flower early this year.
flower.exampleZh: 春天花园里开满了花，今年玫瑰开得早。

flu.example: My brother had the flu last week and stayed home from school.
flu.exampleZh: 我弟弟上周得了流感，待在家里没去上学。

fluctuate.example: Prices often fluctuate during the year, so we check them every week.
fluctuate.exampleZh: 价格在一年中经常波动，所以我们每周都会查看。

fluent.example: She speaks fluent English and can talk with visitors from many countries.
fluent.exampleZh: 她能说流利的英语，可以和来自许多国家的访客交谈。

fluid.example: The doctor told him to drink more fluids and rest for two days.
fluid.exampleZh: 医生让他多喝流质并休息两天。

flush.example: Her face began to flush when she saw the surprise party.
flush.exampleZh: 看到惊喜派对时，她的脸开始发红。

fly.example: A fly landed on my bread, so I waved it away quickly.
fly.exampleZh: 一只苍蝇落在我的面包上，所以我很快把它挥走了。

foam.example: The waves left white foam on the sand after the storm.
foam.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，海浪在沙滩上留下白色的泡沫。

focus.example: Please focus on your homework and turn off the TV.
focus.exampleZh: 请专心做作业，把电视关掉。

fog.example: The thick fog made it hard for us to see the road.
fog.exampleZh: 浓雾让我们很难看清道路。

foggy.example: It was foggy this morning, so we drove to school very slowly.
foggy.exampleZh: 今天早上有雾，所以我们开车去学校开得很慢。

fold.example: She will fold the clean clothes and put them in the drawer.
fold.exampleZh: 她将把干净的衣服叠好，放进抽屉里。

folk.example: My grandmother loves old folk songs and often sings them at family gatherings.
folk.exampleZh: 我奶奶喜欢古老的民歌，常在家庭聚会上唱它们。

follow.example: Please follow me and I will show you the way.
follow.exampleZh: 请跟着我，我来给你指路。

following.example: Please read the following words and write them down in your notebook.
following.exampleZh: 请读下列单词并把它们写在笔记本上。

food.example: We buy fresh food at the market every week.
food.exampleZh: 我们每周都在市场上买新鲜的食物。

fool.example: Do not fool your friends, or they will think you are a fool.
fool.exampleZh: 不要愚弄你的朋友，否则他们会觉得你是个傻子。

foolish.example: It was foolish of him to leave his umbrella at home on a rainy day.
foolish.exampleZh: 他在下雨天把伞留在家里，真是愚蠢。

foot.example: My left foot hurts after the long walk.
foot.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我的左脚疼。

football.example: My brother plays football with his friends every Saturday afternoon.
football.exampleZh: 我弟弟每周六下午都和他的朋友们踢足球。

footstep.example: I heard his footsteps on the stairs late last night.
footstep.exampleZh: 昨晚很晚我听到楼梯上他的脚步声。

for.example: I bought this book for you because you like history.
for.exampleZh: 我买了这本书给你，因为你喜欢历史。

forbid.example: The school forbids students from using phones during class.
forbid.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

force.example: The police had to use force to stop the crowd.
force.exampleZh: 警察不得不使用武力来阻止人群。

forecast.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
forecast.exampleZh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

forehead.example: She put her hand on his forehead to check for a fever.
forehead.exampleZh: 她把手放在他的额头上，看看他有没有发烧。

foreign.example: She learned a foreign language before her first trip abroad.
foreign.exampleZh: 她在第一次出国旅行前学了一门外语。

foreigner.example: Many foreigners come to China to study Chinese and learn about its culture.
foreigner.exampleZh: 许多外国人来中国学习中文并了解中国文化。

foremost.example: She is one of the foremost doctors in our city today.
foremost.exampleZh: 她是当今我们城市最重要的医生之一。

foresee.example: We cannot foresee what will happen next year.
foresee.exampleZh: 我们无法预见明年会发生什么。

forest.example: We walked through the forest and saw many tall trees.
forest.exampleZh: 我们穿过森林，看见了许多高大的树木。

forever.example: I will remember the happy days we spent together forever.
forever.exampleZh: 我会永远记得我们一起度过的快乐时光。

forge.example: The blacksmith used fire and a hammer to forge a strong iron knife.
forge.exampleZh: 铁匠用火和锤子锻造了一把结实的铁刀。

forget.example: Don't forget to bring your book to school tomorrow morning.
forget.exampleZh: 别忘了明天早上把书带到学校。

forgive.example: She could not forgive her brother for breaking her favorite cup.
forgive.exampleZh: 她无法原谅弟弟打碎了她最喜欢的杯子。

fork.example: She put a clean fork next to my plate on the table.
fork.exampleZh: 她把一把干净的餐叉放在桌上我的盘子旁边。

form.example: Ice is a solid form of water and it melts quickly.
form.exampleZh: 冰是水的一种固态形式，它会很快融化。

formal.example: He wore a formal suit to the important meeting yesterday.
formal.exampleZh: 他昨天穿了一套正式的西装去参加那个重要的会议。

format.example: Please change the format of this file before you send it.
format.exampleZh: 发送这个文件之前，请先更改它的格式。

formation.example: The formation of the new team took several weeks.
formation.exampleZh: 新团队的形成花了几个星期。

former.example: She met her former teacher at the store yesterday.
former.exampleZh: 她昨天在商店里遇到了她以前的老师。

formula.example: The scientist wrote a simple formula on the board for his students.
formula.exampleZh: 科学家在黑板上为学生们写下一个简单的公式。

formulate.example: The team will formulate a simple plan for the new project.
formulate.exampleZh: 团队将为这个新项目系统地制定一个简单的计划。

forth.example: The sun came forth from behind the clouds after the rain.
forth.exampleZh: 雨后，太阳从云层后面露了出来。

forthcoming.example: The details of the forthcoming meeting are now available to everyone.
forthcoming.exampleZh: 即将举行的会议的细节现在对所有人都是可获得的。

fortnight.example: We will go on a trip to the mountains for a fortnight next month.
fortnight.exampleZh: 下个月我们会去山里旅行两星期。

fortunate.example: I feel fortunate to have good friends who help me every day.
fortunate.exampleZh: 我很幸运，有每天都帮助我的好朋友。

fortunately.example: Fortunately, I found my lost keys under the sofa.
fortunately.exampleZh: 幸运的是，我在沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

fortune.example: He made a large fortune by selling simple toys to children.
fortune.exampleZh: 他靠向孩子们出售简单的玩具赚了一大笔钱。

forty.example: There are forty students in my class this year.
forty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有四十名学生。

forum.example: The school forum lets students share ideas about new clubs.
forum.exampleZh: 学校的论坛让学生们分享关于新社团的想法。

forward.example: She took a step forward and smiled at the crowd.
forward.exampleZh: 她向前迈了一步，对着人群微笑。

fossil.example: Scientists found a fossil of a small fish in the desert rock.
fossil.exampleZh: 科学家在沙漠岩石中发现了一块小鱼化石。

foster.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
foster.exampleZh: 好老师培养学生的求知欲。

foul.example: The dirty old kitchen smelled foul, so we cleaned it before cooking.
foul.exampleZh: 那个肮脏的旧厨房散发着恶臭，所以我们在做饭前把它打扫干净了。

found.example: They decided to found a small school in their village.
found.exampleZh: 他们决定在自己的村庄里创办一所小学校。

foundation.example: The new school was built on a strong foundation of stone.
foundation.exampleZh: 这所新学校建在坚固的石头地基上。

founder.example: The founder of the small school wanted every child to learn to read.
founder.exampleZh: 这所小学校的创始人希望每个孩子都能学会阅读。

fountain.example: The children love to play near the fountain in the park.
fountain.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。

four.example: There are four apples on the table.

fourteen.example: My sister is fourteen years old and she loves playing basketball.
fourteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十四岁，她喜欢打篮球。

fourth.example: This is the fourth time I have read this book.
fourth.exampleZh: 这是我第四次读这本书。

fox.example: The fox ran across the field and hid behind a big tree.
fox.exampleZh: 那只狐狸跑过田野，躲到了一棵大树后面。

fraction.example: Only a small fraction of the students came to the meeting today.
fraction.exampleZh: 今天只有一小部分学生来参加会议。

fracture.example: The doctor said the small crack in my arm was a minor fracture.
fracture.exampleZh: 医生说我手臂上的小裂缝是轻微骨折。

fragment.example: She found a small fragment of glass on the kitchen floor.
fragment.exampleZh: 她在厨房地板上发现了一小块玻璃碎片。

frame.example: The frame of the old house is still strong after many years.
frame.exampleZh: 这座老房子的框架在多年之后依然很结实。

framework.example: The new framework helps us organize our work more clearly.
framework.exampleZh: 这个新框架帮助我们更有条理地组织工作。

frank.example: To be frank, I do not like the plan at all.
frank.exampleZh: 坦白说，我一点也不喜欢这个计划。

free.example: The museum is free for students, so we can go this afternoon.
free.exampleZh: 博物馆对学生免费，所以我们今天下午可以去。

freedom.example: Students at this school enjoy great freedom to choose their own books.
freedom.exampleZh: 这所学校的学生享有很大的自由去选择自己的书。

freeway.example: We drove on the freeway for two hours to visit my grandparents.
freeway.exampleZh: 我们沿着高速公路开了两个小时去看望我的祖父母。

freeze.example: Water will freeze into ice when the temperature drops below zero.
freeze.exampleZh: 当温度降到零度以下时，水会结成冰。

freight.example: The freight train carries heavy goods across the country every day.
freight.exampleZh: 这列货运列车每天运送重货穿越全国。

frequency.example: The frequency of his visits decreased after he moved to another city.
frequency.exampleZh: 他搬到另一个城市后，来访的频率降低了。

frequent.example: Heavy rain is frequent in this city during summer.
frequent.exampleZh: 夏天这座城市经常下大雨。

fresh.example: I bought some fresh fruit and vegetables at the small market this morning.
fresh.exampleZh: 今天早上我在那个小市场买了些新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

freshman.example: My brother is a freshman at a big university this year.
freshman.exampleZh: 我哥哥今年是一所大型大学的大一新生。

friction.example: There was some friction between the two teams at first.
friction.exampleZh: 起初两个团队之间存在一些摩擦。

friday.example: We will meet again this Friday to finish the group project.
friday.exampleZh: 我们这个星期五会再见面，完成小组项目。

fridge.example: Please put the milk in the fridge after you open it.
fridge.exampleZh: 打开牛奶后请把它放进冰箱。

friend.example: My best friend helped me move to a new apartment last weekend.
friend.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友上周末帮我搬到了新公寓。

friendly.example: Our new neighbors are very friendly and often help us.
friendly.exampleZh: 我们的新邻居非常友好，经常帮助我们。

friendship.example: True friendship is built on trust and honest talks between two people.
friendship.exampleZh: 真正的友谊建立在两个人之间的信任和坦诚交流之上。

fright.example: The loud noise gave the little girl a terrible fright.
fright.exampleZh: 那声巨响把小女孩吓了一大跳。

frighten.example: The loud noise from the street frightened my little sister last night.
frighten.exampleZh: 昨晚街上的巨响吓到了我的小妹妹。

frog.example: A green frog jumped from the wet grass into the small pond.
frog.exampleZh: 一只绿色的青蛙从湿漉漉的草丛跳进了小池塘里。

from.example: She walked home from the library after finishing her work.
from.exampleZh: 她完成工作后从图书馆步行回家。

front.example: The front of the old house faces a small garden with many flowers.
front.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的正面朝向一座种着许多花的小花园。

frontier.example: They traveled west to the frontier in search of new land.
frontier.exampleZh: 他们向西前往边疆，寻找新的土地。

frost.example: The frost on the grass made the path very slippery this morning.
frost.exampleZh: 今天早上草地上的霜让小路变得很滑。

frown.example: The teacher frowned when she saw the messy homework on my desk.
frown.exampleZh: 老师看到我桌上凌乱的作业时皱了皱眉。

fruit.example: Eating fresh fruit every day is good for your health.
fruit.exampleZh: 每天吃新鲜水果对你的健康有好处。

fruitful.example: The long talk with my teacher was very fruitful for me.
fruitful.exampleZh: 和老师的那次长谈对我来说非常富有成效。

frustrate.example: His boss kept changing the plan, which frustrated everyone on the team.
frustrate.exampleZh: 他的老板不断改变计划，这让团队里的每个人都感到沮丧。

fry.example: I like to fry two eggs for breakfast every morning.
fry.exampleZh: 我喜欢每天早上煎两个鸡蛋当早餐。

fuel.example: The rising cost of fuel makes life hard for many poor families.
fuel.exampleZh: 燃料价格的上涨让许多贫困家庭的生活变得艰难。

fulfill.example: She worked hard every day to fulfill her dream of becoming a doctor.
fulfill.exampleZh: 她每天努力工作，以实现成为医生的梦想。

full.example: The glass is full of cold water from the kitchen.
full.exampleZh: 杯子装满了厨房里的凉水。

fun.example: We had a lot of fun at the party last night.
fun.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

function.example: The main function of this small tool is to cut paper.
function.exampleZh: 这个小工具的主要功能是裁纸。

fund.example: We used the fund to buy new books for the school.
fund.exampleZh: 我们用这笔基金为学校买了新书。

fundamental.example: Reading and writing are fundamental skills that every student needs.
fundamental.exampleZh: 阅读和写作是每个学生都需要的基本技能。

funeral.example: Many people came to the funeral to say goodbye to their old friend.
funeral.exampleZh: 许多人来参加葬礼，向他们的老朋友告别。

funny.example: It is funny that my cat sleeps in a box.
funny.exampleZh: 有趣的是，我的猫睡在一个盒子里。

fur.example: The cat has soft white fur and big green eyes.
fur.exampleZh: 这只猫有柔软的白毛和绿色的大眼睛。

furious.example: My father was furious when he saw the broken window.
furious.exampleZh: 我父亲看到破碎的窗户时暴怒不已。

furnace.example: The old furnace keeps the whole house warm in winter.
furnace.exampleZh: 那台旧火炉在冬天让整栋房子保持温暖。

furnish.example: They will furnish the new office with desks and chairs next week.
furnish.exampleZh: 他们下周会用桌椅来布置新办公室。

furniture.example: We bought new furniture for our small living room last week.
furniture.exampleZh: 上周我们为我们的小客厅买了新家具。

further.example: We need further talks before we can sign the new contract.
further.exampleZh: 在签署新合同之前，我们还需要进一步商谈。

furthermore.example: The food is cheap, and furthermore it tastes really good.
furthermore.exampleZh: 这里的食物便宜，而且味道真的很好。

fuss.example: Don't make a fuss about small things; it only makes everyone tired.
fuss.exampleZh: 别为小事大惊小怪，那只会让每个人都很累。

future.example: I want to be a doctor in the future.
future.exampleZh: 我将来想成为一名医生。

gain.example: She hopes to gain more experience from this job.
gain.exampleZh: 她希望从这份工作中获得更多经验。

galaxy.example: Our teacher showed us a picture of a galaxy far away.
galaxy.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张遥远星系的图片。

gamble.example: He likes to gamble on card games with his friends every weekend.
gamble.exampleZh: 他喜欢每个周末和朋友们玩牌赌博。

game.example: The children played a fun game in the park after lunch.
game.exampleZh: 午饭后孩子们在公园里玩了一个有趣的游戏。

gang.example: A gang of workers repaired the road outside our school today.
gang.exampleZh: 今天一队工人在我们学校外面修路。

gap.example: There is a small gap between the door and the floor.
gap.exampleZh: 门和地板之间有一道小缝隙。

garage.example: My father keeps his old car in the garage behind our house.
garage.exampleZh: 我父亲把他的旧车停在我们家后面的车库里。

garbage.example: Please put your garbage in the bin outside the door.
garbage.exampleZh: 请把你的垃圾放到门外的垃圾桶里。

garden.example: My grandmother grows many beautiful flowers in her small garden.
garden.exampleZh: 我的祖母在她的小花园里种了许多美丽的花。

garlic.example: My mother puts garlic in the soup to make it taste better.
garlic.exampleZh: 我妈妈在汤里放了大蒜，让它味道更好。

garment.example: She washed each garment by hand and hung it in the sun.
garment.exampleZh: 她把每件衣服都用手洗了，然后挂在太阳下晾干。

gas.example: Please turn off the gas before you leave the house.
gas.exampleZh: 离开家之前请把煤气关掉。

gaseous.example: Water turns into a gaseous form when it is heated to a high temperature.
gaseous.exampleZh: 水被加热到高温时会变成气态形式。

gasoline.example: The car stopped because it ran out of gasoline on the way home.
gasoline.exampleZh: 汽车在回家的路上因为汽油用完而停了下来。

gasp.example: She gasped for air after running up the stairs.
gasp.exampleZh: 她跑上楼梯后大口喘气。

gate.example: The farmer closed the gate before the sheep went out.
gate.exampleZh: 农夫在羊群出去之前关上了大门。

gather.example: People gather in the park every morning to run and talk.
gather.exampleZh: 人们每天早上聚集在公园里跑步和聊天。

gauge.example: It is hard to gauge how much time we will need.
gauge.exampleZh: 很难估计我们需要多少时间。

gay.example: They sang a gay song and laughed all the way home.
gay.exampleZh: 他们唱着一首欢快的歌，一路笑着回家。

gaze.example: She gazed at the stars for a long time last night.
gaze.exampleZh: 昨晚她久久地凝视着星空。

gear.example: The bike shop will gear the new bike for steep hills.
gear.exampleZh: 自行车店会调整这辆新自行车以适应陡峭的山坡。

gender.example: The form asks for your name, age and gender.
gender.exampleZh: 这张表格要求填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

gene.example: Each gene carries information that helps decide the color of your eyes.
gene.exampleZh: 每个基因都携带帮助决定你眼睛颜色的信息。

general.example: The general opinion is that we need more time to finish the work.
general.exampleZh: 普遍的看法是我们需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

generalize.example: It is not fair to generalize about all students from one test.
generalize.exampleZh: 仅凭一次考试就对所有学生一概而论是不公平的。

generally.example: People generally agree that a good night's sleep helps them work better.
generally.exampleZh: 人们通常认为，一夜好眠有助于他们更好地工作。

generate.example: The new factory will generate many jobs for people in our town.
generate.exampleZh: 这座新工厂将为我们镇上的人们创造许多就业机会。

generation.example: This generation of students learns very fast with new technology.
generation.exampleZh: 这一代学生借助新技术学得非常快。

generator.example: The generator in our building keeps the lights on during a power cut.
generator.exampleZh: 我们楼里的发电机在停电时让灯保持亮着。

generous.example: My generous neighbor often gives fresh vegetables to everyone on our street.
generous.exampleZh: 我慷慨的邻居经常给我们街上每个人送新鲜蔬菜。

genetic.example: Scientists say genetic factors can affect how tall a child grows.
genetic.exampleZh: 科学家表示，遗传因素会影响孩子能长多高。

genius.example: She is a genius at math and loves to solve hard problems.
genius.exampleZh: 她是数学天才，喜欢解难题。

gentle.example: The gentle teacher spoke to the child in a soft voice.
gentle.exampleZh: 那位温和的老师用轻柔的声音对孩子说话。

gentleman.example: That old gentleman always opens the door for others.
gentleman.exampleZh: 那位老先生总是为别人开门。

genuine.example: Her smile was genuine, and everyone trusted her at once.
genuine.exampleZh: 她的微笑很真诚，大家立刻就信任了她。

geography.example: We study geography to learn about mountains, rivers and countries.
geography.exampleZh: 我们学习地理，以了解山脉、河流和国家。

geometry.example: We study geometry in math class and learn about shapes and angles.
geometry.exampleZh: 我们在数学课上学习几何，了解图形和角。

germ.example: Wash your hands well so that germs do not get into your food.
germ.exampleZh: 好好洗手，这样细菌就不会进入你的食物里。

german.example: My German friend speaks English and German very well.
german.exampleZh: 我的德国朋友英语和德语都说得很好。

germany.example: My brother lives in Germany and studies music there.
germany.exampleZh: 我哥哥住在德国，在那里学习音乐。

gesture.example: She made a small gesture with her hand to say hello.
gesture.exampleZh: 她用手做了个小手势来打招呼。

get.example: You can get a lot of useful information from this small book.
get.exampleZh: 你可以从这本小书中得到很多有用的信息。

ghost.example: The little girl says she saw a ghost in the old house.
ghost.exampleZh: 那个小女孩说她在老房子里看到一个鬼。

giant.example: That company is a giant in the computer industry.
giant.exampleZh: 那家公司在计算机行业里是一个巨头。

gift.example: She gave me a small gift for my birthday last week.
gift.exampleZh: 上周她送了我一份小小的生日礼物。

gifted.example: She is a gifted student who loves to draw and paint.
gifted.exampleZh: 她是个有天赋的学生，喜欢画画。

gigantic.example: The elephant in the zoo is a gigantic animal.
gigantic.exampleZh: 动物园里的大象是一只巨大的动物。

girl.example: The little girl likes to sing and dance with her friends.
girl.exampleZh: 这个小女孩喜欢和朋友们一起唱歌跳舞。

girlfriend.example: My girlfriend and I go to the park every Sunday morning.
girlfriend.exampleZh: 我和女朋友每个星期天早上去公园。

give.example: Please give this book to your sister when you go home.
give.exampleZh: 你回家时请把这本书给你的妹妹。

given.example: Given the bad weather, the game was stopped early.
given.exampleZh: 考虑到天气恶劣，比赛提前结束了。

glad.example: I am glad to see you and your family here today.
glad.exampleZh: 今天在这里见到你和你的家人，我很高兴。

glance.example: She gave the letter a quick glance and smiled.
glance.exampleZh: 她匆匆看了一眼那封信，然后笑了。

glare.example: She gave him an angry glare and walked out of the room.
glare.exampleZh: 她愤怒地瞪了他一眼，然后走出了房间。

glass.example: Please give me a glass of water because I am very thirsty.
glass.exampleZh: 请给我一杯水，因为我很渴。

glide.example: The boat glided slowly across the calm lake at sunset.
glide.exampleZh: 日落时分，小船缓缓滑过平静的湖面。

glimpse.example: I caught a glimpse of the tall man at the door.
glimpse.exampleZh: 我在门口瞥见了那个高个子男人。

glitter.example: The star's dress glittered under the bright lights of the stage.
glitter.exampleZh: 这位明星的裙子在舞台明亮的灯光下闪闪发光。

global.example: Climate change is a global problem that affects everyone on Earth.
global.exampleZh: 气候变化是一个影响地球上每个人的全球性问题。

globe.example: She found China on the globe and showed it to her class.
globe.exampleZh: 她在地球仪上找到了中国，并指给全班看。

gloomy.example: The sky was gloomy, so we stayed inside and played cards all afternoon.
gloomy.exampleZh: 天空阴沉，所以我们待在室内打了一下午牌。

glorious.example: It was a glorious day for the whole team.
glorious.exampleZh: 对整个团队来说，那是光荣的一天。

glory.example: The team won great glory for their school last year.
glory.exampleZh: 这支队伍去年为学校赢得了巨大的荣誉。

glove.example: I wear a warm pair of gloves when I walk to school in winter.
glove.exampleZh: 冬天步行去学校时，我会戴一副暖和的手套。

glow.example: Her face began to glow with joy when she saw the good news.
glow.exampleZh: 看到这个好消息时，她的脸因喜悦而泛起了红光。

glue.example: Please use some glue to stick the broken cup back together.
glue.exampleZh: 请用一些胶水把破碎的杯子粘回原样。

go.example: I go to the park with my dog every morning.
go.exampleZh: 我每天早上和我的狗一起去公园。

goal.example: My goal is to learn English well before the end of this year.
goal.exampleZh: 我的目标是在今年年底之前把英语学好。

goat.example: The goat is eating grass on the hill behind our house.
goat.exampleZh: 那只山羊正在我们屋后的山坡上吃草。

god.example: Many people pray to God when they are afraid.
god.exampleZh: 许多人在害怕时会向上帝祈祷。

gold.example: She wore a gold ring on her finger at the party.
gold.exampleZh: 她在聚会上手指上戴着一枚金戒指。

golden.example: The golden leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
golden.exampleZh: 秋天，金黄色的树叶从树上飘落。

golf.example: My father plays golf with his friends every Sunday morning.
golf.exampleZh: 我父亲每个星期天早上都和他的朋友们打高尔夫球。

good.example: She is very good at math and often helps her friends.
good.exampleZh: 她数学很好，经常帮助她的朋友们。

goodby.example: I waved and said goodby to my friends at the busy station.
goodby.exampleZh: 我在繁忙的车站挥手向朋友们告别。

goodness.example: She thanked me with such goodness that I will never forget her kindness.
goodness.exampleZh: 她满怀善意地感谢我，我永远不会忘记她的善良。

goods.example: The goods in this store are cheap and good.
goods.exampleZh: 这家商店里的商品又便宜又好。

goose.example: The goose swims across the small lake with her young.
goose.exampleZh: 那只鹅带着幼崽游过小湖。

govern.example: Strong laws govern how companies use our personal data.
govern.exampleZh: 严格的法律管控着公司如何使用我们的个人数据。

government.example: The local government promised to build a new school for the children.
government.exampleZh: 当地政府承诺为孩子们建一所新学校。

governor.example: The governor spoke to the people about the new school plan.
governor.exampleZh: 州长就新学校计划向民众发表了讲话。

grab.example: He grabbed his bag and ran out of the door.

grace.example: She moved across the stage with such grace that everyone stopped to watch.
grace.exampleZh: 她在舞台上移动得如此优雅，以至于所有人都停下来观看。

graceful.example: Her graceful dancing made everyone in the room smile.
graceful.exampleZh: 她优雅的舞姿让房间里的每个人都笑了。

grade.example: My teacher gave me a good grade on the math test.
grade.exampleZh: 老师给我的数学考试打了一个好分数。

gradual.example: The gradual change in the weather made the days warmer and longer.
gradual.exampleZh: 天气的逐渐变化使白天变得更暖和、更长了。

gradually.example: The weather gradually became warmer as spring arrived.
gradually.exampleZh: 随着春天的到来，天气逐渐变暖。

graduate.example: She will graduate from college next June and look for a job.
graduate.exampleZh: 她明年六月大学毕业，然后找工作。

grain.example: She bought a bag of grain to feed the small birds in the garden.
grain.exampleZh: 她买了一袋谷物来喂花园里的小鸟。

gram.example: I need two hundred grams of flour to make this cake.
gram.exampleZh: 我需要两百克面粉来做这个蛋糕。

grammar.example: Learning grammar helps me write clear English sentences every day.
grammar.exampleZh: 学习语法帮助我每天写出清楚的英语句子。

grammatical.example: The teacher said my sentence is grammatical and easy to understand.
grammatical.exampleZh: 老师说我的句子符合语法规则，而且很容易理解。

gramme.example: Please weigh 100 grammes of sugar for this simple cake recipe.
gramme.exampleZh: 请为这个简单的蛋糕食谱称出100克糖。

grand.example: The grand opening of the new library drew a large crowd yesterday.
grand.exampleZh: 新图书馆的盛大开幕昨天吸引了一大群人。

grandfather.example: My grandfather tells me funny stories about his childhood every Sunday afternoon.
grandfather.exampleZh: 我祖父每个星期天下午都会给我讲他童年的有趣故事。

grandmother.example: My grandmother makes delicious cakes for us every Sunday afternoon.
grandmother.exampleZh: 我祖母每个星期天下午都给我们做好吃的蛋糕。

grant.example: The school gave him a grant to study abroad for one year.
grant.exampleZh: 学校给了他一笔补助金，供他出国学习一年。

grape.example: She bought a bunch of grape juice and some fresh fruit at the store.
grape.exampleZh: 她在商店买了一串葡萄汁和一些新鲜水果。

graph.example: The teacher showed us a simple graph of the class test scores.
graph.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了一张简单的班级考试分数图表。

graphic.example: The book gives a graphic description of life in the old city.
graphic.exampleZh: 这本书生动地描写了老城区的生活。

grasp.example: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
grasp.exampleZh: 她很快理解这节课的主要意思。

grass.example: The children are playing on the grass in front of our house.
grass.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们家前面的草地上玩耍。

grateful.example: I am very grateful for all the help you gave me.
grateful.exampleZh: 我非常感谢你给我的所有帮助。

gratitude.example: I want to express my gratitude to everyone who helped me.
gratitude.exampleZh: 我想对每一位帮助过我的人表示感谢。

grave.example: There is an old grave near the river behind our school.
grave.exampleZh: 我们学校后面、河边有一座古老的坟墓。

gravity.example: The apple fell from the tree because of gravity.
gravity.exampleZh: 苹果因为重力从树上掉了下来。

gray.example: The sky looks gray and cloudy before the rain comes.
gray.exampleZh: 下雨前天空显得阴沉灰暗。

great.example: This is a great city with many tall buildings.
great.exampleZh: 这是一座有很多高楼的大城市。

greatly.example: He was greatly helped by his teacher and friends.
greatly.exampleZh: 他得到了老师和朋友们的很大帮助。

greedy.example: The greedy boy ate all the cakes before his sister came home.
greedy.exampleZh: 那个贪吃的男孩在妹妹回家前把蛋糕全吃光了。

greek.example: My friend is Greek and she teaches me simple words in her language.
greek.exampleZh: 我的朋友是希腊人，她教我一些她语言里的简单词汇。

green.example: The green leaves turn red in autumn, and we eat fresh greens every day.
green.exampleZh: 绿叶在秋天变红，我们每天也吃新鲜蔬菜。

greenhouse.example: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse during the cold winter months.
greenhouse.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬季，我们在温室里种西红柿。

greet.example: She likes to greet her neighbors with a warm smile every morning.
greet.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上用温暖的微笑和邻居们打招呼。

greeting.example: She smiled and gave me a warm greeting at the door.
greeting.exampleZh: 她在门口微笑着热情地问候了我。

grey.example: The old cat has soft grey fur and bright green eyes.
grey.exampleZh: 那只老猫有柔软的灰色毛和明亮的绿色眼睛。

grief.example: She felt deep grief after her old dog died last winter.
grief.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗去世后，她感到深深的悲伤。

grieve.example: She still grieves for her father after all these years.
grieve.exampleZh: 这么多年过去了，她仍然为父亲的去世而悲伤。

grill.example: We cooked chicken on the grill and then grilled some vegetables.
grill.exampleZh: 我们在烤架上烤了鸡肉，然后又烤了一些蔬菜。

grim.example: The teacher gave us a grim look and told us to work harder.
grim.exampleZh: 老师严厉地看了我们一眼，叫我们更用功一些。

grin.example: She gave me a big grin when she saw the cake.
grin.exampleZh: 她看到蛋糕时冲我咧嘴大笑。

grind.example: The old machine can grind coffee beans into a fine powder.
grind.exampleZh: 这台旧机器能把咖啡豆磨成细粉。

grip.example: She had to grip the rope tightly to avoid falling into the water.
grip.exampleZh: 她只得紧紧抓住绳子，以免掉进水里。

groan.example: He let out a low groan when he saw the heavy boxes.
groan.exampleZh: 看到那些沉重的箱子时，他低声呻吟了一下。

grocer.example: The grocer sells fresh fruit and vegetables at his small shop.
grocer.exampleZh: 这位杂货商在他的小店里卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

grocery.example: I need to stop at the grocery store to buy milk and bread.
grocery.exampleZh: 我需要去趟杂货店买牛奶和面包。

groom.example: The groom takes care of the horses every morning.
groom.exampleZh: 马夫每天早上照料这些马。

gross.example: The company's gross income was much higher than its net profit last year.
gross.exampleZh: 公司去年的总收入远高于净利润。

ground.example: The children are playing football on the wet ground behind the school.
ground.exampleZh: 孩子们正在学校后面潮湿的地上踢足球。

group.example: Students in this group work together and share their ideas.
group.exampleZh: 这个组的学生一起合作并分享他们的想法。

grove.example: There is a small grove of apple trees behind our house.
grove.exampleZh: 我们房子后面有一小片苹果树林。

grow.example: My grandfather grows tomatoes and beans in the small garden behind his house.
grow.exampleZh: 我爷爷在他房子后面的小花园里种西红柿和豆子。

growth.example: The fast growth of the city brought many new jobs for young people.
growth.exampleZh: 这座城市的快速增长为年轻人带来了许多新工作。

guarantee.example: Can you guarantee that the product will arrive before Friday?
guarantee.exampleZh: 你能保证产品在周五之前送到吗？

guard.example: Two soldiers guard the gate at night and keep everyone safe.
guard.exampleZh: 两名士兵夜里守卫大门，保护大家的安全。

guess.example: I can only guess why she left so early.
guess.exampleZh: 我只能猜测她为什么这么早离开。

guest.example: Our guest will arrive at the hotel before dinner tonight.
guest.exampleZh: 我们的客人将在今晚晚饭前到达酒店。

guidance.example: The teacher gave me useful guidance on how to improve my English.
guidance.exampleZh: 老师给了我关于如何提高英语的有用指导。

guide.example: Our guide showed us the old streets and told many interesting stories.
guide.exampleZh: 我们的向导带我们参观了老街，讲了许多有趣的故事。

guideline.example: Please read the safety guidelines before you use the new machine.
guideline.exampleZh: 使用新机器前请先阅读安全准则。

guilty.example: He felt guilty because he forgot his mother's birthday again this year.
guilty.exampleZh: 他因为今年又忘了母亲的生日而感到内疚。

guitar.example: My brother plays the guitar every evening after dinner.
guitar.exampleZh: 我弟弟每天晚饭后都弹吉他。

gulf.example: There is a wide gulf between what he says and what he does.
gulf.exampleZh: 他说的和他做的之间有巨大的鸿沟。

gum.example: He likes to chew gum while he walks to school.
gum.exampleZh: 他喜欢在走路上学时嚼口香糖。

gun.example: The police officer told him to put the gun down slowly.
gun.exampleZh: 警察让他慢慢把枪放下。

guy.example: That guy at the front desk helped me find my lost bag.
guy.exampleZh: 前台那个小伙子帮我找到了丢失的包。

gym.example: I go to the gym with my friends every Tuesday and Thursday.
gym.exampleZh: 我每周二和周四和朋友一起去健身房。

habit.example: Reading before bed is a good habit for young children.
habit.exampleZh: 睡前阅读对幼儿来说是一个好习惯。

habitat.example: The forest is a good habitat for many small birds.
habitat.exampleZh: 这片森林是许多小鸟的良好栖息地。

hair.example: My sister has long black hair and big brown eyes.
hair.exampleZh: 我妹妹有一头乌黑的长发和一双棕色的大眼睛。

half.example: She ate half of the cake and gave the rest to her brother.
half.exampleZh: 她吃了一半蛋糕，把剩下的给了她弟弟。

hall.example: The students waited in the hall before the meeting began.
hall.exampleZh: 学生们在会议开始前在大厅里等候。

halt.example: The train came to a halt at the small station.

hamburger.example: I ate a hot hamburger with cheese for lunch today.
hamburger.exampleZh: 我今天午餐吃了一个夹奶酪的热汉堡包。

hammer.example: He used a hammer to fix the broken chair in the kitchen.
hammer.exampleZh: 他用锤子修好了厨房里那把坏掉的椅子。

hamper.example: The heavy rain will hamper our plans to finish the work today.
hamper.exampleZh: 大雨会妨碍我们今天完成工作的计划。

hand.example: Please hand the book to your sister and raise your hand.
hand.exampleZh: 请把书递给你妹妹，然后举手。

handbook.example: This handbook tells new students how to use the library.
handbook.exampleZh: 这本手册告诉新生如何使用图书馆。

handful.example: Only a handful of students came to class today.
handful.exampleZh: 今天只有少数几个学生来上课。

handicap.example: His poor English was a real handicap at work, but he never gave up.
handicap.exampleZh: 他的英语不好在工作中是个很大的障碍，但他从未放弃。

handle.example: She held the hot pan by its handle and moved it carefully.
handle.exampleZh: 她握住锅柄，小心地把热锅移开。

handwriting.example: Her handwriting is small and neat, so her notes are easy to read.
handwriting.exampleZh: 她的字又小又工整，所以她的笔记很容易读。

handy.example: This small tool is very handy when you fix things at home.
handy.exampleZh: 这个小工具在你家里修东西时很方便。

hang.example: She likes to hang her wet clothes on the line outside.
hang.exampleZh: 她喜欢把湿衣服挂在屋外的绳子上。

happen.example: I happened to see your brother at the station yesterday.
happen.exampleZh: 昨天我碰巧在车站看到了你哥哥。

happy.example: I am very happy to see my old friends today.
happy.exampleZh: 今天见到老朋友我很开心。

harbor.example: The small boat found a safe harbor before the storm arrived.
harbor.exampleZh: 小船在暴风雨来临前找到了一个安全的港口。

hard.example: This math problem is too hard for me to finish.
hard.exampleZh: 这道数学题对我来说太难了，我完成不了。

harden.example: The bread will harden quickly if you leave it out overnight.
harden.exampleZh: 如果你把面包放在外面过夜，它很快就会变硬。

hardly.example: I can hardly hear you because the music is too loud.
hardly.exampleZh: 音乐太吵了，我几乎听不见你说话。

hardship.example: Many families face great hardship during the cold winter months.
hardship.exampleZh: 许多家庭在寒冷的冬季月份里面临巨大的艰难。

hardware.example: The store sells tools and other hardware for building a house.
hardware.exampleZh: 这家店出售建造房屋所需的工具和其他五金器具。

hardy.example: Hardy farmers can work outside all day in cold weather.
hardy.exampleZh: 能吃苦耐劳的农民能在寒冷天气里整天在户外干活。

harm.example: Too much sugar can harm your teeth and your health.
harm.exampleZh: 过多的糖会损害你的牙齿和健康。

harmful.example: Staying up too late every night is harmful to your health.
harmful.exampleZh: 每晚熬夜太晚对你的健康有害。

harmony.example: The two sisters live in perfect harmony with each other.
harmony.exampleZh: 姐妹俩彼此相处得非常和睦融洽。

harsh.example: The harsh light from the old lamp hurt my eyes.
harsh.exampleZh: 那盏旧灯发出的刺眼光线刺痛了我的眼睛。

harvest.example: Farmers work hard in the fields to bring in a good harvest every autumn.
harvest.exampleZh: 农民们每年秋天都在田里辛勤劳作，以收获丰收。

haste.example: In her haste to leave, she forgot her keys on the desk.
haste.exampleZh: 她匆忙离开时，把钥匙忘在了桌子上。

hasten.example: She hastened to the door when she heard the bell ring.
hasten.exampleZh: 听到门铃响，她急忙赶到门口。

hasty.example: She made a hasty decision and later wished to change it.
hasty.exampleZh: 她做了一个仓促的决定，后来又想改变它。

hat.example: He wears a warm hat when he walks to school in winter.
hat.exampleZh: 冬天他走路去学校时会戴一顶暖和的帽子。

hatch.example: The chickens will hatch from their eggs in a few days.
hatch.exampleZh: 小鸡几天后就会从蛋里孵出来。

hate.example: I hate waiting in long lines at the busy supermarket on weekends.
hate.exampleZh: 我讨厌周末在繁忙的超市里排长队等候。

hatred.example: Her deep hatred for him grew stronger after that terrible argument.
hatred.exampleZh: 那次激烈的争吵之后，她对他深深的憎恨变得更强烈了。

haul.example: The workers used a truck to haul the heavy boxes to the new store.
haul.exampleZh: 工人们用卡车把那些沉重的箱子运到新商店。

have.example: I have a small dog and two cats at home.
have.exampleZh: 我在家里养了一只小狗和两只猫。

hawk.example: The hawk flew high above the trees and looked for small animals.
hawk.exampleZh: 那只鹰在树梢上方高高飞翔，寻找小动物。

hay.example: The farmer put dry hay in the barn for the cows.
hay.exampleZh: 农民把干草放进谷仓里给奶牛吃。

he.example: My brother said he will come home early today.
he.exampleZh: 我哥哥说他今天会早点回家。

head.example: She turned her head and smiled at the man behind her.
head.exampleZh: 她转过头，对身后的那个男人笑了笑。

headache.example: I had a bad headache this morning, so I stayed home from work.
headache.exampleZh: 今天早上我头痛得厉害，所以没有去上班，留在了家里。

heading.example: The heading at the top of the page tells you what the report is about.
heading.exampleZh: 页面顶部的标题告诉你这份报告讲的是什么。

headline.example: The headline on the front page caught my attention this morning.
headline.exampleZh: 今天早上头版的大字标题吸引了我的注意。

headquarters.example: The company moved its headquarters to a new city last year.
headquarters.exampleZh: 公司去年把总部搬到了一座新城市。

heal.example: Time can heal a broken heart and help people move on.
heal.exampleZh: 时间能治愈一颗破碎的心，并帮助人们继续前行。

health.example: Regular exercise and good food are important for your health.
health.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和良好的饮食对你的健康很重要。

healthy.example: Fresh fruit and vegetables help us stay healthy and strong.
healthy.exampleZh: 新鲜水果和蔬菜帮助我们保持健康强壮。

heap.example: He put the dirty clothes in a heap on the floor.
heap.exampleZh: 他把脏衣服堆成一堆放在地板上。

hear.example: I can hear the birds singing outside my window every morning.
hear.exampleZh: 每天早上我都能听见鸟儿在我窗外歌唱。

hearing.example: His hearing has gotten worse, so he needs a hearing aid now.
hearing.exampleZh: 他的听力变差了，所以他现在需要助听器。

heart.example: She has a kind heart and always helps people in need.
heart.exampleZh: 她心地善良，总是帮助有需要的人。

heat.example: The heat from the sun made the room very warm and bright.
heat.exampleZh: 太阳的热量让房间变得非常温暖明亮。

heating.example: The heating in our old house stops working when it gets very cold.
heating.exampleZh: 我们老房子的暖气在天很冷的时候就会停止工作。

heaven.example: She said her garden feels like heaven on a warm summer day.
heaven.exampleZh: 她说她的花园在温暖的夏日里感觉就像天堂。

heavy.example: This box is too heavy for me to carry upstairs.
heavy.exampleZh: 这个箱子太重了，我搬不上楼。

hedge.example: He planted a hedge around his garden to keep the animals out.
hedge.exampleZh: 他在花园周围种了一道树篱，防止动物进来。

heel.example: My new shoes hurt my heel when I walk for a long time.
heel.exampleZh: 我走路久了，新鞋就磨我的脚后跟。

height.example: The height of the mountain is about three thousand meters.
height.exampleZh: 这座山的高度大约是三千米。

heir.example: The old man left his house to his only heir.
heir.exampleZh: 老人把房子留给了他唯一的继承人。

helicopter.example: The helicopter landed on the roof of the tall building.
helicopter.exampleZh: 直升机降落在高楼的楼顶上。

hell.example: The old man said that war is a hell on earth.
hell.exampleZh: 那位老人说战争就是人间地狱。

hello.example: She smiled and said hello to everyone in the room.
hello.exampleZh: 她微笑着向房间里的每个人问好。

help.example: Can you help me carry these heavy boxes to the car?
help.exampleZh: 你能帮我把这些重箱子搬到车上吗？

helpful.example: My teacher is very helpful when I have questions about math.
helpful.exampleZh: 当我有数学问题时，我的老师非常乐于助人。

helpless.example: The little boy felt helpless when he lost his mother in the crowd.
helpless.exampleZh: 那个小男孩在人群中找不到妈妈时感到无助。

hen.example: The hen lays three brown eggs in the warm nest every morning.
hen.exampleZh: 这只母鸡每天早上在温暖的窝里下三个褐色的蛋。

hence.example: It rained all day, hence we stayed at home.
hence.exampleZh: 下了一整天雨，因此我们待在家里。

her.example: I gave her the book because she asked for it.
her.exampleZh: 我把书给了她，因为是她向我要的。

herd.example: The farmer leads his herd of cows to the field every morning.
herd.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上把他的牛群赶到田野里。

here.example: Please come here and sit next to me.

hero.example: The young boy wants to be a hero when he grows up.
hero.exampleZh: 这个小男孩长大后想成为一名英雄。

heroic.example: The heroic firefighter saved three children from the burning building.
heroic.exampleZh: 那位英勇的消防员从燃烧的大楼里救出了三个孩子。

hers.example: This book is mine and that blue bag is hers.
hers.exampleZh: 这本书是我的，那个蓝色包是她的。

herself.example: She made the cake herself and shared it with everyone.
herself.exampleZh: 她自己做了蛋糕，并和大家一起分享。

hesitate.example: I hesitate to ask for help because I do not want to bother anyone.
hesitate.exampleZh: 我不好意思开口求助，因为我不想麻烦任何人。

hi.example: Hi, my name is Tom and I am new here.
hi.exampleZh: 嗨，我叫汤姆，我是新来的。

hide.example: She tried to hide the small key under the old brown box.
hide.exampleZh: 她试着把那把小钥匙藏在那只旧的棕色盒子下面。

hierarchy.example: In many companies, there is a clear hierarchy of power and responsibility.
hierarchy.exampleZh: 在许多公司里，存在着明确的权力与责任等级体系。

high.example: The high wall around the old garden keeps the children safe.
high.exampleZh: 老花园周围的高墙保护着孩子们的安全。

highland.example: We walked across the highland and saw many sheep.
highland.exampleZh: 我们走过高地，看见了许多绵羊。

highly.example: She is highly respected by her students and colleagues.
highly.exampleZh: 她深受学生和同事的尊敬。

highway.example: The new highway makes it faster to drive to the city.
highway.exampleZh: 这条新公路使开车去城里更快了。

hijack.example: Two men tried to hijack a plane and fly it to another country.
hijack.exampleZh: 两名男子试图劫持一架飞机，并把它飞往另一个国家。

hill.example: The children ran up the green hill behind their school.
hill.exampleZh: 孩子们跑上了学校后面的绿色小山。

him.example: I gave him a book for his birthday.
him.exampleZh: 他生日那天我送了他一本书。

himself.example: He learned to cook dinner for himself after moving into a new apartment.
himself.exampleZh: 搬进新公寓后，他学着自己做晚饭。

hinder.example: Bad weather can hinder our plan to go hiking this weekend.
hinder.exampleZh: 恶劣天气可能会妨碍我们这周末去徒步的计划。

hint.example: She gave me a hint about the answer to the question.
hint.exampleZh: 她给了我一个关于这个问题答案的暗示。

hip.example: My grandmother fell and hurt her hip while walking to the store.
hip.exampleZh: 我奶奶在走去商店的路上摔倒，伤到了髋部。

hire.example: They hire a car for a week every summer.
hire.exampleZh: 他们每年夏天都租一辆车用上一周。

his.example: His bike is old, but he rides it to school every day.
his.exampleZh: 他的自行车很旧了，但他每天骑它去上学。

historian.example: The historian wrote a clear book about life in ancient China.
historian.exampleZh: 这位历史学家写了一本关于中国古代生活的清晰著作。

historic.example: This is a historic day for our country and all its people.
historic.exampleZh: 对我们的国家和全体人民来说，这是一个具有历史意义的日子。

historical.example: This book tells a historical story about our town.
historical.exampleZh: 这本书讲述了我们镇上的一个历史故事。

history.example: She studied history in college and now teaches it at a high school.
history.exampleZh: 她在大学学的是历史，现在在一所高中教历史。

hit.example: The new song was a big hit and everyone sang it.
hit.exampleZh: 这首新歌非常风行，每个人都在唱。

hobby.example: My favorite hobby is reading books in the evening after work.
hobby.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的业余爱好是下班后晚上看书。

hold.example: Please hold the box carefully while I open the door for you.
hold.exampleZh: 请小心拿着这个盒子，我来为你开门。

holder.example: The holder of the ticket must show it at the door.
holder.exampleZh: 持票人必须在门口出示票据。

hole.example: The children dug a deep hole in the sand.
hole.exampleZh: 孩子们在沙子里挖了一个深洞。

holiday.example: We are going to the beach for our summer holiday next month.
holiday.exampleZh: 下个月我们要去海边过暑假。

hollow.example: The old tree has a hollow trunk where small animals sleep.
hollow.exampleZh: 这棵老树的树干是空心的，小动物在里面睡觉。

holy.example: This old church is a holy place for many people.
holy.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂对许多人来说是神圣的地方。

home.example: After a long day at work, I always want to go home.
home.exampleZh: 工作了一整天后，我总是想回家。

homework.example: I finish my homework before dinner every day after school.
homework.exampleZh: 我每天放学后都会在晚饭前完成家庭作业。

honest.example: She is an honest girl and always tells the truth to her friends.
honest.exampleZh: 她是个诚实的女孩，总是对朋友说真话。

honesty.example: Her honesty made everyone in the team trust her words.
honesty.exampleZh: 她的诚实让团队里的每个人都相信她的话。

honey.example: She likes to put honey in her tea every morning.
honey.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上在茶里放蜂蜜。

honor.example: It is a great honor to stand here and speak to all of you.
honor.exampleZh: 站在这里对大家讲话是我莫大的荣幸。

honorable.example: He is an honorable man who always helps his friends.
honorable.exampleZh: 他是一个高尚的人，总是帮助他的朋友。

hook.example: Hang your coat on the hook next to the door.
hook.exampleZh: 把你的外套挂在门旁边的挂钩上。

hope.example: I hope you can come to my birthday party this Saturday.
hope.exampleZh: 我希望你能来参加这个星期六我的生日聚会。

hopeful.example: We are hopeful that the weather will be better tomorrow.
hopeful.exampleZh: 我们希望明天天气会好一些。

hopeless.example: After losing the game, the team felt hopeless and stopped trying.
hopeless.exampleZh: 输掉比赛后，这支队伍感到绝望，不再努力了。

horizon.example: Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons and change the way you see the world.
horizon.exampleZh: 出国旅行能开阔你的眼界，并改变你看世界的方式。

horizontal.example: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
horizontal.exampleZh: 在页面中间画一条水平线。

horn.example: The car horn sounded loudly when the driver pressed the button.
horn.exampleZh: 司机按下按钮时，汽车喇叭响亮地响了。

horror.example: She watched the horror film and could not sleep that night.
horror.exampleZh: 她看了那部恐怖电影，那天晚上无法入睡。

horse.example: The farmer rides a horse to the field every morning.
horse.exampleZh: 农夫每天早上骑马去田里。

horsepower.example: This old truck has only eighty horsepower, so it climbs hills very slowly.
horsepower.exampleZh: 这辆旧卡车只有八十马力，所以爬坡非常慢。

hospital.example: My mother works as a nurse in a large hospital near our home.
hospital.exampleZh: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一家大医院里当护士。

hospitality.example: The people in this small town are known for their warm hospitality.
hospitality.exampleZh: 这个小镇的人们以热情好客而闻名。

host.example: Our host made us feel welcome and showed us around the city.
host.exampleZh: 我们的主人让我们感到很受欢迎，还带我们游览了这座城市。

hostile.example: The hostile crowd shouted at the speaker during the meeting.
hostile.exampleZh: 会议上，敌对的人群对着演讲者大喊大叫。

hostility.example: There was open hostility between the two groups after the argument.
hostility.exampleZh: 争吵之后，两个群体之间公开敌对。

hot.example: The soup is too hot to eat right now.
hot.exampleZh: 这汤太烫了，现在没法吃。

hotel.example: The new hotel is near the train station and has a big restaurant.
hotel.exampleZh: 那家新旅馆在火车站附近，还有一家大餐厅。

hound.example: The hound ran quickly across the field after the rabbit.
hound.exampleZh: 那只猎犬飞快地穿过田野追赶兔子。

hour.example: The meeting will start in an hour, so please be on time.
hour.exampleZh: 会议将在一小时后开始，所以请准时。

house.example: They bought a small house near the river last year.
house.exampleZh: 他们去年在河边买了一套小房子。

household.example: Most households in this small town use less water than before.
household.exampleZh: 这个小镇的大多数家庭用水比过去少了。

housewife.example: My mother was a housewife and she cooked every meal for us.
housewife.exampleZh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，她给我们做每一顿饭。

housework.example: I help my mother with the housework every Saturday morning.
housework.exampleZh: 我每周六早上帮妈妈做家务。

housing.example: The city needs more affordable housing for young families.
housing.exampleZh: 这座城市需要为年轻家庭提供更多负担得起的住房。

how.example: How do you go to school every morning?
how.exampleZh: 你每天早上怎么去学校？

however.example: It was raining hard; however, we still went out for a walk.
however.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，然而我们还是出去散步了。

hug.example: She gave her mother a warm hug at the airport.
hug.exampleZh: 她在机场给了母亲一个温暖的拥抱。

huge.example: There is a huge tree in front of my house.
huge.exampleZh: 我家门前有一棵巨大的树。

human.example: Every human being should be treated with respect and kindness.
human.exampleZh: 每个人都应该受到尊重和善待。
