humanity.example: The teacher said that humanity must work together to solve climate change.
humanity.exampleZh: 老师说人类必须共同努力解决气候变化问题。

humble.example: He is a humble man who never talks about his success.
humble.exampleZh: 他是个谦卑的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

humid.example: The air in the room is very humid, so please open the window.
humid.exampleZh: 房间里的空气很潮湿，请把窗户打开。

humidity.example: The humidity in the room made my clothes feel wet.
humidity.exampleZh: 房间里的湿气让我的衣服感觉湿漉漉的。

humor.example: His sense of humor makes everyone in the office laugh every day.
humor.exampleZh: 他的幽默感让办公室里的每个人每天都开怀大笑。

humorous.example: My uncle is a humorous man who tells funny stories at dinner.
humorous.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个幽默的人，晚饭时总讲有趣的故事。

hundred.example: There are more than three hundred students in our school.
hundred.exampleZh: 我们学校有三百多名学生。

hunger.example: Many children in the world still suffer from hunger every day.
hunger.exampleZh: 世界上仍有许多儿童每天都在忍受饥饿。

hungry.example: The hungry children ate all the bread on the table.
hungry.exampleZh: 饥饿的孩子们把桌上的面包全吃光了。

hunt.example: They went to the forest to hunt for food and water.
hunt.exampleZh: 他们去森林里狩猎，寻找食物和水。

hunter.example: The hunter walked into the forest early in the morning to look for deer.
hunter.exampleZh: 猎人一大早就走进森林寻找鹿。

hurry.example: We must hurry to catch the last bus home tonight.
hurry.exampleZh: 我们今晚必须赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

hurt.example: Her words hurt me, but I know she did not mean it.
hurt.exampleZh: 她的话伤害了我，但我知道她不是故意的。

husband.example: My husband cooks dinner for us every evening after work.
husband.exampleZh: 我丈夫每天下班后都给我们做晚饭。

hut.example: The old man lives in a small hut near the river.
hut.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边一间小屋里。

i.example: I like to read books in the evening after dinner.

ice.example: The lake is covered with thick ice, so we can walk on it.
ice.exampleZh: 湖面结着厚厚的冰，我们可以从上面走过去。

idea.example: I have a good idea for our class project this weekend.
idea.exampleZh: 这个周末我们班的项目我有个好主意。

ideal.example: Her small garden is an ideal place to relax after work.
ideal.exampleZh: 她的小花园是下班后放松的理想去处。

identical.example: The two sisters wore identical dresses to the party last night.
identical.exampleZh: 两姐妹昨晚穿着一模一样的连衣裙去参加聚会。

identification.example: The police need your identification before they can let you enter the building.
identification.exampleZh: 警察需要你的身份证明才能让你进入大楼。

identify.example: Can you identify the man in this photo for me?
identify.exampleZh: 你能帮我确认这张照片里的那个男人吗？

identity.example: She kept her identity a secret from everyone at work.
identity.exampleZh: 她在工作中对所有人隐瞒了自己的身份。

ideology.example: The party's ideology shaped every part of daily life in that country.
ideology.exampleZh: 这个政党的意识形态塑造了那个国家日常生活的方方面面。

idiom.example: This English idiom is hard to understand without a good example.
idiom.exampleZh: 这个英语习语如果没有一个好例子就很难理解。

idiot.example: My brother is such an idiot that he forgot his own birthday.
idiot.exampleZh: 我弟弟真是个白痴，连自己的生日都忘了。

idle.example: The machines stood idle all day because there was no work.
idle.exampleZh: 机器整天闲置着，因为没有活儿可干。

idol.example: Many young people treat a famous singer as their idol.
idol.exampleZh: 许多年轻人把一位著名歌手当作自己的偶像。

if.example: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a movie.
if.exampleZh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里看场电影。

ignorance.example: His ignorance of the rules caused him to make a serious mistake.
ignorance.exampleZh: 他对规则的无知使他犯了一个严重的错误。

ignorant.example: He is ignorant of the basic rules and often makes simple mistakes.
ignorant.exampleZh: 他对基本规则一无所知，常常犯简单的错误。

ignore.example: Do not ignore the small warning signs your body gives you.
ignore.exampleZh: 不要忽视身体给你的那些小警告信号。

ill.example: My father is ill and must stay in bed today.
ill.exampleZh: 我父亲生病了，今天必须卧床休息。

illegal.example: It is illegal to drive a car without a license in this country.
illegal.exampleZh: 在这个国家，没有驾照开车是违法的。

illness.example: His illness kept him at home for two weeks.
illness.exampleZh: 他的病让他在家待了两周。

illustrate.example: Let me illustrate my idea with a simple example from daily life.
illustrate.exampleZh: 让我用日常生活中一个简单的例子来说明我的想法。

illustration.example: The book has a clear illustration of how plants grow.
illustration.exampleZh: 这本书有一幅清晰的插图，说明植物是如何生长的。

image.example: The old photograph shows a clear image of my grandmother as a young girl.
image.exampleZh: 这张老照片清晰地映出我祖母年轻时的模样。

imaginary.example: The dragon in the story is an imaginary creature that only children can see.
imaginary.exampleZh: 故事里的那条龙是只有孩子们才能看见的想象中的生物。

imagination.example: Children often use their imagination to turn a simple box into a spaceship.
imagination.exampleZh: 孩子们常常发挥想象力，把一个简单的纸箱变成宇宙飞船。

imaginative.example: She is an imaginative child who often tells funny stories to her friends.
imaginative.exampleZh: 她是个富于想象力的孩子，常给朋友们讲有趣的故事。

imagine.example: I can imagine how happy you were when you heard the news.
imagine.exampleZh: 我能想象你听到这个消息时有多开心。

imitate.example: Children often imitate the words and actions of their parents.
imitate.exampleZh: 孩子们常常模仿父母的言语和行为。

imitation.example: Her cheap bag is just an imitation of a famous brand.
imitation.exampleZh: 她的便宜包只是对一个著名品牌的仿制品。

immediate.example: We need an immediate answer from the manager before we leave.
immediate.exampleZh: 我们在离开前需要经理立即给出答复。

immediately.example: Please call the doctor immediately because your father is not feeling well.
immediately.exampleZh: 请立即给医生打电话，因为你父亲感觉不舒服。

immense.example: The immense stadium was full of happy fans on game day.
immense.exampleZh: 比赛日那天，巨大的体育场里坐满了快乐的球迷。

immerse.example: She likes to immerse herself in music after a long day.
immerse.exampleZh: 漫长的一天过后，她喜欢让自己沉浸在音乐中。

immigrant.example: The immigrant works hard in a new city and sends money home.
immigrant.exampleZh: 这位移民在新的城市努力工作，并把钱寄回家。

immigrate.example: My grandparents decided to immigrate to Canada many years ago.
immigrate.exampleZh: 我的祖父母很多年前决定移居加拿大。

impact.example: The new law had a big impact on small businesses in our town.
impact.exampleZh: 这项新法律对我们镇上的小企业产生了很大影响。

impair.example: Lack of sleep can impair your ability to think clearly.
impair.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会损害你清晰思考的能力。

impatient.example: He was impatient with the slow waiter and asked for the bill.
impatient.exampleZh: 他对慢吞吞的服务员很不耐烦，要求结账。

imperative.example: It is imperative that we finish this urgent work before Friday.
imperative.exampleZh: 我们必须在周五前完成这项紧急工作。

imperial.example: The imperial palace in the old city is very large and beautiful.
imperial.exampleZh: 老城里的皇宫又大又漂亮。

implement.example: We need to implement the new plan next week.
implement.exampleZh: 我们需要在下周实施这个新计划。

implication.example: The implication of his words was clear to everyone in the room.
implication.exampleZh: 他话里的含意对房间里的每个人来说都很清楚。

implicit.example: There was an implicit warning in her calm voice.
implicit.exampleZh: 她平静的声音里有一种含蓄的警告。

imply.example: Dark clouds often imply that rain is coming soon.
imply.exampleZh: 乌云往往暗示着很快就要下雨了。

import.example: The country imports most of its oil from nearby nations.
import.exampleZh: 这个国家的大部分石油都是从邻近国家进口的。

importance.example: Many students do not understand the importance of daily practice.
importance.exampleZh: 许多学生不明白每日练习的重要性。

important.example: It is important to sleep well before a big test.

impose.example: The government imposed new taxes on imported cars last year.
impose.exampleZh: 政府去年对进口汽车征收了新的税。

impossible.example: It is impossible to finish all this work before noon.
impossible.exampleZh: 在中午之前完成所有这项工作是不可能的。

impress.example: Her kind words impressed everyone in the room that day.
impress.exampleZh: 那天她善良的话语给房间里的每个人都留下了深刻印象。

impression.example: Her first impression of the city was that it was noisy.
impression.exampleZh: 她对这座城市的第一印象是它很吵。

impressive.example: Her speech about climate change was very impressive and moved the whole audience.
impressive.exampleZh: 她关于气候变化的演讲非常令人印象深刻，感动了全场观众。

improve.example: We must improve our English skills before the exam next month.
improve.exampleZh: 我们必须在下个月的考试前提高我们的英语水平。

improvement.example: There is a clear improvement in his English this year.
improvement.exampleZh: 今年他的英语有了明显的进步。

impulse.example: She bought the expensive dress on impulse without thinking about the price.
impulse.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条昂贵的裙子，没有考虑价格。

in.example: My keys are in my bag, but my phone is still at home.
in.exampleZh: 我的钥匙在我包里，但我的手机还在家里。

inch.example: The nail is one inch too long for this small hole.
inch.exampleZh: 这颗钉子对这个小小的洞来说长了一英寸。

incidence.example: The incidence of the disease is higher in older people.
incidence.exampleZh: 这种疾病的发病率在老年人中更高。

incident.example: A small incident at school taught him to be more careful.
incident.exampleZh: 学校里的一个小插曲让他学会了更加小心。

incline.example: The road inclines sharply as it climbs the hill.
incline.exampleZh: 这条路在爬坡时急剧倾斜。

include.example: The price includes breakfast and free use of the hotel gym.
include.exampleZh: 这个价格包括早餐和免费使用酒店健身房。

inclusive.example: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free Wi-Fi.
inclusive.exampleZh: 这个价格包含早餐和免费 Wi-Fi。

income.example: Her monthly income is not enough to pay for the rent.
income.exampleZh: 她的月收入不足以支付房租。

increase.example: The price of food will increase again next year.
increase.exampleZh: 明年食品价格将再次上涨。

increasingly.example: People are increasingly using their phones to pay for things.
increasingly.exampleZh: 人们越来越多地使用手机来付款。

incredible.example: The view from the mountain was incredible, and we took many photos.
incredible.exampleZh: 山上的景色美得令人难以置信，我们拍了很多照片。

indeed.example: The movie was indeed very long, but I enjoyed it.
indeed.exampleZh: 这部电影确实很长，但我很享受。

independence.example: Learning to cook gave her more independence at home.
independence.exampleZh: 学会做饭让她在家里更加独立。

independent.example: She is an independent woman who makes her own decisions.
independent.exampleZh: 她是个独立的女性，自己做决定。

index.example: The book has a helpful index at the back.
index.exampleZh: 这本书后面有一个有用的索引。

indicate.example: The red light indicates that the machine is not working.
indicate.exampleZh: 红灯表明机器没有运转。

indication.example: A high fever can be an indication that the body is fighting an infection.
indication.exampleZh: 高烧可能是身体正在抵抗感染的一个迹象。

indifferent.example: He was indifferent to the bad news and went on reading.
indifferent.exampleZh: 他对这个坏消息漠不关心，继续看书。

indirect.example: She gave an indirect answer to my question about the money.
indirect.exampleZh: 她对我关于钱的问题给了一个拐弯抹角的回答。

indispensable.example: Good sleep is indispensable for a student's health and good grades.
indispensable.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠对学生的健康和好成绩是必不可少的。

individual.example: Each individual student in our class has a different way of learning.
individual.exampleZh: 我们班每个学生都有不同的学习方式。

indoor.example: We play indoor games when the weather is cold and rainy.
indoor.exampleZh: 天气寒冷又多雨时，我们玩室内游戏。

indoors.example: When it rains, the children play indoors with their toys.
indoors.exampleZh: 下雨的时候，孩子们在室内玩玩具。

induce.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about the trip.
induce.exampleZh: 没有什么能劝诱他改变关于这次旅行的想法。

indulge.example: Parents should not indulge their children too much.
indulge.exampleZh: 父母不应过于纵容孩子。

industrial.example: This city is a major industrial center with many large factories.
industrial.exampleZh: 这座城市是一个拥有许多大型工厂的主要工业中心。

industrialize.example: Many countries began to industrialize quickly after the war.
industrialize.exampleZh: 许多国家在战后开始迅速工业化。

industry.example: The car industry provides many jobs for people in this city.
industry.exampleZh: 汽车产业为这座城市的许多人提供了工作机会。

inevitable.example: It is inevitable that we will make mistakes when we learn new things.
inevitable.exampleZh: 我们学习新事物时犯错是不可避免的。

infant.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms all afternoon.
infant.exampleZh: 那个婴儿整个下午都在母亲怀里安静地睡觉。

infect.example: The sick child may infect others, so he must stay home today.
infect.exampleZh: 这个生病的孩子可能会传染给别人，所以今天他必须待在家里。

infectious.example: Her laughter is so infectious that everyone in the room smiles too.
infectious.exampleZh: 她的笑声极具感染力，房间里的每个人也都跟着笑了。

infer.example: From her face, I inferred that she was not happy.
infer.exampleZh: 从她的表情，我推断出她并不开心。

inference.example: From these facts we can draw a reasonable inference about the cause.
inference.exampleZh: 根据这些事实，我们可以对原因作出合理的推断。

inferior.example: This phone is cheaper but clearly inferior to the one I bought last year.
inferior.exampleZh: 这部手机更便宜，但明显不如我去年买的那部。

infinite.example: The night sky seems infinite when you look at all the stars.
infinite.exampleZh: 当你看着满天繁星时，夜空似乎无边无际。

inflation.example: High inflation makes it hard for families to buy food and clothes.
inflation.exampleZh: 高通货膨胀使家庭难以购买食物和衣服。

influence.example: Parents have a strong influence on how their children think and behave.
influence.exampleZh: 父母对孩子的思考和行为方式有很大的影响。

influential.example: She is an influential teacher who helps many students learn English well.
influential.exampleZh: 她是一位有影响力的老师，帮助许多学生学好英语。

inform.example: Please inform your teacher if you cannot come to class tomorrow.
inform.exampleZh: 如果你明天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

information.example: Please send me more information about the new English course.
information.exampleZh: 请把关于新英语课程的更多信息发给我。

infrared.example: The camera can see infrared light that our eyes cannot see.
infrared.exampleZh: 这种相机能看到我们眼睛看不到的红外线光。

ingredient.example: The main ingredient in this cake is fresh milk and eggs.
ingredient.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕的主要原料是新鲜牛奶和鸡蛋。

inhabit.example: Many kinds of birds inhabit this quiet forest near the lake.
inhabit.exampleZh: 许多种类的鸟栖息在湖边这片安静的森林里。

inhabitant.example: The small island has only about two hundred inhabitants.
inhabitant.exampleZh: 这个小岛只有大约两百名居民。

inherit.example: She will inherit her grandmother's old house next spring.
inherit.exampleZh: 她明年春天将继承她祖母的旧房子。

initial.example: Please write your initial at the bottom of the page.
initial.exampleZh: 请在页面底部写下你姓名的首字母。

initiate.example: The company will initiate a new training program next month.
initiate.exampleZh: 公司下个月将启动一个新的培训项目。

initiative.example: She took the initiative to organize the meeting and helped every team member.
initiative.exampleZh: 她主动组织会议，并帮助了每位团队成员。

inject.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into his arm this morning.
inject.exampleZh: 护士今天上午会把药注射进他的手臂。

injure.example: He fell off his bike and injured his left leg yesterday.
injure.exampleZh: 他昨天从自行车上摔下来，伤了左腿。

injury.example: He missed the game because of a knee injury.
injury.exampleZh: 他因为膝盖受伤而错过了比赛。

injustice.example: The workers stood together against the injustice they faced every day.
injustice.exampleZh: 工人们团结起来，反对他们每天面临的不公正。

ink.example: My pen needs more ink before I can finish the letter.
ink.exampleZh: 我的笔需要更多墨水，我才能写完这封信。

inn.example: We spent the night at a small inn near the river.
inn.exampleZh: 我们在河边一家小旅馆住了一晚。

inner.example: Her inner room is small, but it is warm and quiet.
inner.exampleZh: 她的里间很小，但温暖又安静。

innocent.example: The judge said the young man was innocent and let him go home.
innocent.exampleZh: 法官说这个年轻人是无罪的，于是让他回家了。

innovation.example: This new phone shows great innovation in design and is easy to use.
innovation.exampleZh: 这款新手机在设计上展现了很大的创新，而且使用起来很方便。

innumerable.example: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.

input.example: The computer needs more input before it can finish the work.
input.exampleZh: 这台电脑需要更多输入才能完成这项工作。

inquire.example: She called to inquire about the price of the tickets.
inquire.exampleZh: 她打电话询问了机票的价格。

inquiry.example: She made a polite inquiry about the new job at the front desk.
inquiry.exampleZh: 她礼貌地在前台询问了那份新工作的情况。

insane.example: It is insane to drive that fast on a busy road.
insane.exampleZh: 在繁忙的道路上开那么快真是疯了。

insect.example: A small insect is walking on the green leaf.
insect.exampleZh: 一只小昆虫正在绿叶上爬行。

insert.example: Please insert your card into the machine and wait for a moment.
insert.exampleZh: 请把卡插入机器，然后稍等片刻。

inside.example: The keys are inside the small blue bag on the table.
inside.exampleZh: 钥匙在桌子上那个蓝色的小包里。

insight.example: Her book gives useful insight into how young children learn to read.
insight.exampleZh: 她的书为了解幼儿如何学习阅读提供了有用的深刻见解。

insist.example: She insists that we should leave early to catch the train.
insist.exampleZh: 她坚持我们应该早点出发去赶火车。

inspect.example: The teacher came to inspect our classroom before the new term began.
inspect.exampleZh: 新学期开始前，老师来检查了我们的教室。

inspector.example: The inspector looked closely at the old bridge and wrote a short report.
inspector.exampleZh: 检查员仔细查看了那座旧桥，并写了一份简短的报告。

inspire.example: Her hard work and kind words inspired me to try again.
inspire.exampleZh: 她的努力工作和善意话语激励我再次尝试。

install.example: We will install the new software on every computer tomorrow morning.
install.exampleZh: 我们明天早上会在每台电脑上安装这个新软件。

installation.example: The installation of the new machine took two days.
installation.exampleZh: 新机器的安装花了两天时间。

installment.example: I pay my new phone in monthly installments of fifty dollars.
installment.exampleZh: 我以每月五十美元的分期付款方式购买这部新手机。

instance.example: This is a clear instance of how small changes can save money.
instance.exampleZh: 这是一个关于小改变如何省钱的清晰例子。

instant.example: The rain stopped and the instant the sun came out, the children ran outside to play.
instant.exampleZh: 雨停了，就在太阳出来的那一刻，孩子们跑到外面去玩。

instead.example: I stayed home instead of going out in the rain.
instead.exampleZh: 下雨了，我没出门，而是待在家里。

instinct.example: She trusted her instinct and took the job that felt right.
instinct.exampleZh: 她相信自己的直觉，接受了那份感觉很合适的工作。

institute.example: She works at a small institute that studies how children learn language.
institute.exampleZh: 她在一家研究儿童如何学习语言的小型研究所工作。

institution.example: The bank is a large financial institution in our city.
institution.exampleZh: 这家银行是我们城市中一家大型金融机构。

instruct.example: The teacher will instruct the students to read the new book.
instruct.exampleZh: 老师会指示学生们阅读这本新书。

instruction.example: Read the instructions carefully before you use this new machine.
instruction.exampleZh: 使用这台新机器前，请仔细阅读用法说明。

instructor.example: Our driving instructor is very patient with new students.
instructor.exampleZh: 我们的驾驶教练对新学员非常有耐心。

instrument.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my ears.
instrument.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查我的耳朵。

instrumental.example: Her advice was instrumental in helping me find a new job.
instrumental.exampleZh: 她的建议对我找到新工作起了很大作用。

insult.example: He did not mean to insult you with that joke.
insult.exampleZh: 他那个玩笑并不是有意侮辱你。

insurance.example: I pay for car insurance every month to feel safe.
insurance.exampleZh: 我每个月付汽车保险费，以获得安全感。

insure.example: We insure our house against fire and theft.
insure.exampleZh: 我们为房子投保火灾和盗窃险。

intact.example: The old vase stayed intact after the earthquake shook the whole house.
intact.exampleZh: 地震震动了整栋房子后，那只旧花瓶依然完好无损。

integrate.example: We need to integrate the new workers into our team quickly.
integrate.exampleZh: 我们需要让新员工尽快融入我们的团队。

integration.example: The integration of these two teams will make our work much faster.
integration.exampleZh: 这两个团队的融合会让我们的工作快得多。

integrity.example: Her integrity made everyone trust her with important work.
integrity.exampleZh: 她的正直让每个人都放心把重要的工作交给她。

intellectual.example: She enjoys intellectual conversations with her friends and reads a lot of books.
intellectual.exampleZh: 她喜欢和朋友们进行有智力的交谈，也读很多书。

intelligence.example: Her intelligence helps her solve difficult problems quickly.
intelligence.exampleZh: 她的智慧帮助她迅速解决难题。

intelligent.example: She is an intelligent student who always asks good questions.
intelligent.exampleZh: 她是个聪明的学生，总是提出好问题。

intend.example: I intend to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
intend.exampleZh: 我打算今晚晚饭前完成作业。

intense.example: The competition was so intense that everyone felt very tired afterwards.
intense.exampleZh: 比赛如此激烈，以至于赛后每个人都感到非常疲惫。

intensity.example: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
intensity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的强度让小镇上的每个人都感到惊讶。

intensive.example: The city offers an intensive English course for busy working adults.
intensive.exampleZh: 这座城市为忙碌的上班族开设了密集英语课程。

intention.example: I have no intention of changing my plan.
intention.exampleZh: 我没有改变计划的意图。

interact.example: These two chemicals interact with each other when you mix them.
interact.exampleZh: 当你把这两种化学品混合时，它们会相互作用。

interaction.example: Good interaction between teachers and students makes learning more fun.
interaction.exampleZh: 师生之间良好的互动让学习更有趣。

interest.example: She has a strong interest in music and wants to learn the piano.
interest.exampleZh: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣，想学钢琴。

interesting.example: This book is very interesting and I read it every night.
interesting.exampleZh: 这本书很有趣，我每天晚上都读。

interfere.example: Please do not interfere with my work while I am busy.
interfere.exampleZh: 我忙的时候请不要打扰我的工作。

interference.example: The bad weather caused interference with the radio signal.
interference.exampleZh: 恶劣的天气对无线电信号造成了干扰。

interior.example: The interior of the old house was warm and full of light.
interior.exampleZh: 这座老房子的内部温暖而明亮。

intermediate.example: This class is for intermediate students who already know some basic English.
intermediate.exampleZh: 这个班是给已经懂一些基础英语的中级学生上的。

internal.example: The company keeps its internal reports private and never shares them.
internal.exampleZh: 公司将其内部报告保密，从不对外分享。

international.example: She works for an international company and travels to many countries.
international.exampleZh: 她在一家国际公司工作，经常去很多国家出差。

internet.example: I use the internet every day to read news and send emails.
internet.exampleZh: 我每天用互联网看新闻和发邮件。

interpret.example: She can interpret what the teacher says into Chinese for us.
interpret.exampleZh: 她能把老师说的话为我们翻译成中文。

interpretation.example: Her interpretation of the poem helped us understand its deeper meaning.
interpretation.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的解读帮助我们理解了它更深层的含义。

interpreter.example: The interpreter helped the two doctors talk to each other during the meeting.
interpreter.exampleZh: 会议期间，那位口译员帮助两位医生互相交流。

interrupt.example: Please do not interrupt me while I am talking to the teacher.
interrupt.exampleZh: 我和老师说话的时候，请不要打断我。

interval.example: There is a short interval between the two classes.
interval.exampleZh: 两节课之间有一段短暂的间隔。

interview.example: She has an interview with a new company tomorrow morning.
interview.exampleZh: 她明天上午要去一家新公司面试。

intimate.example: She is my intimate friend and we share every secret.
intimate.exampleZh: 她是我的密友，我们分享每一个秘密。

into.example: She walked into the kitchen and made a cup of tea.
into.exampleZh: 她走进厨房，泡了一杯茶。

intricate.example: The old clock has an intricate design inside.
intricate.exampleZh: 这座旧钟内部有一个精细复杂的设计。

intrigue.example: The strange old house intrigued the children and they wanted to explore it.
intrigue.exampleZh: 那座古怪的老房子激起了孩子们的好奇心，他们想进去探个究竟。

introduce.example: Let me introduce you to my new teacher.
introduce.exampleZh: 让我把你介绍给我的新老师。

introduction.example: This book has a short introduction at the beginning.
introduction.exampleZh: 这本书的开头有一篇简短的引言。

invade.example: Tourists invade this small town every summer.
invade.exampleZh: 每年夏天，游客都会涌入这座小镇。

invasion.example: The country built a strong army to stop any invasion from the north.
invasion.exampleZh: 这个国家建立了一支强大的军队来阻止来自北方的任何入侵。

invent.example: He wants to invent a small machine that can clean the floor.
invent.exampleZh: 他想发明一台能清洁地板的小机器。

invention.example: The invention of the telephone changed how people talk to each other.
invention.exampleZh: 电话的发明改变了人们相互交流的方式。

inventor.example: The inventor of this machine is a young woman from our town.
inventor.exampleZh: 这台机器的发明者是我们镇上的一位年轻女性。

invest.example: She plans to invest her savings in a small local business.
invest.exampleZh: 她打算把积蓄投资到当地一家小企业。

investigate.example: The police will investigate the case and find out the truth.
investigate.exampleZh: 警方将调查这个案件并查明真相。

investigation.example: The police started an investigation into the missing money.
investigation.exampleZh: 警方开始调查那笔失踪的钱。

investment.example: She made a small investment in a local coffee shop last year.
investment.exampleZh: 她去年在当地一家咖啡店做了一笔小额投资。

invisible.example: The air is invisible, but we can feel it on a windy day.
invisible.exampleZh: 空气是看不见的，但在刮风的日子我们能感觉到它。

invitation.example: She sent me an invitation to her birthday party last week.
invitation.exampleZh: 上周她给我发了一张生日聚会的请帖。

invite.example: I want to invite my new friends to dinner at my home.
invite.exampleZh: 我想邀请我的新朋友们来我家吃晚饭。

involve.example: The new job will involve a lot of travel and long hours.
involve.exampleZh: 这份新工作需要经常出差和长时间工作。

inward.example: He turned his eyes inward and thought about his own feelings.
inward.exampleZh: 他把目光转向内心，思考自己的感受。

iron.example: She used a hot iron to press her white shirt before work.
iron.exampleZh: 上班前她用热熨斗熨平了她的白衬衫。

irony.example: The irony is that the fire station itself burned down last night.
irony.exampleZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，消防站昨晚自己烧毁了。

irregular.example: His sleep schedule is irregular because he often works late at night.
irregular.exampleZh: 他的睡眠时间不规律，因为他经常工作到深夜。

irrelevant.example: His question was irrelevant to the topic, so nobody answered it.
irrelevant.exampleZh: 他的问题与主题不相关，所以没有人回答。

irrespective.example: Irrespective of the weather, we will go to the park tomorrow.
irrespective.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，我们明天都会去公园。

irrigate.example: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.

irrigation.example: The farmers use irrigation to bring water to their dry fields in summer.
irrigation.exampleZh: 夏天，农民们用灌溉把水引到干旱的田地里。

irritate.example: Loud music late at night can irritate the neighbors and cause serious problems.
irritate.exampleZh: 深夜的大声音乐会激怒邻居并引发严重问题。

island.example: This small island is very beautiful and many birds live on it.
island.exampleZh: 这个小岛非常美丽，许多鸟住在上面。

isle.example: We took a small boat to the isle and walked along its quiet beach.
isle.exampleZh: 我们乘小船去了那座小岛，沿着它安静的海滩散步。

isolate.example: Doctors had to isolate the sick child from the other children for a week.
isolate.exampleZh: 医生们不得不把那个生病的孩子与其他孩子隔离一周。

isolation.example: After the storm, the small village lived in isolation for three days.
isolation.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，这个小村庄与世隔绝地生活了三天。

issue.example: The new issue of our school magazine comes out on Friday.
issue.exampleZh: 我们学校杂志的新一期在周五发行。

it.example: It is very cold outside, so please put on your warm coat.
it.exampleZh: 外面很冷，请穿上你的暖和外套。

item.example: The first item on the list is a small red bag.
item.exampleZh: 清单上的第一项是一个红色的小包。

its.example: The dog wagged its tail when I came home from school.
its.exampleZh: 我放学回家时，那只狗摇了摇它的尾巴。

itself.example: The little cat can wash itself with its own tongue.
itself.exampleZh: 那只小猫能用它自己的舌头给自己洗澡。

ivory.example: The old piano keys are made of ivory, not plastic.
ivory.exampleZh: 那架旧钢琴的琴键是象牙做的，不是塑料的。

jail.example: The thief was sent to jail for two years after the trial.
jail.exampleZh: 审判后，那个小偷被送进监狱服刑两年。

jam.example: The morning traffic jam made me late for work again today.
jam.exampleZh: 今天早上的交通堵塞又让我上班迟到了。

january.example: January is the first month of the year in many countries.
january.exampleZh: 在许多国家，一月是一年中的第一个月。

jar.example: She put the fresh cookies in a glass jar on the shelf.
jar.exampleZh: 她把新鲜的饼干放进架子上一个玻璃罐里。

jargon.example: Legal jargon makes the contract hard for ordinary people to read.
jargon.exampleZh: 法律术语让普通人很难读懂这份合同。

jaw.example: He hit his jaw on the table and it hurt for days.
jaw.exampleZh: 他的下巴撞到了桌子上，疼了好几天。

jazz.example: My father loves jazz and plays it loud every Sunday morning.
jazz.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢爵士乐，每个周日早上都放得很大声。

jealous.example: She felt jealous when her best friend got a better job.
jealous.exampleZh: 当她最好的朋友找到一份更好的工作时，她感到妒忌。

jeans.example: My brother wears blue jeans and a white T-shirt every weekend.
jeans.exampleZh: 我哥哥每个周末都穿蓝色牛仔裤和一件白色T恤。

jet.example: The jet flew high above the clouds and left a long white line.
jet.exampleZh: 那架喷气式飞机在云层上方高高飞行，留下了一道长长的白线。

jewel.example: The queen wore a beautiful jewel on her crown.
jewel.exampleZh: 女王在自己的王冠上镶了一颗美丽的宝石。

jewelry.example: She keeps her jewelry in a small box on the table.
jewelry.exampleZh: 她把珠宝放在桌上的一个小盒子里。

job.example: She found a new job at a small shop near her home.
job.exampleZh: 她在家附近的一家小商店找到了一份新工作。

join.example: Would you like to join us for dinner tonight?
join.exampleZh: 你今晚想和我们一起吃饭吗？

joint.example: The two countries signed a joint agreement to protect the river.
joint.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项共同协议来保护这条河流。

joke.example: My friend told a funny joke and everyone laughed at the table.
joke.exampleZh: 我的朋友讲了一个有趣的笑话，桌上的每个人都笑了。

journal.example: She writes in her journal every night before going to bed.
journal.exampleZh: 她每晚睡前都会在日记里写点什么。

journalist.example: The journalist asked the mayor a question about the new school.
journalist.exampleZh: 这名记者就新学校的事向市长提了一个问题。

journey.example: The long journey across the desert took three days by car.
journey.exampleZh: 穿越沙漠的漫长旅程开车用了三天。

joy.example: The children jumped with joy when they saw the snow.
joy.exampleZh: 孩子们看到雪时高兴得跳了起来。

judge.example: The judge listened carefully and then made a fair decision for everyone.
judge.exampleZh: 法官仔细倾听，然后为每个人做出了公正的裁决。

judgment.example: Good judgment helps us make better choices in daily life.
judgment.exampleZh: 良好的判断力帮助我们在日常生活中做出更好的选择。

juice.example: I like to drink a glass of orange juice with breakfast.
juice.exampleZh: 我早餐时喜欢喝一杯橙汁。

july.example: We go to the beach with our family every July.
july.exampleZh: 每年七月我们全家都会去海边。

jump.example: The dog jumped over the fence and ran across the field.
jump.exampleZh: 那只狗跳过栅栏，跑过田野。

junction.example: Turn left at the junction and you will see the station.
junction.exampleZh: 在交叉路口向左转，你就会看到车站。

june.example: We will take a short family trip in June this year.
june.exampleZh: 今年六月我们会去进行一次短途家庭旅行。

jungle.example: The monkey quickly climbed a tall tree in the thick green jungle.
jungle.exampleZh: 那只猴子迅速爬上了茂密丛林中的一棵大树。

junior.example: My junior brother is still in high school and plays basketball every day.
junior.exampleZh: 我弟弟还在上高中，每天打篮球。

junk.example: The old man keeps junk in his yard and never throws it away.
junk.exampleZh: 那位老人在院子里堆着旧货，从不扔掉。

jury.example: The jury listened carefully to all the facts before making a decision.
jury.exampleZh: 陪审团在做出决定前仔细听取了所有事实。

just.example: The bus has just left, so we need to wait.
just.exampleZh: 公交车刚刚开走，所以我们需要等一等。

justice.example: The judge wants to bring justice to every family in this town.
justice.exampleZh: 这位法官希望为镇上的每个家庭带来公正。

justify.example: He tried to justify his mistake by blaming the bad weather.
justify.exampleZh: 他试图把错误归咎于恶劣的天气来为自己辩解。

juvenile.example: The juvenile bird cannot fly yet, so it stays in the nest.
juvenile.exampleZh: 这只幼鸟还不会飞，所以它待在巢里。

keel.example: The workers cleaned the keel of the old boat before painting it.
keel.exampleZh: 工人们在刷漆前清洗了旧船的龙骨。

keen.example: She is very keen to learn English and practices every day.
keen.exampleZh: 她非常渴望学英语，每天都练习。

keep.example: Please keep the door closed when you leave the room.
keep.exampleZh: 离开房间时请保持门关着。

keg.example: The farmer filled a small keg with fresh water for the workers.
keg.exampleZh: 农民往一个小桶里装满了清水给工人们喝。

ken.example: The book is beyond my ken, but I still enjoy reading it.
ken.exampleZh: 这本书超出了我的知识范围，但我仍然喜欢读它。

kennel.example: The little dog sleeps in a warm kennel beside the house.
kennel.exampleZh: 那只小狗睡在房子旁边一个温暖的狗窝里。

kernel.example: The kernel of his idea is simple and easy to understand.
kernel.exampleZh: 他想法中的核心很简单，容易理解。

kerosene.example: We used kerosene to start the fire in the old stove.
kerosene.exampleZh: 我们用煤油在旧炉子里生火。

kettle.example: She put the kettle on the stove to make hot tea for us.
kettle.exampleZh: 她把水壶放在炉子上，为我们烧水泡茶。

key.example: The key to the front door is on the small table.
key.exampleZh: 前门的钥匙在那张小桌子上。

keyboard.example: I type my homework on the keyboard every evening after dinner.
keyboard.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后都在键盘上打作业。

keynote.example: Her keynote set the tone for the whole meeting.
keynote.exampleZh: 她的主题演讲为整个会议定下了基调。

kick.example: He gave the ball a strong kick and it flew over the wall.
kick.exampleZh: 他用力踢了球一下，球飞过了墙。

kid.example: The kid next door likes to kid his sister about her new haircut.
kid.exampleZh: 隔壁的小孩喜欢拿他妹妹的新发型开玩笑。

kidnap.example: The police are looking for the men who kidnapped the young boy.
kidnap.exampleZh: 警方正在寻找那些绑架了这个小男孩的男子。

kidney.example: The doctor said my left kidney is very healthy and works well.
kidney.exampleZh: 医生说我左肾非常健康，运转良好。

kill.example: The cold weather may kill the young plants in the garden.
kill.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气可能会冻死花园里的幼苗。

kilo.example: The bag of rice weighs about one kilo, so it is easy to carry.
kilo.exampleZh: 这袋米大约重一公斤，所以很容易携带。

kilogram.example: The bag of rice weighs one kilogram more than my little sister's cat.
kilogram.exampleZh: 这袋大米比我妹妹的猫重一公斤。

kilometer.example: The school is two kilometers away from my house.
kilometer.exampleZh: 学校离我家有两公里远。

kimono.example: She wore a beautiful kimono to the festival last summer.
kimono.exampleZh: 去年夏天她穿着一件漂亮的和服去参加节日庆典。

kin.example: My kin will come to visit us this weekend.
kin.exampleZh: 我的亲属这个周末会来看望我们。

kind.example: She is kind to everyone and helps people whenever she can.
kind.exampleZh: 她对每个人都很和蔼，只要能帮到别人就会伸出援手。

kindergarten.example: My little sister goes to kindergarten every morning with our mother.
kindergarten.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天早上和妈妈一起去幼儿园。

kindle.example: Her story kindled a strong hope in my heart.
kindle.exampleZh: 她的故事在我心中激起了强烈的希望。

kindness.example: She showed great kindness to the old man next door.
kindness.exampleZh: 她对隔壁的老人非常仁慈。

kinetic.example: The moving car has kinetic energy that makes it hard to stop.
kinetic.exampleZh: 行驶中的汽车具有动能，因此很难停下来。

king.example: The king lived in a large castle with his family.
king.exampleZh: 国王和他的家人住在一座大城堡里。

kingdom.example: The old king ruled his kingdom for over forty years.
kingdom.exampleZh: 这位老国王统治他的王国四十多年。

kiss.example: She gave her baby a gentle kiss on the cheek before bed.
kiss.exampleZh: 她在睡前轻轻吻了宝宝的脸颊。

kit.example: I always keep a small tool kit in the back of my car.
kit.exampleZh: 我总是在车后备厢里放一个小工具箱。

kitchen.example: My mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
kitchen.exampleZh: 我妈妈现在正在厨房里做晚饭。

kite.example: The little boy is flying a red kite in the park.
kite.exampleZh: 小男孩正在公园里放一只红色的风筝。

kitty.example: The little kitty is sleeping on the warm sofa.
kitty.exampleZh: 那只小猫正在温暖的沙发上睡觉。

knack.example: She has a knack for making difficult ideas seem simple.
knack.exampleZh: 她有一种诀窍，能把复杂的想法讲得浅显易懂。

knead.example: She kneads the dough for ten minutes before baking the bread.
knead.exampleZh: 她烤面包前把面团揉了十分钟。

knee.example: My knee hurts a little after I played football for two hours.
knee.exampleZh: 我踢了两个小时足球后，膝盖有点疼。

kneel.example: She had to kneel down to tie her little son's shoes.
kneel.exampleZh: 她不得不跪下来给她小儿子的鞋系鞋带。

knelt.example: She knelt down beside the old dog and gently touched its head.
knelt.exampleZh: 她在老狗旁边跪下，轻轻摸了摸它的头。

knife.example: Please be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the bread.
knife.exampleZh: 切面包时请小心那把锋利的刀。

knight.example: The brave knight rode a white horse and carried a long sword.
knight.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士骑着白马，手持一把长剑。

knit.example: She likes to knit warm sweaters for her family in winter.
knit.exampleZh: 她喜欢在冬天为家人编织温暖的毛衣。

knob.example: She turned the knob on the door and walked into the room.
knob.exampleZh: 她转动门上的把手，走进了房间。

knock.example: Someone knocked on the door while we were eating dinner.
knock.exampleZh: 我们吃晚饭的时候有人敲门。

knot.example: He tied a tight knot in the rope and pulled it hard.
knot.exampleZh: 他在绳子上打了一个紧结，然后用力拉。

know.example: I know his name, but I do not know him well.
know.exampleZh: 我知道他的名字，但不太了解他。

knowledge.example: Good knowledge of English can help you find a better job.
knowledge.exampleZh: 良好的英语知识能帮助你找到一份更好的工作。

knuckle.example: He cut his knuckle on the rough edge of the door.
knuckle.exampleZh: 他在门的粗糙边缘上割伤了指关节。

lab.example: The students went to the lab to do a science experiment.
lab.exampleZh: 学生们去实验室做一个科学实验。

label.example: Please read the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
label.exampleZh: 吃药前请先看一下瓶子上的标签。

laboratory.example: The students did a simple science experiment in the laboratory today.
laboratory.exampleZh: 学生们今天在实验室里做了一个简单的科学实验。

labour.example: The workers asked for better pay and safer working conditions for their labour.
labour.exampleZh: 工人们要求为他们的劳动获得更好的报酬和更安全的工作条件。

lack.example: Many students lack the money to buy new books for school.
lack.exampleZh: 很多学生缺钱买新书上学。

lad.example: The young lad helped his father carry the heavy boxes into the house.
lad.exampleZh: 这个少年帮父亲把沉重的箱子搬进屋里。

ladder.example: He climbed the ladder to reach the top shelf.
ladder.exampleZh: 他爬上梯子去够最上层的架子。

lady.example: The kind lady helped me find my way home.
lady.exampleZh: 那位好心的女士帮我找到了回家的路。

lag.example: Our old computer lags behind the new ones at work.
lag.exampleZh: 我们的旧电脑比办公室里的新电脑慢。

lake.example: We went swimming in the lake near our house last summer.
lake.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们在我家附近的湖里游泳。

lamb.example: The little lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.exampleZh: 小羊羔在田野里紧挨着它的妈妈。

lamp.example: She turned on the small lamp beside her bed and read a book.
lamp.exampleZh: 她打开床边的小灯，读起一本书来。

land.example: They landed the small plane on a wide field near the village.
land.exampleZh: 他们让那架小飞机降落在村庄附近的一片宽阔田野上。

landlady.example: The landlady collects the rent from every family in the building.
landlady.exampleZh: 女房东向这栋楼里的每一户收房租。

landlord.example: The landlord fixed the broken window in our apartment yesterday.
landlord.exampleZh: 房东昨天修好了我们公寓里坏掉的窗户。

landscape.example: The mountain landscape looks beautiful in the early morning light.
landscape.exampleZh: 清晨的山地风景看起来很美。

lane.example: The old man walks slowly down the narrow lane every morning.
lane.exampleZh: 那位老人每天早上都沿着狭窄的小巷慢慢走。

language.example: Learning a new language takes time and daily practice.
language.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间和每天练习。

lantern.example: We hung a red paper lantern outside the front door last night.
lantern.exampleZh: 昨晚我们在前门外挂了一盏红纸灯笼。

lap.example: The cat sat on her lap and began to lick its paw.
lap.exampleZh: 猫坐在她腿上，开始舔自己的爪子。

large.example: This box is too large for my small car.
large.exampleZh: 这个箱子对我的小汽车来说太大了。

largely.example: The success of the project largely depends on careful planning and teamwork.
largely.exampleZh: 这个项目的成功很大程度上取决于周密的计划和团队合作。

laser.example: The doctor used a laser to fix the problem in my eye.
laser.exampleZh: 医生用激光治疗我眼睛的问题。

last.example: This is the last bus, and the trip takes two hours.
last.exampleZh: 这是最后一班公交车，车程需要两个小时。

late.example: I am late for school because my alarm clock did not ring.
late.exampleZh: 我上学迟到了，因为我的闹钟没有响。

lately.example: I have been very busy at work lately.

latent.example: The doctor said the virus may stay latent in the body for years.
latent.exampleZh: 医生说这种病毒可能在体内潜伏多年。

later.example: I will call you later when I finish my work.
later.exampleZh: 我完成工作后会稍后给你打电话。

lateral.example: The doctor found a small cut on the lateral side of his left leg.
lateral.exampleZh: 医生在他左腿的外侧发现了一个小伤口。

latin.example: Latin is still taught in many schools around the world today.
latin.exampleZh: 如今世界上许多学校仍在教授拉丁语。

latter.example: Of the two plans, I prefer the latter one.
latter.exampleZh: 这两个方案中，我更喜欢后一个。

laugh.example: Her funny story made all of us laugh out loud in the small kitchen.
laugh.exampleZh: 她有趣的故事让我们所有人在小厨房里都大声笑了起来。

laughter.example: Her loud laughter filled the small room and made everyone smile.
laughter.exampleZh: 她响亮的笑声充满了小房间，让每个人都笑了。

launch.example: The company will launch its new phone next week.
launch.exampleZh: 公司将于下周推出它的新手机。

laundry.example: I take my dirty clothes to the laundry every Sunday morning.
laundry.exampleZh: 我每个星期天早上把脏衣服送到洗衣店。

lavatory.example: The school has a clean lavatory next to the library.
lavatory.exampleZh: 学校图书馆旁边有一间干净的盥洗室。

law.example: Everyone must obey the law, even people with power.
law.exampleZh: 每个人都必须遵守法律，即使是有权有势的人。

lawn.example: The children are playing football on the lawn in front of our house.
lawn.exampleZh: 孩子们正在我们房子前面的草坪上踢足球。

lawsuit.example: The company faced a lawsuit after the accident.
lawsuit.exampleZh: 事故发生后，这家公司面临一场诉讼。

lawyer.example: The lawyer asked my brother a few simple questions about the accident.
lawyer.exampleZh: 律师就那起事故问了我哥哥几个简单的问题。

lay.example: She will lay the baby on the soft bed.
lay.exampleZh: 她会把婴儿放在柔软的床上。

layer.example: The cake has three layers of cream and fruit.
layer.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕有三层奶油和水果。

layoff.example: The company announced a layoff of fifty workers at its factory last week.
layoff.exampleZh: 公司上周宣布在其工厂裁员五十名工人。

layout.example: The layout of the small room makes it feel big.
layout.exampleZh: 这个小房间的布局让它显得很大。

lazy.example: My little brother is too lazy to clean his room on weekends.
lazy.exampleZh: 我弟弟太懒了，周末都不肯打扫自己的房间。

lead.example: The new manager will lead the team to finish the project on time.
lead.exampleZh: 新经理将带领团队按时完成这个项目。

leader.example: A good leader listens to the team and makes fair decisions.
leader.exampleZh: 好的领导者会倾听团队的意见并做出公正的决定。

leadership.example: Good leadership helps a team work together and reach its goals.
leadership.exampleZh: 良好的领导力能帮助团队协同合作并达成目标。

leading.example: This company is a leading maker of electric cars.
leading.exampleZh: 这家公司是电动汽车的主要制造商。

leaf.example: A green leaf fell from the tall tree and landed on the grass.
leaf.exampleZh: 一片绿叶从高高的树上落下，掉在了草地上。

leaflet.example: She handed me a leaflet about the new library hours.
leaflet.exampleZh: 她递给我一张关于图书馆新开放时间的传单。

league.example: The two small countries formed a league to protect each other.
league.exampleZh: 这两个小国结成一个联盟以互相保护。

leak.example: Gas began to leak from the old pipe under the kitchen sink.
leak.exampleZh: 煤气开始从厨房水槽下面的旧管道中泄漏出来。

leakage.example: The plumber found a small leakage in the pipe under the kitchen sink.
leakage.exampleZh: 水管工在厨房水槽下方的管道里发现了一个小渗漏。

lean.example: The old tree leans to one side because of the strong wind.
lean.exampleZh: 那棵老树因为强风而向一侧倾斜。

leap.example: The cat made a big leap onto the table and knocked over the cup.
leap.exampleZh: 猫猛地一跳跳上桌子，把杯子撞倒了。

learn.example: Children learn new words quickly when they read simple books every day.
learn.exampleZh: 孩子们每天读简单的书时，学新单词很快。

learned.example: The learned old professor explained the difficult idea in a simple way.
learned.exampleZh: 这位博学的老教授用简单的方式解释了这个难懂的概念。

learning.example: Learning a new language takes time, practice and a lot of patience.
learning.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要时间、练习和很大的耐心。

lease.example: We signed a two-year lease for the small apartment near the park.
lease.exampleZh: 我们为公园附近那套小公寓签了一份两年的租约。

least.example: This old car uses the least gas among all the cars here.
least.exampleZh: 这辆旧车是这里所有车中最省油的。

leather.example: My father bought a brown leather bag for his trip to Beijing.
leather.exampleZh: 我父亲为他的北京之行买了一个棕色皮包。

leave.example: I will leave my bag at home and go to work now.
leave.exampleZh: 我现在会把包留在家里然后去上班。

lecture.example: Our teacher gave a lecture about the history of our city.
lecture.exampleZh: 我们的老师做了一场关于我们城市历史的讲座。

lecturer.example: The lecturer explained the difficult topic in a clear and simple way.
lecturer.exampleZh: 这位讲师用清晰简单的方式讲解了这个难懂的话题。

left.example: Turn left at the bank, and the left door is yours.
left.exampleZh: 在银行处向左转，左边那扇门就是你的。

leg.example: My leg hurts after the long walk to school.
leg.exampleZh: 走到学校那么远之后，我的腿疼。

legacy.example: His family gave the old house to the city as a legacy.
legacy.exampleZh: 他的家人把那座老房子作为遗产捐给了这座城市。

legal.example: It is legal to drive a car in most countries after you turn eighteen.
legal.exampleZh: 在大多数国家，年满十八岁后开车是合法的。

legend.example: The old legend says a hero once lived in this mountain.
legend.exampleZh: 这个古老的传说讲的是曾有一位英雄住在这座山里。

legislation.example: The new legislation will protect children from dangerous online content.
legislation.exampleZh: 新立法将保护儿童免受危险的网络内容侵害。

legislative.example: The legislative group met to discuss the new school rules.
legislative.exampleZh: 立法小组开会讨论新的学校规定。

legitimate.example: It is a legitimate question, so please answer it clearly.
legitimate.exampleZh: 这是一个合理的问题，所以请清楚地回答它。

leisure.example: I have more leisure on weekends to read books and take long walks.
leisure.exampleZh: 周末我有更多空闲时间读书和长时间散步。

lemon.example: I like to put a slice of lemon in my tea.
lemon.exampleZh: 我喜欢在茶里放一片柠檬。

lemonade.example: On hot days, my sister likes to drink cold lemonade in the garden.
lemonade.exampleZh: 热天里，我妹妹喜欢在花园里喝冰柠檬水。

lend.example: Can you lend me your book for a few days?
lend.exampleZh: 你能把书借给我几天吗？

length.example: The length of this table is two meters.
length.exampleZh: 这张桌子的长度是两米。

lengthen.example: They plan to lengthen the road before winter comes.
lengthen.exampleZh: 他们计划在冬天到来前把这条路延长。

lens.example: The camera lens was dirty, so every photo looked a little blurry.
lens.exampleZh: 相机镜头脏了，所以每张照片看起来都有点模糊。

less.example: I have less time today, so let us work faster.
less.exampleZh: 我今天时间更少，所以我们快点干活吧。

lesser.example: This is a lesser problem than the one we faced yesterday.
lesser.exampleZh: 这是一个比我们昨天面对的问题次要的问题。

lesson.example: The teacher gave us a useful lesson about honesty and hard work.
lesson.exampleZh: 老师给我们上了一堂关于诚实与勤奋的有益课程。

lest.example: She spoke softly lest she wake the sleeping baby.
lest.exampleZh: 她轻声说话，唯恐吵醒睡着的婴儿。

let.example: My father lets me use his car on weekends.
let.exampleZh: 我父亲允许我在周末用他的车。

letter.example: She wrote a short letter to her teacher last week.
letter.exampleZh: 她上周给老师写了一封短短的信。

level.example: Her English level is higher than mine, but we both keep learning every day.
level.exampleZh: 她的英语水平比我高，但我们俩每天都在继续学习。

lever.example: The workers used a long iron lever to lift the heavy box.
lever.exampleZh: 工人们用一根长铁杠杆抬起了那个沉重的箱子。

leverage.example: The company used its strong brand as leverage in the negotiation.
leverage.exampleZh: 这家公司利用其强大的品牌作为谈判筹码。

levy.example: The city plans to levy a new tax on large cars next year.
levy.exampleZh: 市政府计划明年对大型汽车征收一项新税。

liability.example: Heavy debt became a liability for the small company.
liability.exampleZh: 沉重的债务成了这家小公司的累赘。

liable.example: The driver is liable for any damage caused in the accident.
liable.exampleZh: 司机对事故中造成的任何损失负有法律责任。

liar.example: He is a liar, so nobody here believes his stories.
liar.exampleZh: 他是个说谎者，所以这里没人相信他的故事。

liberal.example: She has liberal views and always supports new ideas.
liberal.exampleZh: 她思想开明，总是支持新想法。

liberate.example: The soldiers came to liberate the small town from its enemies.
liberate.exampleZh: 士兵们来从敌人手中解放这座小镇。

liberty.example: Every person should have the liberty to speak and live as they choose.
liberty.exampleZh: 每个人都应该拥有按照自己意愿说话和生活的自由。

librarian.example: The librarian helped me find a quiet corner to read my book.
librarian.exampleZh: 图书管理员帮我找到了一个安静的角落读我的书。

library.example: I often study in the library after school with my friends.
library.exampleZh: 放学后我经常和朋友们在图书馆学习。

license.example: You need a license to drive a car in this country.
license.exampleZh: 在这个国家，你需要驾照才能开车。

lick.example: The dog began to lick my hand after I gave it some food.
lick.exampleZh: 我给了它一些食物后，那只狗开始舔我的手。

lid.example: She lifted the lid of the pot to check the soup.

lie.example: Do not lie to your friends, because they will trust you less.
lie.exampleZh: 不要对朋友说谎，因为他们会因此不那么信任你。

lieutenant.example: The lieutenant led his soldiers across the small river before sunrise.
lieutenant.exampleZh: 中尉在日出前带领士兵渡过了那条小河。

life.example: My grandfather says his life became much happier after he retired.
life.exampleZh: 我爷爷说退休后他的一生变得快乐多了。

lifetime.example: She spent her lifetime helping children learn to read.
lifetime.exampleZh: 她一生都在帮助孩子们学习阅读。

lift.example: She lifted the heavy box and carried it to the elevator.
lift.exampleZh: 她把那个沉重的箱子抬起来，搬到了电梯里。

light.example: Please turn on the light so we can see the way.
light.exampleZh: 请打开灯，这样我们就能看清路了。

lightning.example: The lightning was very bright and lit up the whole sky.
lightning.exampleZh: 那道闪电非常明亮，照亮了整个天空。

like.example: I like this small blue bag because it looks like my sister's.
like.exampleZh: 我喜欢这个蓝色的小包，因为它看起来像我姐姐的那个。

likelihood.example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow afternoon.
likelihood.exampleZh: 明天下午下雨的可能性很大。

likely.example: It is likely to rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
likely.exampleZh: 明天可能会下雨，所以带把伞。

likewise.example: She works hard, and her brother works likewise.
likewise.exampleZh: 她工作很努力，她的弟弟也同样努力。

limb.example: The boy fell from the tree and hurt his left limb.
limb.exampleZh: 男孩从树上摔下来，伤到了他的左肢。

limit.example: There is a limit to how fast we can run.
limit.exampleZh: 我们奔跑的速度是有限度的。

limitation.example: One major limitation of this plan is its high cost.
limitation.exampleZh: 这个计划的一个主要局限是成本太高。

limited.example: The seats in this small room are very limited.
limited.exampleZh: 这个小房间里的座位非常有限。

line.example: Please stand in a straight line and wait for your turn.
line.exampleZh: 请排成一条直线，等待轮到你。

linear.example: The graph shows a linear rise in temperature over the past ten years.
linear.exampleZh: 这张图显示过去十年气温呈线性上升。

linen.example: She put fresh linen on the bed before her guests arrived.
linen.exampleZh: 客人到来之前，她在床上铺上了干净的亚麻布。

liner.example: The liner sailed across the ocean with hundreds of happy passengers on board.
liner.exampleZh: 那艘班轮载着数百名快乐的乘客横渡大洋。

linger.example: She likes to linger in the garden after school.
linger.exampleZh: 放学后她喜欢在花园里逗留。

link.example: The new bridge will link the small town to the busy city.
link.exampleZh: 这座新桥将把小镇与繁忙的城市连接起来。

lip.example: She put some red color on her lips before the party.
lip.exampleZh: 她在聚会前给嘴唇涂了点红色。

liquid.example: Water is a liquid, but ice is a solid.

liquor.example: He does not drink liquor because it makes him feel sick.
liquor.exampleZh: 他不喝烈性酒，因为那会让他感到不舒服。

list.example: Please make a list of the things we need for the trip.
list.exampleZh: 请列一张我们旅行需要带的东西的清单。

listen.example: Please listen to your teacher carefully in class every day.
listen.exampleZh: 请每天在课堂上认真听老师讲课。

literacy.example: Basic literacy helps people find jobs and take care of their families.
literacy.exampleZh: 基本的识字能力帮助人们找到工作并照顾家人。

literal.example: His literal translation of the poem sounds strange in English.
literal.exampleZh: 他对这首诗的字面翻译在英语里听起来很奇怪。

literally.example: He literally ate every cookie on the plate in five minutes.
literally.exampleZh: 他确实在五分钟内吃光了盘子里的每一块饼干。

literary.example: She writes literary essays in her free time.
literary.exampleZh: 她在空闲时间写文学随笔。

literature.example: She studies English literature at a large university in the north.
literature.exampleZh: 她在北方的一所大型大学学习英国文学。

litre.example: We bought two litres of milk at the small shop near our school.
litre.exampleZh: 我们在学校附近的小店买了两升牛奶。

litter.example: Please do not litter in the park; put your trash in the bin.
litter.exampleZh: 请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾，把垃圾扔进垃圾桶里。

little.example: There is little water left in the old bottle.
little.exampleZh: 旧瓶子里剩下的水不多了。

live.example: My grandparents live in a small village, and they enjoy a quiet life.
live.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在一个小村庄里，他们享受安静的生活。

lively.example: The lively children played games in the park all afternoon.
lively.exampleZh: 那些活泼的孩子们整个下午都在公园里玩游戏。

liver.example: The doctor said my liver is healthy, so I can keep eating well.
liver.exampleZh: 医生说我的肝脏很健康，所以我可以继续保持良好的饮食。

living.example: The old man is still living in that small house near the river.
living.exampleZh: 那位老人仍然住在河边的那座小房子里。

load.example: The truck can carry a heavy load of boxes and bags.
load.exampleZh: 这辆卡车能装载很重的箱子和袋子。

loaf.example: She bought a loaf of bread and some milk at the store.
loaf.exampleZh: 她在商店买了一条面包和一些牛奶。

loan.example: The bank gave me a loan to buy a small house.
loan.exampleZh: 银行给了我一笔贷款，用来买一套小房子。

lobby.example: She waited in the hotel lobby while her husband talked to the manager.
lobby.exampleZh: 她在酒店门厅等候，而她丈夫在和经理谈话。

local.example: The local food here is fresh and cheap, and the local people are very friendly.
local.exampleZh: 这里的当地食物新鲜又便宜，本地人也非常友好。

locate.example: Please help me locate the small park on this map.
locate.exampleZh: 请帮我在这张地图上找到那个小公园的位置。

location.example: The hotel is in a quiet location near the park.
location.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于公园附近一个安静的位置。

lock.example: Please lock the front door before you go to work.
lock.exampleZh: 你去上班前请把前门锁好。

locomotive.example: The old locomotive pulled six cars along the river.
locomotive.exampleZh: 那辆旧机车沿着河边拉着六节车厢。

lodge.example: We will lodge in a small hotel near the station tonight.
lodge.exampleZh: 今晚我们将寄宿在车站附近的一家小旅馆里。

lofty.example: The old church stands on a lofty hill above our small town.
lofty.exampleZh: 那座古老的教堂矗立在我们小镇上方一座高耸的山丘上。

log.example: The captain wrote in the ship's log every night during the long voyage.
log.exampleZh: 在漫长的航行中，船长每晚都在航海日志里写下记录。

logic.example: The logic of his plan is easy to follow.
logic.exampleZh: 他计划的逻辑很容易理解。

logical.example: Her answer was logical and easy for everyone to understand.
logical.exampleZh: 她的回答合乎逻辑，每个人都容易理解。

lonely.example: The old man lives alone and often feels lonely in his small house.
lonely.exampleZh: 那位老人独自生活，在他那间小房子里常常感到孤独。

long.example: The river is very long and runs through three small towns.
long.exampleZh: 这条河很长，流经三个小镇。

look.example: You should look at the map before you start the trip.
look.exampleZh: 你应该在出发旅行前看一下地图。

loop.example: The kids ran in a loop around the garden.
loop.exampleZh: 孩子们绕着花园跑了一圈。

loophole.example: The company used a loophole in the law to avoid paying taxes.
loophole.exampleZh: 公司利用了法律中的一个漏洞来逃避缴税。

loose.example: This shirt is too loose for me, so I need a smaller size.
loose.exampleZh: 这件衬衫对我来说太宽松了，所以我需要小一号的。

loosen.example: Please loosen the tight lid before you open the bottle.
loosen.exampleZh: 打开瓶子之前，请先把紧盖子松开。

lord.example: The old lord lived in a large castle near the river.
lord.exampleZh: 那位老领主住在河边一座大城堡里。

lorry.example: The lorry is carrying a lot of boxes to the new shop.
lorry.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正载着许多箱子去新商店。

lose.example: Be careful with your keys, or you will lose them again.
lose.exampleZh: 小心你的钥匙，不然你又会把它们弄丢。

loss.example: The loss of his old dog made him very sad.
loss.exampleZh: 他那只老狗的失去让他非常伤心。

lost.example: The lost dog was found near the park this morning.
lost.exampleZh: 那只丢失的狗今天早上在公园附近被找到了。

lot.example: There is a lot of water on the floor after the rain.

loud.example: The music is too loud, so please turn it down.
loud.exampleZh: 音乐太响了，请把它调小一点。

loudspeaker.example: The teacher used a loudspeaker so everyone could hear her clearly.
loudspeaker.exampleZh: 老师用了一个扬声器，这样每个人都能清楚地听到她说话。

lounge.example: We waited in the hotel lounge before our room was ready.
lounge.exampleZh: 我们在酒店休息室里等房间准备好。

love.example: I love my family, and they love me too.
love.exampleZh: 我爱我的家人，他们也爱我。

lovely.example: She has a lovely smile and everyone in our class likes her.
lovely.exampleZh: 她有一个可爱的笑容，我们班上每个人都很喜欢她。

lover.example: He is a great lover of music and plays the piano every day.
lover.exampleZh: 他非常热爱音乐，每天都会弹钢琴。

low.example: The table is too low for my tall chair.
low.exampleZh: 这张桌子对我的高椅子来说太矮了。

lower.example: Please lower the volume of the music so I can hear you.
lower.exampleZh: 请把音乐音量调低一点，这样我才能听见你说话。

loyal.example: A loyal friend will always stand by you when times are hard.
loyal.exampleZh: 忠诚的朋友在困难时总会站在你身边。

loyalty.example: Her loyalty to her friends never changed, even in difficult times.
loyalty.exampleZh: 她对朋友的忠诚从未改变，即使在困难时期也是如此。

lucky.example: She feels lucky to have such kind friends and a happy family.
lucky.exampleZh: 她觉得很幸运，能有这么善良的朋友和一个幸福的家庭。

luggage.example: Please put your luggage in the car before we leave.
luggage.exampleZh: 我们出发前，请把你的行李放进车里。

lumber.example: The old truck was full of lumber and moved slowly down the road.
lumber.exampleZh: 那辆旧卡车装满了木材，沿着公路缓慢行驶。

luminous.example: The luminous moon made the whole garden look bright and beautiful.
luminous.exampleZh: 明亮的月亮让整个花园看起来明亮又美丽。

lump.example: He found a small lump on his arm and went to see a doctor.
lump.exampleZh: 他在手臂上发现一个小肿块，就去看医生了。

lunar.example: The lunar calendar is very important in Chinese culture.
lunar.exampleZh: 阴历在中国文化中非常重要。

lunch.example: I eat lunch with my friends at school every day.
lunch.exampleZh: 我每天在学校和朋友们一起吃午餐。

lung.example: Smoking is very bad for your lungs and your heart.
lung.exampleZh: 吸烟对你的肺和心脏都非常有害。

luxury.example: She saved money for years to buy one small luxury for herself.
luxury.exampleZh: 她存了好几年的钱，只为给自己买一件小小的奢侈品。

machine.example: This machine helps farmers pick fruit faster than before.
machine.exampleZh: 这台机器帮助农民比以前更快地采摘水果。

machinery.example: The factory bought new machinery to make the work faster and safer.
machinery.exampleZh: 工厂购买了新机器，让工作更快更安全。

mad.example: He went mad when he saw the broken window.
mad.exampleZh: 他看到破窗户时气疯了。

magazine.example: She buys a fashion magazine every month at the small shop near her office.
magazine.exampleZh: 她每个月都在办公室附近的小店买一本时尚杂志。

magic.example: The children believe that magic can make their toys come alive at night.
magic.exampleZh: 孩子们相信魔法能让他们的玩具在夜里活过来。

magistrate.example: The magistrate listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
magistrate.exampleZh: 地方法官在做出决定前仔细听取了双方的意见。

magnet.example: The magnet on the fridge holds my shopping list in place.
magnet.exampleZh: 冰箱上的磁铁把我的购物清单固定住了。

magnetic.example: Her magnetic smile made everyone in the room feel welcome.
magnetic.exampleZh: 她富有魅力的微笑让房间里的每个人都感到亲切。

magnificent.example: The view from the mountain was magnificent in the early morning light.
magnificent.exampleZh: 清晨的光线下，山上的景色十分壮丽。

maid.example: The young maid cleans the rooms every morning before the family wakes up.
maid.exampleZh: 这位年轻的女仆每天早上在家人醒来前打扫房间。

mail.example: I will send the mail to my friend this afternoon.
mail.exampleZh: 我今天下午会把邮件寄给我的朋友。

main.example: Safety is the main reason we wear helmets on the job.
main.exampleZh: 安全是我们工作时佩戴头盔的主要原因。

mainland.example: Many people travel from the mainland to this small island every summer.
mainland.exampleZh: 每年夏天，许多人从大陆前往这个小岛。

maintain.example: We must maintain our car every year so it runs well.
maintain.exampleZh: 我们必须每年保养汽车，这样它才能运转良好。

maintenance.example: Regular maintenance of the machine keeps it running safely all year.
maintenance.exampleZh: 定期保养这台机器能让它全年安全运转。

major.example: English is my major, and it is a major part of my life.
major.exampleZh: 英语是我的专业，它也是我生活中重要的一部分。

majority.example: The majority of students in our class walk to school every day.
majority.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生每天步行上学。

make.example: My mother will make a big cake for my birthday.
make.exampleZh: 我妈妈会为我的生日做一个大蛋糕。

male.example: The male doctor said the baby boy is very healthy.
male.exampleZh: 那位男医生说这个男婴非常健康。

mall.example: We spent the whole afternoon shopping at the new mall.
mall.exampleZh: 我们在新开的购物中心逛了一下午。

mammal.example: The whale is a large mammal that lives in the ocean.
mammal.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是一种生活在海洋里的大型哺乳动物。

man.example: The old man sits on the bench and reads a book.
man.exampleZh: 那位老人坐在长椅上看书。

manage.example: She manages a small shop and takes care of the money every day.
manage.exampleZh: 她经营一家小店，每天负责管钱。

management.example: Good management helps the small team finish its work on time.
management.exampleZh: 良好的管理有助于这个小团队按时完成工作。

manager.example: The new manager will start work next Monday morning.
manager.exampleZh: 新经理将于下周一上午开始工作。

manifest.example: The small smile on her face manifested her true happiness.
manifest.exampleZh: 她脸上那一丝微笑显示出了她真正的快乐。

manipulate.example: He tried to manipulate the results to make himself look better.
manipulate.exampleZh: 他试图篡改结果，让自己显得更出色。

mankind.example: This new medicine may help all mankind in the future.
mankind.exampleZh: 这种新药未来可能会帮助全人类。

manner.example: He speaks in a calm and friendly manner, so everyone likes him.
manner.exampleZh: 他说话的方式平静又友好，所以大家都喜欢他。

manual.example: This manual work is hard, but he keeps the safety manual on his desk.
manual.exampleZh: 这份体力活很辛苦，但他把安全手册放在桌上。

manufacture.example: This factory can manufacture many small parts for cars.
manufacture.exampleZh: 这家工厂能为汽车制造许多小零件。

manuscript.example: She sent the manuscript to a publisher last week.
manuscript.exampleZh: 她上周把手稿寄给了一家出版社。

many.example: Many people in my town like to walk in the park.
many.exampleZh: 我们镇上的许多人喜欢在公园里散步。

map.example: I looked at the map to find the way to the station.
map.exampleZh: 我看着地图寻找去车站的路。

march.example: The students will march in the school parade next week.
march.exampleZh: 学生们下周将在学校游行中行进。

margin.example: The teacher wrote a short note in the margin of my book.
margin.exampleZh: 老师在我书的页边空白处写了一条简短的批注。

marginal.example: The change had only a marginal effect on our daily life.
marginal.exampleZh: 这一变化对我们的日常生活只有微小的作用。

marine.example: The marine animals live in deep, cold water far from land.
marine.exampleZh: 这些海洋动物生活在远离陆地的深冷水域中。

mark.example: The teacher put a red mark on my test paper.
mark.exampleZh: 老师在我的试卷上打了一个红色的分数。

market.example: The small town holds a busy market every Saturday morning near the river.
market.exampleZh: 这个小镇每周六上午在河边举办一个热闹的集市。

marriage.example: Their marriage is happy because they talk and listen to each other every day.
marriage.exampleZh: 他们的婚姻很幸福，因为他们每天都会交流和倾听彼此。

married.example: My married sister lives in a small house near the river.
married.exampleZh: 我已婚的姐姐住在河边的一所小房子里。

marry.example: I want to marry her next year after we save enough money.
marry.exampleZh: 我想在我们攒够钱后的明年和她结婚。

marvelous.example: The view from the top of the hill is truly marvelous.
marvelous.exampleZh: 从山顶看到的景色真是奇妙极了。

marxism.example: In college, she read books about Marxism and began to question the society around her.
marxism.exampleZh: 在大学里，她读了一些关于马克思主义的书，并开始质疑周围的社会。

marxist.example: He is a Marxist scholar who studies the history of modern China.
marxist.exampleZh: 他是一位研究中国近代史的马克思主义学者。

masculine.example: His deep voice and short hair make him look very masculine.
masculine.exampleZh: 他低沉的嗓音和短发让他看起来很男性化。

mask.example: She wore a mask on the bus and tried to mask her cough.
mask.exampleZh: 她在公交车上戴着口罩，并试图掩饰自己的咳嗽。

mass.example: A large mass of people waited outside the station in the cold morning.
mass.exampleZh: 清晨，一大群人冒着寒冷在车站外等候。

massive.example: The old bridge was too massive for the small truck to cross safely.
massive.exampleZh: 那座旧桥对那辆小卡车来说太大太重，无法安全通过。

master.example: He works hard every day to master the new language.
master.exampleZh: 他每天努力学习，以掌握这门新语言。

masterpiece.example: This old book is a masterpiece of modern Chinese writing.
masterpiece.exampleZh: 这本旧书是现代中文写作的一部杰作。

mat.example: Please put the sleeping mat on the floor before you rest.
mat.exampleZh: 休息前请把睡垫铺在地板上。

match.example: This match is easy, and the two colors match well.
match.exampleZh: 这场比赛很轻松，而且这两种颜色很相配。

mate.example: My old mate from school came to visit me last week.
mate.exampleZh: 我上学时的老伙伴上周来看我了。

material.example: We need more material to finish this work.
material.exampleZh: 我们需要更多材料来完成这项工作。

math.example: I am not good at math, so my sister helps me with it.
math.exampleZh: 我不擅长数学，所以我姐姐帮我学。

mathematical.example: She has strong mathematical skills and solves every problem quickly.
mathematical.exampleZh: 她有很强的数学能力，能很快解决每一道题。

mathematics.example: My brother studies mathematics at the university near our home.
mathematics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在我们家附近的大学学习数学。

matter.example: It does not matter what other people think of your plan.
matter.exampleZh: 别人怎么看待你的计划并不重要。

mature.example: She is very mature for her age and often helps younger students.
mature.exampleZh: 她就年龄而言非常成熟，经常帮助年纪更小的学生。

maximum.example: The maximum speed of this small car is very high.
maximum.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车的最高速度非常高。

may.example: It may rain this afternoon, so please take your umbrella with you.
may.exampleZh: 今天下午可能会下雨，所以请带上你的伞。

maybe.example: Maybe she is still at work and will come home later.
maybe.exampleZh: 她大概还在上班，晚一点才会回家。

mayor.example: The mayor of our city opened the new library last week.
mayor.exampleZh: 我们城市的市长上周为新图书馆揭幕。

meadow.example: The children ran across the green meadow and picked wild flowers.
meadow.exampleZh: 孩子们跑过绿色的草地，采摘野花。

meal.example: We had a big meal with our family last night.
meal.exampleZh: 昨晚我们和家人一起吃了一顿丰盛的饭。

mean.example: I do not know what this word means, so please tell me.
mean.exampleZh: 我不知道这个单词是什么意思，请告诉我。

meaning.example: Can you explain the meaning of this word to me?
meaning.exampleZh: 你能给我解释一下这个单词的意思吗？

means.example: The bicycle is a cheap means of travel for many students.
means.exampleZh: 自行车是许多学生出行的廉价方式。

measurable.example: The new plan brought a measurable improvement in our daily work.
measurable.exampleZh: 新计划让我们的日常工作有了明显的改善。

measure.example: We need to measure the room before we buy new furniture.
measure.exampleZh: 买新家具之前我们需要测量一下房间。

measurement.example: The tailor took my measurements before making the suit.
measurement.exampleZh: 裁缝在做西装前量了我的尺寸。

meat.example: I eat meat and rice for dinner every day.
meat.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭都吃肉和米饭。

mechanic.example: The mechanic fixed my car in less than an hour.
mechanic.exampleZh: 这位机械工不到一小时就修好了我的车。

mechanical.example: Her voice sounded cold and mechanical on the phone last night.
mechanical.exampleZh: 昨晚她在电话里的声音听起来冷淡而呆板。

mechanism.example: The clock's mechanism is simple and easy to repair.
mechanism.exampleZh: 这个钟的机械装置很简单，容易修理。

medal.example: She won a gold medal in the swimming race last year.
medal.exampleZh: 她去年在游泳比赛中赢得了一枚金牌。

media.example: Social media helps people share news and ideas with friends.
media.exampleZh: 社交媒体帮助人们与朋友分享新闻和想法。

medical.example: Her medical records are kept safely at the local hospital.
medical.exampleZh: 她的医疗记录安全地保存在当地医院里。

medicine.example: The doctor gave me some medicine for my bad cough.
medicine.exampleZh: 医生给了我一些治咳嗽的药。

medieval.example: This old church was built in medieval times.
medieval.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂建于中世纪。

medium.example: The internet is a medium for sharing news and ideas quickly.
medium.exampleZh: 互联网是快速分享新闻和思想的媒介。

meet.example: I will meet my friend at the train station today.
meet.exampleZh: 我今天会在火车站见我的朋友。

meeting.example: The meeting starts at nine tomorrow morning in the main office.
meeting.exampleZh: 会议明天上午九点在主办公室开始。

melody.example: She hummed a soft melody while working in the garden.
melody.exampleZh: 她在花园里干活时轻轻哼着一支柔和的旋律。

melt.example: The snow will melt quickly in the warm sun today.
melt.exampleZh: 今天在温暖的阳光下，雪很快就会融化。

member.example: Every member of our team helped plan the school event.
member.exampleZh: 我们团队的每一位成员都帮忙策划了学校的活动。

membership.example: Club membership gives you free access to the pool and gym.
membership.exampleZh: 会员资格让你可以免费使用游泳池和健身房。

memorial.example: We visited the memorial to the soldiers who died in the war.
memorial.exampleZh: 我们参观了为战争中阵亡士兵而建的纪念碑。

memory.example: She has a good memory for names and faces.
memory.exampleZh: 她对名字和长相记性很好。

menace.example: The broken roof is a menace to everyone living in the old house.
menace.exampleZh: 破损的屋顶对住在这所老房子里的每个人都是个威胁。

mend.example: My father will mend the old chair this afternoon.
mend.exampleZh: 我父亲今天下午会修理那把旧椅子。

mental.example: Regular exercise is good for your mental health as well as your body.
mental.exampleZh: 规律运动对你的心理健康和身体都有好处。

mention.example: She did not mention the meeting in her email.
mention.exampleZh: 她在邮件里没有提到那次会议。

merchant.example: The merchant sells fresh fruit and vegetables at the town market every morning.
merchant.exampleZh: 这位商人每天早上在镇上的市场卖新鲜水果和蔬菜。

mercury.example: The old thermometer contains a small amount of mercury inside its glass tube.
mercury.exampleZh: 这支旧温度计的玻璃管内含有少量水银。

mercy.example: The kind doctor showed mercy to the poor family and helped them.
mercy.exampleZh: 那位善良的医生对那个贫困家庭动了怜悯之心，并帮助了他们。

mere.example: The mere idea of leaving made her feel sad.
mere.exampleZh: 仅仅是离开这个念头就让她感到难过。

merely.example: He is merely a friend, not my boyfriend.
merely.exampleZh: 他只不过是个朋友，不是我男朋友。

merge.example: The two small companies decided to merge into one larger team last year.
merge.exampleZh: 这两家小公司去年决定合并成一个更大的团队。

merit.example: Her plan has one clear merit: it is simple and cheap.
merit.exampleZh: 她的方案有一个明显的优点：简单又省钱。

merry.example: The children were merry and sang songs all through the long afternoon.
merry.exampleZh: 孩子们很欢乐，整个漫长的下午都在唱歌。

mess.example: My room is a mess, so I need to clean it today.
mess.exampleZh: 我的房间很乱，所以我今天需要打扫一下。

message.example: She left a message for me on the kitchen table.
message.exampleZh: 她在厨房桌子上给我留了一条口信。

metal.example: The box is made of metal and is very strong.
metal.exampleZh: 这个盒子由金属制成，非常坚固。

meter.example: The meter shows how much water we used this month.
meter.exampleZh: 这个仪表显示我们这个月用了多少水。

method.example: This method is easy and works well for most students.
method.exampleZh: 这个方法很简单，对大多数学生都有效。

metropolitan.example: He enjoys the busy life in a large metropolitan area.
metropolitan.exampleZh: 他喜欢大都市地区的繁忙生活。

microphone.example: She spoke into the microphone so everyone in the hall could hear her.
microphone.exampleZh: 她对着麦克风讲话，好让大厅里的每个人都能听到。

microscope.example: We used a microscope to see the tiny cells in the water.
microscope.exampleZh: 我们用显微镜观察水中的微小细胞。

midst.example: In the midst of the crowd, I lost sight of my friend.
midst.exampleZh: 在人群中间，我看不见我的朋友了。

might.example: Her great might as a leader helped the whole team succeed.
might.exampleZh: 她作为领导者的强大威力帮助整个团队取得了成功。

mild.example: The soup has a mild taste, so my little sister likes it.
mild.exampleZh: 这汤味道很淡，所以我妹妹喜欢喝。

mile.example: My house is only one mile from the school.
mile.exampleZh: 我家离学校只有一英里。

military.example: The military base is near our town and many soldiers live there.
military.exampleZh: 那个军事基地就在我们镇附近，许多士兵住在那里。

militia.example: The local militia trained every weekend to protect their small village.
militia.exampleZh: 当地民兵组织每个周末都训练，以保护他们的小村庄。

milk.example: My mother gives me a glass of milk every morning.
milk.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上给我一杯牛奶。

mill.example: The old mill by the river still grinds wheat into flour today.
mill.exampleZh: 河边那座老磨坊如今仍在把小麦磨成面粉。

millimetre.example: The line is only two millimetres wide, so please draw it carefully.
millimetre.exampleZh: 这条线只有两毫米宽，所以请仔细画。

million.example: There are more than two million people living in this city.
million.exampleZh: 这座城市里住着两百多万人。

mind.example: Please keep in mind that she does not mind waiting.
mind.exampleZh: 请记住，她不介意等一等。

mine.example: This old coal mine is now closed, but my father once worked there.
mine.exampleZh: 这座老煤矿现在关闭了，但我父亲曾在那里工作。

mineral.example: This rock is rich in a mineral called iron.
mineral.exampleZh: 这块岩石富含一种叫作铁的矿物。

minimum.example: This room is the minimum size we can accept.
minimum.exampleZh: 这个房间是我们能接受的最小尺寸。

minister.example: The minister spoke to the people about the new law.
minister.exampleZh: 部长就新法律向民众发表了讲话。

ministry.example: The Ministry of Education wants more children to read books at home.
ministry.exampleZh: 教育部希望更多孩子在家里读书。

minor.example: The car was in a minor accident, but nobody was hurt.
minor.exampleZh: 这辆车出了个小事故，但没有人受伤。

minority.example: Only a small minority of students wanted to change the school rules.
minority.exampleZh: 只有少数学生想改变校规。

minus.example: Seven minus three is four, and the temperature is minus five degrees today.
minus.exampleZh: 七减三等于四，今天的温度是零下五度。

minute.example: Please wait a minute, I want to read the meeting minutes.
minute.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我想看一下会议记录。

miracle.example: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
miracle.exampleZh: 事故中没有人受伤，这真是个奇迹。

mirror.example: The mirror on the wall shows my face very clearly.
mirror.exampleZh: 墙上的镜子非常清楚地照出我的脸。

miserable.example: He felt miserable after losing his old dog.
miserable.exampleZh: 他的老狗死后，他感到很痛苦。

misery.example: The loss of her dog brought her great misery for months.
misery.exampleZh: 失去她的狗让她痛苦了好几个月。

mislead.example: False news can mislead people and make them afraid.
mislead.exampleZh: 虚假新闻会误导人们，让他们感到害怕。

miss.example: I miss my friends, so I call them every week.
miss.exampleZh: 我很想念我的朋友们，所以我每周都给他们打电话。

missile.example: The missile flew high over the city and landed in an empty field.
missile.exampleZh: 导弹高高飞过城市，落在一片空地上。

mission.example: Our mission is to help every student learn English with confidence.
mission.exampleZh: 我们的使命是帮助每一位学生自信地学习英语。

mist.example: A soft mist covered the lake early this morning.
mist.exampleZh: 今天清晨，一层薄雾笼罩着湖面。

mistake.example: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so please do not worry about it.
mistake.exampleZh: 每个人有时都会犯错，所以请不要为此担心。

mistress.example: The mistress of the house welcomed her guests with a warm smile.
mistress.exampleZh: 这家的女主人带着温暖的笑容欢迎客人的到来。

misunderstand.example: I think you misunderstand me, so please let me explain again.
misunderstand.exampleZh: 我觉得你误解我了，请让我再解释一遍。

mix.example: Mix the flour and water in a bowl before you add the eggs.
mix.exampleZh: 在加入鸡蛋之前，把面粉和水在碗里混合。

mixture.example: This soup is a mixture of fresh vegetables and simple spices.
mixture.exampleZh: 这汤是新鲜蔬菜和简单香料的混合物。

moan.example: Old Tom began to moan about the pain in his back.
moan.exampleZh: 老汤姆开始呻吟，抱怨他背上的疼痛。

mob.example: An angry mob gathered outside the court and shouted at the judges.
mob.exampleZh: 一群愤怒的暴民聚集在法院外，对着法官大喊大叫。

mobile.example: The hospital uses mobile beds to move patients from room to room.
mobile.exampleZh: 这家医院使用可移动的病床把病人从一个房间送到另一个房间。

mobilize.example: The teacher helped mobilize students to clean the park this weekend.
mobilize.exampleZh: 老师帮助动员学生们这周末去清理公园。

mode.example: I like to change my mode of study before every big exam.
mode.exampleZh: 每次大考前，我都喜欢改变一下自己的学习方式。

model.example: He built a small model of the ship with his son last night.
model.exampleZh: 昨晚他和儿子一起做了一艘小船模型。

moderate.example: She does moderate exercise every morning to stay healthy.
moderate.exampleZh: 她每天早上做适度的运动以保持健康。

modern.example: Modern life moves fast, and we need new tools to keep up.
modern.exampleZh: 现代生活节奏很快，我们需要新工具来跟上。

modernization.example: The modernization of our city has brought better roads and faster trains.
modernization.exampleZh: 我们城市的现代化带来了更好的道路和更快的列车。

modest.example: He is a modest man who never talks about his success.
modest.exampleZh: 他是个谦虚的人，从不谈论自己的成功。

modify.example: We need to modify the plan before we start the work.
modify.exampleZh: 我们需要在开始工作之前修改这个计划。

moist.example: The cake stays moist if you keep it in a closed box.
moist.exampleZh: 如果你把蛋糕放在密闭的盒子里，它就能保持湿润。

moisture.example: The air near the sea has a lot of moisture in it.
moisture.exampleZh: 海边的空气里含有大量水分。

mold.example: The bread has green mold on it, so we must throw it away.
mold.exampleZh: 面包上长了绿色霉菌，所以我们必须把它扔掉。

molecule.example: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.exampleZh: 一个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

moment.example: Please wait a moment while I find the right file.
moment.exampleZh: 请稍等片刻，我来找到正确的文件。

momentum.example: The team's momentum slowed after the first goal.
momentum.exampleZh: 第一个进球之后，球队的势头减缓了。

monetary.example: The bank controls monetary policy and tries to keep prices stable.
monetary.exampleZh: 银行掌控货币政策，并努力保持物价稳定。

money.example: I do not have enough money to buy a new car this year.
money.exampleZh: 我今年没有足够的钱买一辆新车。

monitor.example: The class monitor sits at the front and watches the computer monitor.
monitor.exampleZh: 班长坐在前面，看着电脑显示器。

monkey.example: The monkey is eating a banana in the tree.
monkey.exampleZh: 那只猴子正在树上吃香蕉。

monopoly.example: The big company has a monopoly on selling water in this small town.
monopoly.exampleZh: 这家大公司垄断了这个小镇的饮用水销售。

month.example: We will visit our grandparents next month during the school holiday.
month.exampleZh: 我们下个月学校假期会去看望祖父母。

monthly.example: The monthly meeting is held on the first Monday of every month.
monthly.exampleZh: 每月例会于每个月的第一个星期一举行。

monument.example: The old monument stands in the center of our town.
monument.exampleZh: 这座古老的纪念碑矗立在我们小镇的中心。

mood.example: Her mood improved after she took a short walk outside.
mood.exampleZh: 她在外面短暂散步后，心情好了起来。

moon.example: The moon is very bright and beautiful tonight.

moral.example: Parents should teach children moral values early in life.
moral.exampleZh: 父母应该从小教孩子道德价值观。

more.example: I need more time to finish this work today.
more.exampleZh: 我今天需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

moreover.example: The room is clean and cheap; moreover, it is very close to the station.
moreover.exampleZh: 这个房间干净又便宜，而且离车站很近。

morning.example: I drink a cup of hot water every morning before breakfast.
morning.exampleZh: 我每天早晨吃早饭前都喝一杯热水。

mortal.example: All humans are mortal, so we should value every day.
mortal.exampleZh: 所有人都是终有一死的，因此我们应该珍惜每一天。

mortgage.example: They pay their mortgage every month.
mortgage.exampleZh: 他们每个月都支付抵押贷款。

most.example: Most students in our class like to play sports after school.
most.exampleZh: 我们班大多数学生喜欢放学后做运动。

mostly.example: The students in this class are mostly from the same small town.
mostly.exampleZh: 这个班的学生大部分来自同一个小镇。

motel.example: We stayed at a small motel near the highway for one night.
motel.exampleZh: 我们在公路旁的一家小汽车旅馆住了一晚。

mother.example: My mother makes breakfast for us every morning before school.
mother.exampleZh: 我妈妈每天早上上学前给我们做早餐。

motion.example: The motion of the boat made me feel a little sick.
motion.exampleZh: 船的晃动让我感到有点恶心。

motivate.example: Good teachers motivate their students to work hard and never give up.
motivate.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生努力学习，永不放弃。

motive.example: The police could not find a clear motive for the crime.
motive.exampleZh: 警方无法为这起犯罪找到明确的动机。

motor.example: The motor in this old machine makes a loud noise.
motor.exampleZh: 这台旧机器里的发动机发出很大的噪音。

motorway.example: We drove along the motorway for two hours to reach the city.
motorway.exampleZh: 我们沿着高速公路开了两个小时才到达那座城市。

mount.example: We will mount the steps to the old temple on Sunday.
mount.exampleZh: 我们星期天将登上通往古庙的台阶。

mountain.example: We climbed a high mountain last summer and took many photos there.
mountain.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们爬了一座高山，并在那里拍了很多照片。

mourn.example: Many people mourn the loss of their old friend.
mourn.exampleZh: 许多人哀悼他们老朋友的离世。

mouse.example: The cat chased a small mouse under the old wooden table.
mouse.exampleZh: 猫在旧木桌下追赶一只小老鼠。

mouth.example: He opened his mouth wide and took a big bite of the apple.
mouth.exampleZh: 他张大嘴，咬了一大口苹果。

move.example: Please move your chair closer to the table so we can talk.
move.exampleZh: 请把你的椅子挪近桌子一点，这样我们方便说话。

movement.example: The slow movement of the music made everyone in the room feel calm.
movement.exampleZh: 这段缓慢的乐章让房间里的每个人都感到平静。

movie.example: We watched a funny movie together at home last night.
movie.exampleZh: 昨晚我们一起在家看了一部有趣的电影。

much.example: I do not have much time to finish my work today.
much.exampleZh: 我今天没有很多时间完成工作。

mud.example: The children came home with mud all over their shoes.
mud.exampleZh: 孩子们回家时鞋上全是泥。

mug.example: She poured hot coffee into a big mug and sat down.
mug.exampleZh: 她把热咖啡倒进一个大马克杯里，然后坐了下来。

multiple.example: The app has multiple ways to help you learn new words.
multiple.exampleZh: 这个应用有多种方法帮助你学习新单词。

multiply.example: If you multiply three by four, the answer is twelve.
multiply.exampleZh: 如果你把三乘以四，答案就是十二。

multitude.example: A multitude of people came to the park on Sunday morning.
multitude.exampleZh: 周日早上，大量的人来到了公园。

municipal.example: The municipal government is building a new park near our school.
municipal.exampleZh: 市政府正在我们学校附近建一个新公园。

murder.example: The police said a man murdered his neighbor last night and is now in jail.
murder.exampleZh: 警方说一名男子昨晚谋杀了他的邻居，现在已被关进监狱。

murderer.example: The police finally caught the murderer who had been hiding for years.
murderer.exampleZh: 警方终于抓住了那个藏匿多年的杀人犯。

muscle.example: He goes to the gym every day to build strong muscles in his arms.
muscle.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房锻炼，让手臂的肌肉更强壮。

muscular.example: He goes to the gym every day and has a very muscular body.
muscular.exampleZh: 他每天去健身房，拥有非常肌肉发达的身体。

museum.example: We visited a large museum in the city last Sunday with our friends.
museum.exampleZh: 上周日我们和朋友们参观了城里一座很大的博物馆。

music.example: She listens to music every morning while she makes breakfast for her family.
music.exampleZh: 她每天早上为家人做早餐时都会听音乐。

musical.example: Her voice is so musical that everyone stops to listen.
musical.exampleZh: 她的嗓音如此悦耳，以至于每个人都停下来倾听。

musician.example: She is a talented musician who plays the piano very well.
musician.exampleZh: 她是一位才华横溢的音乐家，钢琴弹得非常好。

must.example: You must finish your homework before you watch TV.
must.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业，然后才能看电视。

mutual.example: We have mutual respect for each other and work well together.
mutual.exampleZh: 我们彼此相互尊重，合作得很好。
