my.example: My sister and I go to the park near my house every Sunday.
my.exampleZh: 我和我妹妹每个星期天都去我家附近的公园。

myself.example: I made this cake by myself for my mother's birthday.
myself.exampleZh: 这块蛋糕是我为妈妈的生日自己做的。

mysterious.example: The old house on the hill looks mysterious at night.
mysterious.exampleZh: 山上那座老房子在夜里显得很神秘。

mystery.example: The old house on the hill is still a mystery to everyone in town.
mystery.exampleZh: 山上的那座老房子对镇上的每个人来说仍然是个谜。

myth.example: The old story about a dragon in the lake is just a myth.
myth.exampleZh: 关于湖里有龙的那个古老故事只是一个神话。

nail.example: He used a hammer to hit the nail into the wall.
nail.exampleZh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进墙里。

naive.example: It is naive to trust a stranger with all your money.
naive.exampleZh: 把所有的钱都托付给陌生人，这太天真了。

naked.example: The little boy ran across the beach completely naked.
naked.exampleZh: 那个小男孩一丝不挂地跑过海滩。

name.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
name.exampleZh: 请把你的名字写在页面顶端。

namely.example: Only one person can lead the team, namely our best player.
namely.exampleZh: 只有一个人能带领这支队伍，也就是我们最好的球员。

narration.example: Her narration of the story made the whole class listen quietly.
narration.exampleZh: 她对故事的叙述让全班同学都安静地听着。

narrative.example: Her novel tells a powerful narrative about family life in a small town.
narrative.exampleZh: 她的小说讲述了一个关于小镇家庭生活的有力故事。

narrow.example: The narrow street is too small for two cars to pass.
narrow.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的街道太小了，两辆车无法通过。

nasty.example: The weather was nasty, so we stayed inside and played card games.
nasty.exampleZh: 天气很恶劣，所以我们待在屋里打牌。

nation.example: Our nation has a long history and many different people.
nation.exampleZh: 我们的国家历史悠久，人民也多种多样。

national.example: The national team will play an important game next week.
national.exampleZh: 国家队下周将进行一场重要的比赛。

nationality.example: Please write your name and nationality on this form.
nationality.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和国籍。

native.example: She speaks English like a native, but her family is from China.
native.exampleZh: 她的英语说得像本地人一样，但她的家人来自中国。

natural.example: She has a natural talent for music and loves to sing.
natural.exampleZh: 她天生有音乐天赋，喜欢唱歌。

naturally.example: She naturally speaks in a calm voice when she talks to children.
naturally.exampleZh: 她和孩子说话时自然而然地用平静的声音。

nature.example: It is in her nature to help people who are in trouble.
nature.exampleZh: 乐于帮助有困难的人是她的本性。

naval.example: He joined a naval school when he was eighteen years old.
naval.exampleZh: 他十八岁时进入了一所海军学校。

navigation.example: The map app gives us clear navigation on long car trips.
navigation.exampleZh: 这个地图应用在长途驾车时为我们提供清晰的导航。

navy.example: My older brother joined the navy when he was eighteen years old.
navy.exampleZh: 我哥哥十八岁时加入了海军。

near.example: My house is near the school, so I walk there every morning.
near.exampleZh: 我家离学校很近，所以我每天早上走路去那里。

nearby.example: There is a small library nearby where we often go to study.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一家小图书馆，我们经常去那里学习。

nearly.example: I nearly missed the last bus home last night.
nearly.exampleZh: 昨晚我差点错过了回家的末班车。

neat.example: Her small room is always neat and clean.
neat.exampleZh: 她的小房间总是整洁干净。

necessarily.example: A cheap plan is not necessarily a bad plan for small teams.
necessarily.exampleZh: 对小型团队来说，便宜的计划未必就是不好的计划。

necessary.example: It is necessary to drink enough water every day.
necessary.exampleZh: 每天喝足够的水是必要的。

necessity.example: Water is a basic necessity for life on earth.
necessity.exampleZh: 水是地球上生命的基本必需品。

neck.example: He put a warm scarf around his neck before going out.
neck.exampleZh: 他出门前在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

need.example: We need more time to finish this work today.
need.exampleZh: 我们今天需要更多时间来完成这项工作。

needle.example: The nurse used a clean needle to give him the medicine.
needle.exampleZh: 护士用一根干净的针给他注射药物。

negative.example: He gave a negative answer to my question about the plan.
negative.exampleZh: 他对我就这个计划提出的问题给出了否定的回答。

neglect.example: Many parents neglect their own health while taking care of their children.
neglect.exampleZh: 许多父母在照顾孩子时忽视了自己的健康。

negligible.example: The difference between the two results is negligible and we can ignore it.
negligible.exampleZh: 这两个结果之间的差异微不足道，我们可以忽略它。

negotiate.example: We will negotiate with the company about the price tomorrow.
negotiate.exampleZh: 我们明天会和公司就价格进行协商。

negro.example: The old book used the word Negro to describe the man.
negro.exampleZh: 这本旧书用“黑人”一词来描述那个人。

neighbor.example: My neighbor often helps me water the plants when I am away.
neighbor.exampleZh: 我不在的时候，我的邻居经常帮我给植物浇水。

neighborhood.example: Our neighborhood is quiet and safe, so we often walk around in the evening.
neighborhood.exampleZh: 我们附近安静又安全，所以我们傍晚经常散步。

neither.example: Neither of my two brothers likes coffee, so we drink tea.
neither.exampleZh: 我的两个兄弟都不喜欢咖啡，所以我们喝茶。

nephew.example: My nephew is coming to visit us this weekend with his parents.
nephew.exampleZh: 我侄子这个周末要和父母一起来看我们。

nerve.example: It takes a lot of nerve to speak in front of the whole school.
nerve.exampleZh: 在全校师生面前讲话需要很大的勇气。

nervous.example: She feels nervous before every English test at school.
nervous.exampleZh: 她在学校的每次英语考试前都感到紧张。

nest.example: The bird built a small nest in the tree behind our house.
nest.exampleZh: 那只鸟在我们屋后的树上筑了一个小巢。

net.example: The fisherman pulled the heavy net out of the water.
net.exampleZh: 渔夫把沉重的网拉出了水面。

network.example: The city has a large network of buses and trains.
network.exampleZh: 这座城市拥有庞大的公交和火车网络。

neutral.example: The teacher stayed neutral and listened to both students before deciding what to do.
neutral.exampleZh: 老师保持中立，先听了两个学生的说法，再决定怎么做。

never.example: I never drink coffee after dinner because it keeps me awake.
never.exampleZh: 我从不在晚饭后喝咖啡，因为那会让我失眠。

nevertheless.example: The plan is hard, nevertheless we will try it today.
nevertheless.exampleZh: 这个计划很难，然而我们今天还是会尝试。

new.example: She bought a new phone last week and loves it.
new.exampleZh: 她上周买了一部新手机，非常喜欢。

news.example: I heard good news about your new job this morning.
news.exampleZh: 今天早上我听说了你新工作的好消息。

newspaper.example: My father reads the newspaper every morning before he goes to work.
newspaper.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上上班前都会看报纸。

next.example: We will visit the museum next Friday morning.
next.exampleZh: 我们下周五上午将去参观博物馆。

nice.example: It is nice to meet you and your family today.
nice.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人真是太好了。

nickel.example: This old coin is made of nickel and copper.
nickel.exampleZh: 这枚旧硬币是由镍和铜制成的。

niece.example: My niece loves to draw pictures of her cat.
niece.exampleZh: 我的侄女喜欢画她那只猫的画。

night.example: The stars look very bright in the sky at night.
night.exampleZh: 夜晚天空中的星星看起来非常明亮。

nightmare.example: I had a terrible nightmare last night and woke up very scared.
nightmare.exampleZh: 我昨晚做了一个可怕的噩梦，醒来时非常害怕。

nine.example: My little brother is nine years old and he loves to play football.
nine.exampleZh: 我弟弟九岁了，他喜欢踢足球。

nitrogen.example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow strong and green.
nitrogen.exampleZh: 植物需要从土壤中获取氮才能长得强壮又翠绿。

no.example: There is no milk in the fridge, so we need to buy some.
no.exampleZh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了，所以我们需要买一些。

noble.example: He is a noble man who always helps people in need.
noble.exampleZh: 他是个高尚的人，总是帮助有需要的人。

nobody.example: Nobody in my class knows the answer to this question.
nobody.exampleZh: 我班上没有人知道这个问题的答案。

nod.example: She gave a small nod and smiled at me.
nod.exampleZh: 她轻轻点了点头，对我笑了笑。

noise.example: The noise from the street kept me awake all night.
noise.exampleZh: 街上的噪音让我整夜没睡着。

noisy.example: The classroom was too noisy for me to hear the teacher.
noisy.exampleZh: 教室太吵了，我听不见老师说话。

nominal.example: He is the nominal head of the company but has little real power.
nominal.exampleZh: 他是公司名义上的负责人，但没有多少实权。

nominate.example: My teacher will nominate me for the school writing prize this year.
nominate.exampleZh: 今年老师会提名我参评学校写作奖。

nomination.example: Her nomination for the award surprised everyone in the office.
nomination.exampleZh: 她获得该奖项的提名让办公室里的每个人都很惊讶。

none.example: None of my friends came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 昨晚我的朋友一个都没来参加聚会。

nonsense.example: Don't believe him because everything he said was complete nonsense.
nonsense.exampleZh: 别信他，因为他说的全是彻底的胡说。

noodle.example: My mother cooks noodle soup with eggs and vegetables for lunch.
noodle.exampleZh: 我妈妈午餐煮了加鸡蛋和蔬菜的面条汤。

noon.example: We usually eat lunch at noon on school days.
noon.exampleZh: 上学的日子我们通常中午吃午饭。

nor.example: She did not call me, nor did she send any message.
nor.exampleZh: 她没有给我打电话，也没有发任何消息。

norm.example: Every school has its own norms about how students should behave.
norm.exampleZh: 每所学校对学生的行为举止都有自己的规范。

normal.example: It is normal to feel tired after a long day at work.
normal.exampleZh: 工作一整天后感到疲倦是正常的。

normalization.example: The normalization of relations between the two countries took many years.
normalization.exampleZh: 两国关系的正常化花了很多年。

normally.example: I normally walk to school with my sister every morning.
normally.exampleZh: 我通常每天早上和妹妹一起走路去学校。

north.example: The cold wind comes from the north in winter.

northern.example: The northern part of the country is colder than the south.
northern.exampleZh: 这个国家的北部比南方更冷。

nose.example: My dog has a wet nose and a very good sense of smell.
nose.exampleZh: 我的狗鼻子湿湿的，嗅觉非常灵敏。

not.example: I am not hungry now, but I will eat later.
not.exampleZh: 我现在不饿，但稍后会吃。

note.example: Please take note of the teacher's words before you leave.
note.exampleZh: 离开前请注意听老师说的话。

notebook.example: I write my homework in a small notebook every evening after dinner.
notebook.exampleZh: 我每天晚上晚饭后都在一个小笔记本里写作业。

nothing.example: There is nothing in the box, so don't look for it.
nothing.exampleZh: 盒子里什么也没有，所以别找了。

notice.example: I did not notice the small notice on the door.
notice.exampleZh: 我没有注意到门上的那张小布告。

noticeable.example: There was a noticeable change in his voice after the long trip.
noticeable.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，他的声音有了明显的变化。

notify.example: Please notify your teacher if you cannot come to class today.
notify.exampleZh: 如果你今天不能来上课，请通知你的老师。

notion.example: The notion that hard work always brings success is not always true.
notion.exampleZh: 努力总能带来成功这一观念并不总是正确的。

notorious.example: This street is notorious for its noise and heavy traffic at night.
notorious.exampleZh: 这条街因夜间的噪音和繁忙交通而臭名昭著。

notwithstanding.example: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the football match went on as planned.
notwithstanding.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，足球赛还是按计划进行了。

noun.example: In English, a noun can name a person, a place, or a thing.
noun.exampleZh: 在英语中，名词可以表示人、地点或事物。

nourish.example: Good food and love nourish a child's body and mind.
nourish.exampleZh: 好的食物和爱滋养孩子的身心。

novel.example: This new novel tells a funny story about a clever young girl.
novel.exampleZh: 这本新小说讲了一个关于聪明小女孩的有趣故事。

novelty.example: The novelty of the new game wore off after a few weeks.
novelty.exampleZh: 这款新游戏的新奇感几周后就消失了。

now.example: I am busy now, so we can talk later.
now.exampleZh: 我现在很忙，所以我们晚点再谈。

nowadays.example: Nowadays, most people use their phones to shop and pay.
nowadays.exampleZh: 如今，大多数人用手机购物和付款。

nowhere.example: There is nowhere to sit because the small room is full of boxes.
nowhere.exampleZh: 没有地方可坐，因为这个小房间里堆满了箱子。

nuclear.example: Nuclear power can give us clean and cheap energy.
nuclear.exampleZh: 核能可以为我们提供清洁又廉价的能源。

nucleus.example: The nucleus is the central part of an atom.
nucleus.exampleZh: 原子核是原子的中心部分。

nude.example: The artist painted a nude figure sitting by the window.
nude.exampleZh: 画家画了一个坐在窗边的裸体人物。

nuisance.example: The loud music from next door is a real nuisance at night.
nuisance.exampleZh: 隔壁传来的吵闹音乐在晚上真是件麻烦事。

number.example: Please write your phone number at the top of this page.
number.exampleZh: 请把你的电话号码写在这一页的顶部。

numerous.example: There are numerous books on the table in our school library.
numerous.exampleZh: 我们学校图书馆的桌子上有许多书。

nurse.example: The nurse is very kind to the children in the hospital.
nurse.exampleZh: 这位护士对医院里的孩子们非常和蔼。

nursery.example: The children spend all day at the nursery while their parents work.
nursery.exampleZh: 父母上班时，孩子们整天都待在托儿所。

nut.example: She eats a nut every morning before school.
nut.exampleZh: 她每天早上上学前吃一颗坚果。

nutrition.example: Good nutrition helps children grow strong and stay healthy every day.
nutrition.exampleZh: 良好的营养有助于孩子每天茁壮成长并保持健康。

nylon.example: My new jacket is made of light nylon and it keeps me dry.
nylon.exampleZh: 我的新夹克是用轻便的尼龙做的，它能让我保持干爽。

o'clock.example: I usually get up at seven o'clock in the morning.
o'clock.exampleZh: 我通常早上七点钟起床。

oak.example: There is a large oak in front of our house.
oak.exampleZh: 我们家门前有一棵大橡树。

oar.example: He pulled hard on the oar to move the small boat forward.
oar.exampleZh: 他用力划桨，让小船向前移动。

oath.example: He made an oath to tell the truth in court.
oath.exampleZh: 他在法庭上宣誓说出真相。

obedience.example: The dog showed great obedience to its owner every day.
obedience.exampleZh: 这只狗每天都对主人表现出极大的服从。

obedient.example: The obedient dog sat quietly when its owner gave the command.
obedient.exampleZh: 那只听话的狗在主人下命令时安静地坐下了。

obey.example: Students should obey the school rules and listen to their teachers.
obey.exampleZh: 学生应该遵守校规，听老师的话。

object.example: He put the heavy object on the table and did not object.
object.exampleZh: 他把那个重物放在桌上，没有反对。

objection.example: She raised a strong objection to the new plan at the meeting.
objection.exampleZh: 她在会上对新计划提出了强烈的反对。

objective.example: Our team set a clear objective for the new project this year.
objective.exampleZh: 我们团队为今年的新项目设定了一个明确的目标。

obligation.example: Parents have a legal obligation to send their children to school.
obligation.exampleZh: 父母有送孩子上学的法律义务。

oblige.example: The heavy rain obliged us to stay inside all afternoon.
oblige.exampleZh: 大雨迫使我们整个下午都待在屋里。

obscene.example: The police removed the obscene pictures from the wall of the small shop.
obscene.exampleZh: 警察把那张淫秽的图片从那家小店的墙上取了下来。

obscure.example: The old book's meaning stays obscure to most readers today.
obscure.exampleZh: 这本旧书的意思对今天的大多数读者来说依然晦涩难懂。

observation.example: Her observation about the weather was correct.
observation.exampleZh: 她对天气的观察是正确的。

observe.example: We observe the birds in the park every morning before school.
observe.exampleZh: 我们每天早上上学前在公园里观察鸟儿。

observer.example: The observer watched the birds quietly from behind a large tree.
observer.exampleZh: 观察者躲在一棵大树后面静静地观察着鸟。

obstacle.example: The heavy rain was a big obstacle to our travel plans.
obstacle.exampleZh: 大雨是我们旅行计划的一大障碍。

obtain.example: You can obtain a free map at the front desk.
obtain.exampleZh: 你可以在前台获得一张免费地图。

obvious.example: It is obvious that he does not want to go with us.
obvious.exampleZh: 很明显他不想和我们一起去。

occasion.example: A birthday is a good occasion to thank your family.
occasion.exampleZh: 生日是感谢家人的好场合。

occasional.example: I make occasional trips to the library to borrow new books.
occasional.exampleZh: 我偶尔会去图书馆借一些新书。

occupation.example: Teaching is a rewarding occupation for people who enjoy working with children.
occupation.exampleZh: 教书对喜欢和孩子打交道的人来说是一份有意义的职业。

occupy.example: The workers occupy the small office near the station every morning.
occupy.exampleZh: 工人们每天早上占用车站附近的那间小办公室。

occur.example: Accidents often occur when people are in a hurry.
occur.exampleZh: 人们匆忙时常常会发生事故。

occurrence.example: The police are still investigating the strange occurrence at the school last night.
occurrence.exampleZh: 警方仍在调查昨晚学校里发生的奇怪事件。

ocean.example: The ocean is very deep and full of many strange fish.
ocean.exampleZh: 海洋非常深，里面有许多奇怪的鱼。

october.example: Our school has a big sports day every October.
october.exampleZh: 我们学校每年十月都会举办一场大型运动会。

odd.example: It is odd that he left the party without saying goodbye.
odd.exampleZh: 他没说再见就离开聚会，这很奇怪。

odds.example: The odds of rain are high this afternoon.
odds.exampleZh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很大。

of.example: The color of her new dress is bright red.
of.exampleZh: 她的新裙子颜色是鲜红色的。

off.example: Please turn off the lights before you leave the room.
off.exampleZh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

offend.example: I did not mean to offend you with my words.
offend.exampleZh: 我不是有意用我的话冒犯你。

offense.example: He did not mean to give offense with his simple question.
offense.exampleZh: 他提出那个简单的问题时并没有想冒犯谁。

offensive.example: His offensive joke made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
offensive.exampleZh: 他那个无礼的玩笑让房间里的每个人都感到不舒服。

offer.example: She offered me a cup of tea and a seat by the window.
offer.exampleZh: 她给我端来一杯茶，并让我坐在窗边。

office.example: She works in a small office near the train station.
office.exampleZh: 她在火车站附近的一间小办公室工作。

officer.example: The police officer helped the old man cross the busy street safely.
officer.exampleZh: 这位警官帮助那位老人安全地穿过繁忙的街道。

official.example: The official told us the official news at the meeting.
official.exampleZh: 那位官员在会上向我们宣布了官方消息。

offspring.example: The old tree gives shade to all its offspring.
offspring.exampleZh: 这棵老树为它所有的后代遮荫。

often.example: I often walk to school with my sister in the morning.
often.exampleZh: 我经常早上和姐姐一起走路上学。

oil.example: The machine needs oil to run smoothly every day.
oil.exampleZh: 这台机器每天都需要油才能顺畅运转。

ok.example: Don't worry, everything is ok with the plan for tomorrow.
ok.exampleZh: 别担心，明天的计划一切都没问题。

old.example: This old book is very nice and easy to read.
old.exampleZh: 这本旧书很好，读起来也很容易。

olive.example: She put a green olive on top of the salad.
olive.exampleZh: 她在沙拉上面放了一颗绿色的橄榄。

omit.example: Do not omit any important details from your report.
omit.exampleZh: 不要在你的报告中遗漏任何重要细节。

once.example: Once you start reading this book, you will not want to stop.
once.exampleZh: 一旦你开始读这本书，你就会不想停下来。

one.example: She has one brother and two sisters in her family.
one.exampleZh: 她家里有一个哥哥和两个姐姐。

oneself.example: It is important to take care of oneself when working long hours.
oneself.exampleZh: 长时间工作时，照顾好自己很重要。

onion.example: My mother cut the onion into small pieces for the soup.
onion.exampleZh: 我妈妈把洋葱切成小块放进汤里。

only.example: This is the only key that opens the old door.
only.exampleZh: 这是唯一能打开这扇旧门的钥匙。

onto.example: The cat jumped onto the table and knocked over a glass.
onto.exampleZh: 猫跳到桌子上，打翻了一个玻璃杯。

opaque.example: The glass door is opaque, so I cannot see inside the room.
opaque.exampleZh: 这扇玻璃门是不透明的，所以我看不到房间里面。

open.example: Please open the window because the room is too hot.
open.exampleZh: 请打开窗户，因为房间里太热了。

opening.example: There is a small opening in the wall near the door.
opening.exampleZh: 门附近的墙上有一个小口子。

opera.example: My mother loves opera, so we often go to the theater together.
opera.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢歌剧，所以我们经常一起去剧院。

operate.example: The doctor will operate on his knee early tomorrow morning.
operate.exampleZh: 医生明天一早将为他做膝盖手术。

operation.example: The doctor said the operation was safe and went very well.
operation.exampleZh: 医生说手术很安全，进行得非常顺利。

operational.example: The new system is now fully operational after a week of testing.
operational.exampleZh: 经过一周的测试，新系统现在已完全投入运转。

operator.example: The operator answered my call and helped me find the right number.
operator.exampleZh: 接线员接了我的电话，并帮我找到了正确的号码。

opinion.example: In my opinion, this book is easy and fun to read.
opinion.exampleZh: 在我看来，这本书读起来既轻松又有趣。

opponent.example: My opponent played very well, but I still won the game.
opponent.exampleZh: 我的对手打得很好，但我还是赢了这场比赛。

opportunity.example: This job is a good opportunity for me to learn new skills.
opportunity.exampleZh: 这份工作是我学习新技能的好机会。

oppose.example: Many people oppose the new rule because it is not fair.
oppose.exampleZh: 许多人反对这项新规定，因为它不公平。

opposite.example: The bank is on the opposite side of the street from my house.
opposite.exampleZh: 银行在我家街道的对面。

oppress.example: The bad king oppressed the poor people in his country for many years.
oppress.exampleZh: 那个坏国王多年来一直压迫他国家的穷人。

opt.example: You can opt for tea instead of coffee at breakfast.
opt.exampleZh: 早餐时你可以选择喝茶而不是咖啡。

optical.example: The new optical lens helps my eyes see small text clearly.
optical.exampleZh: 新的光学镜片帮助我的眼睛清楚地看到小字。

optimistic.example: She stays optimistic about finding a new job soon.
optimistic.exampleZh: 她对很快找到新工作保持乐观。

optimum.example: Early morning is the optimum time to water your garden.
optimum.exampleZh: 清晨是给花园浇水的最佳时间。

option.example: You have two options: take the bus or walk to school.
option.exampleZh: 你有两个选择：坐公交车或者步行去学校。

optional.example: This class is optional, so you can stay home if you want.
optional.exampleZh: 这门课是可选择的，所以你想待在家里也可以。

or.example: You can have tea or coffee, but not both.
or.exampleZh: 你可以喝茶或咖啡，但不能两样都要。

oral.example: The teacher gave us an oral test instead of a written one.
oral.exampleZh: 老师给我们做了口头测试，没有做笔试。

orange.example: I eat an orange every morning and my sister likes the orange color.
orange.exampleZh: 我每天早上吃一个橙子，我妹妹喜欢橙色。

orbit.example: The small satellite moves in a fixed orbit around the Earth.
orbit.exampleZh: 这颗小卫星在围绕地球的固定轨道上运行。

orchestra.example: She plays the violin in the school orchestra every Friday afternoon.
orchestra.exampleZh: 她每周五下午在学校管弦乐队拉小提琴。

order.example: The teacher put the books in order and then gave the class a simple order.
order.exampleZh: 老师把书整理好顺序，然后给全班下了一个简单的命令。

orderly.example: The teacher asked the students to keep the classroom clean and orderly.
orderly.exampleZh: 老师要求学生保持教室干净整齐。

ordinary.example: She lives an ordinary life in a small town with her family.
ordinary.exampleZh: 她和家人在一个小镇上过着普通的生活。

ore.example: The workers dug deep into the mountain to find iron ore.
ore.exampleZh: 工人们往山深处挖掘，寻找铁矿石。

organ.example: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
organ.exampleZh: 心脏是人体内重要的器官。

organic.example: Organic food is grown without harmful chemicals.
organic.exampleZh: 有机食品是在不使用有害化学物质的情况下种植的。

organism.example: Every living organism needs water and food to grow and stay alive.
organism.exampleZh: 每一个生物体都需要水和食物来生长和存活。

organization.example: She works for a large organization in the city center.
organization.exampleZh: 她在市中心一家大型机构工作。

organize.example: We need to organize a meeting for next week.
organize.exampleZh: 我们需要为下周组织一次会议。

orient.example: We need time to orient ourselves in the new office.
orient.exampleZh: 我们需要时间在新办公室里熟悉方向。

orientation.example: The new students will learn about the school during orientation week.
orientation.exampleZh: 新生们将在迎新周期间了解学校的情况。

origin.example: The origin of this old story is still a mystery to us.
origin.exampleZh: 这个古老故事的起源对我们来说仍然是个谜。

original.example: This painting is the original, and the one in the hall is a copy.
original.exampleZh: 这幅画是原作，大厅里的那幅是复制品。

originate.example: This old story originated in a small village long ago.
originate.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事很久以前起源于一个小村庄。

ornament.example: The small glass bird is a pretty ornament on our living room table.
ornament.exampleZh: 那只小玻璃鸟是我们客厅桌子上一件漂亮的装饰品。

orphan.example: The little orphan lives with a kind family in the village.
orphan.exampleZh: 这个小孤儿和村里一户善良的人家一起生活。

ostrich.example: The ostrich runs very fast across the open field.
ostrich.exampleZh: 鸵鸟飞快地跑过开阔的田野。

other.example: Some people like tea, but other people like coffee.
other.exampleZh: 有些人喜欢茶，但其他人喜欢咖啡。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late for the school bus.
otherwise.exampleZh: 快点，否则我们会赶不上校车。

ought.example: You ought to drink more water when the weather is hot.
ought.exampleZh: 天气炎热时，你应该多喝水。

ounce.example: This bottle holds eight ounces of water, which is enough for the trip.
ounce.exampleZh: 这个瓶子能装八盎司水，足够这次旅行用。

our.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework today.
our.exampleZh: 我们的老师今天给我们布置了很多作业。

ours.example: This classroom is ours, and your classroom is on the second floor.
ours.exampleZh: 这间教室是我们的，你们的教室在二楼。

ourselves.example: We should learn to take care of ourselves when we travel alone.
ourselves.exampleZh: 独自旅行时，我们应该学会照顾好自己。

out.example: My father is out at the store right now.
out.exampleZh: 我爸爸现在外出去商店了。

outbreak.example: There was a flu outbreak at the school last week.
outbreak.exampleZh: 上周学校里爆发了流感。

outcome.example: The outcome of the game surprised everyone in the room.
outcome.exampleZh: 比赛的结果让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

outdoor.example: We like to have outdoor meals in the garden on sunny days.
outdoor.exampleZh: 晴天时我们喜欢在花园里享用户外餐。

outdoors.example: The children like to play outdoors when the weather is nice.
outdoors.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。

outer.example: The outer wall of the old house needs a fresh coat of paint.
outer.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的外墙需要重新刷一层漆。

outfit.example: Our team bought a new outfit for every player before the big game.
outfit.exampleZh: 大赛前，我们队为每位队员购置了一套新装备。

outflow.example: The company reported a large outflow of cash last year.
outflow.exampleZh: 公司报告去年有大量现金流出。

outing.example: Our class went on an outing to the lake last Saturday morning.
outing.exampleZh: 上周六上午我们班去湖边郊游了。

outlaw.example: The outlaw hid in the mountains for many years.
outlaw.exampleZh: 那个歹徒在山里躲了很多年。

outlet.example: The store is a popular outlet for cheap clothes in our town.
outlet.exampleZh: 这家商店是我们镇上很受欢迎的廉价服装销售点。

outline.example: The teacher gave us a short outline of the lesson before class.
outline.exampleZh: 老师在课前给我们简要概述了这节课的内容。

outlook.example: His outlook on life changed after he traveled around the world.
outlook.exampleZh: 环游世界后，他的人生观改变了。

output.example: The factory doubled its output last year after buying new machines.
output.exampleZh: 工厂去年购买新机器后，产量翻了一番。

outset.example: From the outset, she made her goals very clear to the whole team.
outset.exampleZh: 从一开始，她就向整个团队明确表达了自己的目标。

outside.example: Let's play outside the house before dinner.
outside.exampleZh: 晚饭前我们在房子外面玩吧。

outskirts.example: They bought a small house on the outskirts of the city last year.
outskirts.exampleZh: 他们去年在城市的郊区买了一栋小房子。

outstanding.example: She did outstanding work on the project last year.
outstanding.exampleZh: 她去年在这个项目上做得非常出色。

outward.example: His outward calm hid a very nervous feeling inside.
outward.exampleZh: 他外表的平静掩盖了内心非常紧张的情绪。

oven.example: My mother put the cake in the oven for thirty minutes.
oven.exampleZh: 我妈妈把蛋糕放进烤箱里烤了三十分钟。

over.example: The plane flew over the mountains and then landed safely.
over.exampleZh: 飞机飞越群山，然后安全降落。

overall.example: Overall, the plan is good, but the cost is too high.
overall.exampleZh: 总的来说，这个计划不错，但成本太高。

overcome.example: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
overcome.exampleZh: 她努力克服了自己当众讲话的恐惧。

overhead.example: The plane flew low overhead, and we could hear its loud engines.
overhead.exampleZh: 飞机从头顶低空飞过，我们能听到它响亮的引擎声。

overhear.example: I overheard them talking about the party in the next room.
overhear.exampleZh: 我无意中听到他们在隔壁房间谈论那个聚会。

overlap.example: Our work hours overlap, so we often meet for lunch.
overlap.exampleZh: 我们的工作时间有重叠，所以我们经常一起吃午饭。

overlook.example: We often overlook small mistakes when we are in a hurry.
overlook.exampleZh: 我们匆忙时常常忽略小错误。

overnight.example: The small shop became famous overnight after a video of it spread online.
overnight.exampleZh: 一段关于这家小店的视频在网上传开后，它一夜之间就出名了。

overseas.example: Many students go overseas to study and learn about new cultures.
overseas.exampleZh: 许多学生去海外学习并了解新的文化。

overtake.example: We ran fast and tried to overtake the bus.
overtake.exampleZh: 我们跑得很快，想追上并超过那辆公交车。

overthrow.example: The people wanted to overthrow the corrupt leader and build a fair government.
overthrow.exampleZh: 人民想要推翻腐败的领导人，建立一个公平的政府。

overtime.example: She works overtime every Friday to finish the weekly report.
overtime.exampleZh: 她每周五都加班完成周报。

overwhelm.example: Too much work can overwhelm a young teacher.
overwhelm.exampleZh: 过多的工作会让年轻教师不知所措。

overwhelming.example: The team won the game by an overwhelming score of ten to zero.
overwhelming.exampleZh: 这支队伍以十比零的压倒性比分赢得了比赛。

owe.example: We still owe the bank money for our new house.
owe.exampleZh: 我们买新房还欠银行的钱。

owing.example: The money owing to the small shop was paid back last week.
owing.exampleZh: 欠那家小商店的钱上周已经还清了。

owl.example: An owl sat quietly on the branch and watched the field below.
owl.exampleZh: 一只猫头鹰静静地停在树枝上，注视着下方的田野。

own.example: I want to have my own room with a big window.
own.exampleZh: 我想要有一间带大窗户的自己的房间。

owner.example: The owner of the small shop knows all his customers well.
owner.exampleZh: 这家小店的店主很了解他所有的顾客。

ownership.example: The ownership of the house passed to her after the sale.
ownership.exampleZh: 房子出售后，所有权转移给了她。

ox.example: The farmer uses a strong ox to pull the heavy cart.
ox.exampleZh: 农夫用一头强壮的牛拉沉重的车。

oxide.example: Rust is an oxide that forms on iron when it gets wet.
oxide.exampleZh: 铁遇水会生成一种氧化物，叫做铁锈。

oxygen.example: Plants give us oxygen so we can breathe and stay alive.
oxygen.exampleZh: 植物为我们提供氧气，这样我们才能呼吸并活下去。

oyster.example: My father ordered a plate of fresh oysters at the seafood restaurant.
oyster.exampleZh: 我爸爸在那家海鲜餐厅点了一盘新鲜牡蛎。

pace.example: He walked at a slow pace and kept looking at his watch.
pace.exampleZh: 他慢慢地走着，不停地看手表。

pack.example: She will pack her clothes and books before the trip tomorrow.
pack.exampleZh: 她会在明天旅行前把衣服和书打包好。

package.example: The new software package helps small shops track their daily sales.
package.exampleZh: 这个新的套装软件帮助小商店跟踪每日销售。

pad.example: She wrote the phone number on a small pad by the phone.
pad.exampleZh: 她把电话号码写在电话旁的一个小便签本上。

page.example: Please turn to page ten in your book and read the story.
page.exampleZh: 请翻到书的第十页，读一读那个故事。

pain.example: The pain in my back is very bad today.
pain.exampleZh: 我今天背部的疼痛很厉害。

paint.example: We will paint the walls of our new house this weekend.
paint.exampleZh: 这个周末我们要给新房子刷墙。

painter.example: The painter is painting a picture of the old bridge.
painter.exampleZh: 这位画家正在画一幅关于那座旧桥的画。

painting.example: The painting on the wall is very old and beautiful.
painting.exampleZh: 墙上的那幅油画很古老，也很美。

pair.example: I bought a new pair of shoes, and they fit me well.
pair.exampleZh: 我买了一双新鞋，它们很适合我。

palace.example: The old king lived in a large palace near the river.
palace.exampleZh: 那位老国王住在河边一座巨大的宫殿里。

pale.example: Her face turned pale when she heard the bad news.
pale.exampleZh: 她听到那个坏消息时脸色变得苍白。

palm.example: She held the small stone in the palm of her hand.
palm.exampleZh: 她把那颗小石头握在手心里。

pamphlet.example: The teacher gave each student a pamphlet about the school library.
pamphlet.exampleZh: 老师给每个学生发了一本关于学校图书馆的小册子。

pan.example: She put the pan on the stove and cooked some eggs.
pan.exampleZh: 她把平底锅放在炉子上，煮了几个鸡蛋。

panel.example: The control panel is easy to use and has clear buttons.
panel.exampleZh: 控制面板很容易使用，上面的按钮也很清晰。

panic.example: The sudden loud noise caused great panic among the small children.
panic.exampleZh: 突然的巨大响声在小孩中间引起了极大的恐慌。

pants.example: He put on his pants and a clean shirt before going to work.
pants.exampleZh: 他穿上裤子和一件干净的衬衫，然后去上班。

paper.example: She wrote her name on a piece of paper and gave it to me.
paper.exampleZh: 她把名字写在一张纸上，然后递给了我。

paragraph.example: Please read the first paragraph of this page again.
paragraph.exampleZh: 请把这页的第一段再读一遍。

parallel.example: The two roads run parallel to each other for several miles.
parallel.exampleZh: 这两条路彼此平行延伸了好几英里。

parcel.example: She sent the parcel to her brother by mail yesterday.
parcel.exampleZh: 她昨天把包裹邮寄给了她的弟弟。

parent.example: His parents taught him to be kind to others.
parent.exampleZh: 他的父母教导他要善待他人。

park.example: We usually park our car near the park on Sundays.
park.exampleZh: 我们通常星期天把车停在那座公园附近。

parliament.example: The new law was passed by parliament after a long debate.
parliament.exampleZh: 经过长时间的辩论，议会通过了这项新法律。

part.example: She played an important part in the school play last year.
part.exampleZh: 她去年在学校戏剧中扮演了一个重要角色。

partial.example: He gave a partial answer because he was not sure of the facts.
partial.exampleZh: 他给出了部分的回答，因为他不确定事实。

participate.example: Many students participate in the school sports meeting every year.
participate.exampleZh: 许多学生每年都参加学校的运动会。

particle.example: Tiny particles of dust floated in the sunlight near the window.
particle.exampleZh: 微小的尘埃颗粒在窗边的阳光中飘浮。

particular.example: She has a particular way of making tea every morning.
particular.exampleZh: 她每天早上泡茶都有一套特别的方法。

partly.example: I partly agree with you, but I still have some questions about the plan.
partly.exampleZh: 我部分同意你的看法，但我对这个计划仍有一些疑问。

partner.example: I asked my partner to help me with the new project.
partner.exampleZh: 我请我的搭档帮我做这个新项目。

party.example: She joined a new political party last year and voted in the election.
party.exampleZh: 她去年加入了一个新的政党，并在选举中投了票。

pass.example: Please pass me the salt on the table.

passage.example: The passage leads to a small garden behind the old house.
passage.exampleZh: 这条通道通向老房子后面的一个小花园。

passenger.example: The passenger asked the driver to stop at the next station.
passenger.exampleZh: 那位乘客请司机在下一站停车。

passion.example: She has a real passion for music and plays the piano every day.
passion.exampleZh: 她对音乐有着真正的热情，每天都弹钢琴。

passive.example: He is too passive in class and rarely asks any questions.
passive.exampleZh: 他在课堂上太被动了，很少提问。

past.example: They walked past the old house and talked about their past.
past.exampleZh: 他们走过那座老房子，聊起了他们的过去。

paste.example: She used paste to stick the paper onto the wall.
paste.exampleZh: 她用浆糊把纸粘到了墙上。

pat.example: She gave the dog a gentle pat on the head and smiled.
pat.exampleZh: 她轻轻拍了拍狗的头，笑了。

patch.example: The farmer grows tomatoes on a small patch of land behind his house.
patch.exampleZh: 农夫在他家后面的一小块土地上种西红柿。

patent.example: The company applied for a patent on its new small machine last year.
patent.exampleZh: 这家公司去年为其新型小型机器申请了专利。

path.example: The path through the park is quiet and very easy to walk.
path.exampleZh: 穿过公园的这条小路很安静，走起来也很轻松。

patience.example: Learning a new language takes patience and a lot of daily practice.
patience.exampleZh: 学习一门新语言需要耐心和大量的日常练习。

patient.example: The doctor is very patient with his young patients.
patient.exampleZh: 这位医生对年幼的病人非常有耐心。

pattern.example: I noticed a clear pattern in the numbers and drew a simple design.
pattern.exampleZh: 我注意到这些数字中有一个清晰的模式，并画了一个简单的图案。

pause.example: We pause for a short break after each lesson.
pause.exampleZh: 每节课后我们会停下来短暂休息。

pave.example: The workers will pave the road before the cold winter comes.
pave.exampleZh: 工人们会在寒冷的冬天到来之前铺好这条路。

paw.example: The little cat licked its paw and then went to sleep.
paw.exampleZh: 那只小猫舔了舔爪子，然后去睡觉了。

pay.example: I will pay for the tickets and you can buy the drinks.
pay.exampleZh: 我来付票钱，你可以买饮料。

payment.example: I make my monthly payment on the first day of each month.
payment.exampleZh: 我在每个月的第一天支付月供。

pea.example: My mother puts fresh peas in the soup every Sunday.
pea.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天都会在汤里放新鲜的豌豆。

peace.example: After the war, the small town finally enjoyed a long period of peace.
peace.exampleZh: 战争结束后，这个小镇终于享受了长期的和平。

peak.example: We reached the peak of the mountain after six hours.
peak.exampleZh: 我们六小时后到达了山顶。

peanut.example: I eat a small bag of peanuts every day after lunch.
peanut.exampleZh: 我每天午饭后吃一小袋花生。

pear.example: My grandmother picks a ripe pear from the tree in her garden.
pear.exampleZh: 我奶奶从她花园里的树上摘下一个熟梨。

peasant.example: The peasant works hard in the fields from morning to night.
peasant.exampleZh: 这个农民从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。

pedal.example: She pressed the pedal hard and the bike moved forward.
pedal.exampleZh: 她用力踩下踏板，自行车向前移动了。

peer.example: Teenagers often care more about their peers than about their parents.
peer.exampleZh: 青少年通常更在意同龄人的看法，而不是父母的看法。

pen.example: She used a pen to write a short letter to her friend.
pen.exampleZh: 她用笔给朋友写了一封短信。

penalty.example: The player scored a penalty in the last minute of the game.
penalty.exampleZh: 那名球员在比赛最后一分钟罚进了一个点球。

pencil.example: Please use a pencil to write your name on this paper.
pencil.exampleZh: 请用铅笔把你的名字写在这张纸上。

penetrate.example: The sunlight can penetrate the thin curtains in the morning.
penetrate.exampleZh: 早晨的阳光能穿透薄薄的窗帘。

peninsula.example: This small peninsula is a great place to watch the sunrise.
peninsula.exampleZh: 这个小半岛是看日出的好地方。

penny.example: I found an old penny under the sofa this morning.
penny.exampleZh: 今天早上我在沙发下面找到了一枚旧便士。

pension.example: After forty years of work, he lives on a small pension.
pension.exampleZh: 工作四十年后，他靠一份微薄的养老金生活。

pepper.example: Please add some salt and pepper to the soup before you serve it.
pepper.exampleZh: 请在端上汤之前往里面加些盐和胡椒。

per.example: We meet once per week to talk about our plans.
per.exampleZh: 我们每周见一次，谈谈我们的计划。

perceive.example: I can perceive a slight change in her voice today.
perceive.exampleZh: 我今天能察觉出她声音里的一丝变化。

percent.example: About sixty percent of the students in our class walk to school every day.
percent.exampleZh: 我们班大约百分之六十的学生每天步行上学。

percentage.example: A large percentage of students study English every day.
percentage.exampleZh: 很大比例的学生每天学习英语。

perfect.example: Nobody is perfect, but we can try to improve ourselves every day.
perfect.exampleZh: 没有人是完美的，但我们可以每天努力完善自己。

perform.example: The team will perform the new play on Friday night.
perform.exampleZh: 这个团队将在周五晚上演出这部新戏。

performance.example: Her performance in the school show made all the teachers very happy.
performance.exampleZh: 她在学校演出中的表现让所有老师都非常高兴。

perhaps.example: Perhaps we can meet at the library after school tomorrow.
perhaps.exampleZh: 也许我们明天放学后可以在图书馆见面。

period.example: This period of history is important for all students.
period.exampleZh: 这段历史时期对所有学生都很重要。

periodical.example: The library keeps every periodical on the second floor for students to read.
periodical.exampleZh: 图书馆把每一本期刊都放在二楼供学生阅读。

permanent.example: The museum needs a permanent home so the art can stay safe.
permanent.exampleZh: 这座博物馆需要一个永久的馆址，这样艺术品才能安全保存。

permission.example: You must ask your teacher for permission before you leave the room.
permission.exampleZh: 你离开房间前必须先征得老师的允许。

permit.example: The school does not permit students to use phones during class.
permit.exampleZh: 学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

persist.example: If you persist in practicing every day, your English will improve.
persist.exampleZh: 如果你坚持每天练习，你的英语就会进步。

person.example: She is a very kind person who always helps others.
person.exampleZh: 她是一个非常善良的人，总是帮助别人。

personal.example: I keep my personal letters in a small box under my bed.
personal.exampleZh: 我把私人信件放在床底下的一个小盒子里。

personality.example: Her warm personality makes everyone feel welcome at work.
personality.exampleZh: 她热情的性格让每个人在工作中都感到受欢迎。

personnel.example: The personnel in our office are very friendly and helpful.
personnel.exampleZh: 我们办公室的人员非常友好且乐于助人。

persuade.example: I tried to persuade my friend to come with us.
persuade.exampleZh: 我试着说服我的朋友和我们一起去。

persuasion.example: Her gentle persuasion finally helped him change his mind.
persuasion.exampleZh: 她温和的说服最终让他改变了主意。

pessimistic.example: My brother is too pessimistic about his chances of finding a new job.
pessimistic.exampleZh: 我弟弟对自己找到新工作的机会太悲观了。

pet.example: My pet dog likes to sleep on my bed every night.
pet.exampleZh: 我的宠物狗喜欢每天晚上睡在我的床上。

petrol.example: We need to buy petrol for the car before we leave.
petrol.exampleZh: 我们出发前需要给车买汽油。

petroleum.example: This country needs a lot of petroleum to run its cars and factories.
petroleum.exampleZh: 这个国家需要大量石油来驱动汽车和工厂。

petty.example: Don't waste your time arguing about such petty problems with him.
petty.exampleZh: 别浪费时间和他为这么琐碎的问题争吵。

phase.example: This project has three phases, and we start the first one today.
phase.exampleZh: 这个项目有三个阶段，我们今天开始第一个阶段。

phenomenon.example: This strange weather is a natural phenomenon that scientists still cannot fully explain.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 这种奇怪的天气是一种科学家们仍无法完全解释的自然现象。

philosopher.example: The old philosopher often sits by the river and thinks about life.
philosopher.exampleZh: 那位年老的哲学家常常坐在河边思考人生。

philosophy.example: Her philosophy of life is to stay curious and help others.
philosophy.exampleZh: 她的人生观是保持好奇并帮助他人。

phone.example: I use my phone to call my mother every Sunday morning.
phone.exampleZh: 我每周日早上都用手机给妈妈打电话。

photo.example: She showed me a photo of her family at the beach.
photo.exampleZh: 她给我看了一张她家人在海滩上的照片。

phrase.example: This common phrase is easy to remember and use every day.
phrase.exampleZh: 这个常用短语很容易记住，而且每天都能用。

physical.example: Regular physical activity helps children stay healthy and strong.
physical.exampleZh: 经常进行身体活动有助于孩子保持健康和强壮。

physician.example: My physician told me to drink more water and get enough sleep.
physician.exampleZh: 我的医生让我多喝水、保证充足睡眠。

physicist.example: The physicist explained how light travels through space to the students.
physicist.exampleZh: 这位物理学家向学生们解释了光如何在太空中传播。

physics.example: I like physics because it helps me understand how the world works.
physics.exampleZh: 我喜欢物理学，因为它帮助我理解世界是如何运作的。

piano.example: My sister plays the piano every evening after she finishes her homework.
piano.exampleZh: 我妹妹每天傍晚写完作业后都会弹钢琴。

pick.example: Please pick a red apple from the tree for me.
pick.exampleZh: 请帮我从树上摘一个红苹果。

picnic.example: We had a picnic in the park last Sunday with all our friends.
picnic.exampleZh: 上周日我们和所有朋友在公园里野餐。

picture.example: She took a picture of the sunset and showed it to her friends.
picture.exampleZh: 她拍了一张日落的照片，并把它给朋友们看了。

pie.example: My mother made an apple pie for us yesterday.
pie.exampleZh: 我妈妈昨天给我们做了一个苹果派。

piece.example: She gave me a piece of cake and a piece of advice.
piece.exampleZh: 她给了我一块蛋糕，还给了我一条建议。

pig.example: The pig is eating apples in the mud.
pig.exampleZh: 那头猪正在泥里吃苹果。

pigeon.example: A gray pigeon sat on the roof and watched the busy street below.
pigeon.exampleZh: 一只灰色的鸽子停在屋顶上，看着下面繁忙的街道。

pile.example: The old books were in a pile on the floor.
pile.exampleZh: 这些旧书在地板上堆成一堆。

pill.example: She takes a small pill with water every morning before breakfast.
pill.exampleZh: 她每天早上早餐前用水服下一小片药丸。

pillar.example: The old stone pillar still holds up the roof of the temple.
pillar.exampleZh: 那根古老的石柱仍然支撑着寺庙的屋顶。

pillow.example: I put a soft pillow under my head before I go to sleep.
pillow.exampleZh: 睡觉前，我在头下垫了一个柔软的枕头。

pilot.example: The pilot tested the new plane before the airline used it.
pilot.exampleZh: 飞行员在航空公司使用这架新飞机之前对它进行了测试。

pin.example: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
pin.exampleZh: 她用一枚别针把纸固定在板子上。

pinch.example: She gave the baby a gentle pinch on the cheek and smiled.
pinch.exampleZh: 她轻轻捏了捏宝宝的脸颊，笑了。

pine.example: He sat by the pine and longed for his old home.
pine.exampleZh: 他坐在松树旁，渴望回到故乡。

pink.example: She wore a pink dress to the party last night.
pink.exampleZh: 她昨晚穿了一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

pint.example: He drank a pint of cold beer after work.
pint.exampleZh: 他下班后喝了一品脱冰啤酒。

pioneer.example: She was a pioneer in science and helped many young women.
pioneer.exampleZh: 她是科学领域的先驱，帮助了许多年轻女性。

pipe.example: Water flows through the pipe under the street to our house.
pipe.exampleZh: 水通过街道下面的管子流到我们家。

pistol.example: The police officer found a pistol hidden under the bed.
pistol.exampleZh: 警察发现床下藏着一把手枪。

pit.example: The old mine has a deep pit near the road.
pit.exampleZh: 那座旧矿井在路边有一个很深的坑。

pitch.example: He will pitch the new plan to the team tomorrow.
pitch.exampleZh: 他明天会向团队推销这个新方案。

pity.example: It is a pity that she cannot come to my birthday party.
pity.exampleZh: 很遗憾她不能来参加我的生日聚会。

pizza.example: We ordered a large pizza with cheese and shared it with our friends.
pizza.exampleZh: 我们点了一个大份的芝士比萨饼，和朋友们一起分享。

place.example: Please place your bag in a safe place near the door.
place.exampleZh: 请把你的包放在门附近一个安全的地方。

plain.example: The rules are plain and easy to understand for everyone.
plain.exampleZh: 这些规则清楚明了，每个人都容易理解。

plan.example: We made a simple plan for the weekend trip.
plan.exampleZh: 我们为周末的旅行制定了一个简单的计划。

plane.example: The plane flew high above the clouds for two hours.
plane.exampleZh: 飞机在云层上方高高飞行了两个小时。

planet.example: Earth is the only planet where we know life exists.
planet.exampleZh: 地球是我们已知唯一存在生命的行星。

plant.example: Every spring we plant new flowers in the small garden.
plant.exampleZh: 每年春天，我们都在小花园里种下新的花。

plantation.example: My grandfather worked on a coffee plantation when he was young.
plantation.exampleZh: 我祖父年轻时在一个咖啡种植园工作。

plastic.example: This cheap plastic chair is light and easy to carry.
plastic.exampleZh: 这把便宜的塑料椅子很轻，便于携带。

plate.example: She put the hot soup in a deep plate on the table.
plate.exampleZh: 她把热汤盛在桌上的一只深盘子里。

platform.example: The train to Beijing leaves from platform three every morning.
platform.exampleZh: 开往北京的火车每天早上从三号站台发车。

play.example: The children like to play outside after school, and they sometimes play simple games.
play.exampleZh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在外面玩，他们有时也玩些简单的游戏。

plea.example: She made a desperate plea for help, but no one listened.
plea.exampleZh: 她绝望地恳求帮助，但没有人听。

plead.example: She began to plead with her boss for one more chance.
plead.exampleZh: 她开始恳求老板再给她一次机会。

pleasant.example: The weather is pleasant today, so we can walk in the park.
pleasant.exampleZh: 今天天气令人愉快，所以我们可以去公园散步。

please.example: Please sit down and tell me what you would like to eat.
please.exampleZh: 请坐下，告诉我你想吃什么。

pleasure.example: It is a great pleasure to meet you and your family today.
pleasure.exampleZh: 今天见到你和你的家人是一件非常愉快的事。

pledge.example: She made a pledge to help her friend every day.
pledge.exampleZh: 她发誓每天都要帮助她的朋友。

plenty.example: There is plenty of food and water for everyone here.
plenty.exampleZh: 这里有丰富的食物和水供每个人使用。

plight.example: Many farmers still face a serious plight because of the long drought.
plight.exampleZh: 由于长期干旱，许多农民仍然面临着严重的困境。

plot.example: The novel has a clever plot, and the heroes plot to save the town.
plot.exampleZh: 这部小说情节巧妙，主人公们密谋拯救小镇。

plug.example: He put the plug into the wall socket and turned on the TV.
plug.exampleZh: 他把插头插进墙上的插座，然后打开了电视。

plunge.example: The company's shares plunged after the bad news.
plunge.exampleZh: 坏消息传出后，公司股价暴跌。

plus.example: Two plus three is five, and the extra help is a real plus.
plus.exampleZh: 二加三等于五，而额外的帮助是一个真正的好处。

pocket.example: He put his keys in the pocket of his old brown coat.
pocket.exampleZh: 他把钥匙放进了他那件旧棕色外套的口袋里。

poem.example: She wrote a short poem about the sea for her class.
poem.exampleZh: 她为班级写了一首关于大海的短诗。

poet.example: My father is a poet who writes about small village life.
poet.exampleZh: 我的父亲是一位诗人，他写的是小村庄的生活。

poetry.example: She reads poetry every night before going to sleep.
poetry.exampleZh: 她每晚睡觉前都会读诗。

point.example: The main point of his talk was very clear.
point.exampleZh: 他讲话的要点非常清楚。

poison.example: Someone put poison in the dog's food last night.
poison.exampleZh: 昨晚有人把毒药放进了狗的食物里。

poisonous.example: Some mushrooms in the forest are poisonous, so never eat them.
poisonous.exampleZh: 森林里有些蘑菇是有毒的，所以千万不要吃它们。

pole.example: The flag hangs from a tall wooden pole in front of the school.
pole.exampleZh: 旗子挂在学校前面一根高高的木杆上。

police.example: The police came quickly and helped the old man find his way home.
police.exampleZh: 警察很快赶来，帮助那位老人找到了回家的路。

policy.example: The company changed its policy to help new workers.
policy.exampleZh: 公司改变了政策来帮助新员工。

polish.example: I need to polish my shoes before the meeting tomorrow morning.
polish.exampleZh: 明天上午开会前，我需要把鞋子擦亮。

polite.example: She is always polite to her teachers and classmates at school.
polite.exampleZh: 她在学校对老师和同学总是很有礼貌。

political.example: She often talks about political problems with her friends.
political.exampleZh: 她经常和朋友们谈论政治问题。

politician.example: The politician gave a short speech to the crowd.
politician.exampleZh: 这位政治家向人群做了简短的演讲。

politics.example: My brother studies politics at university because he wants to help his city.
politics.exampleZh: 我哥哥在大学学政治学，因为他想帮助他所在的城市。

poll.example: The poll shows that most people want better schools in our city.
poll.exampleZh: 民意测验显示，我们城市的大多数人希望有更好的学校。

pollute.example: The factory throws waste into the river and pollutes the water.
pollute.exampleZh: 那家工厂把废料倒进河里，污染了河水。

pollution.example: The new factory has caused serious pollution in the river near our town.
pollution.exampleZh: 这家新工厂给我们镇附近的河流造成了严重的污染。

pond.example: There are many small fish swimming in the pond behind our house.
pond.exampleZh: 我们家后面的池塘里有许多小鱼在游。

ponder.example: She sat by the window and pondered the question for a long time.
ponder.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，沉思那个问题很久。

pool.example: The children swim in the small pool behind our house every summer.
pool.exampleZh: 每年夏天，孩子们都在我们屋后的那个小水池里游泳。

poor.example: The poor family had little food and no warm clothes for winter.
poor.exampleZh: 这个贫穷的家庭食物很少，冬天也没有保暖的衣服。

pop.example: The pop song suddenly popped into my head this morning.
pop.exampleZh: 这首流行歌曲今天早上突然出现在我脑海里。

popular.example: This song is very popular with young people in our school.
popular.exampleZh: 这首歌在我们学校的年轻人中很受欢迎。

population.example: The population of this small city grew quickly last year.
population.exampleZh: 这座小城市的人口去年增长得很快。

porch.example: She sat on the porch and watched the children play in the yard.
porch.exampleZh: 她坐在门廊上，看着孩子们在院子里玩耍。

port.example: The ship will arrive at the port early tomorrow morning.
port.exampleZh: 这艘船明天一早会抵达港口。

portable.example: This small portable radio is easy to carry when we travel.
portable.exampleZh: 这台小型便携收音机在我们旅行时很容易携带。

porter.example: The porter helped us carry our heavy bags to the room.
porter.exampleZh: 搬运工帮我们把沉重的行李搬到了房间。

portion.example: She ate only a small portion of the cake and shared the rest with us.
portion.exampleZh: 她只吃了一小部分蛋糕，把剩下的分给了我们。

portrait.example: The artist painted a portrait of his mother last summer.
portrait.exampleZh: 那位艺术家去年夏天为他的母亲画了一幅肖像。

portray.example: The movie portrays a young teacher who changes a small village school.
portray.exampleZh: 这部电影描绘了一位改变乡村小学的年轻教师。

pose.example: The new rule may pose a serious problem for small shops.
pose.exampleZh: 新规定可能会给小商店带来严重问题。

position.example: He got a new position at a bank in the city.
position.exampleZh: 他在城里一家银行获得了一个新职位。

positive.example: She always stays positive even when things are hard.
positive.exampleZh: 即使事情艰难，她也始终保持积极。

possess.example: She possesses a rare talent for making people feel at ease.
possess.exampleZh: 她拥有一种罕见的天赋，能让人感到自在。

possession.example: Her most valuable possession is the old watch from her father.
possession.exampleZh: 她最珍贵的所有物是父亲留给她的那块旧手表。

possibility.example: There is a real possibility that he will change his mind.
possibility.exampleZh: 他改变主意是很有可能的。

possible.example: It is possible to finish this work before Friday.
possible.exampleZh: 在周五之前完成这项工作是可能的。

post.example: He will post the letter at the post office today.
post.exampleZh: 他今天会去邮局寄这封信。

postage.example: The postage for sending this small package to another city is not very expensive.
postage.exampleZh: 把这个小包裹寄到另一个城市的邮费并不贵。

postpone.example: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was ill.
postpone.exampleZh: 因为经理生病了，我们不得不推迟会议。

pot.example: She put the soup in a big pot on the stove.
pot.exampleZh: 她把汤倒进炉子上的一口大锅里。

potato.example: My mother cooks potatoes with beef for dinner every Sunday.
potato.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天晚餐都会用土豆炖牛肉。

potential.example: She has great potential as a singer, but she needs more practice.
potential.exampleZh: 她作为歌手很有潜力，但还需要更多练习。

pound.example: The dog's heart began to pound when it heard the loud noise.
pound.exampleZh: 那只狗听到巨响时，心脏开始猛烈跳动。

pour.example: She poured the hot soup into a big bowl for us.
pour.exampleZh: 她把热汤倒进一个大碗里给我们。

poverty.example: Many families in this small village still live in poverty today.
poverty.exampleZh: 这个村子里的许多家庭至今仍生活在贫穷之中。

powder.example: She put some baby powder on the baby's skin after the bath.
powder.exampleZh: 洗完澡后，她在宝宝的皮肤上涂了一些爽身粉。

power.example: The new machine needs a lot of power to run every day.
power.exampleZh: 这台新机器每天运行需要大量电力。

powerful.example: This small car has a powerful engine and it runs very fast.
powerful.exampleZh: 这辆小汽车有一台强劲的发动机，跑得很快。

practical.example: We need a practical plan that everyone can follow today.
practical.exampleZh: 我们需要一个今天大家都能照着做的可行计划。

practically.example: The room was so small that it was practically impossible to move.
practically.exampleZh: 这个房间太小了，几乎不可能移动。

practice.example: Daily practice is the best way to improve your English speaking skills.
practice.exampleZh: 每天练习是提高英语口语能力的最佳方式。

practise.example: I practise English with my friends every day after school.
practise.exampleZh: 我每天放学后和朋友们一起练习英语。

praise.example: Her teacher gave her great praise for the hard work she did.
praise.exampleZh: 老师因为她付出的努力而大大赞扬了她。

pray.example: Every night she prays for her family's health and happiness.
pray.exampleZh: 每天晚上她都祈祷家人健康幸福。

prayer.example: She said a quiet prayer before going to bed.
prayer.exampleZh: 她睡觉前默默地做了一次祈祷。

preach.example: The teacher likes to preach about the value of hard work.
preach.exampleZh: 这位老师喜欢说教努力工作的价值。

precaution.example: Taking simple precautions can keep your family safe at home.
precaution.exampleZh: 采取简单的预防措施可以让家人在家中保持安全。

precede.example: A short introduction will precede the main talk this afternoon.
precede.exampleZh: 今天下午，一段简短的介绍将安排在主要演讲之前。

precedent.example: The judge followed a precedent from an older case.
precedent.exampleZh: 法官遵循了一个更早案件的先例。

preceding.example: The preceding chapter explains the basic rules of the game.
preceding.exampleZh: 前面那一章讲解了游戏的基本规则。

precious.example: Time with family is precious, so we should never waste it.
precious.exampleZh: 与家人共度的时光是珍贵的，所以我们绝不应该浪费它。

precise.example: Her instructions were precise, so everyone finished the task without any mistakes.
precise.exampleZh: 她的指示很精确，所以每个人都毫无差错地完成了任务。

precision.example: This machine can cut the metal with great precision.
precision.exampleZh: 这台机器能非常精确地切割金属。

predict.example: Scientists can predict the weather with the help of modern computers.
predict.exampleZh: 科学家借助现代计算机能够预测天气。

predominant.example: Blue is the predominant color in this small room.
predominant.exampleZh: 蓝色是这个狭小房间里的主色调。

predominate.example: Small shops predominate in this quiet old part of town.
predominate.exampleZh: 在这个安静的旧城区，小商店占主导地位。

preface.example: The author wrote a short preface to explain why he wrote the book.
preface.exampleZh: 作者写了一篇简短的序言，解释他为什么写这本书。

prefer.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
prefer.exampleZh: 早上我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

preferable.example: This plan is preferable to the old one for our small team.
preferable.exampleZh: 对我们这个小团队来说，这个方案比旧方案更可取。

preference.example: She has a strong preference for tea over coffee in the morning.
preference.exampleZh: 她早上更偏爱茶而不是咖啡。

pregnant.example: Her long silence was pregnant with meaning that nobody dared to name.
pregnant.exampleZh: 她长久的沉默意味深长，却没人敢说破。

prejudice.example: His judgment was clouded by prejudice against people from other countries.
prejudice.exampleZh: 他的判断被对外国人的偏见所蒙蔽。

preliminary.example: The preliminary results look good, and we will do more tests next week.
preliminary.exampleZh: 初步结果看起来不错，我们下周会做更多测试。

premier.example: He is the premier of Canada and holds the most important job.
premier.exampleZh: 他是加拿大总理，担任着最重要的职务。

premiere.example: The whole city came out for the premiere of her new film.
premiere.exampleZh: 全城的人都出来参加她新电影的首映。

preparation.example: Good preparation before a long trip saves you a lot of trouble.
preparation.exampleZh: 长途旅行前做好充分准备能为你省去很多麻烦。

prepare.example: She needs to prepare dinner for her family tonight.
prepare.exampleZh: 她今晚需要为家人准备晚餐。

preposition.example: In this sentence, the word "in" is a preposition.
preposition.exampleZh: 在这个句子中，单词“in”是一个介词。

prescribe.example: The doctor will prescribe some medicine for your cough.
prescribe.exampleZh: 医生会为你的咳嗽开一些药。

prescription.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for cough medicine.
prescription.exampleZh: 医生给我开了一张止咳药的处方。

presence.example: Her calm presence made everyone in the room feel safe.
presence.exampleZh: 她沉静的仪表让房间里的每个人都感到安心。

present.example: She was present at the meeting and gave him a small gift.
present.exampleZh: 她出席了会议，并送给他一份小礼物。

presently.example: The doctor will be here presently, so please wait in this room.
presently.exampleZh: 医生不久就会来，请在这个房间里等一下。

preserve.example: We must preserve the old trees in our town for future generations.
preserve.exampleZh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护好镇上的老树。

preside.example: The teacher will preside over the class meeting this afternoon.
preside.exampleZh: 老师将在今天下午主持班会。

president.example: The president of the company gave a short speech to all the workers.
president.exampleZh: 公司的董事长向所有员工做了简短的讲话。

press.example: Please press the button to open the door.

pressure.example: My teacher put pressure on us to finish the work on time.
pressure.exampleZh: 老师向我们施压，要求我们按时完成工作。

prestige.example: The old university has great prestige among students and teachers.
prestige.exampleZh: 这所古老的大学在师生中享有很高的声望。

prestigious.example: She works at a prestigious university in the north of the country.
prestigious.exampleZh: 她在该国北部一所享有盛誉的大学工作。

presumably.example: He is not here, so he is presumably still at work.
presumably.exampleZh: 他不在这里，所以大概还在上班。

presume.example: I presume you are tired after the long trip.
presume.exampleZh: 我猜你长途旅行后一定累了。

pretend.example: The little boy likes to pretend that he is a superhero.
pretend.exampleZh: 这个小男孩喜欢假装自己是超级英雄。

pretext.example: He used a headache as a pretext to leave the party early.
pretext.exampleZh: 他以头痛为借口提前离开了聚会。

pretty.example: The garden looks pretty in spring, and the weather is pretty warm today.
pretty.exampleZh: 这个花园在春天看起来很漂亮，而且今天天气相当暖和。

prevail.example: In the end, common sense will prevail over fear and anger.
prevail.exampleZh: 最终，常识将战胜恐惧和愤怒。

prevalent.example: This idea is very prevalent among young people today.
prevalent.exampleZh: 这个想法在当今年轻人中非常普遍。

prevent.example: Wash your hands often to prevent the spread of germs.
prevent.exampleZh: 经常洗手，以防止细菌传播。

previous.example: My previous teacher gave me a lot of help with math.
previous.exampleZh: 我以前的老师在数学上给了我很多帮助。

prey.example: The lion hunts its prey at night.

price.example: The price of this book is very low for students.
price.exampleZh: 这本书的价格对学生来说很低。

pride.example: She takes great pride in her work at the small town school.
pride.exampleZh: 她对自己在小镇学校的工作深感自豪。

priest.example: The priest spoke quietly with the family after the Sunday morning service.
priest.exampleZh: 周日早晨礼拜结束后，牧师与这家人轻声交谈。

primarily.example: The class is primarily for beginners who want to learn English.
primarily.exampleZh: 这个班主要是为想学英语的初学者开设的。

primary.example: Safety is our primary goal, so we check every machine before use.
primary.exampleZh: 安全是我们的首要目标，因此我们在使用前会检查每台机器。

prime.example: Safety is our prime concern, so we check every machine before work.
prime.exampleZh: 安全是我们首要关注的问题，所以我们上班前会检查每台机器。

primitive.example: These primitive tools were made of stone and wood long ago.
primitive.exampleZh: 这些原始工具很久以前是用石头和木头制成的。

prince.example: The young prince will become king when his father dies.
prince.exampleZh: 这位年轻的王子将在父亲去世后成为国王。

princess.example: The little princess wore a beautiful blue dress to the party.
princess.exampleZh: 小公主穿了一条漂亮的蓝色连衣裙去参加聚会。

principal.example: The principal reason we chose this school is its kind principal.
principal.exampleZh: 我们选择这所学校的主要原因是它有一位和蔼的校长。

principle.example: Honesty is an important principle in our family.
principle.exampleZh: 诚实是我们家一条重要的原则。

print.example: The book will print next week and go on sale soon after.
print.exampleZh: 这本书将于下周印刷，之后不久就会发售。

prior.example: Please finish this task prior to the meeting tomorrow morning.
prior.exampleZh: 请在明天上午的会议之前完成这项任务。

priority.example: Safety is our top priority when we plan the school trip.
priority.exampleZh: 当我们筹划学校旅行时，安全是我们的首要优先事项。

prison.example: The man was sent to prison for two years after the trial.
prison.exampleZh: 审判之后，那名男子被送进监狱服刑两年。

prisoner.example: The prisoner was allowed to see his family once a month.
prisoner.exampleZh: 这名囚犯获准每月见家人一次。

privacy.example: Many people worry about their privacy when they use the internet every day.
privacy.exampleZh: 许多人每天上网时都担心自己的隐私。

private.example: He keeps his private life away from his many fans.
private.exampleZh: 他把自己的私生活与众多粉丝隔离开来。

privilege.example: It is a privilege to work with such kind and helpful people.
privilege.exampleZh: 能和这样善良又乐于助人的人一起工作是一种荣幸。

prize.example: She won first prize in the school singing contest last year.
prize.exampleZh: 她在去年的学校歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

probability.example: There is a high probability that it will rain tomorrow.

probable.example: It is probable that the meeting will start late today.
probable.exampleZh: 今天的会议很可能会晚一点开始。

probably.example: She is probably at home now because her car is still here.
probably.exampleZh: 她现在大概在家，因为她的车还在这里。

probe.example: The doctor used a small probe to check the wound carefully.
probe.exampleZh: 医生用一根小探针仔细检查了伤口。

problem.example: We talked about the problem together and found a simple answer.
problem.exampleZh: 我们一起讨论了这个难题，并找到了一个简单的答案。

procedure.example: You must follow the correct procedure to apply for a new passport.
procedure.exampleZh: 你必须遵循正确的程序来申请新护照。

proceed.example: We will proceed with the plan after everyone agrees.
proceed.exampleZh: 等大家都同意后，我们就着手进行这个计划。

process.example: We need to learn each step of the process before we start.
process.exampleZh: 在开始之前，我们需要了解这个过程的每一个步骤。

proclaim.example: The school proclaimed the good news to all the students.
proclaim.exampleZh: 学校向所有学生宣告了这个好消息。

produce.example: The factory produces many cheap goods for the local market.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂为当地市场生产许多便宜的商品。

product.example: This new product is very popular with young people.
product.exampleZh: 这款新产品很受年轻人的欢迎。

production.example: The factory increased its production of cars by twenty percent last year.
production.exampleZh: 这家工厂去年的汽车产量提高了百分之二十。

productive.example: A short break can make your afternoon much more productive.
productive.exampleZh: 短暂休息一下能让你的下午效率高得多。

productivity.example: Good sleep can improve your productivity at work and school.
productivity.exampleZh: 良好的睡眠能提高你在工作和学习中的效率。

profession.example: Teaching is a profession that requires patience and care.
profession.exampleZh: 教学是一门需要耐心和关爱的职业。

professional.example: She is a professional nurse and works in a large city hospital.
professional.exampleZh: 她是一名专业护士，在一家大城市医院工作。

professor.example: My professor is very kind and often helps us after class.
professor.exampleZh: 我的教授非常和善，经常在课后帮助我们。

proficiency.example: Her proficiency in English helped her get a better job.
proficiency.exampleZh: 她的英语熟练度帮助她找到了一份更好的工作。

profile.example: The website gives a short profile of each new teacher.
profile.exampleZh: 这个网站给出了每位新教师的简短简介。

profit.example: The small shop made a good profit this year and hired two more workers.
profit.exampleZh: 这家小店今年赚了不少利润，还多雇了两名工人。

profitable.example: The small shop became very profitable after the owner started selling coffee.
profitable.exampleZh: 店主开始卖咖啡后，这家小店变得非常有利可图。

profound.example: The teacher's words had a profound effect on my life.
profound.exampleZh: 老师的话对我的一生产生了深远的影响。

program.example: I watch my favorite program on TV every evening after dinner.
program.exampleZh: 我每天晚饭后都在电视上看我最喜欢的节目。

progress.example: She has made good progress in English this year.
progress.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上取得了很好的进步。

progressive.example: Our school has made progressive changes to help students learn better.
progressive.exampleZh: 我们学校做出了逐步的改进，帮助学生更好地学习。

prohibit.example: The school prohibits students from using phones during class.
prohibit.exampleZh: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。

project.example: Our team will start a new project next Monday.
project.exampleZh: 我们团队下周一将开始一个新项目。

prominent.example: She is a prominent scientist at our university.
prominent.exampleZh: 她是我们大学一位著名的科学家。

promise.example: I promise to call you every night, so please don't worry about me.
promise.exampleZh: 我答应每天晚上给你打电话，所以请不要为我担心。

promising.example: She is a promising young singer with a beautiful voice.
promising.exampleZh: 她是一位有前途的年轻歌手，嗓音很美。

promote.example: The new program can promote better health among young students.
promote.exampleZh: 这项新计划能促进年轻学生获得更好的健康。

prompt.example: The teacher gave us a prompt answer and a helpful prompt.
prompt.exampleZh: 老师给了我们迅速的回答和一个有用的提示。

pronoun.example: In the sentence 'She likes him', the word 'him' is a pronoun.
pronoun.exampleZh: 在句子“She likes him”中，单词“him”是一个代词。

pronounce.example: Many students cannot pronounce this long word correctly at first.
pronounce.exampleZh: 许多学生一开始无法正确发音这个长单词。

pronunciation.example: Her English pronunciation is very clear, so everyone can understand her easily.
pronunciation.exampleZh: 她的英语发音非常清晰，所以每个人都能轻松听懂她的话。

proof.example: The police found no proof that he took the money.
proof.exampleZh: 警方没有找到他拿了这笔钱的证据。

propaganda.example: The government used propaganda to make people believe the false news.
propaganda.exampleZh: 政府利用宣传让人们相信那则假消息。

propel.example: The wind can propel a small boat across the lake very quickly.
propel.exampleZh: 风能推动一艘小船非常快地穿过湖面。

proper.example: It is proper to say thank you when someone helps you.
proper.exampleZh: 当别人帮助你时说声谢谢是恰当的。

property.example: The old house is the most valuable property that my family owns.
property.exampleZh: 那栋老房子是我家拥有的最值钱的财产。

proportion.example: A large proportion of students walk to school every day.
proportion.exampleZh: 很大一部分学生每天步行上学。

proposal.example: She accepted his proposal to meet again next week.
proposal.exampleZh: 她接受了他下周再见一面的提议。

propose.example: I propose that we start the meeting a little earlier tomorrow.
propose.exampleZh: 我提议我们明天把会议提前一点开始。

proposition.example: Her proposition sounded simple, but nobody in the room agreed with it.
proposition.exampleZh: 她的主张听起来很简单，但房间里没有人同意。

prose.example: She writes short prose about her small town and the people in it.
prose.exampleZh: 她写一些关于她的小镇和镇里人们的短篇散文。

prosecute.example: The police decided to prosecute the driver for breaking the traffic law.
prosecute.exampleZh: 警方决定以违反交通法规为由起诉这名司机。

prospect.example: The prospect of a long holiday makes everyone in the office happy.
prospect.exampleZh: 漫长假期的前景让办公室里的每个人都很高兴。

prospective.example: She has a meeting with a prospective buyer tomorrow morning.
prospective.exampleZh: 她明天上午要和一位潜在买家会面。

prosper.example: The small town began to prosper after the new road was built.
prosper.exampleZh: 新路修好之后，这个小镇开始繁荣起来。

prosperity.example: The town enjoyed years of peace and prosperity after the new road was built.
prosperity.exampleZh: 新路建成后，这个小镇享受了多年的和平与繁荣。

prosperous.example: Our small town became prosperous after the new factory opened last year.
prosperous.exampleZh: 去年新工厂开工后，我们的小镇变得繁荣起来。

protect.example: Parents should protect their children from danger at all times.
protect.exampleZh: 父母应该时刻保护孩子免受危险。

protein.example: You need to eat more protein if you want to build strong muscles.
protein.exampleZh: 如果你想练出强壮的肌肉，就需要多吃蛋白质。

protest.example: The students organized a peaceful protest against the new school rules.
protest.exampleZh: 学生们组织了一场和平抗议，反对学校的新规定。

prototype.example: The engineers built a prototype of the new car before starting full production.
prototype.exampleZh: 工程师们在开始全面生产之前制作了这辆新车的原型。

proud.example: My parents are very proud of me because I work hard at school.
proud.exampleZh: 我父母为我感到非常骄傲，因为我在学校很努力。

prove.example: The teacher asked me to prove that the answer was correct.
prove.exampleZh: 老师让我证明这个答案是正确的。

provide.example: The school provides free books for every student in the class.
provide.exampleZh: 学校为班上每个学生提供免费课本。

provided.example: We will go to the park provided it does not rain tomorrow.
provided.exampleZh: 假如明天不下雨，我们就去公园。

province.example: He grew up in a small village in the northern province.
province.exampleZh: 他在北部省份的一个小村庄长大。

provision.example: The contract has a provision about extra pay for weekend work.
provision.exampleZh: 合同里有一项关于周末加班额外报酬的条款。

provoke.example: His rude words provoked an angry reply from the whole class.
provoke.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的话激起了全班同学愤怒的回应。

psychological.example: Stress can cause serious psychological problems for students during exam week.
psychological.exampleZh: 考试周期间，压力可能会给学生带来严重的心理问题。

psychology.example: She wants to study psychology because she is interested in how people think.
psychology.exampleZh: 她想学习心理学，因为人们对思考的方式很感兴趣。

pub.example: We met some friends at a small pub near the station.
pub.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近的一家小酒吧见了几个朋友。

public.example: The public library is open to everyone in our small town.
public.exampleZh: 我们小镇的公共图书馆对所有人开放。

publication.example: The publication of her first book made her very happy.
publication.exampleZh: 她第一本书的出版让她非常开心。

publicity.example: The new movie got a lot of publicity before it came out.
publicity.exampleZh: 这部新电影上映前获得了大量宣传。

publish.example: The school will publish the exam results on its website next Monday.
publish.exampleZh: 学校将于下周一在其网站上公布考试结果。

puff.example: He took a puff of his cigarette and slowly blew out the smoke.
puff.exampleZh: 他吸了一口烟，然后慢慢把烟吐出来。

pull.example: She pulled the heavy box across the floor to the door.
pull.exampleZh: 她把那个沉重的箱子从地板上拖到门口。

pulse.example: The doctor felt his pulse and said he was fine.
pulse.exampleZh: 医生摸了摸他的脉搏，说他没事。

pump.example: The farmer used a pump to bring water from the well.

punch.example: He gave the wall a hard punch and broke the board.
punch.exampleZh: 他用力猛击墙壁，把木板打坏了。

punctual.example: She is always punctual for every class.
punctual.exampleZh: 她每次上课总是很准时。

punish.example: The teacher will punish students who cheat on the exam.
punish.exampleZh: 老师会惩罚考试作弊的学生。

punishment.example: The punishment for breaking the school rules was a week of extra homework.
punishment.exampleZh: 违反校规的惩罚是额外做一周的家庭作业。

pupil.example: The pupil in the front row asked his teacher a very good question.
pupil.exampleZh: 前排的那名小学生问了老师一个非常好的问题。

purchase.example: I want to purchase a new laptop for my online classes.
purchase.exampleZh: 我想买一台新笔记本电脑用于我的网课。

pure.example: This water is pure and safe for children to drink.
pure.exampleZh: 这水是纯净的，孩子们喝是安全的。

purify.example: We can purify the water before we drink it.
purify.exampleZh: 我们可以在喝水前把水净化。

purple.example: She wore a purple dress to the party last night.
purple.exampleZh: 昨晚她穿了一条紫色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

purpose.example: The purpose of this meeting is to plan our next project.
purpose.exampleZh: 这次会议的目的是规划我们的下一个项目。

purse.example: She keeps her keys and some money in a small red purse.
purse.exampleZh: 她把钥匙和一些钱放在一个红色的小钱包里。

pursue.example: She wants to pursue a career in music after college.
pursue.exampleZh: 她想在大学毕业后从事音乐方面的职业。

pursuit.example: Her pursuit of a better life led her to a new city.
pursuit.exampleZh: 她对更好生活的追求使她来到了一座新城市。

push.example: She pushed the heavy box across the floor and then sat down.
push.exampleZh: 她把那个沉重的箱子推过地板，然后坐了下来。

put.example: Please put the books on the desk before you leave.
put.exampleZh: 请在离开前把书放在桌子上。

puzzle.example: The missing key is a puzzle that makes everyone confused.
puzzle.exampleZh: 丢失的钥匙是一个让每个人都困惑的谜。

pyramid.example: The children built a small pyramid with blocks on the floor.
pyramid.exampleZh: 孩子们在地板上用积木搭了一个小金字塔。

quake.example: The ground began to quake, and people ran out of their houses.
quake.exampleZh: 大地开始震动，人们纷纷跑出了房子。

qualification.example: This job requires good qualifications and a lot of hard work.
qualification.exampleZh: 这份工作需要良好的资历和大量的努力工作。

qualify.example: She must pass the exam to qualify for the job.
qualify.exampleZh: 她必须通过考试才能取得这份工作的资格。

qualitative.example: This qualitative study describes how students feel about online classes.
qualitative.exampleZh: 这项定性研究描述了学生对网课的感受。

quality.example: This shop sells good quality shoes at a low price.
quality.exampleZh: 这家店以低价出售质量好的鞋子。

quantify.example: Scientists use simple tools to quantify the amount of water in the soil.
quantify.exampleZh: 科学家用简单的工具来量化土壤中的水分含量。

quantitative.example: The study gives quantitative data about how students spend their free time.
quantitative.exampleZh: 这项研究提供了关于学生如何度过空闲时间的定量数据。

quantity.example: The store has a large quantity of fresh apples today.
quantity.exampleZh: 这家店今天有大量的新鲜苹果。

quarrel.example: My parents had a quarrel about money last night.
quarrel.exampleZh: 我父母昨晚为了钱吵了一架。

quart.example: She bought a quart of milk at the small store near her home.
quart.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的小店买了一夸脱牛奶。

quarter.example: The company will move its office to a new quarter next spring.
quarter.exampleZh: 公司明年春天将把办公室搬到一个新的地区。

quarterly.example: The company sends a quarterly report to all its workers.
quarterly.exampleZh: 公司向所有员工发送季度报告。

quartz.example: The white sand on this beach is mostly made of tiny quartz grains.
quartz.exampleZh: 这片海滩上的白沙主要由细小的石英颗粒组成。

queen.example: The queen waved to the happy people from her bright golden chair.
queen.exampleZh: 女王坐在明亮的金色椅子上，向快乐的人们挥手。

queer.example: There is something queer about the way he keeps looking at us.
queer.exampleZh: 他一直那样看我们，这有点可疑。

quench.example: After the long run, he drank cold water to quench his thirst.
quench.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他喝冷水来解渴。

query.example: If you have a query about the schedule, please ask your teacher.
query.exampleZh: 如果你对日程安排有疑问，请问你的老师。

quest.example: His quest for knowledge led him to many countries.
quest.exampleZh: 他对知识的追求带他去了许多国家。

question.example: She asked a question about the homework, but nobody knew the answer.
question.exampleZh: 她问了一个关于作业的问题，但没有人知道答案。

questionnaire.example: Please fill in this questionnaire and give it back to me tomorrow.
questionnaire.exampleZh: 请填写这份问卷，明天交回给我。

queue.example: We had to queue for an hour to buy the concert tickets.
queue.exampleZh: 我们不得不排队一个小时才买到音乐会门票。

quick.example: She is quick at math and finishes her homework fast.
quick.exampleZh: 她数学很敏捷，很快就做完了作业。

quiet.example: Please be quiet because the baby is sleeping in the next room.
quiet.exampleZh: 请安静，因为宝宝正在隔壁房间睡觉。

quilt.example: My grandmother made a warm quilt for me last winter.
quilt.exampleZh: 去年冬天，我奶奶给我做了一床暖和的棉被。

quit.example: She decided to quit her job and travel for a few months.
quit.exampleZh: 她决定辞职，去旅行几个月。

quite.example: The test was quite easy, so everyone finished it early.
quite.exampleZh: 这次考试相当容易，所以大家都提前做完了。

quiver.example: Her voice began to quiver as she told us the sad news.
quiver.exampleZh: 当她告诉我们那个悲伤的消息时，她的声音开始颤抖。

quiz.example: Our teacher gave us a short quiz on the new words today.
quiz.exampleZh: 老师今天给我们做了一次关于新单词的小测验。

quota.example: Each country has a strict quota for how much sugar it can import.
quota.exampleZh: 每个国家都有严格的食糖进口配额。

quotation.example: The teacher put a quotation from the novel at the top of the page.
quotation.exampleZh: 老师在页面顶部放了一段小说中的引文。

quote.example: She asked the shop to quote a fair price for the repair.
quote.exampleZh: 她请那家店为这次维修报一个公道的价格。

rabbit.example: The white rabbit is eating a carrot in the garden.
rabbit.exampleZh: 那只白兔正在花园里吃胡萝卜。

race.example: People of every race can join the running race today and race for fun.
race.exampleZh: 任何种族的人今天都可以参加这场跑步比赛，为乐趣而奔跑。

racial.example: Many people are working hard to end racial discrimination in schools.
racial.exampleZh: 许多人正在努力消除学校里的种族歧视。

racism.example: Racism hurts people and makes our communities weaker.
racism.exampleZh: 种族主义会伤害人们，并使我们的社区变得更脆弱。

rack.example: He put the old books on the wooden rack by the door.
rack.exampleZh: 他把旧书放在门边的木架子上。

radar.example: The small boat used radar to find the harbor in the dark.
radar.exampleZh: 小船用雷达在黑暗中找到了港口。

radiant.example: The bride looked radiant in her white dress on the sunny wedding day.
radiant.exampleZh: 婚礼那天阳光明媚，新娘穿着白色婚纱，看上去容光焕发。

radiate.example: The warm sun radiates light and heat onto the small garden.
radiate.exampleZh: 温暖的太阳向小花园散发出光和热。

radiation.example: The doctor said too much radiation can harm your body and skin.
radiation.exampleZh: 医生说过多的辐射会伤害你的身体和皮肤。

radical.example: The new leader wants radical changes in the company.
radical.exampleZh: 这位新领导希望公司进行根本性的变革。

radio.example: The pilot used the radio to ask for help during the storm.
radio.exampleZh: 飞行员在暴风雨中用无线电求助。

radius.example: The police searched the whole area within a radius of five miles.
radius.exampleZh: 警方搜查了方圆五英里内的整个区域。

rag.example: He cleaned the dusty table with an old rag.
rag.exampleZh: 他用一块旧抹布擦干净了满是灰尘的桌子。

rage.example: His face turned red with rage when he heard the bad news.
rage.exampleZh: 听到那个坏消息时，他的脸因狂怒而变红。

raid.example: The police made a raid on the house at night.
raid.exampleZh: 警方在夜间突袭了那所房子。

rail.example: Hold the rail tightly when you walk down the stairs.
rail.exampleZh: 下楼梯时要紧紧抓住栏杆。

railroad.example: The new railroad will connect our small town to the big city.
railroad.exampleZh: 这条新铁路将把我们的小镇连接到大城市。

railway.example: My father takes the railway to work every morning.
railway.exampleZh: 我父亲每天早上坐铁路列车去上班。

rain.example: The rain fell hard all night, so we stayed inside and played cards.
rain.exampleZh: 雨下了一整夜，所以我们待在屋里打牌。

rainbow.example: After the storm, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky above the hills.
rainbow.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，山丘上方的天空中出现了美丽的彩虹。

raise.example: They plan to raise money to build a new school for local children.
raise.exampleZh: 他们计划筹集资金为当地孩子建一所新学校。

rally.example: The team rallied after the break and won the game.
rally.exampleZh: 球队在中场休息后振作起来并赢得了比赛。

range.example: The shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables.
range.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

rank.example: He reached the rank of captain after ten years in the army.
rank.exampleZh: 他在军队服役十年后晋升到上尉军衔。

rapid.example: The city has seen rapid growth in the past ten years.
rapid.exampleZh: 这座城市在过去十年里经历了迅速的增长。

rare.example: It is rare to see snow in this warm city.
rare.exampleZh: 在这座温暖的城市里看到雪是很罕见的。

rarely.example: He rarely goes to the movies because he is always busy.
rarely.exampleZh: 他很少去看电影，因为他总是很忙。

rash.example: It was a rash decision, and soon a rash appeared on his arm.
rash.exampleZh: 那是个轻率的决定，很快他的手臂上就起了一片皮疹。

rat.example: The rat ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the old box.
rat.exampleZh: 那只老鼠跑过厨房地板，躲到了旧箱子下面。

rate.example: The rate of pay is higher for night work.
rate.exampleZh: 夜间工作的报酬比率更高。

rather.example: I would rather stay home tonight than go out in the rain.
rather.exampleZh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里，也不想冒雨出门。

ratio.example: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is three to two.
ratio.exampleZh: 我们班男生和女生的比例是三比二。

ration.example: During the war, each family got a small ration of bread every day.
ration.exampleZh: 战争期间，每个家庭每天只能分到一小份面包。

rational.example: She made a rational choice after thinking about all the facts.
rational.exampleZh: 在考虑了所有事实之后，她做出了一个理性的选择。

raw.example: She washed the raw vegetables before putting them into the hot soup.
raw.exampleZh: 她把生的蔬菜洗干净后才放进热汤里。

ray.example: A ray of sunlight came through the window and lit the room.
ray.exampleZh: 一束阳光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

reach.example: We can reach the small town by bus in two hours.
reach.exampleZh: 我们坐公交车两小时就能到达那个小镇。

react.example: How did she react when she heard the good news?
react.exampleZh: 她听到这个好消息时是怎么反应的？

reaction.example: My body had a strange reaction to the new medicine last night.
reaction.exampleZh: 昨晚我的身体对这种新药产生了奇怪的反应。

read.example: I like to read a book before I go to sleep.
read.exampleZh: 我喜欢在睡觉前读一本书。

reader.example: The reader wrote a short letter to the editor about the story.
reader.exampleZh: 这位读者就那篇报道给编辑写了一封简短的来信。

readily.example: She readily agreed to help us with the project.
readily.exampleZh: 她乐意地答应帮助我们做这个项目。

reading.example: Reading is a good habit that helps you learn new things every day.
reading.exampleZh: 阅读是一个好习惯，能帮助你每天学到新东西。

ready.example: Are you ready to go home now?
ready.exampleZh: 你现在准备好回家了吗？

real.example: Is this a real diamond or just a piece of glass?
real.exampleZh: 这是一颗真钻石，还是只是一块玻璃？

realism.example: Her realism about money helped the family avoid many unnecessary problems.
realism.exampleZh: 她对金钱的务实态度帮助家庭避免了许多不必要的问题。

realistic.example: We need a realistic plan that we can finish this year.
realistic.exampleZh: 我们需要一个今年能完成的现实计划。

reality.example: We must accept the reality of our situation and move forward.
reality.exampleZh: 我们必须接受现实的处境，然后继续前进。

realization.example: The realization that she was right came to him slowly.
realization.exampleZh: 他慢慢意识到她是对的。

realize.example: I did not realize how late it was until my mother called me.
realize.exampleZh: 直到妈妈给我打电话，我才意识到时间已经这么晚了。

really.example: This book is really good, and I want to read it again.
really.exampleZh: 这本书真的很好，我想再读一遍。

realm.example: In the realm of science, small discoveries can lead to great changes.
realm.exampleZh: 在科学领域，小小的发现也能带来巨大的变化。

reap.example: Farmers reap the rice in autumn and sell it at the market.
reap.exampleZh: 农民在秋天收割稻谷，然后拿到市场上卖。

rear.example: The children sat in the rear seats of the car while their parents drove home.
rear.exampleZh: 孩子们坐在汽车后排的座位上，父母开车回家。

reason.example: There is no reason to be afraid of the dark.
