reasonable.example: It is reasonable to ask for more time to finish the work.
reasonable.exampleZh: 要求更多时间来完成这项工作是合理的。

rebel.example: The young men decided to rebel against the unfair new rules.
rebel.exampleZh: 那些年轻人决定反抗不公平的新规定。

rebellion.example: The king sent soldiers to stop the rebellion in the north.
rebellion.exampleZh: 国王派士兵去阻止北方的叛乱。

recall.example: I cannot recall the name of the book you lent me.
recall.exampleZh: 我想不起来你借给我的那本书的名字了。

recede.example: The flood water began to recede after the heavy rain stopped.
recede.exampleZh: 大雨停后，洪水开始退去。

receipt.example: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the shirt.
receipt.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以备你需要退这件衬衫。

receive.example: I receive a letter from my best friend every month.
receive.exampleZh: 我每个月都会收到我最好的朋友寄来的一封信。

receiver.example: The receiver of the letter was very happy to read it.
receiver.exampleZh: 这封信的收信人读到它非常高兴。

recent.example: Recent studies show that simple exercise can improve our memory.
recent.exampleZh: 最近的研究表明，简单的运动能改善我们的记忆力。

recently.example: I have recently started learning to cook simple meals at home.
recently.exampleZh: 我最近开始学着在家做简单的饭菜。

reception.example: The hotel reception is on the first floor near the stairs.
reception.exampleZh: 酒店接待处在一楼，靠近楼梯。

recession.example: The country lost many jobs during the recession last year.
recession.exampleZh: 去年经济衰退期间，这个国家失去了许多工作岗位。

recipient.example: The recipient of the letter was very happy to read the good news.
recipient.exampleZh: 这封信的收件人读到这个好消息非常高兴。

reciprocal.example: The two countries signed a reciprocal agreement to share information and reduce trade barriers.
reciprocal.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项互惠协议，以共享信息并减少贸易壁垒。

recite.example: Every morning the students recite a short poem to their teacher.
recite.exampleZh: 每天早上学生们向老师背诵一首短诗。

reckless.example: It was reckless of him to drive so fast in the rain.
reckless.exampleZh: 他在雨中开那么快真是鲁莽。

reckon.example: I reckon it will rain later this afternoon.
reckon.exampleZh: 我估计今天下午晚些时候会下雨。

recognition.example: Her work finally received the recognition it deserved from the whole team.
recognition.exampleZh: 她的工作终于得到了整个团队的认可。

recognize.example: I did not recognize him at first because he looked very different.
recognize.exampleZh: 我一开始没认出他，因为他看起来判若两人。

recollect.example: I cannot recollect the name of that old film.
recollect.exampleZh: 我想不起那部老电影的名字了。

recommend.example: Can you recommend a good book for me to read?
recommend.exampleZh: 你能给我推荐一本值得读的好书吗？

recommendation.example: My teacher wrote a recommendation for me to help me get the job.
recommendation.exampleZh: 我的老师为我写了一封推荐信，帮我得到这份工作。

reconcile.example: She tried to reconcile the two friends after their argument.
reconcile.exampleZh: 她试图在争吵后让这两个朋友和解。

record.example: She keeps a record of all the books she reads.
record.exampleZh: 她记录下自己读过的每一本书。

recorder.example: She turned on the small recorder and began to sing a song.
recorder.exampleZh: 她打开那台小录音机，开始唱了一首歌。

recover.example: She is slowly recovering from a bad cold and hopes to return to work soon.
recover.exampleZh: 她正慢慢从重感冒中康复，希望能很快回去工作。

recovery.example: Her recovery after the surgery was slow but complete.
recovery.exampleZh: 她手术后的康复很慢，但已完全恢复。

recreation.example: Swimming is my favorite form of recreation on hot summer days.
recreation.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏天，游泳是我最喜欢的消遣方式。

recruit.example: The company wants to recruit new members for its weekend team.
recruit.exampleZh: 公司想为周末团队招募新成员。

rectangle.example: The teacher drew a long rectangle on the board and asked us to find its area.
rectangle.exampleZh: 老师在黑板上画了一个长方形，让我们求它的面积。

recur.example: The same problem may recur if we do not fix the root cause.
recur.exampleZh: 如果我们不解决根本原因，同样的问题可能会再次发生。

red.example: She wore a red dress and carried a small red bag.
red.exampleZh: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙，还带了一个红色的小包。

reduce.example: We must reduce the amount of waste we produce every day.
reduce.exampleZh: 我们必须减少每天产生的垃圾量。

reduction.example: The new plan led to a big reduction in waste at our school.
reduction.exampleZh: 这项新计划使我们学校的浪费大幅减少。

refer.example: Please refer to the dictionary when you see a new word.
refer.exampleZh: 看到新单词时，请查阅词典。

reference.example: My teacher wrote a reference for me to help with my job application.
reference.exampleZh: 老师为我写了一封推荐信，帮助我申请工作。

refine.example: We need to refine our plan before the meeting starts.
refine.exampleZh: 我们需要在会议开始前改进我们的计划。

reflect.example: The calm lake reflects the mountains and the sky like a mirror.
reflect.exampleZh: 平静的湖面像镜子一样倒映着群山和天空。

reflection.example: The calm lake showed a clear reflection of the mountains and the sky.
reflection.exampleZh: 平静的湖面映出群山与天空的清晰倒影。

reform.example: The new leader wants to reform the old tax system this year.
reform.exampleZh: 新领导人希望今年改革旧的税收制度。

refrain.example: Please refrain from smoking in this area.
refrain.exampleZh: 请避免在这个区域内吸烟。

refresh.example: A cold drink will refresh you after a long walk.
refresh.exampleZh: 走了很远的路之后，喝一杯冷饮会让你感到清爽。

refuge.example: The old church became a refuge for families during the storm.
refuge.exampleZh: 暴风雨中，那座古老的教堂成了家庭的避难所。

refugee.example: The refugee family arrived in a new country and needed food and shelter.
refugee.exampleZh: 这个难民家庭抵达了一个新国家，需要食物和住所。

refund.example: The shop will refund your money if the shoes do not fit.
refund.exampleZh: 如果鞋子不合脚，商店会退款给你。

refusal.example: Her refusal to answer made everyone in the room feel uneasy.
refusal.exampleZh: 她拒绝回答，这让房间里的每个人都感到不安。

refuse.example: She refused to eat the old food and threw it away.
refuse.exampleZh: 她拒绝吃那些旧食物，把它扔掉了。

regard.example: I regard her as a good friend and often ask for her advice.
regard.exampleZh: 我把她看作好朋友，经常向她请教。

regarding.example: I have a question regarding the new class schedule.
regarding.exampleZh: 我有一个关于新课程安排的问题。

regardless.example: Regardless of the weather, we will go to the park tomorrow.
regardless.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，我们明天都会去公园。

region.example: This region is famous for its tea and beautiful mountains.
region.exampleZh: 这个地区以茶叶和美丽的山而闻名。

regional.example: This regional food is very popular in the south of China.
regional.exampleZh: 这种地方特色食物在中国南方很受欢迎。

register.example: Please register your name at the front desk before you enter.
register.exampleZh: 请在进入前到前台登记你的姓名。

regret.example: I regret not saying goodbye to her before she left.
regret.exampleZh: 我后悔在她离开前没有和她说再见。

regular.example: She has a regular meeting with her teacher every Friday afternoon.
regular.exampleZh: 她每周五下午和老师有一次定期的会面。

regulate.example: The government made new rules to regulate how factories use water.
regulate.exampleZh: 政府制定了新规定来管理工厂的用水方式。

regulation.example: The new regulation requires all drivers to wear seat belts.
regulation.exampleZh: 新规章要求所有司机系安全带。

rehearsal.example: The band had a long rehearsal before the big show.
rehearsal.exampleZh: 乐队在大型演出前进行了长时间的排练。

rehearse.example: The students will rehearse the play in the school hall tomorrow afternoon.
rehearse.exampleZh: 学生们明天下午将在学校礼堂排练这出戏。

reign.example: The queen's reign lasted for many years and brought peace.
reign.exampleZh: 这位女王的统治持续了很多年，带来了和平。

reinforce.example: The teacher used games to reinforce the new words we learned today.
reinforce.exampleZh: 老师用游戏来巩固我们今天学的新单词。

reject.example: The company rejected his idea because it was too expensive and hard to test.
reject.exampleZh: 公司否决了他的想法，因为它太贵且难以测试。

rejection.example: Her rejection of the offer surprised everyone in the room.
rejection.exampleZh: 她对这份提议的拒绝让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

relate.example: I can relate this story to my own life.
relate.exampleZh: 我能把这个故事和我自己的生活联系起来。

relation.example: There is a close relation between diet and health.
relation.exampleZh: 饮食与健康之间有密切的关系。

relationship.example: A good relationship between teachers and students makes learning easier.
relationship.exampleZh: 良好的师生关系让学习变得更轻松。

relative.example: My relatives are coming to visit us this weekend.
relative.exampleZh: 我的亲戚这个周末要来看望我们。

relatively.example: This book is relatively easy, so most students can read it quickly.
relatively.exampleZh: 这本书相对容易，所以大多数学生都能很快读完。

relax.example: You should relax and take a short break after a long day at work.
relax.exampleZh: 工作了一整天之后，你应该放松一下，短暂休息一会儿。

release.example: The band will release their new album next Friday.
release.exampleZh: 这支乐队下周五将发行他们的新专辑。

relevant.example: Please give me all the relevant facts about this problem.
relevant.exampleZh: 请给我关于这个问题的所有相关事实。

reliance.example: Our reliance on the old computer system often causes long delays at work.
reliance.exampleZh: 我们对旧电脑系统的依赖常常导致工作中出现长时间的延误。

relief.example: It was a great relief to hear that she was safe.
relief.exampleZh: 听说她平安无事，我大大松了一口气。

relieve.example: A warm bath can relieve the pain in your back after a long day.
relieve.exampleZh: 漫长一天之后，洗个热水澡能缓解你背部的疼痛。

religion.example: Many people around the world follow a religion that guides how they live.
religion.exampleZh: 世界上许多人信奉一种指导他们如何生活的宗教。

religious.example: Her family is very religious and goes to church every Sunday morning.
religious.exampleZh: 她的家人非常虔诚，每个星期天早上都去教堂。

relish.example: She did not relish the idea of working late again, but she stayed.
relish.exampleZh: 她并不喜欢又要加班的想法，但还是留了下来。

reluctant.example: She was reluctant to speak in front of the whole class.
reluctant.exampleZh: 她不情愿在全班同学面前发言。

rely.example: Many small children rely on their parents for help every day.
rely.exampleZh: 许多小孩每天依靠父母帮忙。

remain.example: She remained calm and stayed in the room until help arrived.
remain.exampleZh: 她保持冷静，留在房间里直到救援到来。

remainder.example: Please eat the remainder of the rice in the bowl.
remainder.exampleZh: 请把碗里剩下的米饭吃完。

remains.example: The remains of the old castle still stand on the hill.
remains.exampleZh: 那座古老城堡的遗迹仍然矗立在山丘上。

remark.example: She made a kind remark about my new job.
remark.exampleZh: 她对我的新工作说了句好话。

remarkable.example: Her progress in English this year has been remarkable.
remarkable.exampleZh: 她今年在英语上的进步非常显著。

remedy.example: There is no easy remedy for this problem, but we can try.
remedy.exampleZh: 这个问题没有简单的补救办法，但我们可以试试。

remember.example: Please remember to close the window before you leave the office.
remember.exampleZh: 请记得在离开办公室前关上窗户。

remind.example: Please remind me to call my mother tonight after dinner.
remind.exampleZh: 请提醒我今晚晚饭后给我妈妈打电话。

remnant.example: Only a small remnant of the old wall is still standing.
remnant.exampleZh: 旧墙现在只剩下一个小残余。

remote.example: He lives in a remote village far from the city.
remote.exampleZh: 他住在一个远离城市的偏僻村庄里。

removal.example: The removal of the old tree made the street much brighter.
removal.exampleZh: 移走那棵老树后，街道变得明亮多了。

remove.example: Please remove your shoes before you walk into the house.

render.example: The judge will render a decision after reading all the reports.
render.exampleZh: 法官将在阅读所有报告后作出裁决。

renew.example: I need to renew my library books before they are due next week.
renew.exampleZh: 我需要在下周到期之前续借我的图书馆书籍。

rent.example: We rent a small house near the river, and the rent is not high.
rent.exampleZh: 我们在河边租了一间小房子，租金不高。

repair.example: My father can repair the old bike in about an hour.
repair.exampleZh: 我父亲大约一小时就能修好那辆旧自行车。

repay.example: I will repay the money to my friend next week.
repay.exampleZh: 我下周会把钱还给我的朋友。

repeal.example: The government decided to repeal the old tax law last year.
repeal.exampleZh: 政府去年决定废除那项旧的税收法律。

repeat.example: Please repeat the question slowly so everyone in the room can hear it.
repeat.exampleZh: 请慢慢重复一遍这个问题，好让房间里的每个人都能听见。

repeatedly.example: She repeatedly asked the teacher to explain the difficult question again.
repeatedly.exampleZh: 她反复地请老师再解释一遍那道难题。

repel.example: The strong smell of the spray can repel mosquitoes from the room.
repel.exampleZh: 喷雾的强烈气味能把蚊子从房间里赶走。

repetition.example: Learning a language requires repetition, so practice the same words every day.
repetition.exampleZh: 学习一门语言需要重复，所以每天练习同样的单词。

replace.example: Please replace the old battery with a new one today.
replace.exampleZh: 请今天把旧电池换成一个新的。

replacement.example: This old chair is a replacement for the one we lost.
replacement.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子是我们丢失的那把的替代品。

reply.example: Please reply to my email before you leave the office today.
reply.exampleZh: 请在今天离开办公室之前回复我的邮件。

report.example: She will report the news to her teacher tomorrow morning.
report.exampleZh: 她明天早上会把这条消息报告给她的老师。

reporter.example: The reporter asked the teacher several questions after the school meeting.
reporter.exampleZh: 记者在学校会议后问了老师几个问题。

represent.example: The five stars on the flag represent the unity of the people.
represent.exampleZh: 旗帜上的五颗星代表人民的团结。

representation.example: This painting is a good representation of life in the countryside.
representation.exampleZh: 这幅画很好地表现了乡村生活。

representative.example: She is a representative from our school and speaks for all the students.
representative.exampleZh: 她是我们学校的代表，为所有学生发声。

repression.example: The government's repression of peaceful protests made many citizens angry and afraid.
repression.exampleZh: 政府对和平抗议的镇压让许多公民感到愤怒和恐惧。

reproach.example: She reproached him for forgetting their anniversary again.
reproach.exampleZh: 她责备他又一次忘记了他们的纪念日。

reproduce.example: Many small fish reproduce quickly in warm water during the summer months.
reproduce.exampleZh: 许多小鱼在夏季温暖的water中迅速繁殖。

republic.example: The country became a republic after the people voted for a new government.
republic.exampleZh: 人民投票选出新政府后，这个国家成为了共和国。

republican.example: He is a republican who believes the people should choose their leaders.
republican.exampleZh: 他是一名共和党人，认为人民应该选择自己的领导人。

reputable.example: She is a reputable doctor who is trusted by many people.
reputable.exampleZh: 她是一位声誉好的医生，受到许多人的信任。

reputation.example: This small school has a very good reputation in our town.
reputation.exampleZh: 这所小学校在我们镇上名声很好。

request.example: She made a polite request for more time to finish the work.
request.exampleZh: 她礼貌地请求多给一些时间来完成这项工作。

require.example: Most jobs require good communication skills.
require.exampleZh: 大多数工作都需要良好的沟通能力。

requirement.example: A good job has clear requirements and fair pay.
requirement.exampleZh: 一份好工作有明确的要求和公平的报酬。

rescue.example: The firemen worked all night to rescue the family from the burning house.
rescue.exampleZh: 消防员整夜工作，从燃烧的房子里营救出这家人。

research.example: She does research on how children learn new words at school.
research.exampleZh: 她研究儿童在学校里如何学习新单词。

researcher.example: The researcher found a new way to study the old books.
researcher.exampleZh: 这位研究员找到了一种研究这些古书的新方法。

resemble.example: The little boy really resembles his father when he smiles.
resemble.exampleZh: 这个小男孩微笑时真的很像他父亲。

resent.example: She still resents him for leaving without saying goodbye.
resent.exampleZh: 她仍然怨恨他不告而别。

reservation.example: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant tonight.
reservation.exampleZh: 我预订了今晚餐厅两个人的位子。

reserve.example: We reserve a table for two at the restaurant every Friday evening.
reserve.exampleZh: 我们每周五晚上都在这家餐厅预订一张两人桌。

reside.example: Many older people reside in small villages near the river.
reside.exampleZh: 许多老年人居住在河边的小村庄里。

residence.example: Their new residence is a small house near the river.
residence.exampleZh: 他们的新住宅是河边的一栋小房子。

resident.example: The new resident is a young doctor at our local hospital.
resident.exampleZh: 新来的住院医生是我们当地医院的一位年轻医生。

residual.example: There is still some residual water left in the bottom of the old bottle.
residual.exampleZh: 那个旧瓶子底部还残留着一些水。

resign.example: He decided to resign from his job and look for a new one.
resign.exampleZh: 他决定辞去工作，去寻找一份新工作。

resist.example: She could not resist the sweet smell of fresh bread.
resist.exampleZh: 她抵挡不住新鲜面包的香甜气味。

resistance.example: The body has a natural resistance to many common infections.
resistance.exampleZh: 人体对许多常见感染具有天然的抵抗力。

resistant.example: This kind of plant is resistant to cold weather.
resistant.exampleZh: 这种植物对寒冷天气有抵抗力。

resolute.example: She was resolute about finishing the race even in the rain.
resolute.exampleZh: 即使下着雨，她也坚决要跑完这场比赛。

resolution.example: She made a resolution to study English every day this year.
resolution.exampleZh: 她下定决心今年每天都要学英语。

resolve.example: She made a firm resolve to solve the problem before Friday.
resolve.exampleZh: 她下定决心在周五之前解决这个问题。

resort.example: Many people resort to the internet when they need quick answers.
resort.exampleZh: 很多人在需要快速答案时会求助于互联网。

resource.example: We must use our limited natural resources wisely and share them with others.
resource.exampleZh: 我们必须明智地使用有限的自然资源，并与他人分享。

resourceful.example: Our teacher is very resourceful and always finds a simple way to explain hard ideas.
resourceful.exampleZh: 我们的老师非常足智多谋，总能找到简单的方法来解释难懂的概念。

respect.example: I respect my teacher because she is kind and patient with us.
respect.exampleZh: 我尊敬我的老师，因为她对我们既亲切又有耐心。

respectable.example: He is a respectable man who always helps his neighbors.
respectable.exampleZh: 他是一个总是帮助邻居的可敬的人。

respectful.example: Please be respectful to your teachers and classmates at school every day.
respectful.exampleZh: 请每天在学校里对老师和同学保持恭敬有礼。

respective.example: The two students went back to their respective classrooms after lunch.
respective.exampleZh: 午饭后，两名学生回到了各自的教室。

respond.example: She did not respond to my email, so I called her.
respond.exampleZh: 她没有回复我的邮件，所以我给她打了电话。

response.example: Her quick response to my question made everyone in the room smile.
response.exampleZh: 她对我问题的快速回答让房间里的每个人都笑了。

responsibility.example: It is my responsibility to take care of my younger brother.

responsible.example: Parents are responsible for their children's safety at home.
responsible.exampleZh: 父母要负责孩子在家里的安全。

rest.example: After a long walk, we sat down to rest under a big tree.
rest.exampleZh: 走了很长的路后，我们坐在一棵大树下休息。

restaurant.example: We had dinner at a small restaurant near the river.
restaurant.exampleZh: 我们在河边的一家小餐馆吃了晚饭。

restless.example: He felt restless all night and could not sleep at all.
restless.exampleZh: 他整夜焦躁不安，一点也睡不着。

restore.example: The workers will restore the old building to its former beauty.
restore.exampleZh: 工人们将把这座旧建筑恢复到昔日的美丽。

restrain.example: She tried hard to restrain her anger during the meeting.
restrain.exampleZh: 她努力在会议期间抑制自己的怒火。

restraint.example: He showed great restraint and did not shout at them.
restraint.exampleZh: 他表现出极大的克制，没有对他们大喊大叫。

restrict.example: The school restricts phone use during class to help students focus.
restrict.exampleZh: 学校限制上课时使用手机，以帮助学生集中注意力。

restriction.example: The new rules put strict restrictions on how much water we can use.
restriction.exampleZh: 新规定对我们能用多少水作出了严格的限制。

result.example: The result of the test made everyone very happy.
result.exampleZh: 这次考试的成绩让每个人都很高兴。

resume.example: She will resume her studies next week after a long break.
resume.exampleZh: 休息了很长时间之后，她下周将恢复学业。

retail.example: The store sells clothes at retail and also online.
retail.exampleZh: 这家店既做零售也做线上销售。

retain.example: I still retain happy memories of my first day at school.
retain.exampleZh: 我仍然记得上学第一天的快乐时光。

retention.example: The retention of water in the soil helps plants grow in dry weather.
retention.exampleZh: 土壤中对水分的保留有助于植物在干旱天气中生长。

retire.example: My father will retire from his job next year and stay home.
retire.exampleZh: 我父亲明年将退休，然后待在家里。

retirement.example: My father is looking forward to his retirement next year.
retirement.exampleZh: 我父亲正期待着明年退休。

retort.example: She retorted that she had never seen the file before.
retort.exampleZh: 她反驳说她以前从未见过那份文件。

retreat.example: The soldiers had to retreat when the enemy attacked at night.
retreat.exampleZh: 敌人夜间进攻时，士兵们不得不撤退。

retrospect.example: In retrospect, I should have studied harder for the exam.
retrospect.exampleZh: 回顾起来，我本应更努力地为考试学习。

return.example: Please return the book to the library before Friday.
return.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把书还给图书馆。

reunite.example: The family will reunite at the old house this summer.
reunite.exampleZh: 这家人今年夏天将在那栋老房子里重聚。

reveal.example: The new test can reveal small problems early.
reveal.exampleZh: 这项新测试能及早揭示一些小问题。

revelation.example: The discovery of the letter was a revelation to the whole family.
revelation.exampleZh: 这封信的发现对全家人来说是一个新发现。

revenge.example: He wanted revenge on the man who had hurt his family.
revenge.exampleZh: 他想报复那个伤害他家人的人。

revenue.example: The company's revenue grew quickly last year because more people bought its products.
revenue.exampleZh: 去年公司的收入快速增长，因为更多人购买了它的产品。

reverse.example: The new evidence may reverse the judge's earlier decision.
reverse.exampleZh: 新证据可能会逆转法官先前的判决。

review.example: I need to review my notes before the test tomorrow morning.
review.exampleZh: 我需要在明天早上考试前复习我的笔记。

revise.example: I need to revise my essay before I give it to the teacher.
revise.exampleZh: 我需要先把文章修改一下，再交给老师。

revive.example: The city hopes to revive its old market with new shops.
revive.exampleZh: 这座城市希望通过新商店让旧市场重新活跃起来。

revolt.example: The poor workers revolted against the cruel king and his unfair taxes.
revolt.exampleZh: 贫穷的工人们反抗残暴的国王和他不公平的税收。

revolution.example: The internet caused a revolution in how people learn and share ideas.
revolution.exampleZh: 互联网引发了一场人们学习和分享思想方式的革命。

revolutionary.example: The revolutionary idea changed the way people think about work.
revolutionary.exampleZh: 这个革命性的想法改变了人们对工作的看法。

revolve.example: The earth and the moon revolve around the sun together.
revolve.exampleZh: 地球和月亮一起围绕太阳公转。

reward.example: She got a small reward for helping the old man find his way home.
reward.exampleZh: 她因为帮助那位老人找到回家的路而得到了一点小小的报酬。

rhythm.example: The drummers kept a steady rhythm during the whole song.
rhythm.exampleZh: 鼓手们在整首歌中保持着稳定的节奏。

rib.example: He fell off his bike and broke a rib in his chest.
rib.exampleZh: 他从自行车上摔了下来，摔断了胸部的一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: She tied a red ribbon around the small gift box.
ribbon.exampleZh: 她在小礼盒上系了一条红丝带。

rid.example: She wants to rid her room of old toys.
rid.exampleZh: 她想把房间里的旧玩具清除掉。

ride.example: I ride my bike to school every morning with my sister.
ride.exampleZh: 我每天早上和妹妹一起骑自行车去学校。

ridge.example: We walked along the narrow ridge and looked down at the valley below.
ridge.exampleZh: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行走，俯瞰下面的山谷。

ridiculous.example: It is ridiculous to wear a coat in such hot weather.
ridiculous.exampleZh: 这么热的天气穿外套真是可笑。

rifle.example: The soldier cleaned his rifle carefully before the long march began.
rifle.exampleZh: 士兵在长途行军开始前仔细地擦了他的步枪。

right.example: You are right, and you have the right to say no.
right.exampleZh: 你是对的，而且你有权利说不。

rigid.example: He is very rigid about the rules and never changes his mind.
rigid.exampleZh: 他对规则非常严格，从不改变主意。

rigorous.example: The teacher is rigorous about our homework and checks every answer carefully.
rigorous.exampleZh: 老师对我们的作业要求很严格，会仔细检查每一个答案。

ring.example: She bought a gold ring and called her mother at once.
ring.exampleZh: 她买了一枚金戒指，然后马上给母亲打了电话。

riot.example: The city was quiet again after the riot ended last night.
riot.exampleZh: 昨晚暴乱结束后，城市又恢复了平静。

rip.example: The strong wind rips the old flag into pieces.
rip.exampleZh: 大风把旧旗子撕成了碎片。

ripe.example: The apples on the tree are ripe and ready to eat.
ripe.exampleZh: 树上的苹果已经成熟，可以吃了。

rise.example: The sun will rise in the east at six tomorrow morning.
rise.exampleZh: 明天早上六点太阳将从东方升起。

risk.example: You should think about the risk before you invest all your money.
risk.exampleZh: 在投入你所有的钱之前，你应该考虑一下风险。

ritual.example: Every morning she follows the same small ritual before starting work.
ritual.exampleZh: 每天早上她开始工作前都会遵循同样的小仪式。

rival.example: The two rival teams will play again next week.
rival.exampleZh: 这两支竞争的队伍下周将再次比赛。

river.example: The river runs slowly through the small town where I grew up.
river.exampleZh: 这条河缓缓流过我长大的那个小镇。

road.example: The road to the village is narrow but very safe.
road.exampleZh: 通往村庄的路很窄，但非常安全。

roam.example: We like to roam around the old town on quiet Sunday afternoons.
roam.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在安静的周日下午到老城区里闲逛。

roar.example: The old car roared loudly as it climbed the steep hill.
roar.exampleZh: 那辆旧车爬上陡峭的山坡时发出很大的轰鸣声。

roast.example: My mother likes to roast chicken with potatoes on Sunday.
roast.exampleZh: 我妈妈喜欢在星期天烤鸡肉配土豆。

rob.example: Two men tried to rob the small bank on Main Street yesterday.
rob.exampleZh: 昨天两名男子试图抢劫主街上的那家小银行。

robot.example: The robot can clean the floor and help us cook dinner.
robot.exampleZh: 这个机器人能擦地板，还能帮我们做晚饭。

robust.example: This old chair is still robust after many years of daily use.
robust.exampleZh: 这把旧椅子经过多年日常使用仍然很坚固。

rock.example: The children like to rock the boat and sing loud rock songs.
rock.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢摇晃小船，还大声唱摇滚歌曲。

rocket.example: The rocket flew into space, and ticket prices rocketed last year.
rocket.exampleZh: 火箭飞入太空，去年票价也猛涨了。

rod.example: He used a long wooden rod to reach the ball under the bed.
rod.exampleZh: 他用一根长木杆够到了床底下的球。

role.example: She plays an important role in the school play.
role.exampleZh: 她在学校的话剧中扮演一个重要的角色。

roll.example: The ball began to roll slowly down the hill toward the river.
roll.exampleZh: 球开始慢慢滚下山坡，朝河边滚去。

romance.example: Their romance began at a small coffee shop near the river.
romance.exampleZh: 他们的爱情故事始于河边一家小咖啡店。

romantic.example: She has a romantic idea about life and always hopes for the best.
romantic.exampleZh: 她对生活有一种浪漫的想法，总是抱着最好的希望。

roof.example: The cat sat on the roof and watched the birds fly by.
roof.exampleZh: 猫坐在屋顶上，看着鸟儿飞过。

room.example: There is enough room in this car for five people.
room.exampleZh: 这辆车里有足够的空间坐五个人。

root.example: The root of the tall tree grows deep into the soil.
root.exampleZh: 这棵大树的根深深扎进土壤里。

rope.example: He tied the boat to the dock with a long, strong rope.
rope.exampleZh: 他用一根又长又结实的绳子把船拴在码头上。

rose.example: She gave me a red rose on my birthday.
rose.exampleZh: 她在我生日那天送给我一朵红玫瑰。

rotate.example: Warm air rises and makes the small fan rotate near the window.
rotate.exampleZh: 暖空气上升，使窗边的小风扇转动起来。

rotten.example: The rotten apples smell bad, so we must throw them away.
rotten.exampleZh: 那些腐烂的苹果闻起来很糟，所以我们必须把它们扔掉。

rough.example: The table has a rough surface, so please be careful with your hands.
rough.exampleZh: 这张桌子的表面很粗糙，所以请小心你的手。

round.example: The children sat round the round table and shared a big cake.
round.exampleZh: 孩子们围坐在圆桌旁，一起分享一个大蛋糕。

rouse.example: The loud noise outside the window roused him from a deep sleep.
rouse.exampleZh: 窗外的巨响把他从深睡中唤醒。

route.example: The driver chose a new route to avoid the busy city roads.
route.exampleZh: 司机选择了一条新路线，以避开繁忙的城市道路。

routine.example: My morning routine helps me start the day in a good mood.
routine.exampleZh: 我的早晨惯例帮助我以好心情开始一天。

row.example: We sat in the front row and watched the boats row slowly across the lake.
row.exampleZh: 我们坐在前排，看着船只慢慢划过湖面。

royal.example: The royal family lives in a large palace in the city.
royal.exampleZh: 王室一家住在城里一座很大的宫殿里。

rub.example: She rubbed her cold hands together to make them warm.
rub.exampleZh: 她搓着冰冷的双手让它们暖和起来。

rubber.example: This ball is made of rubber and it bounces very well.
rubber.exampleZh: 这个球是橡胶做的，它弹得很好。

rubbish.example: Please put your rubbish in the bin before you leave the room.
rubbish.exampleZh: 离开房间前，请把你的垃圾放进垃圾桶。

rude.example: It is rude to talk loudly on the phone in a quiet place.
rude.exampleZh: 在安静的场所大声打电话是粗鲁的。

rug.example: She put a soft rug in front of the fireplace.
rug.exampleZh: 她在壁炉前铺了一块柔软的小地毯。

ruin.example: The heavy rain ruined our picnic and we had to go home early.
ruin.exampleZh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐，我们只好早早回家。

rule.example: The school has a rule that students must arrive on time.
rule.exampleZh: 学校有一条规定，学生必须准时到校。

ruler.example: The ruler of the small country lives in a big old house.
ruler.exampleZh: 这个小国的统治者住在一栋又大又旧的房子里。

run.example: I run in the park every morning before work.
run.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前去公园跑步。

rural.example: Many young people from rural areas move to big cities for work.
rural.exampleZh: 许多来自农村地区的年轻人搬到大城市工作。

rush.example: Every morning I rush to catch the busy train before it leaves.
rush.exampleZh: 每天早上我都匆忙赶在繁忙的火车开走前上车。

rust.example: The old car was covered with rust after years in the rain.
rust.exampleZh: 那辆旧车在雨中放了多年，表面布满了锈。

sabotage.example: The workers were arrested for sabotage after they damaged the factory machines.
sabotage.exampleZh: 工人们破坏工厂机器后因蓄意破坏而被逮捕。

sack.example: They filled one sack with rice and another with fresh apples.
sack.exampleZh: 他们用一个麻袋装大米，用另一个装新鲜苹果。

sacred.example: This mountain is a sacred place for the local people.
sacred.exampleZh: 这座山对当地人来说是一个神圣的地方。

sacrifice.example: Her parents made many sacrifices so she could go to a good school.
sacrifice.exampleZh: 她的父母做出了许多牺牲，好让她能上一所好学校。

sad.example: The sad movie made my little sister cry for a long time.
sad.exampleZh: 那部悲伤的电影让我的小妹妹哭了好久。

saddle.example: He put the saddle on the horse and rode to town.
saddle.exampleZh: 他把马鞍放在马上，然后骑马进城。

safe.example: Please keep your money in a safe place at home.
safe.exampleZh: 请把钱放在家里安全的地方。

safeguard.example: We must safeguard our personal data when we shop online.
safeguard.exampleZh: 我们在网上购物时必须保护好自己的个人数据。

safety.example: Please wear a helmet for your safety when you ride a bike.
safety.exampleZh: 骑自行车时为了你的安全请戴上头盔。

sail.example: We sail across the lake every summer with our small boat.
sail.exampleZh: 每年夏天我们都乘小船横渡这个湖。

sailor.example: The sailor works hard on a big ship every day.
sailor.exampleZh: 这名水手每天在一艘大船上辛勤工作。

saint.example: My grandmother was a saint who helped everyone in our small town.
saint.exampleZh: 我的祖母是一位圣人，她帮助过我们小镇上的每一个人。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, you should stop smoking now.
sake.exampleZh: 为了你的健康，你现在应该戒烟。

salad.example: I make a fresh salad with tomatoes and green vegetables for lunch.
salad.exampleZh: 我午餐用西红柿和绿色蔬菜做了一份新鲜沙拉。

salary.example: She saves part of her salary every month for a new car.
salary.exampleZh: 她每个月把一部分薪水存起来，用来买一辆新车。

sale.example: The store is having a sale on all winter clothes this week.
sale.exampleZh: 这家店这周所有冬装都在打折促销。

salesman.example: The salesman showed us a new phone and explained how it works.
salesman.exampleZh: 那位售货员给我们展示了一部新手机，并解释了它的用法。

salt.example: Please add a little salt to the soup before you serve it.
salt.exampleZh: 上汤之前请往汤里加一点盐。

salute.example: The soldiers salute the flag every morning before they start their training.
salute.exampleZh: 士兵们每天早上开始训练前都会向国旗敬礼。

salvation.example: The doctor's quick work was their only salvation that night.
salvation.exampleZh: 那天晚上，医生的快速救治是他们唯一的救星。

same.example: We are in the same class and we sit together every day.
same.exampleZh: 我们在同一个班，每天坐在一起。

sample.example: The doctor took a small sample of blood for testing.
sample.exampleZh: 医生抽取了一小份血液样本用于检验。

sanction.example: The government decided to sanction the new trade deal after a long debate.
sanction.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，政府决定批准这项新的贸易协议。

sand.example: The children played in the warm sand by the sea.
sand.exampleZh: 孩子们在海边温暖的沙子里玩耍。

sandwich.example: I eat a sandwich with cheese and tomato at school every day.
sandwich.exampleZh: 我每天在学校吃一个夹着奶酪和西红柿的三明治。

sarcastic.example: His sarcastic comment made everyone at the table feel uncomfortable.
sarcastic.exampleZh: 他讽刺的评论让在座的每个人都感到不舒服。

satellite.example: The satellite moves around the Earth and sends pictures back to us.
satellite.exampleZh: 这颗卫星绕着地球运行，并把图片传送回给我们。

satire.example: The writer used satire to criticize the problems in his city.
satire.exampleZh: 这位作家用讽刺来批评他所在城市的问题。

satisfaction.example: Her smile showed clear satisfaction with the simple meal.
satisfaction.exampleZh: 她的微笑表明她对这顿简单的饭菜很满意。

satisfy.example: Our new plan should satisfy most of the customers.
satisfy.exampleZh: 我们的新方案应该能让大多数顾客满意。

saturate.example: Heavy rain will saturate the dry soil and fill the small ponds.
saturate.exampleZh: 大雨会使干燥的土壤饱和，并让小池塘积满水。

saturday.example: We often go to the park together on Saturday morning with our dog.
saturday.exampleZh: 我们经常在星期六早上带我们的狗一起去公园。

sauce.example: She likes a little sweet sauce on her rice.
sauce.exampleZh: 她喜欢在米饭上放一点甜酱。

sausage.example: My father cooks sausage and eggs for breakfast every Sunday morning.
sausage.exampleZh: 我爸爸每个星期天早上都做香肠和鸡蛋当早餐。

savage.example: The savage dog barked loudly at every stranger who walked past the gate.
savage.exampleZh: 那只凶猛的狗对每个走过大门的陌生人大声吠叫。

save.example: He works hard to save money for a new bike.
save.exampleZh: 他努力工作攒钱买一辆新自行车。

saving.example: Regular saving helped her buy a small house last year.
saving.exampleZh: 定期储蓄帮助她去年买了一套小房子。

say.example: People say she is a good teacher, but she has little say in the school.
say.exampleZh: 人们说她是个好老师，但她在学校里没什么发言权。

scaffold.example: The workers set up a scaffold around the old building.
scaffold.exampleZh: 工人们在旧楼周围搭起了脚手架。

scald.example: Be careful with the hot soup or you will scald your hand.
scald.exampleZh: 小心那锅热汤，否则你会烫伤自己的手。

scale.example: The scale of the problem was much bigger than we expected.
scale.exampleZh: 这个问题的规模比我们预想的要大得多。

scalp.example: The brave warrior took the scalp of his enemy after the long fight.
scalp.exampleZh: 那场漫长的战斗之后，勇敢的战士取下了敌人的头皮。

scan.example: I scan the page quickly to find the main idea.
scan.exampleZh: 我快速浏览这一页，找出主要意思。

scandal.example: The news about the money scandal spread quickly through the whole town.
scandal.exampleZh: 关于那起金钱丑闻的消息迅速传遍了整个小镇。

scant.example: There is only scant evidence to support his claim.
scant.exampleZh: 支持他这一说法的证据不足。

scar.example: The deep scar on his arm reminds him of the accident.
scar.exampleZh: 他手臂上那道深深的伤疤让他想起那场事故。

scarce.example: Clean water is scarce in many dry parts of the world.
scarce.exampleZh: 在世界许多干旱地区，干净的水是缺乏的。

scarcely.example: I had scarcely sat down when the phone rang.

scare.example: The loud noise did not scare the little boy at all.
scare.exampleZh: 那声巨响一点也没有吓到那个小男孩。

scarf.example: She wore a red scarf around her neck because the weather was cold.
scarf.exampleZh: 因为天气很冷，她在脖子上围了一条红色的围巾。

scatter.example: The wind will scatter the dry leaves all over the yard.
scatter.exampleZh: 风会把干枯的叶子吹散到院子各处。

scenario.example: We must prepare for every possible scenario before the trip.
scenario.exampleZh: 我们必须为旅行前每一种可能的情景做好准备。

scene.example: The police arrived at the scene of the accident very quickly.
scene.exampleZh: 警察很快就到达了事故现场。

scenery.example: The mountain scenery is very beautiful in autumn every year.
scenery.exampleZh: 每年秋天，山间的风景都非常美。

scent.example: The sweet scent of flowers filled the whole room after the rain.
scent.exampleZh: 雨后，花的甜香充满了整个房间。

schedule.example: I will check my schedule and call you this afternoon.
schedule.exampleZh: 我会查看一下我的日程安排，今天下午给你打电话。

scheme.example: The police found a secret scheme to steal money from the bank.
scheme.exampleZh: 警方发现了一个从银行偷钱的秘密阴谋。

scholar.example: The young scholar reads many books in the library every day.
scholar.exampleZh: 这位年轻学者每天在图书馆读很多书。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study music at a good university.
scholarship.exampleZh: 她获得了一笔奖学金，去一所好大学学习音乐。

school.example: My school is near the park, and I walk there every morning.
school.exampleZh: 我的学校在公园附近，我每天早上步行去那里。

science.example: My brother wants to study computer science at a big university next year.
science.exampleZh: 我哥哥想明年去一所大型大学学习计算机科学。

scientific.example: We need a scientific way to test this idea.
scientific.exampleZh: 我们需要一种科学的方法来检验这个想法。

scientist.example: The scientist studies plants and animals in the forest near her home.
scientist.exampleZh: 这位科学家研究她家附近森林里的动植物。

scissors.example: I use scissors to cut paper.

scold.example: My mother scolded me for coming home late last night.
scold.exampleZh: 我妈妈因为昨晚回家晚而责骂了我。

scoop.example: The reporter got a big scoop about the new factory.
scoop.exampleZh: 那名记者得到了关于新工厂的一条重大独家新闻。

scope.example: The scope of this project is too large for our small team.
scope.exampleZh: 这个项目的范围对我们这个小团队来说太大了。

score.example: She got a high score on her math test last week.
score.exampleZh: 她上周数学考试得了高分。

scorn.example: He looked at the old plan with scorn and refused to try it.
scorn.exampleZh: 他轻蔑地看着那个旧计划，拒绝去尝试。

scornful.example: She gave a scornful laugh at his simple question.
scornful.exampleZh: 她对他那个简单的问题轻蔑地笑了一声。

scout.example: The scout ran ahead to see if the road was safe.
scout.exampleZh: 侦察员跑在前面，去看那条路是否安全。

scrap.example: He wrote the phone number on a scrap of paper.
scrap.exampleZh: 他把电话号码写在一小片纸上。

scrape.example: He had to scrape the ice off his car before driving to work.
scrape.exampleZh: 他开车上班前不得不把车上的冰刮掉。

scratch.example: The cat likes to scratch the old sofa with its sharp claws.
scratch.exampleZh: 那只猫喜欢用锋利的爪子抓那张旧沙发。

scream.example: She screamed when she saw a mouse in the kitchen.
scream.exampleZh: 她在厨房里看到一只老鼠时尖叫了起来。

screen.example: My phone screen is broken, so I cannot read any messages now.
screen.exampleZh: 我的手机屏幕坏了，所以我现在看不了任何消息。

screw.example: Please screw the lid tightly on the jar before you put it away.
screw.exampleZh: 请把罐子的盖子拧紧后再收起来。

script.example: The actor read the script carefully before the first day of filming.
script.exampleZh: 演员在开拍第一天之前仔细阅读了剧本。

scrutiny.example: The plan is under close scrutiny by the local government.
scrutiny.exampleZh: 该计划正受到当地政府的严密审查。

sculpture.example: The museum has a beautiful sculpture of a horse in the main hall.
sculpture.exampleZh: 博物馆大厅里有一座漂亮的马雕塑。

sea.example: The sea is very calm today, so we can go swimming.
sea.exampleZh: 今天海面很平静，所以我们可以去游泳。

seal.example: The king pressed his seal onto the letter and then sealed it.
seal.exampleZh: 国王把他的印章按在信上，然后把它密封起来。

seam.example: The worker found a small seam of coal deep in the mine.
seam.exampleZh: 工人在矿井深处发现了一条小煤层。

seaport.example: The old seaport is busy with ships from many countries.
seaport.exampleZh: 这座古老的海港里挤满了来自许多国家的船只。

search.example: I will search the whole room for my lost keys.
search.exampleZh: 我会搜遍整个房间来找我丢失的钥匙。

seaside.example: We had a nice trip to the seaside last summer.
seaside.exampleZh: 去年夏天我们去了海边，玩得很开心。

season.example: We add salt and pepper to season the soup in winter.
season.exampleZh: 冬天我们加盐和胡椒给汤调味。

seasoning.example: Salt and pepper are the only seasonings this simple soup needs.
seasoning.exampleZh: 盐和胡椒是这道简单的汤唯一需要的调味品。

seat.example: Please take your seat before the film starts.

second.example: He finished second in the race and won a silver medal.
second.exampleZh: 他在比赛中获得第二名，赢得了一枚银牌。

secondary.example: In this job, money is secondary and happiness comes first.
secondary.exampleZh: 在这份工作中，钱是次要的，快乐才是第一位的。

secret.example: She kept her plan a secret from everyone in the office.
secret.exampleZh: 她对办公室里的所有人都保守着自己的计划秘密。

secretary.example: The secretary answered the phone and wrote down the message.
secretary.exampleZh: 秘书接了电话，并记下了留言。

secrete.example: Some glands secrete useful oils that keep our skin soft.
secrete.exampleZh: 有些腺体会分泌有用的油脂，让我们的皮肤保持柔软。

secretive.example: She was secretive about her plans and told no one.
secretive.exampleZh: 她对自己的计划守口如瓶，没有告诉任何人。

section.example: This section of the book explains how plants grow.
section.exampleZh: 这本书的这一部分解释了植物如何生长。

sectional.example: The sectional sofa fits well in our small living room.
sectional.exampleZh: 这张组合式沙发放在我们的小客厅里很合适。

sector.example: The health sector needs more workers and better pay.
sector.exampleZh: 卫生部门需要更多工作人员和更好的薪酬。

secure.example: We keep our money in a safe place to secure our future.
secure.exampleZh: 我们把钱放在安全的地方，以保障我们的未来。

security.example: The company spends a lot of money on security for its buildings.
security.exampleZh: 公司花了很多钱为其建筑提供安保。

see.example: I can see the tall trees from my window.
see.exampleZh: 我从窗户能看见那些高大的树。

seed.example: The farmer planted seeds in the warm spring soil and waited for rain.
seed.exampleZh: 农民把种子种在温暖的春土里，等待下雨。

seedling.example: The farmer planted each seedling in the wet soil after the rain.
seedling.exampleZh: 雨后，农民把每一株幼苗都栽进了湿润的土壤里。

seek.example: We will seek help from our teacher after class today.
seek.exampleZh: 今天放学后我们会向老师寻求帮助。

seeker.example: She is a young job seeker looking for work in the city.
seeker.exampleZh: 她是一个在城里找工作的年轻求职者。

seem.example: You seem tired today, so you should go to bed early.
seem.exampleZh: 你今天似乎很累，所以应该早点上床睡觉。

seemingly.example: The seemingly small problem turned out to be very serious.
seemingly.exampleZh: 这个看似很小的问题结果却非常严重。

segment.example: Cut the orange into small segments and share them with the children.
segment.exampleZh: 把橙子切成小片，分给孩子们。

segregate.example: Some schools were segregated by race in the past.
segregate.exampleZh: 过去有些学校按种族实行隔离。

segregation.example: The old school was known for its segregation of students by race.
segregation.exampleZh: 这所老学校因按种族隔离学生而闻名。

seize.example: The police seized the bag and took the man away.
seize.exampleZh: 警察夺过那个包，并把那个人带走了。

seizure.example: The police made a seizure of illegal goods at the port yesterday.
seizure.exampleZh: 警方昨天在港口没收了一批非法货物。

seldom.example: I seldom go to the movies because I am busy.
seldom.exampleZh: 我很少去看电影，因为我很忙。

select.example: Please select one book from the shelf and read it quietly.
select.exampleZh: 请从书架上选一本书，然后安静地阅读。

selection.example: The store offers a wide selection of fresh fruit and vegetables.
selection.exampleZh: 这家商店提供多种新鲜水果和蔬菜。

selective.example: She is very selective about the books she reads to her children.
selective.exampleZh: 她给孩子们读什么书是非常挑剔的。

self.example: He is still learning to understand his true self.
self.exampleZh: 他仍在学习理解真实的自己。

selfish.example: He is too selfish to share his toys with other children.
selfish.exampleZh: 他太自私了，不肯和其他孩子分享玩具。

sell.example: They sell fresh fruit and vegetables at the small shop near my home.
sell.exampleZh: 他们在我家附近的小店里卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

semester.example: I will take four classes this semester and study hard for my exams.
semester.exampleZh: 这个学期我要上四门课，并努力备考。

semiconductor.example: This small factory makes semiconductors for phones and computers.
semiconductor.exampleZh: 这家小工厂为手机和电脑制造半导体。

seminar.example: Our teacher asked us to prepare a short talk for this week's seminar.
seminar.exampleZh: 老师让我们为本周的研讨会准备一个简短的发言。

senate.example: The senate voted on the new law yesterday.
senate.exampleZh: 参议院昨天对这项新法律进行了投票。

senator.example: The senator spoke to the crowd about the new road.
senator.exampleZh: 这位参议员向人群谈到了那条新路。

send.example: I will send this letter to my friend tomorrow morning.
send.exampleZh: 我明天早上会把这封信寄给我的朋友。

senior.example: My senior brother is a kind teacher at our school.
senior.exampleZh: 我的学长是我们学校一位和善的老师。

seniority.example: She has more seniority than me, so she leads the team.
seniority.exampleZh: 她的资历比我深，所以她领导这个团队。

sense.example: She has a good sense of humor and laughs at small things.
sense.exampleZh: 她有很好的幽默感，会为小事大笑。

sensible.example: It is sensible to take an umbrella when the sky looks dark.
sensible.exampleZh: 天空看起来发黑时，带把伞是明智的。

sensitive.example: She is very sensitive to cold weather and always wears a warm coat.
sensitive.exampleZh: 她对寒冷的天气很敏感，总是穿着一件暖和的外套。

sensitivity.example: Her sensitivity to other people's feelings makes her a very kind friend.
sensitivity.exampleZh: 她对他人感受的体贴使她成为一个非常善良的朋友。

sensual.example: The film shows the sensual beauty of the city at night.
sensual.exampleZh: 这部电影展现了这座城市夜晚的感官之美。

sentence.example: The judge will sentence him in court tomorrow morning.
sentence.exampleZh: 法官明天上午将在法庭上对他宣判。

sentiment.example: Her speech ended with a warm sentiment about family and friends.
sentiment.exampleZh: 她的演讲以一句关于家人和朋友的温暖感言结束。

sentimental.example: She is too sentimental about old photos and letters from her school days.
sentimental.exampleZh: 她对学生时代的旧照片和信件太多愁善感了。

separate.example: Please separate the white clothes from the colored ones before washing.
separate.exampleZh: 洗衣服前请把白色衣物和彩色衣物分开。

sequence.example: Please put these pictures in the right sequence.
sequence.exampleZh: 请把这些图片按正确的顺序排列。

serene.example: The lake was serene in the early morning light.
serene.exampleZh: 清晨的阳光下，湖面十分平静。

sergeant.example: The sergeant told his soldiers to stand still and wait for new orders.
sergeant.exampleZh: 中士让他的士兵们站着不动，等待新的命令。

serial.example: This popular serial tells a long story about a poor family in the city.
serial.exampleZh: 这部受欢迎的连续剧讲述了一个城市贫困家庭的漫长故事。

series.example: This book is the first in a new series about space travel.
series.exampleZh: 这本书是关于太空旅行的新系列中的第一本。

serious.example: This is a serious problem, so we must solve it today.
serious.exampleZh: 这是一个严重的问题，所以我们必须今天解决它。

sermon.example: The priest gave a short sermon about kindness and forgiveness.
sermon.exampleZh: 牧师做了一场关于善良与宽恕的简短布道。

servant.example: The old servant has worked in this house for many years.
servant.exampleZh: 这位老仆人在这个家里工作了很多年。

serve.example: The small restaurant serves hot soup and fresh bread every morning.
serve.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆每天早上供应热汤和新鲜面包。

service.example: The hotel offers good service and a free bus to the airport.
service.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供优质服务，还有免费班车去机场。

session.example: The next session of our English class starts at nine tomorrow morning.
session.exampleZh: 我们英语课的下一次课明天上午九点开始。

set.example: Please set the cups on the table and leave the box closed.
set.exampleZh: 请把杯子放在桌上，并让盒子保持关着。

setback.example: The team faced a major setback when their best player got injured.
setback.exampleZh: 当他们最好的球员受伤时，球队遭遇了一次重大挫折。

setting.example: The school setting helps children learn how to work with others.
setting.exampleZh: 学校环境有助于孩子们学习如何与他人合作。

settle.example: We need to settle this problem before the meeting starts today.
settle.exampleZh: 我们需要在今天会议开始前解决这个问题。

settlement.example: The two sides reached a peaceful settlement after a long talk.
settlement.exampleZh: 双方经过长时间的谈话达成了一个和平的解决方案。

settler.example: The first settlers built small wooden houses near the river.
settler.exampleZh: 最早的定居者在河边建了小木屋。

seven.example: There are seven days in a week and seven colors in a rainbow.
seven.exampleZh: 一周有七天，彩虹有七种颜色。

several.example: I have read several books about animals this year.
several.exampleZh: 今年我读了几本关于动物的书。

severe.example: The storm was severe and many trees fell down.
severe.exampleZh: 这场暴风雨很严重，许多树倒了。

severity.example: The severity of the storm surprised everyone in the small town.
severity.exampleZh: 这场风暴的严重程度让小镇上的每个人都感到意外。

sew.example: My mother taught me how to sew a button on my shirt.
sew.exampleZh: 我妈妈教我怎么在衬衫上缝扣子。

sewer.example: The dirty water flows through a sewer under the street.
sewer.exampleZh: 脏水从街道下面的下水道流过。

sex.example: Please write your name, age and sex on this form.
sex.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上填写你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shabby.example: He wore a shabby old coat and looked very poor.
shabby.exampleZh: 他穿着一件破旧的旧外套，看起来非常穷。

shack.example: The old man lived in a small shack near the river.
shack.exampleZh: 那位老人住在河边一间小棚屋里。

shade.example: We sat in the shade of the big tree and drank cold water.
shade.exampleZh: 我们坐在大树的阴凉处，喝着凉水。

shadow.example: The tree casts a long shadow on the grass in the afternoon.
shadow.exampleZh: 下午，这棵树在草地上投下长长的影子。

shady.example: We sat in a shady corner of the park to escape the hot sun.
shady.exampleZh: 我们坐在公园里阴凉的角落，躲避炎热的太阳。

shaft.example: The elevator shaft was dark, so we used a flashlight.
shaft.exampleZh: 电梯井很暗，所以我们用了手电筒。

shake.example: She had to shake the bottle before she drank the juice inside.
shake.exampleZh: 她喝里面的果汁前得先摇一摇瓶子。

shall.example: You shall finish your homework before you go out to play.
shall.exampleZh: 你必须先完成作业，然后才能出去玩。

shallow.example: The water in the small pond is very shallow for young children.
shallow.exampleZh: 这个小池塘里的水很浅，适合小孩子。

sham.example: The whole election was a sham, and nobody believed the promises.
sham.exampleZh: 整场选举都是一场骗局，没有人相信那些承诺。

shame.example: It is a shame that he never said sorry for his mistake.
shame.exampleZh: 他从未为自己的错误道歉，真是遗憾。

shape.example: The teacher asked us to shape the clay into a small round ball.
shape.exampleZh: 老师让我们把黏土塑成一个小圆球。

share.example: She likes to share her lunch with friends at school every day.
share.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天在学校和朋友们分享她的午餐。

sharp.example: The knife is very sharp, so please cut the fruit slowly and carefully.
sharp.exampleZh: 这把刀非常锋利，所以请慢慢地、小心地切水果。

shatter.example: The bad news shattered her dream of becoming a doctor.
shatter.exampleZh: 这个坏消息粉碎了她成为医生的梦想。

shave.example: He shaves every morning before work and keeps his razor in the bathroom.
shave.exampleZh: 他每天早上上班前刮胡子，剃须刀放在浴室里。

she.example: She likes to read books in the park every Sunday.
she.exampleZh: 她喜欢每个星期天在公园里看书。

shear.example: The farmer will shear his sheep before the hot summer comes.
shear.exampleZh: 农夫会在炎热夏天到来之前剪羊毛。

shed.example: The old farmer keeps his tools in a small shed near the river.
shed.exampleZh: 那位老农夫把工具存放在河边的一个小棚屋里。

sheep.example: The farmer keeps many sheep on his small farm.
sheep.exampleZh: 这个农民在他的小农场里养了很多羊。

sheer.example: The sheer size of the mountain made the climb seem impossible.
sheer.exampleZh: 这座山的陡峭规模让攀登看起来不可能。

sheet.example: She put a clean sheet on the bed this morning.
sheet.exampleZh: 今天早上她给床铺上了一条干净床单。

shelf.example: She put the books on the top shelf in her room.
shelf.exampleZh: 她把书放在她房间最上层的架子上。

shell.example: The child picked up a white shell on the beach.
shell.exampleZh: 那个孩子在沙滩上捡起了一个白色的贝壳。

shelter.example: We took shelter under a big tree when the rain started.
shelter.exampleZh: 下雨时我们躲在一棵大树下避雨。

shield.example: The knight raised his shield to protect himself from the arrows.
shield.exampleZh: 骑士举起盾牌保护自己免受箭矢伤害。

shift.example: My father works the night shift at the factory, so he sleeps during the day.
shift.exampleZh: 我父亲在工厂上夜班，所以他白天睡觉。

shimmer.example: The lake began to shimmer in the soft light of the evening sun.
shimmer.exampleZh: 傍晚柔和的阳光下，湖面开始闪烁发光。

shin.example: He got a small cut on his shin while playing football yesterday.
shin.exampleZh: 他昨天踢足球时小腿前部划了一个小口子。

shine.example: The sun began to shine brightly after the rain stopped.
shine.exampleZh: 雨停之后，太阳开始明亮地照耀。

ship.example: The ship will carry our goods to the island tomorrow.
ship.exampleZh: 这艘船明天会把我们的货物运到岛上。

shirt.example: I wear a blue shirt to work every morning.
shirt.exampleZh: 我每天早上穿一件蓝色衬衫去上班。

shiver.example: She began to shiver in the cold wind outside the station.
shiver.exampleZh: 她在车站外的寒风中开始瑟瑟发抖。

shock.example: The news of the accident gave everyone a great shock.
shock.exampleZh: 事故的消息让每个人都大为震惊。

shoe.example: I put on my new shoes and walked to school.
shoe.exampleZh: 我穿上新鞋，走路去学校。

shoot.example: The young bamboo shoots come out of the soil in early spring.
shoot.exampleZh: 早春时节，嫩竹笋从土壤里冒出来。

shop.example: I usually shop at the small store near my home and buy fresh food.
shop.exampleZh: 我通常在家附近的小商店购物，买些新鲜食物。

shore.example: We walked along the shore and watched the small boats come in.
shore.exampleZh: 我们沿着岸边散步，看着小船驶入港口。

short.example: The blue skirt is too short for the tall girl.
short.exampleZh: 这条蓝色裙子对那个高个子女孩来说太短了。

shortage.example: There is a serious shortage of water in this small town.

shorthand.example: Her notes were written in shorthand so only she could read them.
shorthand.exampleZh: 她的笔记是用速记写的，所以只有她能读懂。

shortly.example: The bus will arrive shortly, so please wait here.
shortly.exampleZh: 公交车不久就会到，请在这里等。

shot.example: He took a quick shot at the basket and scored.

should.example: You should drink more water every day.

shoulder.example: He carried the heavy bag on his shoulder and never complained about the work.
shoulder.exampleZh: 他把沉重的包扛在肩上，从不抱怨这份工作。

shout.example: He had to shout to be heard over the noise.
shout.exampleZh: 他不得不大声喊叫，才能在嘈杂声中被人听见。

show.example: She will show us her new photos after the concert tonight.
show.exampleZh: 今晚音乐会后她会给我们看她的新照片。

shower.example: I take a quick shower every morning before I go to work.
shower.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前会快速冲个淋浴。

shrewd.example: She is a shrewd businesswoman who always knows a good deal.
shrewd.exampleZh: 她是一位精明的女商人，总是能看出什么是好买卖。

shrimp.example: We caught a small shrimp in the shallow water near the beach.
shrimp.exampleZh: 我们在海滩附近的浅水里抓到一只小虾。

shrine.example: Every morning, the old man leaves flowers at the small shrine.
shrine.exampleZh: 每天早晨，那位老人都会在这座小神龛前献上鲜花。

shrink.example: The sweater may shrink if you wash it in hot water.
shrink.exampleZh: 如果你用热水洗这件毛衣，它可能会缩水。

shrub.example: There is a small green shrub in front of my house.
shrub.exampleZh: 我家门前有一株绿色的小灌木。

shrug.example: She just shrugged and said nothing when I asked why she was so upset.
shrug.exampleZh: 我问她为什么这么难过时，她只是耸了耸肩，什么也没说。

shut.example: Please shut the door quietly when you leave the room.
shut.exampleZh: 你离开房间时请轻轻关上门。

shutter.example: She closed the shutter to keep the bright afternoon sun out.
shutter.exampleZh: 她关上百叶窗，挡住午后刺眼的阳光。

shuttle.example: We took a shuttle from the airport to our hotel downtown.
shuttle.exampleZh: 我们从机场坐穿梭班车到市中心的酒店。

shy.example: The shy boy did not speak at all in class today.
shy.exampleZh: 那个害羞的男孩今天在课上一点也没说话。

sick.example: I feel sick today, so I will stay home and rest.
sick.exampleZh: 我今天觉得不舒服，所以会待在家里休息。

side.example: She stood by my side when everyone else supported the other group.
side.exampleZh: 当其他人都支持另一方时，她站在我身边。

siege.example: The old city fell after a long siege by the enemy army.
siege.exampleZh: 那座古城在敌军长期围攻后陷落了。

sieve.example: She used a sieve to separate the seeds from the flour.
sieve.exampleZh: 她用筛子把种子从面粉里筛出来。

sift.example: She used a small screen to sift the flour before baking the cake.
sift.exampleZh: 她烤蛋糕前用一个小筛子把面粉筛了一遍。

sigh.example: She gave a long sigh and closed the book.

sight.example: The old man lost his sight, but he still enjoys the view from his window.
sight.exampleZh: 那位老人失去了视力，但他仍然喜欢从窗户看到的景色。

sign.example: There is a sign on the door that says the shop is closed.
sign.exampleZh: 门上有一个牌子，上面写着商店已关门。

signal.example: The red light is a signal that we must stop the car.
signal.exampleZh: 红灯是我们必须停车的信号。

signature.example: The teacher asked every student to write a signature at the bottom of the page.
signature.exampleZh: 老师让每个学生在页面底部写下自己的签名。

significance.example: The teacher explained the significance of the old letter to the class.
significance.exampleZh: 老师向全班解释了这封旧信的重要意义。

significant.example: This is a significant change for our small team.
significant.exampleZh: 这对我们的小团队来说是一个重大的变化。

signify.example: Dark clouds often signify that rain is coming soon.
signify.exampleZh: 乌云常常意味着雨很快就要来了。

silence.example: A deep silence filled the room after the teacher asked the question.
silence.exampleZh: 老师提问后，房间里一片深深的寂静。

silent.example: The old library was silent except for the sound of falling rain.
silent.exampleZh: 那座古老的图书馆一片寂静，只有落雨的声音。

silicon.example: Silicon is a common element used to make computer chips and glass.
silicon.exampleZh: 硅是一种常见元素，用于制造电脑芯片和玻璃。

silk.example: This dress is made of soft silk.
silk.exampleZh: 这条裙子是用柔软的丝绸做的。

silly.example: It is silly to go out in the rain without an umbrella.
silly.exampleZh: 下雨天不带伞就出门是很傻的。

silver.example: She keeps her silver in a small wooden box on the table.
silver.exampleZh: 她把银器放在桌上的一个小木盒里。

similar.example: My sister and I have similar hair and similar taste in music.
similar.exampleZh: 我和妹妹有着相似的头发和相似的音 taste 音乐品味。

simple.example: The instructions are simple, so everyone can follow them easily.
simple.exampleZh: 说明很简单，所以每个人都能轻松跟上。

simplify.example: We can simplify the form so that everyone understands it easily.
simplify.exampleZh: 我们可以简化这份表格，让每个人都能轻松理解。

simply.example: You can simply ask him for help if you need it.
simply.exampleZh: 如果你需要帮助，简单地问他一下就可以了。

simulate.example: The computer program can simulate the weather in the coming week.
simulate.exampleZh: 这个电脑程序可以模拟未来一周的天气。

simultaneous.example: The two teams made a simultaneous start, so the race was fair.
simultaneous.exampleZh: 两支队伍同时出发，因此比赛很公平。

sin.example: In many religions, people believe that sin separates them from God.
sin.exampleZh: 在许多宗教中，人们相信罪会让他们与上帝分离。

since.example: Since you are free today, let us go to the park together.
since.exampleZh: 既然你今天有空，我们一起去公园吧。

sincere.example: He gave a sincere apology and promised to help us next time.
sincere.exampleZh: 他真诚地道了歉，并答应下次帮助我们。

sing.example: She likes to sing her favorite songs in the shower every morning.
sing.exampleZh: 她喜欢每天早上在淋浴时唱她最喜欢的歌。

single.example: He lives alone in a single room near the train station.
single.exampleZh: 他独自住在火车站附近的一个单人间里。

singular.example: The teacher asked us to change the singular word into its plural form.
singular.exampleZh: 老师让我们把这个单数单词变成复数形式。

sink.example: The old boat will sink if too much water gets inside it.
sink.exampleZh: 如果船里进了太多水，那条旧船就会下沉。

sir.example: Excuse me, sir, could you tell me the way to the station?
sir.exampleZh: 打扰一下，先生，您能告诉我去车站的路吗？

sister.example: My sister and I walk to school together every morning.
sister.exampleZh: 我和我姐姐每天早上一起步行去上学。

sit.example: Please sit on the chair near the window and wait for me.
sit.exampleZh: 请坐在窗边的椅子上等我。

site.example: The new school site is near the park, and they will build it next year.
site.exampleZh: 新学校的地点靠近公园，他们将在明年建造它。

situation.example: The situation in the city is getting better every day.
situation.exampleZh: 这座城市的情况每天都在好转。

six.example: I have six books on my desk.

size.example: Please check the size of the shoes before you buy them.
size.exampleZh: 买鞋之前请先确认一下尺码。

skate.example: She likes to skate on the frozen lake near her house in winter.
skate.exampleZh: 冬天她喜欢在房子附近的结冰湖面上滑冰。

skeptical.example: She is skeptical about the new plan because it sounds too good.
skeptical.exampleZh: 她对这项新计划持怀疑态度，因为它听起来太好了。

sketch.example: She made a quick sketch of the tree before painting it in detail.
sketch.exampleZh: 在详细上色之前，她先快速画了一幅这棵树的素描。

ski.example: In winter we often ski in the mountains near our small town.
ski.exampleZh: 冬天我们经常在离我们小镇不远的山里滑雪。

skill.example: She has good computer skills and learns new programs very quickly.
skill.exampleZh: 她有很好的电脑技能，学习新程序非常快。

skilled.example: She is a skilled worker and can fix the machine quickly.
skilled.exampleZh: 她是一名熟练的工人，能很快修好这台机器。

skillful.example: She is a skillful cook who makes wonderful meals for her family.
skillful.exampleZh: 她是一位娴熟的厨师，能为家人做出美味的饭菜。

skim.example: She skimmed the report quickly before the meeting started.
skim.exampleZh: 会议开始前，她快速浏览了这份报告。

skin.example: The doctor said I should protect my skin from the strong summer sun.
skin.exampleZh: 医生说，在夏天强烈的阳光下，我应该保护好自己的皮肤。

skip.example: Let's skip the boring part and go straight to the end.
skip.exampleZh: 我们跳过无聊的部分，直接到结尾吧。

skirt.example: She wore a blue skirt to the party and skirted the busy road.
skirt.exampleZh: 她穿着蓝色裙子去参加聚会，绕开了繁忙的道路。

skull.example: The doctor took an X-ray of his skull after the accident.
skull.exampleZh: 事故发生后，医生给他的颅骨拍了X光片。

sky.example: The sky is blue and clear this morning.
sky.exampleZh: 今天早上天空湛蓝而晴朗。

slave.example: The king treated the poor man like a slave for many years.
slave.exampleZh: 国王多年来把那个可怜人当奴隶对待。

sleep.example: I need to sleep for eight hours every night to feel good.
sleep.exampleZh: 我每天晚上需要睡八个小时才能感觉良好。

sleeve.example: He rolled up his sleeves and washed the dishes after dinner.
sleeve.exampleZh: 他卷起袖子，晚饭后洗了碗。

slender.example: She has a slender figure and always wears simple clothes.
slender.exampleZh: 她身材苗条，总是穿着简单的衣服。

slice.example: She cut the cake into slices and gave one to each child.
slice.exampleZh: 她把蛋糕切成薄片，给每个孩子分了一块。

slide.example: The children love to slide down the big slide in the park.
slide.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢从公园的大滑梯上滑下来。

slight.example: There is a slight difference between the two pictures on the wall.
slight.exampleZh: 墙上那两幅画之间有轻微的差别。

slim.example: She eats less sugar and walks daily to stay slim.
slim.exampleZh: 她少吃糖并每天散步，以保持苗条。

slip.example: He slipped on the wet floor and hurt his left arm.
slip.exampleZh: 他在湿滑的地板上滑倒了，伤到了左胳膊。

slope.example: The ball rolled down the slope and stopped near the tree.
slope.exampleZh: 球滚下斜坡，停在树附近。

slot.example: I put the coin into the slot and the machine started to work.
slot.exampleZh: 我把硬币放进狭缝里，机器就开始运转了。

slow.example: The old bus is slow, so we always arrive late.
slow.exampleZh: 那辆旧公交车很慢，所以我们总是迟到。

small.example: This small room is warm and quiet in winter.
small.exampleZh: 这个小房间在冬天既温暖又安静。

smart.example: My smart little sister can solve this hard math problem quickly.
smart.exampleZh: 我聪明的小妹妹能很快解出这道数学难题。

smell.example: The kitchen smells very good when my mother makes bread.
smell.exampleZh: 我妈妈做面包时，厨房里闻起来很香。

smile.example: She gave me a warm smile and said hello.
smile.exampleZh: 她给了我一个温暖的微笑，并向我问好。

smoke.example: The smoke from the kitchen made everyone cough and open the windows.
smoke.exampleZh: 厨房里的烟让每个人都咳嗽起来，并打开了窗户。

smooth.example: The road is smooth and the drive home was quick.
smooth.exampleZh: 路面很平坦，回家的车程很快。

snake.example: The snake moved quietly through the tall grass near the river.
snake.exampleZh: 那条蛇悄悄地穿过河边的高草。

snap.example: The dry branch snapped when I stepped on it, and my dog snapped at a fly.
snap.exampleZh: 我踩到那根干树枝时它啪地断了，我的狗还猛咬了一只苍蝇。

sneeze.example: When I have a cold, I sneeze a lot in the morning.
sneeze.exampleZh: 我感冒的时候，早上会打很多喷嚏。

snow.example: The children played in the snow and made a big snowman.
snow.exampleZh: 孩子们在雪地里玩耍，堆了一个大雪人。

so.example: I was so tired that I went to bed early last night.
so.exampleZh: 我太累了，所以昨晚很早就睡了。

soak.example: I soak my dirty clothes in warm water before washing them.
soak.exampleZh: 洗之前我把脏衣服浸泡在温水里。

soap.example: I wash my hands with soap before I eat dinner.
soap.exampleZh: 我吃晚饭前用肥皂洗手。

soar.example: House prices have soared in this city over the past few years.
soar.exampleZh: 过去几年里，这座城市的房价猛增。

soccer.example: My brother plays soccer with his friends every Saturday morning.
soccer.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六早上都和朋友们踢足球。

sociable.example: She is a sociable person and enjoys meeting new friends at parties.
sociable.exampleZh: 她是个好交际的人，喜欢在聚会上结识新朋友。

social.example: Social media helps people stay in touch with friends and family.
social.exampleZh: 社交媒体帮助人们与朋友和家人保持联系。

society.example: In our society, everyone should help their neighbors when they can.
society.exampleZh: 在我们的社会里，每个人都应该在力所能及时帮助邻居。

sociology.example: She studies sociology at a small university near her home town.
sociology.exampleZh: 她在离家不远的一所小型大学学习社会学。

sock.example: My left sock is wet because I stepped in a puddle.
sock.exampleZh: 我的左袜子湿了，因为我踩进了一个水坑。

soda.example: I would like a cold glass of soda with my lunch today.
soda.exampleZh: 我今天午饭想要一杯冰汽水。

sofa.example: The cat is sleeping on the sofa in the living room.
sofa.exampleZh: 猫正在客厅的沙发上睡觉。

soft.example: Her voice was soft and calm when she spoke to the child.
soft.exampleZh: 她和孩子说话时，声音柔和而平静。

software.example: I need to install new software on my computer today.
software.exampleZh: 我今天需要在电脑上安装新软件。

soil.example: The old farmer said the soil here is good for growing vegetables.
soil.exampleZh: 这位老农说这里的土壤很适合种蔬菜。

solar.example: We put solar panels on the roof to save money.
solar.exampleZh: 我们在屋顶上装了太阳能板，以便节省开支。

soldier.example: The soldier carried a heavy bag and walked slowly to the camp.
soldier.exampleZh: 那名士兵背着一个沉重的包，慢慢地走向营地。

solid.example: The table is made of solid wood and feels very strong.
solid.exampleZh: 这张桌子是实木做的，感觉很结实。

soluble.example: This sugar is soluble in water, so it disappears quickly.
soluble.exampleZh: 这种糖可溶于水，所以它很快就消失了。

solution.example: We need a simple solution to this problem before the meeting.
solution.exampleZh: 我们需要在会议前为这个问题找到一个简单的解决办法。

solve.example: We must solve this problem before the end of the week.
solve.exampleZh: 我们必须在这周结束前解决这个问题。

some.example: I need to buy some bread and milk for breakfast.
some.exampleZh: 我需要买一些面包和牛奶当早餐。

somebody.example: I hope somebody can help me find my lost keys.
somebody.exampleZh: 我希望有人能帮我找到丢失的钥匙。

somehow.example: Somehow she found the lost key under the old sofa.
somehow.exampleZh: 不知怎么地，她在旧沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

someone.example: Someone left a small bag on the chair by the door.
someone.exampleZh: 有人把一个小包落在了门边的椅子上。

something.example: I want to tell you something important about our new plan.
something.exampleZh: 我想告诉你一些关于我们新计划的重要事情。

sometime.example: Please come to see me sometime next week.
sometime.exampleZh: 请下周找个时候来看我。

sometimes.example: Sometimes I walk to school with my sister when the weather is nice.
sometimes.exampleZh: 天气好的时候，我有时和妹妹一起走路去学校。

somewhat.example: The test was somewhat difficult, but most of us finished it on time.
somewhat.exampleZh: 这次考试有点难，但我们大多数人还是按时完成了。

somewhere.example: I think I left my keys somewhere near the front door.
somewhere.exampleZh: 我想我把钥匙落在前门附近的某个地方了。

son.example: My son likes to play football with his friends after school.
son.exampleZh: 我儿子喜欢放学后和朋友们踢足球。

song.example: She sang a beautiful song at the school concert last night.
song.exampleZh: 昨晚她在学校音乐会上唱了一首优美的歌。

soon.example: The bus will come soon, so please wait here.
soon.exampleZh: 公交车很快就来，请在这里等。

sophisticated.example: This computer uses sophisticated software that is easy for anyone to learn.
sophisticated.exampleZh: 这台电脑使用任何人都容易学会的尖端软件。

sore.example: My throat is sore, so I will drink warm water today.
sore.exampleZh: 我的喉咙很痛，所以今天我要喝温水。

sorrow.example: She felt deep sorrow after her old dog died last winter.
sorrow.exampleZh: 去年冬天她的老狗死后，她感到深深的悲伤。

sorry.example: I am sorry for being late to your party last night.
sorry.exampleZh: 很抱歉昨晚参加你的聚会迟到了。

sort.example: She likes this sort of music, and she sorts her CDs by color.
sort.exampleZh: 她喜欢这种音乐，并且按颜色整理她的CD。

soul.example: Music can touch your soul in a way that words cannot.
soul.exampleZh: 音乐能以语言无法做到的方式触动你的灵魂。

sound.example: The sound of the rain made the children feel sleepy.
sound.exampleZh: 雨声让那些孩子感到困倦。

soup.example: My mother makes hot soup for us on cold winter days.
soup.exampleZh: 在寒冷的冬日里，妈妈会为我们煮热汤。

sour.example: The milk in the fridge has gone sour, so please throw it away.
sour.exampleZh: 冰箱里的牛奶已经变酸了，请把它扔掉。

source.example: I always check the source of any news story before I share it.
source.exampleZh: 我在分享任何新闻之前，总会先核实它的来源。

south.example: The birds fly south every winter when the weather gets cold.
south.exampleZh: 每年冬天天气变冷时，这些鸟都会飞向南方。

southern.example: People in the southern part of the country enjoy warm weather all year.
southern.exampleZh: 这个国家南部地区的人们全年都享受温暖的天气。

space.example: There is not enough space in this room for another table.
space.exampleZh: 这个房间里没有足够的空间再放一张桌子。

spacecraft.example: The spacecraft flew past the moon and sent pictures back to Earth.
spacecraft.exampleZh: 这艘宇宙飞船飞过月球，并把照片传回了地球。

spade.example: He dug a hole in the garden with a spade.
spade.exampleZh: 他用铲子在花园里挖了一个洞。

span.example: The bridge spans the wide river and has a span of two kilometers.
span.exampleZh: 这座桥横跨宽阔的河流，跨度为两公里。

spare.example: Can you spare a few minutes to help me move this table?
spare.exampleZh: 你能抽出几分钟帮我搬这张桌子吗？

spark.example: A single spark from the fire started the whole forest fire.
spark.exampleZh: 火中飞出的一点火星引发了整场森林大火。

speak.example: She can speak three languages and often speaks English at work.
speak.exampleZh: 她会说三种语言，并经常在工作中说英语。

speaker.example: The speaker gave a short talk about how to learn English well.
speaker.exampleZh: 演讲者做了一个关于如何学好英语的简短演讲。

special.example: This is a special day for our whole family.
special.exampleZh: 这对我们全家来说是特殊的一天。

specialist.example: The doctor sent me to a heart specialist at the city hospital.
specialist.exampleZh: 医生让我去市医院找一位心脏专科医生。

species.example: Many species of birds live in this forest.
species.exampleZh: 这片森林里生活着许多种鸟类。

specific.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your idea.
specific.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的想法。

specifically.example: This book is written specifically for students who want to learn English.
specifically.exampleZh: 这本书是专门为想学英语的学生写的。

specify.example: Please specify the date and time of your meeting.
specify.exampleZh: 请明确说明你会议的日期和时间。

specimen.example: The doctor took a blood specimen from my arm this morning.
specimen.exampleZh: 今天早上医生从我手臂上取了一份血液样本。

spectacle.example: The fireworks over the lake were a beautiful spectacle for everyone.
spectacle.exampleZh: 湖面上的烟花对每个人来说都是一场美丽的景象。

spectacular.example: The view from the top of the mountain is truly spectacular at sunset.
spectacular.exampleZh: 日落时分从山顶看到的景色真是壮观。

speculate.example: I can only speculate about why she left the meeting early.
speculate.exampleZh: 我只能猜测她为什么提前离开了会议。

speech.example: Her speech at the meeting was short but very clear.
speech.exampleZh: 她在会上的演讲简短但非常清晰。

speed.example: The car picked up speed as it went down the hill.
speed.exampleZh: 汽车下山时加快了速度。

spell.example: Can you spell your last name for me? We had a short spell of cold weather.
spell.exampleZh: 你能拼一下你的姓吗？我们经历了一段短暂的寒冷天气。

spelling.example: The spelling of this word is hard for many students.
spelling.exampleZh: 这个单词的拼写对许多学生来说很难。

spend.example: I spend two hours reading English books every evening.
spend.exampleZh: 我每天晚上花两个小时读英语书。

sphere.example: The moon is a sphere that moves around the earth.
sphere.exampleZh: 月亮是一个围绕地球运动的球体。

spice.example: A little spice makes this soup taste much better.
spice.exampleZh: 加一点香料能让这汤的味道好得多。

spicy.example: This spicy noodle soup is too hot for my little sister.
spicy.exampleZh: 这碗辛辣的面汤对我妹妹来说太辣了。

spider.example: A small spider is making a web in the corner of my room.
spider.exampleZh: 一只小蜘蛛正在我房间的角落里织网。

spill.example: Be careful with that cup, or you will spill hot coffee on the table.
spill.exampleZh: 小心那个杯子，否则你会把热咖啡洒在桌子上。

spin.example: The dancer began to spin faster and faster across the stage.
spin.exampleZh: 舞者在舞台上开始越转越快。

spirit.example: Her spirit stayed strong even during the hardest days of the year.
spirit.exampleZh: 即使在一年中最艰难的日子里，她的精神依然坚强。

spiritual.example: She reads a book about spiritual health every night before bed.
spiritual.exampleZh: 她每晚睡前都会读一本关于心灵健康的书。

spit.example: Please do not spit on the street because it is dirty.
spit.exampleZh: 请不要在街上吐痰，因为那样很脏。

spite.example: He said those words out of spite, not because he meant them.
spite.exampleZh: 他说那些话是出于怨恨，并非真心。

split.example: The teacher split the class into four small groups.
split.exampleZh: 老师把班级分成了四个小组。

spoil.example: Too much rain can spoil the fruit before we pick it.
spoil.exampleZh: 雨水太多会在我们采摘之前让水果坏掉。

spokesman.example: A company spokesman said the new factory will open next month.
spokesman.exampleZh: 一位公司发言人表示，新工厂将于下个月开业。

sponge.example: I use a sponge to wash the dishes after dinner, and my brother always sponges off us.
sponge.exampleZh: 晚饭后我用海绵洗碗，而我弟弟总是白吃白喝占我们便宜。

sponsor.example: The company will sponsor the school football team this year.
sponsor.exampleZh: 这家公司今年将赞助学校的足球队。

spontaneous.example: Her spontaneous laugh made everyone in the room feel relaxed.
spontaneous.exampleZh: 她自然的笑声让房间里的每个人都感到放松。

spoon.example: Please give me a clean spoon for my hot soup.
spoon.exampleZh: 请给我一把干净的勺子，用来喝热汤。

sport.example: My favorite sport is basketball, and I play it with friends every weekend.
sport.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球，每个周末我都和朋友一起打。

spot.example: I found a small spot on my shirt and cleaned it quickly.
spot.exampleZh: 我在衬衫上发现了一个小污点，很快把它擦干净了。

spouse.example: My spouse and I have been married for ten years.
spouse.exampleZh: 我和我的配偶已经结婚十年了。

spray.example: The farmer will spray water on the young plants every morning.
spray.exampleZh: 农民每天早上会给幼苗喷水。

spread.example: The news spread quickly through the small village.
spread.exampleZh: 消息很快传遍了这个小村庄。

spring.example: In spring, the children like to jump on the old spring near the warm water.
spring.exampleZh: 春天，孩子们喜欢在温水旁的旧弹簧上跳。

spy.example: She saw a spy near the old bridge and called the police.
spy.exampleZh: 她在老桥附近看到一个间谍，于是报了警。

square.example: The old square in our town has a big fountain.
square.exampleZh: 我们镇上那座古老的广场有一个大喷泉。

squeeze.example: She had to squeeze the lemon hard to get the juice out.
squeeze.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲挤压柠檬，才能挤出汁来。

stab.example: He felt a sudden stab of pain in his chest while running.
stab.exampleZh: 他跑步时胸口突然感到一阵刺痛。

stability.example: The old bridge was built for stability, so it can hold heavy trucks.
stability.exampleZh: 这座老桥是为稳固而建的，所以它能承受重型卡车。

stable.example: The old wooden stable next to our house is very stable and safe.
stable.exampleZh: 我们房子旁边那座旧木马厩非常稳固而且安全。

stack.example: Please stack the clean plates on the table before dinner.
stack.exampleZh: 请在晚饭前把干净的盘子摞在桌子上。

stadium.example: The new stadium can hold fifty thousand people for a big game.
stadium.exampleZh: 这座新体育场能容纳五万人观看大型比赛。

staff.example: The hotel staff are very friendly and help us every day.
staff.exampleZh: 酒店员工非常友好，每天都在帮助我们。

stage.example: The actors walked onto the stage and began the play.
stage.exampleZh: 演员们走上舞台，开始表演。

stain.example: A dark stain on his shirt was easy to see.
stain.exampleZh: 他衬衫上的深色污渍很容易看见。

stair.example: She walked up the stairs to her room on the second floor.
stair.exampleZh: 她走上楼梯回到自己二楼的房间。

stake.example: He has a big stake in the company and works there every day.
stake.exampleZh: 他在这家公司有很大的股份，而且每天都在那里工作。

stale.example: The bread on the table is stale and hard.
stale.exampleZh: 桌上的面包不新鲜了，而且很硬。

stamp.example: She put a stamp on the letter and stamped her feet in the cold.
stamp.exampleZh: 她在信上贴了张邮票，并在寒冷中跺着脚。

stand.example: I had to stand for an hour because every seat was taken.
stand.exampleZh: 因为所有座位都被占了，我不得不站了一个小时。

standard.example: This hotel meets the standard of a good hotel in the city.
standard.exampleZh: 这家酒店达到了这座城市中一家好酒店的水准。

standpoint.example: From my standpoint, this plan is simple and good for everyone.
standpoint.exampleZh: 从我的立场来看，这个计划很简单，对每个人来说都很好。

star.example: She is a famous movie star, and she will star in a new film.
star.exampleZh: 她是一位著名的电影明星，她将主演一部新电影。

stare.example: She stared at the old photo for a long time without speaking.
stare.exampleZh: 她盯着那张旧照片看了很久，一句话也没说。

start.example: We start work at nine every morning and finish at six.
start.exampleZh: 我们每天早上九点开始工作，六点结束。

startle.example: The loud noise from the street startled the baby awake.
startle.exampleZh: 街上很大的噪音把宝宝吓了一跳，把他吵醒了。

starve.example: Many poor children starve because their families have no food or money.
starve.exampleZh: 许多贫困儿童挨饿，因为他们的家庭没有食物也没有钱。

state.example: The doctor asked me to state my name and describe my current state.
state.exampleZh: 医生让我说出姓名并描述目前的状态。

statement.example: His statement about the new rules was short and clear.
statement.exampleZh: 他关于新规则的声明简短明了。

statesman.example: He was a great statesman who worked for peace all his life.
statesman.exampleZh: 他是一位伟大的政治家，毕生致力于和平事业。

static.example: The old website is static, so its pages never change on their own.
static.exampleZh: 这个旧网站是静态的，所以它的页面本身从不会改变。

statistics.example: The teacher showed us statistics about how many students walk to school.
statistics.exampleZh: 老师给我们看了关于多少学生步行上学的统计数据。

statue.example: There is a large stone statue of a horse in the park.
statue.exampleZh: 公园里有一座巨大的石马雕像。

status.example: Her new job gave her a higher status in the company.
status.exampleZh: 她的新工作让她在公司里有了更高的地位。

stay.example: I will stay at home this weekend and read a good book.
stay.exampleZh: 这个周末我会待在家里读一本好书。

steady.example: He kept his voice steady and finished the speech with confidence.
steady.exampleZh: 他保持声音稳定，自信地完成了演讲。

steal.example: Someone tried to steal my bag on the busy street yesterday.
steal.exampleZh: 昨天有人在繁忙的街上试图偷我的包。

steam.example: Hot steam rose from the pot of soup on the stove.
steam.exampleZh: 热蒸汽从炉子上的那锅汤里升起。

steel.example: The bridge is made of strong steel and can hold heavy trucks.
steel.exampleZh: 这座桥由坚固的钢铁制成，能够承受重型卡车。

steep.example: The street became too steep for the old man to walk up.
steep.exampleZh: 这条街变得太陡了，老人走不上去。

steer.example: She steered the small boat carefully through the narrow river.
steer.exampleZh: 她小心地驾驶小船穿过狭窄的河道。

stem.example: The flower's stem broke, and the government tried to stem the rising tide of complaints.
stem.exampleZh: 花茎断了，政府试图阻止不断高涨的抱怨浪潮。

step.example: Please take one step forward and then stop at the door.
step.exampleZh: 请向前走一步，然后在门口停下。

stick.example: The boy used a stick to hit the ball, then stuck a picture on the wall.
stick.exampleZh: 男孩用一根棍子击球，然后把一幅画粘贴在墙上。

sticky.example: This sticky tape is not strong enough to hold the box.
sticky.exampleZh: 这粘胶带不够结实，无法固定住这个箱子。

stiff.example: My neck feels stiff after sleeping on that old sofa.
stiff.exampleZh: 睡在那张旧沙发上之后，我的脖子感觉很僵硬。

still.example: She is still waiting for the bus at the quiet corner.
still.exampleZh: 她还在那个安静的角落等公交车。

stimulate.example: Good teachers stimulate students to ask more questions in class.
stimulate.exampleZh: 优秀的老师激励学生在课堂上提出更多问题。

sting.example: A bee can sting you if you touch it.
sting.exampleZh: 如果你碰蜜蜂，它可能会蜇你。

stir.example: She used a spoon to stir the hot soup in the pot.
stir.exampleZh: 她用勺子搅拌锅里的热汤。

stock.example: The store keeps a large stock of winter coats for the coming season.
stock.exampleZh: 这家商店为即将到来的季节备了大量冬季外套的库存。

stocking.example: She wore a red stocking on one leg and a blue one on the other.
stocking.exampleZh: 她一条腿上穿着红色的长袜，另一条腿上穿着蓝色的长袜。

stomach.example: My stomach hurts after I eat too much spicy food.
stomach.exampleZh: 我吃太多辛辣食物后肚子就疼。

stone.example: He picked up a small stone and threw it into the river.
stone.exampleZh: 他捡起一块小石头，把它扔进了河里。

stop.example: The bus will stop here for ten minutes.
stop.exampleZh: 公交车会在这里停十分钟。

storage.example: We keep the old books in storage under the stairs.
storage.exampleZh: 我们把旧书存放在楼梯下的储藏室里。

store.example: We store extra food in the small room behind the store.
store.exampleZh: 我们把多余的食物储存在商店后面的小房间里。

storm.example: The storm broke the windows and flooded the small village.
storm.exampleZh: 暴风雨打破了窗户，淹没了小村庄。

story.example: My grandmother told me a funny story about her first day at work.
story.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于她第一天上班的有趣故事。

stove.example: She put the big pot on the hot stove and cooked some soup.
stove.exampleZh: 她把大锅放在热炉子上，煮了一些汤。

straight.example: She drew a straight line on the paper and smiled.
straight.exampleZh: 她在纸上画了一条直线，然后笑了。

strain.example: The heavy work put a lot of strain on his back.
strain.exampleZh: 繁重的工作给他的背部带来了很大压力。

strange.example: There is a strange noise coming from the old house next door.
strange.exampleZh: 隔壁老房子里传来一种奇怪的声音。

stranger.example: I met a stranger on the train who gave me good advice.
stranger.exampleZh: 我在火车上遇到一位陌生人，他给了我很好的建议。

strap.example: He used a strong strap to tie the box onto his bike.
strap.exampleZh: 他用一根结实的带子把箱子绑在自行车上。

strategic.example: This is a strategic decision that will help our small company grow.
strategic.exampleZh: 这是一个战略性的决定，将帮助我们的小公司成长。

strategy.example: We need a better strategy to save money this year.
strategy.exampleZh: 今年我们需要一个更好的策略来省钱。

straw.example: The farmer put dry straw on the floor of the stable.
straw.exampleZh: 农民把干稻草铺在牲口棚的地上。

stream.example: A small stream flows through the green hills behind our little house.
stream.exampleZh: 一条小溪从我们小屋后面的青山间流过。

street.example: There is a small park at the end of my street.
street.exampleZh: 我住的这条街尽头有一个小公园。

strength.example: Her greatest strength is that she never gives up.
strength.exampleZh: 她最大的长处是永不放弃。

strengthen.example: Daily exercise will strengthen your body and help you feel better.
strengthen.exampleZh: 每天锻炼会增强你的体质，让你感觉更好。

stress.example: Too much stress can make it hard to sleep at night.
stress.exampleZh: 过多的压力会让人晚上难以入睡。

stretch.example: We stretch our arms before running, and the road stretches far ahead.
stretch.exampleZh: 我们跑步前伸展手臂，这条路向前延伸得很远。

strict.example: Our teacher is very strict about homework and never accepts late work.
strict.exampleZh: 我们的老师对作业要求很严格，从不接受迟交的作业。

strike.example: The workers decided to strike for better pay and safer working conditions.
strike.exampleZh: 工人们决定罢工，要求更好的薪酬和更安全的工作条件。

striking.example: The old house has a striking red door that everyone notices.
striking.exampleZh: 那栋老房子有一扇引人注目的红门，每个人都会注意到。

string.example: She tied the box with a piece of string from her bag.
string.exampleZh: 她用包里的一根细绳把盒子捆了起来。

strip.example: The teacher told us to strip the old paint off the wooden door.
strip.exampleZh: 老师让我们把木门上的旧漆剥掉。

stripe.example: The zebra has a black and white stripe on its back.
stripe.exampleZh: 斑马背上有一条黑白相间的条纹。

stroke.example: My grandfather had a stroke last year but he is fine now.
stroke.exampleZh: 我爷爷去年中风了，但他现在很好。

strong.example: The strong man can carry that heavy box up the stairs.
strong.exampleZh: 那个强壮的男人能把那个重箱子搬上楼。

structure.example: The structure of the building is very strong and simple.
structure.exampleZh: 这座建筑的结构非常坚固且简单。

struggle.example: They struggle to find clean water in the dry season.
struggle.exampleZh: 在旱季，他们努力寻找干净的水。

student.example: Every student in my class works hard and asks good questions.
student.exampleZh: 我班上的每个学生都很努力，也会提出好问题。
