studio.example: She paints every morning in a small studio near her home.
studio.exampleZh: 她每天早上在家附近的一个小画室里画画。

study.example: I study English every evening in my small study at home.
study.exampleZh: 我每天晚上在家里的小书房学习英语。

stuff.example: Please put your stuff in the box before we leave the room.
stuff.exampleZh: 在我们离开房间之前，请把你的东西放进箱子里。

stupid.example: It was stupid of me to leave my keys in the car.
stupid.exampleZh: 我把钥匙落在车里，真是太愚蠢了。

style.example: Her style of writing is simple and clear.
style.exampleZh: 她的写作风格简洁明了。

subject.example: The subject of today's lesson is easy for most students to understand.
subject.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题对大多数学生来说很容易理解。

submarine.example: The submarine went deep under the sea to look for fish.
submarine.exampleZh: 潜水艇潜入深海寻找鱼群。

submerge.example: The heavy rain submerged the small road near our house.
submerge.exampleZh: 大雨淹没了我们家附近的那条小路。

submit.example: Please submit your homework to the teacher before Friday.
submit.exampleZh: 请在星期五之前把作业交给老师。

subordinate.example: The manager treats each subordinate fairly and listens to their ideas.
subordinate.exampleZh: 经理公平地对待每一位下属，并听取他们的想法。

subscribe.example: I subscribe to two magazines and read them every weekend.
subscribe.exampleZh: 我订阅了两本杂志，每个周末都会读。

subsequent.example: The first meeting was short, and the subsequent meetings were much longer.
subsequent.exampleZh: 第一次会议很短，随后的会议则长得多。

substance.example: Water is a simple substance that all living things need.
substance.exampleZh: 水是一种所有生物都需要的简单物质。

substantial.example: The company made a substantial profit this year.
substantial.exampleZh: 公司今年获得了可观的利润。

substitute.example: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this recipe.
substitute.exampleZh: 在这个食谱里，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtract.example: Please subtract the cost of the broken cup from the total bill.
subtract.exampleZh: 请从账单总额中减去那只破杯子的费用。

suburb.example: They moved to a quiet suburb because the city was too noisy.
suburb.exampleZh: 他们搬到了一个安静的郊区，因为城市太吵了。

subway.example: I take the subway to work every morning at eight.
subway.exampleZh: 我每天早上八点坐地铁去上班。

succeed.example: If you work hard every day, you will succeed in the end.
succeed.exampleZh: 如果你每天努力，你最终会成功。

success.example: Her small business became a great success after only two years.
success.exampleZh: 她的小生意仅仅两年后就取得了巨大成功。

successful.example: She worked very hard and became a successful doctor in her hometown.
successful.exampleZh: 她非常努力，后来成为家乡一位成功的医生。

succession.example: The team won three games in quick succession last month.
succession.exampleZh: 这支队伍上个月连续赢了三场比赛。

successive.example: The team won three successive games last month.
successive.exampleZh: 这支球队上个月连续赢了三场比赛。

such.example: Such a kind person is always welcome in our small town.
such.exampleZh: 这样善良的人在我们小镇总是受欢迎的。

suck.example: Babies suck milk from a bottle or from their mother.
suck.exampleZh: 婴儿从奶瓶里或从母亲身上吮吸奶水。

sudden.example: The sudden rain made everyone run back home quickly.
sudden.exampleZh: 突如其来的雨让大家都快速跑回了家。

suffer.example: He suffered a lot of pain after the accident last year.
suffer.exampleZh: 去年那场事故之后，他遭受了很多痛苦。

sufficient.example: The soup has sufficient salt for most people but not for him.
sufficient.exampleZh: 这汤对大多数人来说盐分足够，但对他来说不够。

sugar.example: Too much sugar in your tea is not good for your teeth.
sugar.exampleZh: 茶里放太多糖对你的牙齿不好。

suggest.example: I suggest we take the early train tomorrow.
suggest.exampleZh: 我建议我们明天坐早班火车。

suggestion.example: Her suggestion about the meeting time was very helpful to us.
suggestion.exampleZh: 她关于会议时间的建议对我们很有帮助。

suicide.example: The school started a program to help prevent suicide among young people.
suicide.exampleZh: 学校启动了一个项目，帮助预防年轻人自杀。

suit.example: This dark suit is perfect for the job interview tomorrow.
suit.exampleZh: 这套深色西装非常适合明天的求职面试。

suitable.example: This film is not suitable for young children to watch.
suitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合年幼的孩子观看。

suitcase.example: My suitcase is too heavy for me to carry up the stairs.
suitcase.exampleZh: 我的手提箱太重了，我搬不上楼。

sum.example: In sum, the report shows a small rise in total costs.
sum.exampleZh: 总之，这份报告显示总成本小幅上升。

summarize.example: Please summarize the main points of the article in two short paragraphs.
summarize.exampleZh: 请用两段简短的文字概括这篇文章的要点。

summary.example: Please write a short summary of the report for the meeting.
summary.exampleZh: 请为会议写一份报告的简短摘要。

summer.example: We often go swimming in the lake during the hot summer.
summer.exampleZh: 炎热的夏天里我们经常去湖里游泳。

sun.example: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
sun.exampleZh: 太阳从东方升起，从西方落下。

super.example: This super phone takes very clear photos at night.
super.exampleZh: 这款超级手机在夜里拍出的照片非常清晰。

superficial.example: His knowledge of the subject is superficial and he cannot answer simple questions.
superficial.exampleZh: 他对这门学科的了解很肤浅，回答不了简单的问题。

supervise.example: My teacher will supervise the students during the science project.
supervise.exampleZh: 在科学项目期间，我的老师会指导这些学生。

supper.example: We usually have supper at seven in the evening.
supper.exampleZh: 我们通常晚上七点吃晚饭。

supplement.example: Doctors say a daily vitamin supplement can help older people stay healthy.
supplement.exampleZh: 医生说每日补充维生素有助于老年人保持健康。

supply.example: The company can supply fresh water to the whole village every day.
supply.exampleZh: 这家公司每天能为整个村庄供应新鲜水。

support.example: My family supports me when I study, and I support them too.
support.exampleZh: 我学习时家人支持我，我也支持他们。

suppose.example: I suppose you are right, so we should try again tomorrow.
suppose.exampleZh: 我想你说得对，所以我们应该明天再试一次。

suppress.example: The government tried to suppress the peaceful protest but failed.
suppress.exampleZh: 政府试图镇压这场和平抗议，但失败了。

supreme.example: The king had supreme power over all the people in his land.
supreme.exampleZh: 国王对他的土地上所有人拥有至高无上的权力。

sure.example: I am sure she will come to the party tonight.
sure.exampleZh: 我确信她今晚会来参加聚会。

surface.example: The surface of the lake was calm and quiet in the morning light.
surface.exampleZh: 清晨的阳光下，湖面平静而安宁。

surge.example: There was a sudden surge in demand for electricity during the cold winter.
surge.exampleZh: 寒冷的冬天里，用电需求突然激增。

surgeon.example: The surgeon washed her hands carefully before the operation began.
surgeon.exampleZh: 手术开始前，这位外科医生仔细地洗了手。

surgery.example: The doctor said I need surgery on my knee next week.
surgery.exampleZh: 医生说我下周需要做膝盖手术。

surpass.example: Her new book is likely to surpass all her earlier works in popularity.
surpass.exampleZh: 她的新书在受欢迎程度上可能会超过她之前所有的作品。

surplus.example: The country sold its surplus grain to other nations last year.
surplus.exampleZh: 去年，这个国家把多余的粮食卖给了其他国家。

surprise.example: The news was a big surprise to everyone in my family.
surprise.exampleZh: 这个消息对我家每个人来说都是一个大惊喜。

surprising.example: It is surprising that he finished the test so quickly.
surprising.exampleZh: 他这么快就完成了测试，这令人惊讶。

surrender.example: He refused to surrender even when his team was losing the game.
surrender.exampleZh: 即使他的球队快输了，他也拒绝认输。

surround.example: Many tall trees surround the small house on the hill.
surround.exampleZh: 许多高大的树木环绕着山上的那座小屋。

survey.example: The team will survey local farmers about their water use next month.
survey.exampleZh: 团队下个月将就用水情况调查当地农民。

survival.example: The survival of the small village depends on clean water and food.
survival.exampleZh: 这个小村庄的存续依赖干净的水和食物。

survive.example: Only two people survived the fire, and they were badly hurt.
survive.exampleZh: 只有两个人在这场火灾中幸存下来，而且他们伤得很重。

suspect.example: The police suspect that the man stole the money from the shop.
suspect.exampleZh: 警方怀疑这名男子从商店里偷了钱。

suspend.example: The school will suspend classes for two days because of the storm.
suspend.exampleZh: 因为暴风雨，学校将暂停上课两天。

suspicion.example: Her strange behavior raised my suspicion about the whole story.
suspicion.exampleZh: 她奇怪的举动让我对整个故事产生了怀疑。

sustain.example: Good food and enough sleep help us sustain our energy at work.
sustain.exampleZh: 充足的食物和睡眠有助于我们维持工作中的精力。

swallow.example: It is hard to swallow such a bitter pill, but she smiled and said nothing.
swallow.exampleZh: 很难咽下这样一颗苦药丸，但她笑了笑什么也没说。

swamp.example: Heavy rain can swamp the small boat in minutes.
swamp.exampleZh: 大雨能在几分钟内淹没这艘小船。

swap.example: I will swap my old phone for a new one today.
swap.exampleZh: 我今天要用旧手机换一部新手机。

swarm.example: A swarm of bees flew over the garden and landed on the old tree.
swarm.exampleZh: 一大群蜜蜂飞过花园，落在了那棵老树上。

sway.example: The tall trees sway gently in the wind every afternoon.
sway.exampleZh: 高高的树木每天下午都在风中轻轻摇摆。

swear.example: I swear I will keep your secret forever.
swear.exampleZh: 我发誓我会永远保守你的秘密。

sweep.example: His eyes sweep the room quickly and he finds the lost key.
sweep.exampleZh: 他的目光迅速扫视房间，找到了丢失的钥匙。

sweet.example: This cake is very sweet, and the children love it.
sweet.exampleZh: 这个蛋糕很甜，孩子们都很喜欢它。

swell.example: My ankle began to swell after I fell on the stairs.
swell.exampleZh: 我在楼梯上摔倒后，脚踝开始肿了起来。

swift.example: Her swift reply surprised everyone in the room.
swift.exampleZh: 她迅速的回复让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

swim.example: My sister can swim very well, but she cannot float for long.
swim.exampleZh: 我妹妹游泳游得很好，但她不能漂浮很久。

swing.example: The children like to swing on the old rope in the garden.
swing.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里的旧绳子上荡秋千。

switch.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the office.
switch.exampleZh: 离开办公室前请把灯关掉。

sword.example: The brave knight carried a long sword into the dark forest.
sword.exampleZh: 那位勇敢的骑士带着一把长剑走进了黑暗的森林。

symbol.example: The dove is a symbol of peace in many cultures.
symbol.exampleZh: 在许多文化中，鸽子是和平的象征。

sympathy.example: I felt deep sympathy for the old man who lost his dog.
sympathy.exampleZh: 我对那位失去爱犬的老人深感同情。

symptom.example: A cough and a fever are common symptoms of a cold.
symptom.exampleZh: 咳嗽和发烧是感冒的常见症状。

system.example: The school has a new system for keeping student records safe.
system.exampleZh: 学校有了一套保存学生记录的新系统。

systematic.example: She keeps a systematic record of all her daily work.
systematic.exampleZh: 她对每天的所有工作都做系统的记录。

table.example: Please put the books on the table before we start our class.
table.exampleZh: 请在我们上课前把这些书放在桌子上。

tablet.example: The doctor told me to take one tablet with water after breakfast.
tablet.exampleZh: 医生告诉我早饭后用水服用一片药片。

tackle.example: The police must tackle this problem before it gets worse.
tackle.exampleZh: 警方必须在这个问题变得更糟之前处理它。

tactics.example: The team changed their tactics after losing the first game.
tactics.exampleZh: 球队在输掉第一场比赛后改变了战术。

tag.example: The teacher put a name tag on every new student's desk.
tag.exampleZh: 老师在每个新学生的课桌上放了一个姓名标签。

tail.example: The dog wagged its tail and ran to the door.
tail.exampleZh: 狗摇了摇尾巴，然后跑向门口。

tailor.example: The tailor made a new suit for my father last week.
tailor.exampleZh: 裁缝上周为我父亲做了一套新西装。

take.example: It takes about twenty minutes to walk to the station from my house.
take.exampleZh: 从我家步行到车站大约需要二十分钟。

takeover.example: The company announced a takeover of its smaller rival last week.
takeover.exampleZh: 该公司上周宣布收购其规模较小的竞争对手。

tale.example: My grandmother told me a funny tale about her old village.
tale.exampleZh: 我奶奶给我讲了一个关于她老家村庄的有趣故事。

talent.example: She has a real talent for drawing and loves to paint every day.
talent.exampleZh: 她在绘画方面很有天赋，每天都喜欢画画。

talented.example: She is a talented young singer and everyone loves her songs.
talented.exampleZh: 她是一位有天赋的年轻歌手，大家都喜欢她的歌。

talk.example: We often talk about our plans after dinner.
talk.exampleZh: 我们经常在晚饭后谈论我们的计划。

tall.example: My brother is very tall and plays basketball well.
tall.exampleZh: 我弟弟个子很高，篮球打得很好。

tame.example: The wild horse became tame after the farmer fed it for many weeks.
tame.exampleZh: 农夫喂养了这只野马好几个星期后，它变得温顺了。

tap.example: She gave the door a gentle tap and waited for an answer.
tap.exampleZh: 她轻轻敲了敲门，等着有人回应。

tape.example: Please put the tape on the box before you send it.
tape.exampleZh: 寄出之前请把胶带贴在箱子上。

target.example: Our main target is to finish the work before Friday.
target.exampleZh: 我们的主要目标是在周五前完成这项工作。

tariff.example: The new tariff on imported cars made them more expensive for many families.
tariff.exampleZh: 进口汽车的新关税使它们对许多家庭来说更贵了。

task.example: My first task today is to check all the emails.
task.exampleZh: 我今天的第一项任务是查看所有邮件。

taste.example: This soup tastes really good with a little salt and fresh pepper.
taste.exampleZh: 这汤加一点盐和新鲜胡椒尝起来真不错。

tax.example: The government plans to tax large companies more and cut taxes for small businesses.
tax.exampleZh: 政府计划对大公司征收更多税，并为小企业减税。

taxi.example: We took a taxi to the airport early this morning.
taxi.exampleZh: 今天一大早我们坐出租车去了机场。

tea.example: I drink a cup of hot tea every morning before work.
tea.exampleZh: 我每天早上上班前都喝一杯热茶。

teach.example: My mother teaches English to children at a small school.
teach.exampleZh: 我妈妈在一所小学校教孩子们英语。

team.example: Our team works well together and finishes every project on time.
team.exampleZh: 我们的团队合作得很好，每个项目都能按时完成。

tear.example: Tears ran down her face as she tore the old letter in half.
tear.exampleZh: 她一边把旧信撕成两半，一边泪流满面。

tease.example: My brother likes to tease me about my new haircut.
tease.exampleZh: 我哥哥喜欢拿我的新发型取笑我。

technical.example: The technical part of this job is hard for new workers.
technical.exampleZh: 这项工作中技术性的部分对新员工来说很难。

technician.example: The technician fixed our computer in less than an hour.
technician.exampleZh: 那位技术员不到一小时就修好了我们的电脑。

technique.example: The teacher showed us a simple technique for drawing faces.
technique.exampleZh: 老师教了我们一个画脸的简单技巧。

technology.example: Modern technology makes it easy for us to talk with friends far away.
technology.exampleZh: 现代技术让我们很容易与远方的朋友交谈。

tedious.example: The long meeting was tedious and everyone wanted to leave early.
tedious.exampleZh: 那场漫长的会议冗长乏味，大家都想早点离开。

teenage.example: My teenage brother likes to play basketball with his friends after school.
teenage.exampleZh: 我十几岁的弟弟喜欢放学后和朋友们打篮球。

teenager.example: As a teenager, he liked to play basketball with his friends.
teenager.exampleZh: 青少年时，他喜欢和朋友们一起打篮球。

telegram.example: My grandfather sent a telegram to our family when he arrived in the city.
telegram.exampleZh: 我祖父到达城里后给我们家发了一封电报。

telephone.example: I use my telephone to call my mother every Sunday morning.
telephone.exampleZh: 我每周日早上都用电话给我妈妈打电话。

telescope.example: My grandfather uses an old telescope to look at the stars at night.
telescope.exampleZh: 我爷爷用一架旧望远镜在夜里看星星。

television.example: My family watches television together after dinner every evening.
television.exampleZh: 我们一家人每天晚饭后一起看电视。

tell.example: Can you tell me how to get to the train station?
tell.exampleZh: 你能告诉我怎么去火车站吗？

temper.example: He lost his temper when the slow computer crashed again.
temper.exampleZh: 那台慢电脑再次死机时，他发了脾气。

temperament.example: Her calm temperament makes her very popular with the children.
temperament.exampleZh: 她温和的性情让她很受孩子们欢迎。

temperature.example: The doctor said his temperature is a little high today.
temperature.exampleZh: 医生说他今天体温有点高。

temple.example: There is an old temple on the top of that green hill.
temple.exampleZh: 那座绿色小山的山顶上有一座古老的庙。

temporary.example: This is only a temporary job for the summer.
temporary.exampleZh: 这只是夏天的一份临时工作。

tempt.example: The smell of fresh bread tempted me to stop at the bakery.
tempt.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的香味诱使我在那家面包店停了下来。

tenant.example: The tenant pays the rent on the first day of each month.
tenant.exampleZh: 房客在每个月的第一天交房租。

tend.example: I tend to drink coffee in the morning and tea at night.
tend.exampleZh: 我早上往往喝咖啡，晚上喝茶。

tendency.example: He has a tendency to talk too much when he is nervous.
tendency.exampleZh: 他一紧张就有说太多话的倾向。

tender.example: She gave the little boy a tender smile and held his hand.
tender.exampleZh: 她给了这个小男孩一个温柔的微笑，并握住了他的手。

tennis.example: My sister plays tennis with her friends every Saturday morning.
tennis.exampleZh: 我姐姐每个星期六早上和朋友们打网球。

tense.example: The room felt tense before the exam started.
tense.exampleZh: 考试开始前，房间里气氛很紧张。

tension.example: The tension in the room grew as they waited for the final result.
tension.exampleZh: 当他们等待最终结果时，房间里的紧张气氛加剧了。

tent.example: We put up a tent near the river and slept there.
tent.exampleZh: 我们在河边搭了一个帐篷，并在那里睡觉。

tentative.example: We made a tentative plan to meet on Friday after work.
tentative.exampleZh: 我们暂时定了一个周五下班后见面的计划。

term.example: We learned many new terms in English class this term.
term.exampleZh: 这学期我们在英语课上学了很多新术语。

terminal.example: The doctor said his illness is now in its terminal stage.
terminal.exampleZh: 医生说他的病现在已进入晚期。

terminate.example: They plan to terminate the contract at the end of this month.
terminate.exampleZh: 他们计划在本月底终止这份合同。

terrible.example: The weather was terrible, so we stayed home all day.
terrible.exampleZh: 天气糟透了，所以我们整天都待在家里。

territory.example: The small island became part of our national territory last year.
territory.exampleZh: 那座小岛去年成为了我国领土的一部分。

terror.example: The loud noise filled the small children with terror.
terror.exampleZh: 巨大的响声让小孩子充满恐惧。

test.example: The doctor will test your blood and tell you the result tomorrow.
test.exampleZh: 医生会化验你的血液，明天告诉你结果。

testify.example: Two witnesses will testify in court about the accident tomorrow.
testify.exampleZh: 两名证人明天将在法庭上就这起事故作证。

testimony.example: Her testimony in court helped the judge understand what really happened that night.
testimony.exampleZh: 她在法庭上的证词帮助法官了解了那晚真正发生的事情。

text.example: Please read the text on page ten and answer the questions.
text.exampleZh: 请阅读第十页的课文并回答问题。

textbook.example: I forgot my textbook at home, so I shared one with my classmate.
textbook.exampleZh: 我把课本忘在家里了，所以和同学一起看一本。

textile.example: This factory makes cheap textiles for shops in many countries.
textile.exampleZh: 这家工厂为许多国家的商店生产便宜的纺织品。

texture.example: This bread has a soft texture and tastes very good.
texture.exampleZh: 这个面包质地松软，味道很好。

than.example: My brother is taller than me, but I run faster than him.
than.exampleZh: 我哥哥比我高，但我跑得比他快。

thank.example: I want to thank you for your help with my homework.
thank.exampleZh: 我想感谢你帮我做作业。

that.example: I think that book on the desk is mine.
that.exampleZh: 我认为桌上那本书是我的。

theater.example: We went to the theater on Saturday to see a new play.
theater.exampleZh: 我们周六去剧院看了一部新戏。

their.example: The children put their books on the table before going outside to play.
their.exampleZh: 孩子们出去玩耍之前把他们的书放在了桌子上。

them.example: I gave the books to them after school yesterday.
them.exampleZh: 昨天放学后我把这些书给了他们。

theme.example: The theme of today's class is how plants grow in spring.
theme.exampleZh: 今天这节课的主题是植物在春天如何生长。

themselves.example: The children made the cake by themselves and cleaned the kitchen afterwards.
themselves.exampleZh: 孩子们自己做了蛋糕，之后又打扫了厨房。

then.example: I was still a student then, and life was very simple.
then.exampleZh: 那时我还是个学生，生活非常简单。

theory.example: His theory explains why the sky looks blue on clear days.
theory.exampleZh: 他的理论解释了为什么晴天时天空看起来是蓝色的。

therapy.example: She goes to therapy every week to talk about her feelings.
therapy.exampleZh: 她每周都去做心理治疗，谈谈自己的感受。

there.example: Put the box over there next to the door.
there.exampleZh: 把箱子放到门旁边的那个地方。

thereby.example: He saved money every month, thereby paying off his debt in a year.
thereby.exampleZh: 他每个月都存钱，因此在一年内还清了债务。

therefore.example: It was raining hard, therefore we stayed at home all day.
therefore.exampleZh: 雨下得很大，因此我们整天都待在家里。

thick.example: The ice on the lake is very thick, so we can walk on it.
thick.exampleZh: 湖上的冰很厚，所以我们可以走在上面。

thief.example: The thief stole her bag while she was waiting for the bus.
thief.exampleZh: 小偷在她等公交车时偷走了她的包。

thin.example: The ice on the lake is too thin to walk on safely.
thin.exampleZh: 湖面上的冰太薄了，走在上面不安全。

thing.example: I have many things to do at home today.
thing.exampleZh: 我今天在家里有很多事情要做。

think.example: I think it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
think.exampleZh: 我认为明天下午会下雨。

third.example: Her office is on the third floor of the building.
third.exampleZh: 她的办公室在这栋楼的第三层。

thirst.example: After the long run, his thirst for water was very strong.
thirst.exampleZh: 长跑之后，他非常口渴，很想喝水。

thirteen.example: My sister is thirteen years old and she loves playing basketball.
thirteen.exampleZh: 我妹妹十三岁，她喜欢打篮球。

thirty.example: My mother is thirty years old and she works in a small shop.
thirty.exampleZh: 我妈妈三十岁，她在一家小商店工作。

this.example: This is my new notebook, and I use it every day.
this.exampleZh: 这是我的新笔记本，我每天都用它。

thorn.example: Be careful, because a sharp thorn on that rose can hurt your finger.
thorn.exampleZh: 小心，那朵玫瑰上的尖刺会扎伤你的手指。

thorough.example: The doctor did a thorough check before giving me any medicine.
thorough.exampleZh: 医生在给我开药前做了全面的检查。

those.example: Those are my books on the desk.

though.example: Though the task was hard, we finished it on time.
though.exampleZh: 虽然这项任务很难，我们还是按时完成了。

thought.example: Her kind thought made my whole day feel brighter.
thought.exampleZh: 她的善意关怀让我一整天都感觉更温暖。

thousand.example: There are about a thousand students in our school this year.
thousand.exampleZh: 我们学校今年大约有一千名学生。

thread.example: She lost the thread of the story and asked him to repeat it.
thread.exampleZh: 她跟不上故事的思路了，让他再讲一遍。

threat.example: The dark clouds are a threat of heavy rain today.
threat.exampleZh: 乌云是今天将有大雨的征兆。

threaten.example: Dark clouds threaten rain, so we should go home now.
threaten.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以我们现在应该回家。

three.example: My little sister is three years old and she loves to sing.
three.exampleZh: 我妹妹三岁了，她喜欢唱歌。

threshold.example: She paused at the threshold before entering the bright room.
threshold.exampleZh: 她在进入明亮的房间前在门槛处停了一下。

thrill.example: The news of the trip gave the children a big thrill.
thrill.exampleZh: 旅行的消息让孩子们非常兴奋。

thrive.example: These small plants thrive when they get enough sun and water.
thrive.exampleZh: 这些植物在阳光和水充足时会长得很茂盛。

throat.example: My throat hurts, so I cannot speak loudly today.
throat.exampleZh: 我的喉咙疼，所以今天我没法大声说话。

throne.example: The young king sat on his throne and smiled at the crowd.
throne.exampleZh: 年轻的国王坐在宝座上，向人群微笑。

through.example: We walked through the quiet park and then went home.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过安静的公园，然后回家了。

throughout.example: The museum is famous throughout the world for its ancient art.
throughout.exampleZh: 这家博物馆因其古代艺术品而闻名于世。

throw.example: He likes to throw the ball to his dog in the park.
throw.exampleZh: 他喜欢在公园里把球扔给他的狗。

thrust.example: He thrust the key into the lock and opened the door quickly.
thrust.exampleZh: 他把钥匙插进锁里，迅速打开了门。

thumb.example: She hurt her thumb while cooking, then thumbed through an old cookbook.
thumb.exampleZh: 她做饭时弄伤了拇指，然后翻查了一本旧食谱。

thunder.example: The loud thunder scared the little dog and it ran under the bed.
thunder.exampleZh: 响亮的雷声吓到了小狗，它跑到了床底下。

thus.example: The road was closed, and thus we had to take a longer way home.
thus.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不绕远路回家。

ticket.example: I bought two tickets for the movie tonight.
ticket.exampleZh: 我买了两张今晚的电影票。

tide.example: The tide comes in and goes out twice every day.

tidy.example: She keeps her desk tidy and puts all the books away.
tidy.exampleZh: 她把书桌保持得很整洁，并把所有的书都收起来。

tie.example: He wore a blue tie and tied his shoes before the meeting.
tie.exampleZh: 开会前，他系了一条蓝色领带，并系好了鞋带。

tiger.example: The tiger is a big wild cat that lives in the forest.
tiger.exampleZh: 老虎是一种生活在森林里的大型野生猫科动物。

tight.example: Hold the rope tight and do not let it go.

tile.example: They will tile the bathroom floor with small white tiles.
tile.exampleZh: 他们将用白色小瓷砖铺浴室地板。

till.example: Please wait here till I come back with the money.
till.exampleZh: 请在这里等到我带着钱回来。

timber.example: The old house was built with strong timber from the local forest.
timber.exampleZh: 这座老房子是用当地森林里结实的木材建造的。

time.example: I do not have much time to finish my work today.
time.exampleZh: 我今天没有太多时间完成我的工作。

tin.example: The old box is made of tin and is very light.
tin.exampleZh: 这个旧盒子是用锡做的，非常轻。

tip.example: She gave the waiter a tip and thanked him for his help.
tip.exampleZh: 她给了服务员小费，并感谢他的帮助。

tire.example: After the long drive, my tires were worn and I began to tire quickly.
tire.exampleZh: 长途驾驶后，我的轮胎磨损了，我也开始很快感到疲倦。

tissue.example: The doctor looked at the tissue under a microscope to find the problem.
tissue.exampleZh: 医生在显微镜下观察这块组织，以找出问题所在。

title.example: The title of his new book is easy to remember.
title.exampleZh: 他那本新书的标题很容易记住。

toast.example: I like to eat toast with butter and drink a cup of hot tea.
toast.exampleZh: 我喜欢吃抹了黄油的烤面包，再喝一杯热茶。

tobacco.example: The farmer grows tobacco on his land and sells it to a local company.
tobacco.exampleZh: 这位农民在自己的土地上种植烟草，然后把它卖给当地的一家公司。

today.example: The weather is very nice today, so we can walk to the park.
today.exampleZh: 今天天气很好，所以我们可以走路去公园。

toe.example: I hurt my toe when I kicked the ball this morning.
toe.exampleZh: 今天早上我踢球时伤到了脚趾。

together.example: We often cook dinner together and talk about our day.
together.exampleZh: 我们经常一起做晚饭，聊聊各自的一天。

toilet.example: The toilet on the second floor is clean and easy to find.
toilet.exampleZh: 二楼的厕所在哪里很干净，也很容易找到。

token.example: The gift was a small token of our thanks for your help.
token.exampleZh: 这份礼物是我们对你帮助的一点小小谢意。

tolerance.example: My teacher has great tolerance for students who ask many questions.
tolerance.exampleZh: 我的老师对问很多问题的学生很有宽容心。

tolerate.example: My teacher cannot tolerate loud noise during the exam.
tolerate.exampleZh: 我的老师无法容忍考试期间的吵闹声。

tomato.example: I put a red tomato in my salad for lunch today.
tomato.exampleZh: 我今天午餐在沙拉里放了一个红色的西红柿。

tomb.example: We walked slowly past the old tomb behind the small church.
tomb.exampleZh: 我们慢慢走过小教堂后面那座古老的坟墓。

tomorrow.example: I will see you tomorrow at the school gate.
tomorrow.exampleZh: 我明天在学校门口见你。

ton.example: This truck can carry about ten tons of coal every day.
ton.exampleZh: 这辆卡车每天能运大约十吨煤。

tone.example: Her gentle tone made the difficult news easier to hear.
tone.exampleZh: 她温柔的语气让这个难以接受的消息更容易听进去。

tongue.example: She burned her tongue on the hot soup and could not speak clearly.
tongue.exampleZh: 她被热汤烫到了舌头，说话都不清楚了。

tonight.example: I will finish my homework tonight and then watch a movie with my family.
tonight.exampleZh: 我今晚会完成作业，然后和家人一起看电影。

too.example: This soup is too hot for me, and it is too salty too.
too.exampleZh: 这汤对我来说太烫了，而且也太咸了。

tool.example: A hammer is a simple tool that helps us build things.
tool.exampleZh: 锤子是一种帮助我们建造东西的简单工具。

tooth.example: The dentist said I should brush every tooth twice a day.
tooth.exampleZh: 牙医说我应该每天刷每颗牙齿两次。

top.example: She put the book on the top shelf and left the room.
top.exampleZh: 她把书放在最上层的架子上，然后离开了房间。

topic.example: The topic of today's class is very interesting to me.
topic.exampleZh: 今天课上的话题对我来说很有意思。

torch.example: She used a torch to find her way in the dark woods.
torch.exampleZh: 她在黑暗的树林里用手电筒找路。

torment.example: She could not sleep because the bad memories began to torment her again.
torment.exampleZh: 她睡不着，因为那些糟糕的回忆又开始折磨她。

torrent.example: A torrent of water rushed down the mountain after the heavy rain.
torrent.exampleZh: 大雨过后，一股激流从山上冲了下来。

torture.example: The bad news tortured him for many days, and he could not sleep.
torture.exampleZh: 这个坏消息折磨了他很多天，他无法入睡。

toss.example: She tossed the keys to me and smiled.
toss.exampleZh: 她把钥匙扔给我，笑了笑。

total.example: The total cost of the trip was more than we expected.
total.exampleZh: 这次旅行的总费用超出了我们的预期。

touch.example: Please do not touch the wet paint on the wall.
touch.exampleZh: 请不要触摸墙上未干的油漆。

tough.example: It was a tough job, but she never gave up.
tough.exampleZh: 那是份艰难的工作，但她从未放弃。

tour.example: The band will tour three cities next month and then return home.
tour.exampleZh: 乐队下个月将在三座城市巡回演出，然后回家。

tourist.example: The tourist took many photos of the old bridge in the city.
tourist.exampleZh: 这位游客拍了很多这座城市那座古老桥梁的照片。

tournament.example: Our school will hold a chess tournament next week.
tournament.exampleZh: 我们学校下周将举办一场国际象棋锦标赛。

toward.example: She walked slowly toward the door and smiled at me.
toward.exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝门口走去，并对我笑了笑。

toward(s).example: She walked slowly toward the door and smiled at her old friend.
toward(s).exampleZh: 她慢慢地朝门口走去，并对她的老朋友微笑。

towel.example: After the shower, I wiped my face with a clean towel.
towel.exampleZh: 洗完澡后，我用一条干净的毛巾擦了擦脸。

tower.example: The old tower stands near the river and is very tall.
tower.exampleZh: 这座古老的塔矗立在河边，非常高。

town.example: My grandparents live in a small town near the river.
town.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一个小镇上。

toy.example: The little boy got a new toy car for his birthday.
toy.exampleZh: 这个小男孩生日时得到了一辆新的玩具车。

trace.example: The police found no trace of the missing car near the river.
trace.exampleZh: 警方在河边没有找到失踪汽车的踪迹。

track.example: The dog followed the track of the rabbit through the snow.
track.exampleZh: 那只狗沿着兔子在雪地里留下的踪迹一路追踪。

trade.example: The two countries trade goods with each other every year.
trade.exampleZh: 这两个国家每年互相进行货物贸易。

tradition.example: It is a family tradition to eat noodles together on New Year's Day.
tradition.exampleZh: 在新年第一天一起吃面条是我们家的传统。

traffic.example: The traffic is very heavy on this road every morning.
traffic.exampleZh: 每天早上这条路上的交通都非常拥堵。

tragedy.example: The fire was a great tragedy for the whole small town.
tragedy.exampleZh: 这场火灾对整个小镇来说是一场巨大的灾难。

trail.example: The dog followed the trail of the fox through the deep snow.
trail.exampleZh: 那只狗在厚厚的雪地里循着狐狸留下的踪迹前行。

train.example: She takes the train to work, and she trains new workers every Friday.
train.exampleZh: 她坐火车上班，而且每周五培训新员工。

trait.example: Patience is a good trait for a teacher to have.
trait.exampleZh: 耐心是老师应该具备的一种好品质。

transfer.example: I need to transfer some money to my sister today.
transfer.exampleZh: 我今天需要转一些钱给我妹妹。

transform.example: The internet has transformed the way we learn and share ideas.
transform.exampleZh: 互联网改变了我们学习和分享想法的方式。

translate.example: She asked me to translate the letter into simple English for her.
translate.exampleZh: 她让我把这封信翻译成简单的英语给她。

transmission.example: The transmission of the disease is faster in crowded places.
transmission.exampleZh: 这种疾病在拥挤的地方传播得更快。

transmit.example: Mosquitoes can transmit this disease from one person to another.
transmit.exampleZh: 蚊子能把这种疾病从一个人传播给另一个人。

transparent.example: The glass bottle is transparent, so we can see the water inside.
transparent.exampleZh: 这个玻璃瓶是透明的，所以我们可以看到里面的水。

transport.example: The city uses buses to transport people to work every day.
transport.exampleZh: 这座城市每天用公交车运送人们去上班。

trap.example: The old mouse was smart enough to avoid the trap in the kitchen.
trap.exampleZh: 那只老老鼠很聪明，避开了厨房里的陷阱。

travel.example: She likes to travel by train with her family every summer.
travel.exampleZh: 她喜欢每年夏天和家人一起坐火车旅行。

tray.example: She put the cups on a tray and carried them to the table.
tray.exampleZh: 她把杯子放在托盘上，端到了桌子旁。

treasure.example: She treasures the old letters from her mother very much.
treasure.exampleZh: 她非常珍视母亲写给她的那些旧信。

treat.example: The kind doctor will treat the sick children and give them small gifts.
treat.exampleZh: 这位善良的医生会治疗这些生病的孩子，还会送给他们小礼物。

treatment.example: The doctor said my treatment would take about two weeks.
treatment.exampleZh: 医生说我这个治疗大约需要两周。

treaty.example: The two countries signed a treaty to keep peace in the region.
treaty.exampleZh: 两国签署了一项条约，以维护该地区的和平。

tree.example: There is a big tree in front of my house.

tremble.example: She began to tremble with fear when she heard the strange noise.
tremble.exampleZh: 听到那奇怪的声音时，她害怕得开始发抖。

tremendous.example: This movie is a tremendous success, and everyone in our class loves it.
tremendous.exampleZh: 这部电影取得了巨大的成功，我们班上每个人都很喜欢它。

trench.example: The farmers dug a deep trench to bring water to their fields.
trench.exampleZh: 农民们挖了一条深沟，把水引到田里。

trend.example: There is a growing trend for young people to shop online.
trend.exampleZh: 年轻人网购的趋势正在增长。

trial.example: The new drug is still on trial and may help many patients.
trial.exampleZh: 这种新药仍在试验中，可能会帮助许多病人。

triangle.example: The children drew a red triangle on the paper.
triangle.exampleZh: 孩子们在纸上画了一个红色的三角形。

trick.example: He used a clever trick to open the old box.
trick.exampleZh: 他用一个巧妙的窍门打开了那个旧盒子。

trifle.example: Don't waste time arguing about such a trifle.
trifle.exampleZh: 别把时间浪费在争论这种琐事上。

trim.example: She trimmed the bushes in her garden and made them look neat.
trim.exampleZh: 她修剪了花园里的灌木，使它们看起来很整齐。

trip.example: Be careful not to trip on that rock during your trip.
trip.exampleZh: 旅行时小心不要被那块石头绊倒。

triumph.example: Her hard work and patience finally led her to triumph over many difficulties.
triumph.exampleZh: 她的努力和耐心最终使她战胜了许多困难，取得了成功。

troop.example: A troop of soldiers marched slowly down the road.
troop.exampleZh: 一队士兵沿着道路缓慢行军。

tropical.example: Tropical fruit like bananas and mangoes grow well in hot, wet places.
tropical.exampleZh: 香蕉和芒果等热带水果在炎热潮湿的地方生长得很好。

trouble.example: I had trouble finding the station, so I asked a policeman for help.
trouble.exampleZh: 我找车站遇到了困难，所以向一位警察求助。

trousers.example: He wears black trousers to work every day.
trousers.exampleZh: 他每天穿黑色长裤上班。

truck.example: The truck is carrying a lot of boxes to the city.
truck.exampleZh: 这辆卡车正载着许多箱子前往城里。

true.example: Her story is true, and everyone in the room believed it.
true.exampleZh: 她的故事是真的，房间里的每个人都相信了。

trust.example: I trust my best friend because he always tells me the truth.
trust.exampleZh: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为他总是对我说实话。

truth.example: She always tells the truth, even when it is hard.
truth.exampleZh: 她总是说实话，即使很难。

try.example: I will try to finish my work before dinner today.
try.exampleZh: 我会努力在今天晚饭前完成我的工作。

tube.example: The water flows through a long plastic tube under the sink.
tube.exampleZh: 水从水槽下面一根长长的塑料管中流过。

tumor.example: The doctor found a small tumor in his lung last week.
tumor.exampleZh: 上周医生在他的肺部发现了一个小肿瘤。

tune.example: She hummed a soft tune while she cleaned the kitchen.
tune.exampleZh: 她一边打扫厨房，一边轻轻哼着柔和的曲调。

tunnel.example: The train goes through a long tunnel under the mountain.
tunnel.exampleZh: 火车穿过山下一段长长的隧道。

turkey.example: The turkey in the oven is too big for our small table.
turkey.exampleZh: 烤箱里的火鸡对我们的这张小桌子来说太大了。

turn.example: Please turn the wheel slowly and then wait for your turn.
turn.exampleZh: 请慢慢转动方向盘，然后等待轮到您。

turtle.example: The turtle swam slowly across the clear blue water near the beach.
turtle.exampleZh: 那只海龟在沙滩附近清澈蔚蓝的水中缓缓游动。

tutor.example: My tutor helps me with math every Tuesday afternoon.
tutor.exampleZh: 我的导师每周二下午帮我辅导数学。

twelfth.example: My birthday is on the twelfth day of May this year.
twelfth.exampleZh: 我今年的生日在五月十二日。

twelve.example: There are twelve months in a year and twelve hours on a clock.
twelve.exampleZh: 一年有十二个月，时钟上有十二个小时。

twenty.example: There are twenty students in our class this year.
twenty.exampleZh: 今年我们班有二十名学生。

twice.example: I read the book twice before the test.
twice.exampleZh: 考试前我把这本书读了两遍。

twin.example: My twin brother and I look the same, but we have different hobbies.
twin.exampleZh: 我的双胞胎哥哥和我长得一样，但我们的爱好不同。

twist.example: She had to twist the lid hard to open the jar.
twist.exampleZh: 她不得不使劲拧盖子才能打开罐子。

two.example: I have two brothers and one sister in my family.
two.exampleZh: 我家有两个兄弟和一个姐妹。

type.example: This type of book is easy to read and very useful for beginners.
type.exampleZh: 这种类型的书通俗易懂，对初学者非常有用。

typical.example: This is a typical day in our small office.
typical.exampleZh: 这是我们小办公室里典型的一天。

typist.example: The typist finished the long report before lunch.
typist.exampleZh: 打字员在午饭前完成了那份长报告。

tyre.example: My bike has a flat tyre, so I must walk to school today.
tyre.exampleZh: 我的自行车轮胎瘪了，所以今天我必须走路去学校。

ugly.example: That old building is really ugly, but it is still very useful.
ugly.exampleZh: 那座旧楼确实很难看，但它仍然非常有用。

ultimate.example: Winning this game is our ultimate goal for the season.
ultimate.exampleZh: 赢得这场比赛是我们本赛季的最终目标。

ultraviolet.example: Ultraviolet light from the sun can hurt your eyes and skin.
ultraviolet.exampleZh: 来自太阳的紫外线会伤害你的眼睛和皮肤。

umbrella.example: Take an umbrella with you because it may rain this afternoon.
umbrella.exampleZh: 带把伞吧，因为今天下午可能会下雨。

unable.example: I am unable to answer the phone right now.

unanimous.example: The group was unanimous in its decision to start the meeting early.
unanimous.exampleZh: 这个小组一致同意提前开始会议。

uncertain.example: I am uncertain about the right time to call her.
uncertain.exampleZh: 我不确定该在什么时间给她打电话才合适。

uncle.example: My uncle lives in a small town near the sea.
uncle.exampleZh: 我叔叔住在海边的一个小镇上。

uncover.example: The police finally uncovered the truth about the missing money.
uncover.exampleZh: 警方最终揭开了那笔失踪钱款的真相。

under.example: The cat is sleeping under the warm table in the kitchen.
under.exampleZh: 那只猫正睡在厨房里温暖的桌子下面。

undergo.example: She had to undergo surgery after the accident last year.
undergo.exampleZh: 去年那场事故后，她不得不接受手术。

undergraduate.example: She is an undergraduate at a small university in the north.
undergraduate.exampleZh: 她是北方一所小型大学的本科生。

underground.example: Many people in this big city take the underground to work every day.
underground.exampleZh: 这座大城市里很多人每天乘地铁上班。

underlie.example: Trust and respect underlie every good friendship between two people.
underlie.exampleZh: 信任和尊重是两个人之间每一段良好友谊的基础。

underline.example: Please underline the important words in this sentence before you read it aloud.
underline.exampleZh: 请在你大声朗读这个句子之前，先给其中的重要单词画下划线。

understand.example: I can understand why she wants to leave this job.
understand.exampleZh: 我能理解她为什么想辞掉这份工作。

understanding.example: A good teacher needs patience and a real understanding of students.
understanding.exampleZh: 一位好老师需要耐心和对学生的真正理解。

undertake.example: She agreed to undertake the difficult task alone.
undertake.exampleZh: 她同意独自承担这项艰巨的任务。

undo.example: He tried to undo the knot but it was too tight.
undo.exampleZh: 他试图解开那个结，但它太紧了。

undoubtedly.example: She is undoubtedly the best player on our team this year.
undoubtedly.exampleZh: 她无疑是今年我们队里最出色的球员。

uneasy.example: She felt uneasy walking home alone late at night.
uneasy.exampleZh: 深夜独自走回家时，她感到不安。

unemployment.example: Unemployment is rising and many young people cannot find good jobs.
unemployment.exampleZh: 失业率在上升，许多年轻人找不到好工作。

unexpected.example: The sudden rain was unexpected, so we ran home very fast.
unexpected.exampleZh: 这场突如其来的雨让人意想不到，所以我们飞快地跑回了家。

unfair.example: It is unfair to blame the whole team for one small mistake.
unfair.exampleZh: 因为一个小错误就责怪整个团队是不公平的。

unfit.example: He is unfit for this job because he lacks experience.
unfit.exampleZh: 他不适合这份工作，因为他缺乏经验。

unfold.example: The story will unfold slowly as we read more pages.
unfold.exampleZh: 随着我们读更多的书页，这个故事会慢慢展开。

unfortunate.example: It was unfortunate that we lost the game on the last minute.
unfortunate.exampleZh: 很遗憾，我们在最后一分钟输掉了比赛。

unhappy.example: She was unhappy because her best friend moved to another city.
unhappy.exampleZh: 她很不快乐，因为她最好的朋友搬到了另一座城市。

uniform.example: All the students wear a blue and white uniform to school every day.
uniform.exampleZh: 所有学生每天穿蓝白相间的校服去上学。

union.example: The workers formed a union to ask for better pay.
union.exampleZh: 工人们成立了工会，要求提高工资。

unique.example: Each person has a unique way of thinking and solving problems.
unique.exampleZh: 每个人都有独特的思考方式和解决问题的方式。

unit.example: Our class is the smallest unit in the school science project.
unit.exampleZh: 我们班是学校科学项目中最小的单位。

unite.example: The two small groups decided to unite and form one strong team.
unite.exampleZh: 两个小团体决定联合起来，组成一个强大的团队。

unity.example: The team's unity helped them win the game.
unity.exampleZh: 团队的团结帮助他们赢得了比赛。

universal.example: The idea of fairness is universal and people everywhere understand it.
universal.exampleZh: 公平这一理念是普遍的，各地的人们都能理解它。

universe.example: The universe is full of stars and planets we do not know.
universe.exampleZh: 宇宙中充满了我们不知道的恒星和行星。

university.example: My sister studies math at a large university in the north.
university.exampleZh: 我姐姐在北方一所规模很大的大学里学习数学。

unless.example: You cannot go out unless you finish your homework first.
unless.exampleZh: 除非你先完成作业，否则你不能出去。

unlike.example: Unlike her sister, she enjoys quiet evenings at home.
unlike.exampleZh: 和她姐姐不同，她喜欢在家安静地度过夜晚。

unlikely.example: It is unlikely that he will come to the party tonight.
unlikely.exampleZh: 他今晚不太可能来参加聚会。

unload.example: The workers unloaded the heavy boxes from the truck and stacked them near the door.
unload.exampleZh: 工人们从卡车上卸下沉重的箱子，把它们堆在门边。

unlock.example: The police used a special key to unlock the old door.
unlock.exampleZh: 警察用一把特殊的钥匙打开了那扇旧门。

unpleasant.example: The weather was unpleasant, so we stayed at home all day.
unpleasant.exampleZh: 天气令人不快，所以我们整天都待在家里。

unpopular.example: This old rule is unpopular with most of the students in our school.
unpopular.exampleZh: 这条旧规定在我们学校大多数学生中不受欢迎。

unsatisfactory.example: The hotel room was dirty and the service was unsatisfactory.
unsatisfactory.exampleZh: 酒店房间很脏，服务也不能令人满意。

unstable.example: The old bridge is unstable and dangerous for cars to cross.
unstable.exampleZh: 这座旧桥不稳定，汽车通过很危险。

unsuccessful.example: His first attempt to fix the old car was unsuccessful, so he tried again.
unsuccessful.exampleZh: 他第一次修理那辆旧车的尝试不成功，所以他又试了一次。

unsuitable.example: This movie is unsuitable for young children because it is too scary.
unsuitable.exampleZh: 这部电影不适合小孩子看，因为它太吓人了。

until.example: We waited at the station until the last train arrived.
until.exampleZh: 我们在车站一直等到最后一班火车到达。

unusual.example: It is unusual for him to be late for work.
unusual.exampleZh: 他上班迟到是不寻常的。

unveil.example: The company will unveil its new phone at a big event next week.
unveil.exampleZh: 公司将在下周的一场大型活动上发布新手机。

unwilling.example: She was unwilling to lend her new bike to strangers.
unwilling.exampleZh: 她不愿意把新自行车借给陌生人。

up.example: I get up at seven and walk up the hill.
up.exampleZh: 我七点起床，然后走上那座小山。

up-to-date.example: Her phone is always up-to-date with the newest apps.
up-to-date.exampleZh: 她的手机总是装有最新的应用程序。

update.example: Please update your phone number in the system today.
update.exampleZh: 请今天在系统里更新你的电话号码。

upgrade.example: We plan to upgrade our old computers next month.
upgrade.exampleZh: 我们计划下个月升级我们的旧电脑。

uphold.example: The judge must uphold the law even when it is unpopular.
uphold.exampleZh: 即使法律不受欢迎，法官也必须维护法律。

upon.example: Upon arriving home, she put her bag on the table.
upon.exampleZh: 一到家，她就把包放在了桌子上。

upper.example: The books are on the upper shelf, so you need a chair.
upper.exampleZh: 那些书在上面的书架上，所以你需要一把椅子。

upright.example: Please keep your back upright while you sit at the desk.
upright.exampleZh: 坐在书桌前时，请保持背部挺直。

upset.example: The sad news made her very upset, so we stayed with her.
upset.exampleZh: 这个悲伤的消息让她非常难过，所以我们留下来陪她。

upstairs.example: My bedroom is upstairs, so I go up the stairs every night.
upstairs.exampleZh: 我的卧室在楼上，所以我每天晚上都要爬楼梯上去。

upward.example: The company's profits showed an upward trend last year.
upward.exampleZh: 公司去年的利润呈上升趋势。

urban.example: Many people move to urban areas to find better jobs and schools.
urban.exampleZh: 许多人搬到城市地区，为了找到更好的工作和学校。

urge.example: I urge you to see a doctor before the pain gets worse.
urge.exampleZh: 我敦促你在疼痛加重之前去看医生。

urgent.example: The doctor said this was an urgent case and needed help right away.
urgent.exampleZh: 医生说这是一个紧急病例，需要马上帮助。

use.example: We use this small room as a quiet study and a place to keep our books.
use.exampleZh: 我们把这个小房间用作安静的书房，也用来存放我们的书。

used.example: I am used to getting up early on cold winter mornings.
used.exampleZh: 我习惯了在寒冷的冬日早晨早起。

useful.example: This small dictionary is very useful for learning new English words.
useful.exampleZh: 这本小词典对学习新的英语单词非常有用。

usual.example: I took my usual seat by the window on the bus this morning.
usual.exampleZh: 今天早上我坐公交车时坐了我惯常的靠窗座位。

utility.example: The utility of this simple tool saves us a lot of time.
utility.exampleZh: 这个简单工具的实用性为我们节省了大量时间。

utilize.example: Farmers utilize new machines to grow more food on the same land.
utilize.exampleZh: 农民利用新机器在同一块土地上种出更多粮食。

utmost.example: She listened to the doctor with the utmost care and asked a few simple questions.
utmost.exampleZh: 她极其认真地听医生说话，并问了几个简单的问题。

utter.example: She was too angry to utter a single word in front of everyone.
utter.exampleZh: 她太生气了，在大家面前一句话也说不出来。

vacant.example: The old house on our street has been vacant for many years.
vacant.exampleZh: 我们街上的那座老房子已经空置很多年了。

vacation.example: We are going to the beach for our summer vacation next month.
vacation.exampleZh: 下个月我们要去海边过暑假。

vacuum.example: The vacuum in space is silent and very cold.
vacuum.exampleZh: 太空中的真空是寂静且非常寒冷的。

vague.example: His answer was vague, so nobody understood what he really meant.
vague.exampleZh: 他的回答很含糊，所以没人明白他真正的意思。

vain.example: All his efforts to fix the old car were in vain.
vain.exampleZh: 他修理那辆旧车的所有努力都是徒劳的。

valid.example: Your ticket is valid for one month after you buy it.
valid.exampleZh: 你的票在购买后一个月内有效。

valley.example: The small village lies in a green valley near the river.
valley.exampleZh: 这个小村庄位于河边一个绿色的山谷中。

valuable.example: This old watch is very valuable to my family.
valuable.exampleZh: 这块旧手表对我家来说非常珍贵。

value.example: Good books have great value for young people because they teach important lessons about life.
value.exampleZh: 好书对年轻人有很大的价值，因为它们教给人们关于人生的重要道理。

vanish.example: The magician made the rabbit vanish, and the children all cheered loudly.
vanish.exampleZh: 魔术师让兔子突然消失，孩子们都大声欢呼起来。

vapo(u)r.example: Steam is a kind of vapor that rises from hot water.
vapo(u)r.exampleZh: 蒸汽是一种从热水中升起的蒸气。

variable.example: The weather in this city is variable, so bring a jacket and an umbrella.
variable.exampleZh: 这座城市的天气多变，所以带上一件外套和一把伞。

variation.example: There is a slight variation in price between the two shops.
variation.exampleZh: 这两家店的价格略有不同。

variety.example: The store sells a wide variety of fresh fruits and vegetables.
variety.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

various.example: The store sells various fruits, such as apples, bananas, and oranges.
various.exampleZh: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果，比如苹果、香蕉和橙子。

vary.example: Room prices vary from season to season at this hotel.
vary.exampleZh: 这家酒店的房间价格随季节而变化。

vast.example: The vast desert stretches for miles under a hot, bright sun.
vast.exampleZh: 广阔的沙漠在炎热明亮的阳光下延伸数英里。

vegetable.example: My mother buys fresh vegetables at the market every Sunday morning.
vegetable.exampleZh: 我妈妈每个星期天早上都在市场买新鲜蔬菜。

vehicle.example: This vehicle is too old to drive on the highway.
vehicle.exampleZh: 这辆车太旧了，不能在高速公路上行驶。

venture.example: He started a small business venture in the city last year.
venture.exampleZh: 他去年在这座城市开始了一个小型商业冒险项目。

verb.example: Every sentence needs a verb to show what the subject does.
verb.exampleZh: 每个句子都需要一个动词来表明主语做了什么。

verbal.example: Her verbal instructions were easy to follow.
verbal.exampleZh: 她的口头指示很容易遵照执行。

verify.example: Please verify your address and phone number before you send the form.
verify.exampleZh: 寄出表格前，请核实你的地址和电话号码。

version.example: The new version of this app is easier to use.
version.exampleZh: 这个应用的新版本更容易使用。

versus.example: Tonight's game is the home team versus the visiting champions.
versus.exampleZh: 今晚的比赛是主队对客队冠军。

vertical.example: Draw a vertical line from the top of the page to the bottom.
vertical.exampleZh: 从页面顶部到底部画一条垂直线。

very.example: This is the very book I need for my class.
very.exampleZh: 这正是我上课需要的那本书。

vessel.example: A small vessel sailed slowly across the calm blue sea.
vessel.exampleZh: 一艘小船在平静的蓝色海面上缓缓航行。

veteran.example: My grandfather is a veteran who served in the army for many years.
veteran.exampleZh: 我的祖父是一位老兵，在军队服役了很多年。

via.example: We sent the letter via air mail and it arrived the next day.
via.exampleZh: 我们通过航空邮件寄出了这封信，第二天就到了。

vibrate.example: The phone began to vibrate on the table next to my bed.
vibrate.exampleZh: 手机在我床边的桌子上开始振动起来。

vice.example: His only vice is eating too much sweet food at night.
vice.exampleZh: 他唯一的坏习惯是晚上吃太多甜食。

victim.example: The victim of the accident was taken to hospital by a kind stranger.
victim.exampleZh: 事故的受害者被一位好心的陌生人送到了医院。

victory.example: The team worked hard all year and finally won a great victory.
victory.exampleZh: 这支队伍全年努力拼搏，最终赢得了一场伟大的胜利。

video.example: I watched a short video about making bread on my phone last night.
video.exampleZh: 昨晚我在手机上观看了一段关于制作面包的短片。

view.example: In my view, the view from the mountain is truly beautiful.
view.exampleZh: 在我看来，山上的风景真美。

viewpoint.example: From my viewpoint, this plan is simple and easy to follow.
viewpoint.exampleZh: 在我看来，这个计划简单易懂。

vigorous.example: My grandfather is still vigorous and walks in the park every morning.
vigorous.exampleZh: 我的祖父依然精力充沛，每天早上都去公园散步。

village.example: My grandparents live in a small village near the river.
village.exampleZh: 我的祖父母住在河边的一个小村庄里。

vinegar.example: My mother puts a little vinegar on the salad to give it more flavor.
vinegar.exampleZh: 我妈妈在沙拉里放一点醋，让它更有味道。

violate.example: Drivers who violate the speed limit must pay a fine.
violate.exampleZh: 违反限速规定的司机必须缴纳罚款。

violence.example: The film shows the violence of war and its effect on children.
violence.exampleZh: 这部电影展现了战争的暴力及其对儿童的影响。

violent.example: The violent storm broke trees and knocked down power lines all night.
violent.exampleZh: 这场猛烈的暴风雨折断树木，整夜刮倒了电线。

violet.example: She picked a small violet flower and put it in a glass of water.
violet.exampleZh: 她摘了一朵小小的紫色花，把它插进一杯水里。

violin.example: My sister plays the violin in the school music band every Friday.
violin.exampleZh: 我妹妹每周五在学校乐队里拉小提琴。

virtual.example: The students built a virtual city on their computers to learn about maps.
virtual.exampleZh: 学生们在电脑上建了一座虚拟城市来学习地图知识。

virtue.example: Honesty is a virtue that everyone should learn to value.
virtue.exampleZh: 诚实是一种每个人都应该学会珍视的美德。

virus.example: The virus made him sick, so he stayed home from school.
virus.exampleZh: 这种病毒使他生病，所以他待在家里没去上学。

visible.example: The mountains are clearly visible from our kitchen window.
visible.exampleZh: 从我们厨房的窗户可以清楚地看到那些山。

vision.example: Good vision helps us read and see the world clearly.
vision.exampleZh: 良好的视力帮助我们阅读并清晰地看世界。

visit.example: I visit my grandparents every weekend and we cook dinner together.
visit.exampleZh: 我每个周末都去看望祖父母，我们一起做晚饭。

visual.example: The visual test shows that his eyes are very healthy.
visual.exampleZh: 这项视力检查表明他的眼睛非常健康。

vital.example: Water is vital for life, so we must keep it clean.
vital.exampleZh: 水对生命至关重要，所以我们必须保持水的清洁。

vivid.example: Her story about the trip was so vivid that I felt I was there.
vivid.exampleZh: 她讲述的旅行故事非常生动，让我感觉身临其境。

vocabulary.example: Reading every day is a good way to build a larger vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 每天阅读是积累更大词汇量的好方法。

voice.example: She used her voice to share a clear opinion with the group.
voice.exampleZh: 她用自己的嗓音向小组表达了一个明确的意见。

volume.example: The volume of this box is too large for my small car.
volume.exampleZh: 这个箱子的体积对我的小车来说太大了。

voluntary.example: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter every weekend.
voluntary.exampleZh: 她每个周末在动物收容所做志愿工作。

volunteer.example: Many students volunteer to help at the animal shelter every weekend.
volunteer.exampleZh: 许多学生每个周末都自愿去动物收容所帮忙。

vote.example: Every citizen has the right to vote in the election.
vote.exampleZh: 每个公民都有权在选举中投票。

voyage.example: The ship began its long voyage across the sea early this morning.
voyage.exampleZh: 这艘船今天一早开始了它漫长的海上航行。

wage.example: The company agreed to raise the workers' wages last month.
wage.exampleZh: 公司上个月同意给工人们涨工资。

wander.example: We like to wander through the old streets on quiet Sunday mornings.
wander.exampleZh: 我们喜欢在安静的周日早晨漫步穿过那些老街。

want.example: I want a cup of tea after work.

war.example: The long war finally ended and people began to rebuild their homes.
war.exampleZh: 那场漫长的战争终于结束了，人们开始重建家园。

ward.example: The doctor walked into the ward to check on the sick children.
ward.exampleZh: 医生走进病房，查看生病的孩子们。

warm.example: The room was warm, so we opened the window and enjoyed the fresh air.
warm.exampleZh: 房间很温暖，所以我们打开窗户，享受新鲜空气。

warn.example: I want to warn you about the busy road near the school.
warn.exampleZh: 我想提醒你注意学校附近那条繁忙的马路。

wash.example: I wash my hands before every meal and my mother washes the dishes after dinner.
wash.exampleZh: 我每顿饭前都洗手，晚饭后妈妈洗盘子。

waste.example: Do not waste water when you wash the dishes.
waste.exampleZh: 洗盘子的时候不要浪费水。

watch.example: I like to watch the birds in the park near my house.
watch.exampleZh: 我喜欢在离家不远的公园里观看鸟儿。

water.example: The children water the flowers every morning before school.
water.exampleZh: 孩子们每天早上上学前给花浇水。

waterproof.example: This waterproof jacket keeps you dry in heavy rain.
waterproof.exampleZh: 这件防水夹克能让你在大雨中保持干爽。

wave.example: She gave me a friendly wave and smiled from across the street.
wave.exampleZh: 她在街对面友好地朝我挥了挥手，笑了笑。

way.example: Can you show me the way to the train station?
way.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去火车站的路吗？

we.example: We go to the park every Saturday morning with our dog.
we.exampleZh: 我们每周六早上都带狗去公园。

weak.example: He felt weak after the long walk in the hot sun.
weak.exampleZh: 在烈日下走了很长的路后，他感到很虚弱。

wealth.example: His wealth comes from years of hard work and good planning.
wealth.exampleZh: 他的财富来自多年的努力工作和周密的规划。

weapon.example: The police found a weapon hidden under the bed in his room.
weapon.exampleZh: 警方在他房间的床下发现了一件藏起来的武器。

wear.example: I wear a warm coat and gloves when the weather turns cold.
wear.exampleZh: 天气变冷时，我会穿上一件暖和的外套，戴上手套。

weary.example: After the long trip, the weary children fell asleep at once.
weary.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，疲倦的孩子们立刻就睡着了。

weather.example: The weather is cold and rainy, so we will stay inside today.
weather.exampleZh: 天气又冷又下雨，所以我们今天会待在家里。

weave.example: The old woman used wool to weave a warm winter coat.
weave.exampleZh: 老妇人用羊毛织了一件温暖的冬衣。

web.example: The spider made a web between two branches of the tree.
web.exampleZh: 蜘蛛在树的两根树枝之间结了一张网。

wedding.example: We went to my cousin's wedding last Saturday and had a great time.
wedding.exampleZh: 上周六我们去参加了表弟的婚礼，玩得很开心。

week.example: I have three English lessons this week.

weekday.example: I get up early on every weekday to catch the bus.
weekday.exampleZh: 每个工作日我都早起去赶公交车。

weekend.example: I usually visit my grandparents on the weekend.
weekend.exampleZh: 我通常在周末去看望我的祖父母。

weekly.example: Our weekly meeting is on Monday, and we also publish a weekly.
weekly.exampleZh: 我们的每周例会定在周一，我们还出版一份周刊。

weep.example: She began to weep when she heard the sad news.
weep.exampleZh: 听到那个悲伤的消息时，她开始哭泣。

weigh.example: Please weigh the box before you send it by mail.
weigh.exampleZh: 邮寄前请先称一下这个箱子的重量。

weight.example: The doctor says my weight is now normal for my height.
weight.exampleZh: 医生说以我的身高来看，我现在的体重是正常的。

welcome.example: They welcome all new students with a warm smile every morning.
welcome.exampleZh: 他们每天早上都用温暖的微笑欢迎所有新生。

welfare.example: The government should spend more money on the welfare of children.
welfare.exampleZh: 政府应该在儿童福利上投入更多资金。

well.example: She sings very well and she is also a kind person.
well.exampleZh: 她唱歌很好，而且她也是个善良的人。

well-known.example: This well-known writer has written many books for young children.
well-known.exampleZh: 这位著名的作家为幼儿写了很多书。

west.example: The sun goes down in the west every evening.
west.exampleZh: 太阳每天傍晚在西方落下。

western.example: Many people in Western countries celebrate Christmas with their families every year.
western.exampleZh: 许多西方国家的人每年都和家人们一起庆祝圣诞节。

wet.example: The wet grass made my shoes and socks very wet this morning.
wet.exampleZh: 今天早上湿漉漉的草地把我的鞋子和袜子都弄湿了。

whale.example: We saw a big whale jump out of the blue sea.
whale.exampleZh: 我们看到一头大鲸鱼从蓝色的大海中跃出。

what.example: What is the name of that small shop on the corner?
what.exampleZh: 街角那家小商店叫什么名字？

whatever.example: Whatever you choose from the menu is fine with me.
whatever.exampleZh: 你从菜单上选什么，我都可以。

wheat.example: My grandfather grows wheat on his small farm in the countryside.
wheat.exampleZh: 我祖父在乡下的小农场里种小麦。

wheel.example: The wheel of the old cart broke on the rough road.
wheel.exampleZh: 旧马车的轮子在崎岖的路上坏了。

when.example: When you get home, please call me and let me know.
when.exampleZh: 你到家的时候，请打电话告诉我一声。

whenever.example: Whenever I feel tired, I stop working and take a short walk outside.
whenever.exampleZh: 每当我感到疲倦时，我就会停下手头的事情，到外面走一小会儿。

where.example: This is the house where I grew up with my family.
where.exampleZh: 这就是我和家人一起长大的房子。

whereas.example: I like tea whereas my brother prefers coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 我喜欢茶，然而我弟弟更喜欢咖啡。

whether.example: I don't know whether he will come to the party tonight.
whether.exampleZh: 我不知道他今晚是否会来参加聚会。

which.example: Which book do you want to read before we leave the classroom today?
which.exampleZh: 今天离开教室前，你想读哪一本书？

whichever.example: You can take whichever of these two books you like best.
whichever.exampleZh: 这两本书中你最喜欢哪一本，就可以拿哪一本。

while.example: Please wait here for a while while I look for the key.
while.exampleZh: 请在这里等一会儿，我去找钥匙。

whip.example: The driver used a long whip to make the horses run faster.
whip.exampleZh: 车夫用一条长鞭子让马跑得更快。

whisper.example: She leaned over and whispered a secret into my ear.
whisper.exampleZh: 她俯过身来，在我耳边低声说了一个秘密。

whistle.example: The referee blew his whistle, and the players stopped running at once.
whistle.exampleZh: 裁判吹响了哨子，球员们立刻停止了跑动。

white.example: The white snow covers the whole field behind our old house.
white.exampleZh: 白雪覆盖了我们老房子后面的整片田野。

who.example: Who is the man standing next to your brother?
who.exampleZh: 站在你哥哥旁边的那个男人是谁？

whole.example: She spent the whole morning cleaning the kitchen and the living room.
whole.exampleZh: 她花了一整个上午打扫厨房和客厅。

whom.example: The teacher whom I met yesterday was very kind to us.
whom.exampleZh: 我昨天见到的那位老师对我们非常和蔼。

whose.example: I want to know whose bag is on the table.
whose.exampleZh: 我想知道桌子上是谁的包。

why.example: I don't know why she left the party so early.
why.exampleZh: 我不知道她为什么这么早就离开了聚会。

wide.example: The wide river runs through our city and many small boats sail on it.
wide.exampleZh: 这条宽阔的河穿过我们的城市，许多小船在河上航行。

widespread.example: The news spread fast and caused widespread fear among local people.
widespread.exampleZh: 消息传播得很快，引起了当地人的普遍恐慌。

widow.example: The old widow lives alone in a small house near the river.
widow.exampleZh: 那位老寡妇独自住在河边的一间小房子里。

width.example: The width of the table is one meter, so it fits the small room.
width.exampleZh: 这张桌子的宽度是一米，所以它适合这个小房间。

wife.example: My wife and I go to the park every Sunday.
wife.exampleZh: 我和妻子每个星期天都去公园。

wild.example: The wild horse ran across the open field.
wild.exampleZh: 那匹野马跑过开阔的田野。

will.example: She will help you with your work if you ask her.
will.exampleZh: 如果你开口，她会帮你做你的工作。

willing.example: I am willing to help you with your homework tonight.
willing.exampleZh: 我愿意今晚帮你做作业。

win.example: Our team hopes to win the game on Saturday and celebrate together.
win.exampleZh: 我们队希望周六赢下这场比赛，然后一起庆祝。

wind.example: The wind is strong today, so I will close the window.
wind.exampleZh: 今天风很大，所以我要关上窗户。

window.example: Please open the window because the room is very hot today.
window.exampleZh: 请打开窗户，因为今天房间里很热。

wine.example: My father likes to drink a glass of red wine with dinner.
wine.exampleZh: 我父亲喜欢晚饭时喝一杯红葡萄酒。

wing.example: The bird hurt one wing and could not fly for a few days.
wing.exampleZh: 那只鸟伤了一只翅膀，几天都飞不了。

winner.example: The winner of the race smiled and thanked all his friends.
winner.exampleZh: 比赛的获胜者微笑着感谢他所有的朋友。

winter.example: We often go skiing in winter when the snow is deep.
winter.exampleZh: 冬天雪厚的时候，我们经常去滑雪。

wipe.example: Please wipe the table with a clean cloth after dinner.
wipe.exampleZh: 晚饭后请用一块干净的布把桌子擦一下。

wire.example: The electrician used a thin wire to connect the lamp to the wall.
wire.exampleZh: 电工用一根细电线把灯连接到墙上。

wisdom.example: My grandmother has great wisdom about life and people.
wisdom.exampleZh: 我的祖母对生活和人情世故有着非凡的智慧。

wise.example: It is wise to save some money every month.
wise.exampleZh: 每个月存一些钱是明智的。

wish.example: I wish you good luck with your new job.
wish.exampleZh: 我祝你在新工作中好运。

wit.example: Her quick wit made everyone laugh during the long meeting.
wit.exampleZh: 在漫长的会议上，她敏捷的才思让每个人都笑了。

with.example: I went to the park with my sister and we played games.
with.exampleZh: 我和妹妹一起去了公园，我们玩了游戏。

withdraw.example: The army had to withdraw from the city before the heavy rain started.
withdraw.exampleZh: 大雨开始前，军队不得不从这座城市撤退。

within.example: Please finish the report within three days so we can review it together.
within.exampleZh: 请在三天内完成这份报告，这样我们可以一起审阅。

without.example: I cannot finish this work without your help today.
without.exampleZh: 没有你今天的帮助，我无法完成这项工作。

withstand.example: This bridge can withstand strong winds and heavy rain.
withstand.exampleZh: 这座桥能经受住强风和暴雨。

witness.example: She was the only witness to the accident on the quiet street.
witness.exampleZh: 她是那条安静街道上那起事故的唯一目击者。

wolf.example: The wolf ran quickly through the cold forest to find its family.
wolf.exampleZh: 那只狼飞快地穿过寒冷的森林去寻找它的家人。

woman.example: The woman next door often helps my mother with the shopping.
woman.exampleZh: 隔壁的那位妇女经常帮我妈妈买东西。

wonder.example: I wonder where my keys are, and I am surprised by this small miracle.
wonder.exampleZh: 我想知道我的钥匙在哪里，我也对这个小小的奇迹感到惊讶。

wonderful.example: We had a wonderful time at the beach with our friends yesterday.
wonderful.exampleZh: 昨天我们和朋友们在海滩上度过了一段美好的时光。

wood.example: The table is made of wood, and it looks very old.
wood.exampleZh: 这张桌子是木头做的，看起来很旧。

wooden.example: The old man sat on a wooden chair and looked out the window.
wooden.exampleZh: 老人坐在一把木椅上，望着窗外。

wool.example: This warm sweater is made of soft wool from sheep.
wool.exampleZh: 这件暖和的毛衣是由绵羊身上柔软的羊毛制成的。

word.example: She did not say a word about the plan.
word.exampleZh: 关于这个计划，她一句话也没说。

work.example: I work in a small office near my home every day.
work.exampleZh: 我每天在我家附近的一间小办公室里工作。

worker.example: The worker starts his job early every morning.
worker.exampleZh: 这名工人每天早上很早就开始工作。

workshop.example: Our teacher held a small workshop to help us improve our writing skills.
workshop.exampleZh: 我们老师举办了一个小型研讨会，帮助我们提高写作能力。

world.example: She wants to travel around the world after she finishes school.
world.exampleZh: 她想在毕业之后环游世界。

worldwide.example: The band has fans worldwide and plays concerts in many countries.
worldwide.exampleZh: 这支乐队在世界各地都有粉丝，并在许多国家举办演唱会。

worm.example: A small worm crawled across the wet ground after the rain.
worm.exampleZh: 雨后一条小虫爬过潮湿的地面。

worry.example: My parents always worry about me when I travel far from home.
worry.exampleZh: 当我远行时，父母总是为我担心。

worse.example: The weather is worse today than it was yesterday morning.
worse.exampleZh: 今天的天气比昨天早上更糟。

worship.example: Many people worship in this small church every Sunday morning.
worship.exampleZh: 许多人每个星期天早上都在这座小教堂里做礼拜。

worst.example: This is the worst movie I have ever seen in my life.
worst.exampleZh: 这是我一生中看过的最差的电影。

worth.example: This old book is worth reading because it teaches us a lot.
worth.exampleZh: 这本旧书值得一读，因为它教给我们很多东西。

worthwhile.example: It is worthwhile to spend more time with your family every day.
worthwhile.exampleZh: 每天都多花些时间陪伴家人是值得的。

worthy.example: She is a worthy teacher who always helps her students with patience.
worthy.exampleZh: 她是一位值得尊敬的好老师，总是耐心地帮助学生。

would.example: I would help you if I had more free time today.
would.exampleZh: 如果我今天有更多空闲时间，我会帮你的。

wound.example: The doctor cleaned the wound and put a clean bandage on it.
wound.exampleZh: 医生清洗了伤口，并在上面敷上了干净的绷带。

wrap.example: She will wrap the gift in colorful paper before the party.
wrap.exampleZh: 她会在聚会前用彩色纸把礼物包起来。

wreck.example: The storm wrecked our small boat, and we were lucky to get home.
wreck.exampleZh: 暴风雨毁坏了我们的小船，我们能回到家真是幸运。

wrestle.example: He had to wrestle with a difficult problem at work today.
wrestle.exampleZh: 他今天不得不努力解决工作中一个棘手的问题。

wretched.example: The wretched old man had no home and no one to help him.
wretched.exampleZh: 那个可怜的老人没有家，也没有人帮助他。

write.example: I write a short letter to my friend every week.
write.exampleZh: 我每周都给朋友写一封简短的信。

writer.example: The writer spends every morning working on a new story for children.
writer.exampleZh: 这位作家每天早上都在写一个新的儿童故事。

writing.example: Her writing has become much clearer since she started reading more books.
writing.exampleZh: 自从她开始读更多的书，她的写作变得清晰多了。

wrong.example: It is wrong to tell a lie to your best friend.
wrong.exampleZh: 对你最好的朋友说谎是不道德的。

x-ray.example: The doctor used an x-ray to see the bone in my arm.
x-ray.exampleZh: 医生用X光检查了我手臂里的骨头。

xerox.example: Please xerox these three pages before the meeting starts.
xerox.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前复印这三页。

yard.example: Our dog likes to run around the yard after dinner.
yard.exampleZh: 晚饭后我们的狗喜欢在院子里跑来跑去。

yardstick.example: Test scores are not the only yardstick for a good student.
yardstick.exampleZh: 考试分数并不是衡量好学生的唯一标准。

yawn.example: The long meeting made everyone yawn and stretch in their chairs.
yawn.exampleZh: 漫长的会议让每个人都在椅子上打哈欠、伸懒腰。

year.example: She will study in Japan for one year.

yearly.example: The company holds a yearly meeting for all its workers.
yearly.exampleZh: 公司为全体员工举行一年一度的会议。

yearn.example: After a year away from home, I yearn to see my family again.
yearn.exampleZh: 离家一年后，我渴望再次见到家人。

yell.example: When the boy saw the big snake, he began to yell for help.
yell.exampleZh: 男孩看到那条大蛇时，开始大声呼救。

yellow.example: The leaves on the tree turn yellow in autumn.

yes.example: Yes, I can help you with your homework tonight.
yes.exampleZh: 是的，我今晚可以帮你做作业。

yesterday.example: I saw your brother at the bus station yesterday afternoon.
yesterday.exampleZh: 我昨天下午在汽车站看到了你哥哥。

yet.example: She has not finished her homework yet, yet she wants to watch TV.
yet.exampleZh: 她还没有做完作业，然而她想看电视。

yield.example: The farm yields enough corn for the whole village every year.
yield.exampleZh: 这个农场每年出产的玉米足够全村人吃。

yoke.example: The heavy yoke of debt kept the poor farmer from sleeping well.
yoke.exampleZh: 沉重的债务枷锁让这个贫穷的农民睡不好觉。

you.example: You can ask me for help at any time.
you.exampleZh: 你随时都可以找我帮忙。

young.example: The young teacher helps her students read English books every day.
young.exampleZh: 这位年轻的老师每天帮助她的学生读英语书。

youngster.example: The youngsters in our village play football every afternoon after school.
youngster.exampleZh: 我们村里的年轻人每天下午放学后都踢足球。

your.example: Please put your books on the table before you leave.
your.exampleZh: 离开前请把你的书放在桌子上。

yourself.example: You should be proud of yourself for finishing the work today.
yourself.exampleZh: 你今天完成了这项工作，应该为你自己感到骄傲。

youth.example: She spent her youth in a small village near the sea.
youth.exampleZh: 她的青年时期是在海边的一个小村庄里度过的。

zebra.example: The zebra has black and white stripes on its body.
zebra.exampleZh: 这只斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

zero.example: The temperature fell below zero again last night, so the roads are icy.
zero.exampleZh: 昨晚气温又降到零度以下，所以路面结冰了。

zigzag.example: The narrow path went in a zigzag up the hill.
zigzag.exampleZh: 这条狭窄的小路呈之字形向山上延伸。

zinc.example: Zinc is a metal that helps keep our body healthy.
zinc.exampleZh: 锌是一种有助于保持身体健康的金属。

zip.example: Please zip up your jacket before we go outside in the cold wind.
zip.exampleZh: 在我们出门吹冷风之前，请把你的夹克拉上拉链。

zone.example: This zone is for children and their parents only.
zone.exampleZh: 这个区域只供儿童及其家长使用。

zoo.example: We took the children to the zoo to see the elephants and monkeys.
zoo.exampleZh: 我们带孩子们去动物园看大象和猴子。

zoom.example: Prices zoomed quickly after the good news.
zoom.exampleZh: 好消息传出后，价格迅速飙升。
